*Alpar Turkoglu,Muralikrishnna G. Sethuraman,Faramarz Fekri*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了SCOUT框架，解决了现有因果发现算法依赖无环、高斯噪声和已知干预目标的局限性，能够从软干预数据中学习非线性循环因果关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的因果发现算法通常依赖于三个严格的假设：系统是无环的、外生噪声变量服从高斯分布、以及干预目标是已知的。然而，现实生活中的系统往往违反这些假设。现有的解决方法大多局限于线性模型或有限的干预设置，缺乏一种能同时处理非线性、循环因果关系且干预目标未知的方法。

Method: 提出了SCOUT（Soft interventional Causal discovery with Unknown Targets）框架。该方法通过最大化数据对数似然来恢复图结构，并采用了两种归一化流架构：收缩残差流（contractive residual flows）和神经样条流（neural spline flows），以处理非线性循环因果关系的建模问题。

Result: 在合成数据和真实世界数据上的实验表明，SCOUT在多种干预和噪声设置下，其因果图恢复和未知目标恢复的性能均优于现有的最先进方法。

Conclusion: SCOUT为解决现实世界复杂的因果发现问题提供了一种有效的工具，放宽了传统方法对无环性、高斯噪声和已知干预目标的依赖，显著提升了因果发现和干预目标识别的准确性。

Abstract: Learning causal relationships between variables from data is a fundamental research area with many applications across disciplines. Most existing causal discovery algorithms rely on the assumptions that (i) the underlying system is acyclic, (ii) the exogenous noise variables are Gaussian, and (iii) the intervention targets for the data-generating experiments are known. While these assumptions simplify the analysis, they are violated in real-life systems. Most existing methods that address these issues either assume the underlying model is linear or are constrained to operate in limited interventional settings. To that end, we propose SCOUT, a novel causal discovery framework for learning nonlinear cyclic causal relationships from soft interventional data with unknown targets. Our approach maximizes the data log-likelihood to recover the graph structure, using two normalizing-flow architectures: contractive residual flows and neural spline flows. Through experiments on synthetic and real-world data, we show that SCOUT outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both causal graph recovery and unknown target recovery across various interventional and noise settings.

</details>


### [80] [Does Weight Decay Enhance Training Stability?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16622)
*Marius Saether,Amir Kolic,Tomaso Poggio,Pierfrancesco Beneventano*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究深入分析了权重衰减（weight decay）在现代深度学习训练动力学中的作用机制。研究发现，权重衰减能够有效减缓“渐进锐化”（progressive sharpening），并且在CNN和MLP中展现出不同的行为模式：在CNN中抑制振荡，在MLP中引发相变使锐度稳定在理论边界之下。研究建立了数学框架，揭示了参数向量与锐度梯度的全局对齐是相变的驱动机制，并指出基于凸/二次启发式的曲率阈值作为稳定性诊断可能不可靠。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在现代深度学习实践中，权重衰减常被认为具有“稳定”训练动力学的作用，这与其作为静态正则化惩罚的经典角色有所不同。然而，一个基本问题尚未得到解答：权重衰减是否真的稳定训练动力学？如果是，通过什么机制实现？训练稳定性在文献中有不同但相关的定义，需要系统性地分析权重衰减对参数空间动力学和损失锐度的影响。

Method: 研究者通过分析权重衰减在“稳定性边缘”（Edge of Stability, EoS）的效应，研究了其对参数空间动力学和损失锐度的影响。具体方法包括：1) 分析权重衰减对渐进锐化的影响；2) 对比CNN和MLP两种架构下的不同表现；3) 建立数学框架来建模观察到的现象；4) 识别参数向量与锐度梯度的全局对齐作为相变的机制驱动；5) 验证这些现象在函数空间（NTK）搜索中的稳定性意义。

Result: 主要发现包括：1) 权重衰减稳健地减缓渐进锐化过程；2) 发现了一个引人注目的架构依赖的相变现象：在CNN中，权重衰减抑制EoS处的振荡；在MLP中，增加权重衰减导致相变，使锐度稳定在显著低于理论边界$\frac{2}{η}$的阈值；3) 建立的数学框架能够准确建模这些现象；4) 识别出参数向量与锐度梯度的全局对齐是相变的机制驱动因素；5) 验证了这些现象在函数空间（NTK）搜索中转化为稳定性；6) 证明了基于凸/二次启发式获得的曲率阈值在正则化下可能不是可靠的稳定性诊断指标。

Conclusion: 本研究证实了权重衰减确实通过特定机制稳定训练动力学，具体体现为减缓渐进锐化和在不同架构中产生不同的稳定化效应。研究建立的数学框架成功解释了CNN和MLP中的不同行为模式，并揭示了参数向量与锐度梯度全局对齐的关键作用。这一发现不仅深化了对权重衰减机制的理解，还挑战了传统基于凸/二次启发式的曲率阈值作为稳定性诊断的可靠性，为理解和设计更稳定的训练算法提供了重要洞察。

Abstract: In modern deep learning, weight decay is often credited with "stabilizing" training dynamics, diverging from its classical role as a static regularization penalty. We investigate a fundamental question: *does weight decay stabilize training dynamics, and if so, through which mechanism?* Indeed, training stability is understood through different but related notions in the literature. We consider how weight decay affects the parameter-space dynamics and loss sharpness by analyzing its effects at the \emph{Edge of Stability} (EoS). We show that weight decay robustly slows *progressive sharpening}. Furthermore, we uncover a striking architecture-dependent phase transition. In CNNs, weight decay dampens the oscillations at the EoS, while in MLPs, increasing weight decay causes a phase transition in which the sharpness stabilizes at a threshold significantly below the theoretical $\frac{2}η$ boundary. We develop a mathematical framework that accurately models these phenomena and identify the global alignment of the parameter vector and the sharpness gradient as the mechanistic driver of the phase transition. Importantly, we show that these phenomena translate into stability in terms of search in function-space (NTK). Last, this shows that curvature thresholds obtained from convex/quadratic heuristics may not be reliable stability diagnostics under regularization.

</details>


### [81] [Learning How to Cube](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16632)
*Ferhat Erata,Sam Kouteili,Thanos Typaldos,Timos Antonopoulos,Robert B. Jones,Byron Cook,Ruzica Piskac*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种神经符号后训练框架，使4B参数的Transformer模型能够学习有效的Cube-and-Conquer分割启发式策略，在SAT竞赛基准测试中达到53的pass@5分数，匹配最佳符号启发式方法并超越Claude-Sonnet-4。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管Cube-and-Conquer (C&C)方法在解决具有挑战性的布尔可满足性(SAT)问题上很有效，但先前的工作尚未证明基于Transformer的模型能够学习有效的分割启发式策略。SAT求解领域传统上由符号方法主导，研究动机在于探索Transformer模型是否能在此领域学习并执行有效的分割决策。

Method: 提出了一种神经符号后训练框架：1) 设计基于MCTS的数据整理流程，使用符号启发式方法探索SAT竞赛公式的分割决策，生成基于求解器统计数据的偏好数据，并用教师模型的推理轨迹进行增强；2) 采用两阶段后训练方法：先进行监督微调(SFT)，再进行直接偏好优化(DPO)。

Result: 4B参数模型在100个SAT竞赛基准测试中达到53的pass@5分数，超越Claude-Sonnet-4(50分)并匹配最佳符号启发式方法(53分)。消融实验表明：单独SFT将pass@5从46提升至51，DPO额外增加2个基准测试；熵/一致性消融显示SFT（而非DPO）决定了根级决策多样性，从而产生对确定性符号方法的互补覆盖。

Conclusion: 证明了Transformer模型可以被训练来在传统上由符号方法主导的领域中做出有效的分割决策，为神经符号方法的结合提供了新的可能性，展示了深度学习模型在组合优化问题求解中的潜力。

Abstract: Despite the effectiveness of Cube-and-Conquer (C&C) for solving challenging Boolean Satisfiability (SAT) problems, no prior work has shown that transformer-based models can learn effective cubing heuristics. We introduce a neuro-symbolic post-training framework for this task. We design an MCTS-based data curation pipeline that uses symbolic heuristics to explore splitting decisions over SAT competition formulas, producing preference data grounded in solver statistics and augmented with reasoning traces from a teacher model. Our two-stage post-training, supervised fine-tuning (SFT) followed by direct preference optimization (DPO), enables a 4B-parameter model to achieve a pass@5 score of 53 on 100 SAT competition benchmarks, surpassing frontier LLMs such as Claude-Sonnet-4 (50) and matching the best symbolic heuristic (53). Ablations show that SFT alone improves pass@5 from 46 to 51, with DPO adding 2 additional benchmarks; an entropy/agreement ablation on realized first-cube decisions further shows that SFT, not DPO, accounts for the root-level decision diversity that produces complementary per-run coverage over deterministic symbolic methods. This demonstrates that transformers can be trained to make effective cubing decisions in a domain traditionally dominated by symbolic methods.

</details>


### [82] [MedMIX: Modality-Internal Expert Fusion for Multimodal Medical Diagnosis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16639)
*Seungik Cho,Anqi Li,Wei Qiu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MedMIX框架通过整合模态内专家融合、模态间学习融合和大小模型协作，解决了多模态临床预测中多基础模型、模态缺失和样本特异性贡献变化三大挑战，在三个基准数据集上实现了在模态不完整情况下的鲁棒预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态临床预测面临三个核心挑战：1) 每种模态存在多个具有互补优势的基础模型(FMs)；2) 训练和测试阶段普遍存在模态缺失问题；3) 不同样本的模态贡献存在特异性差异。现有方法难以同时处理这些问题，需要一个新的统一框架。

Method: MedMIX框架包含三个核心组件：1) 模态内专家融合：聚合来自多个小型专家模型的互补嵌入表示；2) 模态间学习融合：对可用模态执行学习型融合；3) 训练阶段大小模型协作：利用大型教师模型改进部署的表示，在推理时无需额外计算成本。这种设计实现了模态内专家协作、样本特异性跨模态融合和高效的大小模型协作的统一。

Result: 在三个异构基准数据集(OpenI、MIMIC-IV-MM、MMIST-ccRCC)上，MedMIX实现了持续强劲的性能，在受控的模态缺失扰动下保持鲁棒性。在MIMIC-III上的跨队列迁移实验中，进一步验证了模型的持续鲁棒性。

Conclusion: MedMIX是一个实用的多模态临床预测框架，成功统一了模态内专家协作、样本特异性跨模态融合和高效的大小模型协作，同时保持了对不完整模态的鲁棒性，为临床环境中的多模态预测提供了有效解决方案。

Abstract: Multimodal clinical prediction faces three challenges: multiple foundation models (FMs) with complementary strengths per modality, pervasive missing modalities at training and test time, and sample-specific variation in modality contributions. We introduce MedMIX, a multimodal framework that combines intra-modality expert fusion, learned inter-modality fusion, and training-only large--small model collaboration for robust medical prediction under incomplete modalities. Within each modality, MedMIX aggregates complementary embeddings from multiple small expert models; across modalities, it performs learned fusion over available modalities; and during training, it leverages large teacher models to improve deployed representations without additional inference cost. Across three heterogeneous benchmarks (OpenI, MIMIC-IV-MM, and MMIST-ccRCC), MedMIX achieves consistently strong performance while remaining robust under controlled missing-modality perturbations, and further demonstrates sustained robustness under cross-cohort shift on MIMIC-III. These results highlight MedMIX as a practical framework that unifies within-modality expert collaboration, sample-specific cross-modality fusion, and efficient large--small model collaboration while remaining robust to incomplete modalities.

</details>


### [83] [Provably Shorter Scratchpads in Hybrid DeltaNet-Attention Decoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16640)
*Tomasz Steifer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 混合循环-注意力解码器（如Qwen3-Next）相比纯架构具有显著优势：能以常数级草稿本解决奇偶条件检索任务，而纯Gated DeltaNet无法解决，纯Gated Attention需要多项式级草稿本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期开源语言模型（如Qwen3-Next）采用了混合循环-注意力解码器架构，结合了门控注意力头和循环门控DeltaNet头。作者旨在从形式化角度探究这种混合架构在模型表达力或效率方面是否存在理论优势。

Method: 定义了一个奇偶条件检索任务作为测试基准，在常数精度假设下，对比分析三种架构：（1）Qwen风格的Gated DeltaNet与Gated Attention混合架构，（2）纯Gated DeltaNet模型，（3）纯Gated Attention模型，研究它们解决该任务所需的草稿本规模或思维链步数。

Result: 混合架构能够使用常数大小的草稿本（等价于O(1)步思维链）解决奇偶条件检索任务；纯Gated DeltaNet模型无法解决该任务；纯Gated Attention模型至少需要多项式大小的草稿本才能解决。

Conclusion: 从理论层面证明了混合循环-注意力解码器架构相比纯架构具有形式化的表达力优势，为Qwen等模型采用的混合设计提供了理论依据。

Abstract: We investigate the expressive power of hybrid recurrent-attention decoders, a class of architectures used in recent open-source language models such as Qwen3-Next and its successors. These models combine Gated Attention heads with recurrent Gated DeltaNet heads. Is there a formal advantage, in terms of model expressivity or efficiency, to such a hybrid architecture? We show that there is. We define parity-conditioned retrieval task and show that under constant-precision assumption, a Qwen-style hybrid of Gated DeltaNet and Gated Attention solves this task with a constant scratchpad, or equivalently $O(1)$ chain-of-thought steps. In contrast, no similar solution exists for pure Gated DeltaNet models, while pure Gated Attention requires at least a polynomial scratchpad.

</details>


### [84] [In-context learning enables continental-scale subsurface temperature prediction from sparse local observations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16665)
*Daniel O'Malley,Christopher W. Johnson,Javier E. Santos,Pablo Lara,Sandro Malusà,Bharat Srikishan,John Kath,Arnab Mazumder,Mohamed Mehana,David Coblentz,Nathan DeBardeleben,Earl Lawrence,Hari Viswanathan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了In-Context Earth，一个基于Transformer的模型，利用稀疏钻孔观测作为地质背景来预测连续的地温场，在美国本土实现了4.7°C的平均绝对误差，且无需微调即可适应其他地质区域。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 由于钻孔测量成本高且稀疏，大陆尺度的地下温度知识受限，而这对地热资源评估和地壳浅层热传输理解至关重要。传统插值方法会平滑掉尖锐的热异常，物理模型也难以捕捉这些特征，因此需要一种能够利用稀疏观测进行准确预测的方法。

Method: 提出了In-Context Earth模型，这是一个基于Transformer的模型，使用稀疏的局部钻孔观测作为地质背景来预测连续的深度温度场，并提供校准的不确定性估计。模型采用上下文学习方法，无需密集测量或区域特定重新训练即可进行大陆尺度地下特征描述。

Result: 在美国本土，模型实现了4.7°C的平均绝对误差，优于斯坦福热模型、AlphaEarth嵌入模型、Transparent Earth多模态模型和通用克里金方法，同时能够解析地热省中更尖锐的热梯度。不确定性估计校准良好，KS统计量为2.5%。无需微调，仅使用20个局部观测即可适应阿尔伯塔、澳大利亚和英国，MAE分别为2.2°C、6.2°C和5.4°C。可解释性分析表明模型学习了从未观察到的地下属性（如地震波速、地球化学和地壳结构）的内部表示，并以物理一致的方式使用这些表示。

Conclusion: 这项工作表明上下文学习可以利用稀疏钻孔观测进行大陆尺度地下特征描述，无需密集测量或区域特定重新训练，为地热资源评估和地壳热传输理解提供了新的有效方法。

Abstract: Continental-scale knowledge of subsurface temperature is limited by the cost and sparsity of borehole measurements, but such information is essential for geothermal resource assessment and for understanding heat transport in the shallow crust. The thermal field reflects the interaction between lithology, crustal structure, radiogenic heat production, and advective fluid flow, sometimes producing sharp anomalies that are smoothed by conventional interpolation or difficult to capture with physical models. Here we introduce In-Context Earth, a transformer-based model that uses sparse local borehole observations as geological context to predict continuous temperature-at-depth fields with calibrated uncertainty. In the contiguous United States, the model achieves a mean absolute error of 4.7 °C, outperforming the physics-informed Stanford Thermal Model, a model based on AlphaEarth embeddings, the multimodal Transparent Earth model, and universal kriging, while resolving sharper thermal gradients in geothermal provinces. Its uncertainty estimates are well calibrated, with a Kolmogorov-Smirnov statistic of 2.5%. Without finetuning, the model adapts to Alberta, Australia, and the United Kingdom (UK) using only 20 local observations at inference time, maintaining high accuracy in geologically distinct test regions with a mean absolute error of 2.2 °C in Alberta, 6.2 °C in Australia, and 5.4 °C in the UK. Interpretability analyses show that the model learns internal representations of subsurface properties it never observes during training, including seismic velocities, geochemistry, and crustal structure, and uses these representations in physically consistent ways. More broadly, this work shows that in-context learning can use sparse borehole observations for continental-scale subsurface characterization, without requiring dense measurements or region-specific retraining.

</details>


### [85] [GraViti: Graph-Level Variational Autoencoders with Relaxed Permutation Invariance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16668)
*Roman Bresson,Konstantinos Divriotis,Johannes F. Lutzeyer,Iakovos Evdaimon,Michalis Vazirgiannis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了GraViti，一种基于Transformer的图级变分自编码器，能够将整个图映射为紧凑的潜在向量，在分子基准测试中实现了最先进的重建精度和良好的生成性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的节点级嵌入方法存在局限性，无法支持平滑插值和属性引导搜索等下游任务；且在存在可靠规范节点排序的领域（如分子或贝叶斯网络）中，强制置换不变性反而可能对一致性重建产生不利影响。

Method: 提出了基于Transformer的图级变分自编码器GraViti，将整个图映射到紧凑的潜在向量空间，设计单步解码过程作为复杂生成流程的轻量级替代方案。

Result: 在分子基准测试中，GraViti学习解码出符合训练数据中化学约束的有效样本；在大规模数据集上实现了最先进的重建精度；具有良好的生成性能。

Conclusion: GraViti成功构建了真正的图级潜在空间，支持平滑插值和属性引导搜索等下游任务，能够从图级表示中直接恢复领域规则，为图生成任务提供了高效且实用的解决方案。

Abstract: We introduce GraViti, a transformer-based graph-level variational autoencoder that maps entire graphs to compact latent vectors. This design produces a true graph-level latent space that supports smooth interpolation, property-guided search, and other downstream tasks beyond the constraints of node-level embeddings. On molecular benchmarks, GraViti learns to decode valid samples that follow the chemical constraints present in the training data, showing that the model recovers domain rules directly from graph-level representations. We also show that, in domains where a reliable canonical node ordering exists such as molecules or bayesian networks, enforcing permutation invariance can prove detrimental for consistent reconstruction. GraViti achieves state-of-the-art reconstruction accuracy on large datasets, and provides solid generative performance. Its single-step decoding offers a lightweight alternative to more complex generation pipelines while maintaining practical sample quality.

</details>


### [86] [Identify Then Project: Contrastive Learning of Latent Dynamics from Partial Observations with Port-Hamiltonian Structure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16682)
*Peilun Li,Kaiyuan Tan,Daniel Moyer,Thomas Beckers*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种两阶段的“识别-投影”框架，用于从部分观测中学习潜在端口哈密顿系统。该方法首先利用对比学习识别潜在动力学，然后将其投影到端口哈密顿流形上，以实现物理一致性，表现优于单阶段联合学习方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在部分观测和高维观测场景下，直接在观测空间建模不可行，因此需要识别潜在状态表示和动力学。在此背景下，表示学习与物理感知建模本质上是耦合的，特别是对于包含保守和耗散动力学的潜在端口哈密顿系统，如何保证学习到的模型具有物理一致性是一个关键问题。

Method: 提出了一个两阶段的“识别-投影”框架。第一阶段，利用对比教师模型从部分观测中学习连续时间潜在动力学；第二阶段，学生模型通过学习到的仿射图表，将识别出的教师表示和动力学投影到端口哈密顿子流形上，从而获得物理一致的实现。此外，作为对比，还研究了单阶段联合学习方法。

Result: 理论分析表明，仿射投影是连接对比潜在识别的仿射规范和端口哈密顿系统的自然桥梁。实验结果表明，所提出的两阶段方法在保持教师模型动力学的同时成功施加了物理结构，且比单阶段替代方案更可靠，特别是在耗散机制和高维视觉设置中表现更优。

Conclusion: 两阶段的教师-学生框架能够有效地在潜在空间中识别动力学并施加端口哈密顿结构，解决了表示学习与物理建模耦合的问题，在物理一致性和可靠性方面优于单阶段方法。

Abstract: Identifying latent state representations and dynamics is essential when direct modeling in observation space is infeasible, particularly under partial and high-dimensional observations. In such settings, representation learning and physics-aware modeling are inherently coupled. We study this problem for latent port-Hamiltonian systems, a structured class encompassing both conservative and dissipative dynamics. We propose a two-stage identify-then-project framework. First, a contrastive teacher learns continuous-time latent dynamics from partial observations. Then, a student projects the identified teacher representation and dynamics onto a port-Hamiltonian submanifold via a learned affine chart, yielding a physically consistent realization. As a conceptual counterfactual, we also consider a single-stage variant that jointly learns latent identification and port-Hamiltonian structure, but find it to be less reliable, motivating the proposed two-stage teacher-student framework. We show theoretically that affine projection is the natural bridge between the affine gauge of contrastive latent identification and the port-Hamiltonian systems. Empirically, we demonstrate that the proposed two-stage approach preserves the teacher's dynamics while enforcing physical structure, and performs more reliably than the single-stage alternative, particularly in dissipative regimes and high-dimensional visual settings.

</details>


### [87] [Scalable Knowledge Editing for Mixture-of-Experts LLMs via Tensor-Structured Updates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16686)
*Roman Maksimov,Vladimir Aletov,Dmitry Bylinkin,Daniil Medyakov,Vladimir Solodkin,Aleksandr Beznosikov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个针对混合专家（MoE）架构大语言模型的知识编辑框架，通过利用Woodbury矩阵恒等式实现了高效、高质量的模型编辑，编辑速度相比基线提升高达6倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的知识编辑方法主要针对稠密前馈层设计，然而现代大语言模型越来越多地采用混合专家（MoE）架构以获得更好的内存占用和推理效率。这种不匹配导致当前一类日益增长的生产模型缺乏原理性的编辑工具，亟需开发适用于MoE架构的知识编辑方法。

Method: 提出一个类MEMIT框架用于MoE架构LLM的知识编辑。该方法利用MoE层的张量结构，在单个专家层面忠实构建编辑目标，并应用Woodbury矩阵恒等式避免对完整的专家权重堆叠矩阵进行具体化或求逆运算。最终更新归结为固定低秩矩阵的求逆，且无需额外的反向传播过程。

Result: 实验表明，该方法在主要知识编辑指标上匹配强力基线的编辑质量，同时由于批处理MEMIT形式化和Woodbury恒等式带来的低维求逆特性，编辑过程加速高达6倍。

Conclusion: 研究表明，闭式、参数修改的知识编辑方法可以高效地扩展到稠密层之外的架构，为现代稀疏大语言模型架构中的可扩展知识编辑开辟了新路径。

Abstract: Knowledge editing (KE) provides a lightweight alternative to repeated fine-tuning of LLMs. However, most existing KE methods target dense feed-forward layers, while modern LLMs increasingly adopt Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures for their superior memory footprint and inference efficiency. This mismatch leaves a growing class of production models without principled editing tools. We propose a MEMIT-like framework for knowledge editing in MoE-based LLMs. Our method exploits the tensor structure of MoE layers to formulate the editing objective faithfully at the per expert level, and applies the Woodbury matrix identity to avoid materializing or inverting the full stacked matrix of expert weights. The resulting update reduces to inversions of fixed low-rank matrices and requires no additional backward passes. Empirically, our approach matches the editing quality of strong baselines on the main KE metrics while accelerating the editing procedure by up to 6x, owing to the batched MEMIT-style formulation and the low-dimensional inversions enabled by the Woodbury identity. These results show that closed-form, parameter-modifying KE can be extended efficiently beyond dense layers, opening a path toward scalable knowledge editing in modern sparse LLM architectures.

</details>


### [88] [UB-SMoE: Universally Balanced Sparse Mixture-of-Experts for Resource-adaptive Federated Fine-tuning of Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16690)
*Van-Tuan Tran,Hong-Hanh Nguyen-Le,Marco Ruffini,Merim Dzaferagic*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出UB-SMoE框架，通过动态调制路由和通用伪梯度技术，解决了联邦学习中异构资源环境下SMoE存在的专家利用率失衡和路由不可微问题，在低资源客户端实现了45%的计算削减和性能显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的异构LoRA-rank方法仅能带来边际计算节省，而稀疏混合专家（SMoE）在异构联邦环境中的直接应用会引入专家利用率失衡和Top-K路由不可微这两个关键不一致性，导致收敛性下降，特别是对于资源受限的客户端。

Method: 提出通用均衡稀疏混合专家（UB-SMoE）框架，包含两大核心机制：（1）动态调制路由（DMR）用于重新平衡专家利用率；（2）通用伪梯度（PG）用于为非激活专家重构学习信号。这两个机制形成自增强循环，在异构客户端间保持专家活性。

Result: 实验表明，与现有异构LoRA-rank方法相比，UB-SMoE在低资源客户端上实现了高达45.0%的计算削减，同时性能提升达8.7倍；收敛性分析验证了该方法有效解决了资源受限客户端的收敛退化问题。

Conclusion: UB-SMoE成功解决了异构联邦环境中稀疏混合专家方法的关键挑战，通过动态调制路由和通用伪梯度机制实现了计算效率与模型性能的平衡，为异构资源环境下的联邦微调提供了有效解决方案。

Abstract: Heterogeneous LoRA-rank methods address system heterogeneity in federated fine-tuning of foundation models by assigning client-specific ranks based on computational capabilities. However, these methods achieve only marginal computational savings, as dense feed-forward computations dominate. Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (SMoE) provides a promising alternative through conditional computation, yet we identify that its naive application to heterogeneous federated settings introduces two critical discordances: (i) expert utilization imbalance and (ii) non-differentiability of Top-K routing. Our convergence analysis demonstrates that these discordances lead to degraded convergence, particularly for resource-constrained clients. To address these challenges, we propose Universally Balanced Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (UB-SMoE), which introduces Dynamic Modulated Routing (DMR) to rebalance expert utilization, and Universal Pseudo-Gradient (PG) to reconstruct learning signals for non-activated experts. These mechanisms form a self-reinforcing cycle that maintains expert viability across heterogeneous clients. Experiments on benchmarks show that UB-SMoE achieves up to $45.0\%$ computational reduction on low-resource clients while improving their performance by $8.7 \times$ compared to existing heterogeneous LoRA-rank methods.

</details>


### [89] [EfficientTDMPC: Improved MPC Objectives for Sample-Efficient Continuous Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16692)

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TD-MPC系列算法中的规划器使用学习到的模型和价值网络估计回报，这些网络会引入估计误差，限制了样本效率。需要减少这种误差以提升算法在低数据环境下的性能。

Method: 提出两种策略降低估计误差：(1)引入动力学模型集成，对不同模型和不同展开深度上的回报估计取平均；(2)在规划器目标函数中加入不确定性惩罚项，使规划器避免选择回报估计不确定的动作。同时引入实用改进：提高缓冲区数据新鲜度、降低计算量，并利用更高的update-to-data (UTD)比率进一步提升样本效率。

Result: 在各基准测试的低数据环境下，EfficientTDMPC在HumanoidBench-Hard和DMC hard上达到了样本效率的SOTA水平，在DMC easy上匹配了SOTA性能。算法能够更好地从更高的UTD比率中获益。

Conclusion: EfficientTDMPC成功提升了TD-MPC系列算法的样本效率，证明了动力学模型集成和不确定性惩罚策略的有效性，为低数据环境下的连续控制任务提供了一个高效实用的解决方案。

Abstract: We introduce EfficientTDMPC, a sample-efficient model-based reinforcement learning method for continuous control built on the TD-MPC family of algorithms. Central to this family is a planner that aims to find an action sequence that maximizes the estimated return. The return is estimated using a learned model and value networks, each of which can introduce error. EfficientTDMPC proposes to reduce this error in two ways. First, it introduces an ensemble of dynamics models and averages the return estimates across those models and across different rollout depths. Second, it adds the option to apply an uncertainty penalty to the planner objective, yielding a planner that avoids actions with uncertain return estimates. It then adds practical improvements which increase buffer data freshness and reduce compute. Lastly, we find that our contributions enable EfficientTDMPC to benefit more from a higher update-to-data (UTD) ratio, further improving sample efficiency. To the best of our knowledge, in the low data regime of each benchmark, EfficientTDMPC achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) in terms of sample efficiency on HumanoidBench-Hard and DMC hard, while matching SOTA on DMC easy.

</details>

*Caio Gomes*

TL;DR: 本文论证了封顶用量SaaS产品在结构上与保险产品完全相同，提出基于精算科学的建模框架来处理其定价和准备金充足性问题，为CS/ML领域引入了缺失的精算词汇和工具。

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有SaaS定价实践缺乏处理封顶订阅产品尾部风险的理论工具。这类产品具有固定保费与实际消费解耦、用户需求随机且重尾、非流动性限额定期重置等特征，与保险产品结构相同但从业者未意识到这一联系，导致无法正确评估投资组合层面的尾部风险暴露。

Method: 构建精算科学建模框架：采用频率-严重性分解方法、保费计算原理和蒙特卡洛准备金充足性测试；将框架映射到公开可观察的LLM服务和云平台订阅层级；基于经典健康保险经济学文献进行理论支撑；通过算例展示与传统单位经济学的分歧。

Result: 成功将精算科学工具迁移至SaaS领域，在两个领域（LLM服务和云平台）验证了框架的适用性，证明了封顶用量SaaS定价与传统单位经济学方法的显著差异，为机器学习社区提供了处理尾部风险的实用工具。

Conclusion: 封顶用量SaaS产品面临的运营问题本质上与保险产品相同，精算科学数十年发展的工具可直接应用；本文贡献在于为cs.LG/stat.ML领域提供缺失的词汇和工具，而非提出新定理。

Abstract: Capped-usage SaaS products -- LLM subscriptions such as Claude Code and ChatGPT, cloud platforms such as Vercel and Cloudflare Workers, corporate benefit platforms, identity-verification services with liability transfer -- share a structural signature with insurance products: a fixed premium decoupled from realized consumption, stochastic per-user demand with heavy-tailed severity, a non-fungible cap that resets on a fixed schedule, and a portfolio-level exposure that requires reserve adequacy under tail risk. We argue that this is not an analogy. It is the same operational problem actuarial science has been tooled for decades to address, restated with new dependent variables (tokens, bandwidth bytes, function-invocations, gym check-ins) in place of medical claims. This paper proposes a modeling framework for capped-usage SaaS pricing built from frequency-severity decomposition, premium calculation principles, and Monte Carlo reserve adequacy. We map the framework to publicly observable subscription tiers in two domains (LLM services and cloud platforms), ground it in canonical health-insurance economics (Arrow 1963; Pauly 1968; Manning et al. 1987; Brot-Goldberg et al. 2017), and demonstrate divergence from traditional unit economics through a worked example. The contribution is operational rather than theoretical: not a new theorem, but vocabulary and tools currently absent from cs.LG/stat.ML practice.

</details>


### [91] [Convex Dataset Valuation for Post-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16704)
*Siqi Zeng,Christopher Jung,Rui Li,Zhe Kang,Ming Li,Nima Noorshams,Zhigang Wang,Fuchun Peng,Han Zhao,Xue Feng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于核均值匹配（KMM）的可扩展凸数据集估值方法，用于在大语言模型后训练阶段进行数据集选择。该方法在梯度空间中联合考虑与目标任务的匹配度及辅助数据集间的冗余性，在有限预算约束下有效提升了模型性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在实际的大语言模型后训练中，利用辅助数据集往往受限于计算资源、标注成本和许可费用等约束，且日益受到数据集市场预算与谈判的限制。因此，如何在有限预算下进行有原则的数据集级选择，成为亟待解决的问题。现有方法常忽视数据集间的冗余性，导致估值信号不完整。

Method: 首先指出现有的梯度对齐分数虽能提供合理估值信号，但忽略了数据集间冗余。为此，作者提出一种基于核均值匹配（KMM）的可扩展凸数据集估值方法，在梯度空间中运作，同时考虑与目标任务的匹配度以及辅助数据集间的冗余性，从而实现更优的数据集加权与选择。

Result: 在多种后训练设置和任务上的广泛实验表明，该方法一致优于现有估值基线，在较低计算开销下实现了更强的目标任务性能。

Conclusion: 本文将数据集估值定位为市场约束下大语言模型后训练数据选择的实用决策工具，证明了所提方法在提升性能和降低成本方面的有效性，并公开了代码以促进应用。

Abstract: Improving LLM performance on downstream tasks sometimes requires leveraging auxiliary datasets during post-training. In practice, however, developers face constraints on compute, labeling, and licensing costs that preclude using all available data, necessitating principled dataset-level selection. These constraints are increasingly shaped by dataset marketplaces, where data acquisition is governed by budgets and negotiation. We study dataset valuation as a subset selection problem during LLM post-training. Our goal is to identify and weight auxiliary datasets so as to maximize target task performance given constrained budgets. We first show that commonly used gradient alignment scores provide a reasonable yet incomplete valuation signal, as they ignore redundancy among datasets. To address this, we propose a scalable convex dataset-level valuation method based on kernel mean matching (KMM) in gradient space, which jointly accounts for alignment with the target task and redundancy across auxiliary datasets. Through extensive experiments across diverse post-training settings and tasks, we show that our approach consistently outperforms existing valuation baselines, achieving stronger performance with low computational overhead. Our results position dataset valuation as a practical decision tool for post-training data selection in market-constrained large language model settings. The code is available at https://github.com/uiuctml/convex_data_valuation.

</details>


### [92] [Isolating Nonlinear Independent Sources in fMRI with $β$-TCVAE Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16708)
*Qiang Li,Shujian Yu,Jesus Malo,Jingyu Liu,Tülay Adali,Vince D. Calhoun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究将β-TCVAE模型适配到fMRI数据分析中，实现了非线性源分离，成功提取出具有生物学意义的空间成分（如默认模式网络），证明了该方法在捕获大脑非线性动态组织方面的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的独立成分分析（ICA）在fMRI分析中被广泛使用，但其依赖线性混合假设，无法捕获大脑动力学固有的非线性和复杂组织结构。虽然深度表征学习方法能建模非线性潜在结构，但主要在模拟数据或自然图像上验证，缺乏在真实神经影像数据上的评估。因此，需要开发一种能够进行非线性源分离的fMRI分析方法。

Method: 本研究基于β-TCVAE（Total Correlation Variational Autoencoder）框架，这是β-VAE的改进版本，可在训练过程中无需引入额外超参数即可学习潜在表征。作者对该模型进行适配和修改，将其应用于fMRI数据的非线性源分离，旨在将混合的空间和时间大脑信号分离为可解释的成分。

Result: β-TCVAE框架能够恢复具有生物学意义的非线性空间成分，包括已确立的内源性连接网络（如默认模式网络）。通过功能网络连接评估，学习到的潜在结构能够捕获连贯且可解释的大脑组织模式。

Conclusion: 这项研究提供了一项初步探索，连接了非线性表征学习和fMRI分析，证明了深度学习方法在真实神经影像数据中提取有意义非线性成分的潜力，为未来的非线性fMRI分析研究奠定了基础。

Abstract: Learning meaningful latent representations from nonlinear fMRI data remains a fundamental challenge in neuroimaging analysis. Traditional independent component analysis, widely used due to its ability to estimate interpretable functional brain networks, relies on a linear mixing assumption for latent sources, limiting its ability to capture the inherently nonlinear and complex organization of brain dynamics. More recently, deep representation learning methods have emerged as promising alternatives for modeling nonlinear latent structure. However, many of these approaches have been evaluated primarily on simulated datasets or natural image benchmarks, with comparatively limited validation on real-world neuroimaging data such as fMRI. In this work, we are motivated by the $β$-TCVAE (Total Correlation Variational Autoencoder), a refinement of the $β$-VAE framework for learning latent representations without introducing additional hyperparameters during training. We adapt and modify this model to fMRI data for nonlinear source disentanglement, aiming to separate mixed spatial and temporal brain signals into interpretable components. We show that the $β$-TCVAE framework can recover meaningful nonlinear spatial components with biological relevance, including well-established intrinsic connectivity networks such as the default mode network. Furthermore, we evaluate the learned representations using functional network connectivity, showing that the latent structure captures coherent and interpretable brain organization patterns. This study provides a pilot investigation that bridges nonlinear representation learning and fMRI analysis.

</details>


### [93] [EmoMind: Decoding Affective Captions from Human Brain fMRI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16739)
*Bilal A. Mohammed,Lin Gu,Ruogo Fang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了EmoMind，首个从fMRI信号直接解码情感描述的端到端流程，在生成个性化情感描述方面显著优于使用离散情感标签提示的GPT-4。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的脑信号解码系统主要恢复语义内容而忽略情感；语言模型虽然可以用分类标签生成情感文本，但这些标签将丰富的个体间变异性压缩为粗粒度的离散分类。因此需要一种能够捕捉个体化、连续情感特征的方法。

Method: EmoMind采用两阶段流程：首先从脑解码的视觉特征中检索语义基础的中性场景描述，然后使用从同一fMRI记录解码的连续34维情感向量重写该描述。通过无分类器引导训练重写器，并设置身份保持的空分支，实现对语义保真度和情感表达力之间平衡的平滑插值。

Result: 在两个独立的情感fMRI数据集上，EmoMind在主体特异性、结构几何和因果控制三个验证轴上均显著优于使用脑解码top-5情感标签提示的GPT-4基线，在需要个体特定情感结构而非群体水平情感聚合的指标上提升最大。

Conclusion: 连续脑解码情感作为个性化情感描述生成的控制信号是可行的，为研究个体情感脑组织开辟了新方向。

Abstract: Decoding visual experience from brain activity has advanced substantially, but cur- rent brain-to-text systems largely recover semantic content while discarding affect. Additionally, language models can generate emotional text when prompted with categorical labels, but such labels collapse rich inter-subject variability into coarse discrete bins. We present EmoMind, the first end-to-end pipeline for decoding affective captions directly from fMRI signals. EmoMind first retrieves a semanti- cally grounded neutral scene description from brain-decoded visual features, then rewrites it using a continuous 34-dimensional emotion vector decoded from the same fMRI recording. To control the balance between content preservation and affective expression, we train the rewriter with classifier-free guidance against an identity-preserving null branch, enabling smooth interpolation between semantic fidelity and affective expressivity. We evaluate affective caption generation with a three-axis validation framework spanning subject-specificity, structural geometry, and causal control. We further augment this framework with a synthetic-brain substitution test that probes robustness to the measurement apparatus, and we benchmark each axis against GPT-4 prompted with brain-decoded top-5 emotion labels as a strong discrete baseline. Across two independent emotion fMRI datasets, EmoMind significantly outperforms label-prompted GPT-4 on all three axes, with the largest gains on metrics that require person-specific affective structure rather than population-level emotion aggregation. These results establish continuous brain-decoded affect as a viable control signal for individualized affective cap- tion generation and open new directions for studying individual affective brain organisation.

</details>


### [94] [Propagation of Chaos in Contextual Flow Maps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16747)
*Shi Chen,Zhengjiang Lin,Kaizhao Liu,Philippe Rigollet*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文建立了Transformer在长上下文机制下的定量统计理论，利用上下文流图抽象和McKean-Vlasov结构，证明了有限上下文模型与理想无限上下文系统之间的偏差在一般情况下达到最优Wasserstein收敛率n^{-1/d}，在包含Transformer的特殊情况下达到参数率n^{-1/2}。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 建立Transformer在长上下文机制下的定量统计理论基础，将上下文长度视为统计资源，通过有限上下文模型逼近理想化无限上下文系统的角度来理解Transformer的工作机制和收敛性质。

Method: 采用上下文流图(CFMs)抽象，将Transformer建模为在上下文测度存在下演化特定token的动力学系统；利用McKean-Vlasov动力学结构和传播混沌的经典机制；发展新的损失梯度欧拉伴随表述以及前向-伴随系统的稳定性估计。

Result: 建立了有限上下文和无限上下文CFMs之间偏差的前向界（沿深度一致控制）和后向界（沿在线梯度下降迭代一致控制）；一般CFMs达到最优Wasserstein收敛率n^{-1/d}；包括Transformer在内的受限CFMs类达到参数率n^{-1/2}。

Conclusion: 成功建立了Transformer在长上下文机制下的完整统计理论框架，所得收敛率达到了理论最优值，其中发展的欧拉伴随表述和稳定性估计方法具有独立的理论价值，为理解Transformer的统计性质提供了严格的数学基础。

Abstract: We develop a quantitative statistical theory of transformers in the large-context regime by adopting the abstraction of contextual flow maps (CFMs): dynamical systems that evolve a distinguished token in the presence of a contextual measure across a stack of attention blocks. Within this framework, the finite-context model approximates an idealized infinite-context system in which the contextual measure is replaced by its underlying population, so that the context length $n$ becomes a statistical resource. Exploiting the McKean--Vlasov structure of the dynamics and the classical machinery of propagation of chaos, we establish a forward bound controlling the deviation between the finite- and infinite-context CFMs uniformly along depth, and a backward bound controlling the deviation between the corresponding training trajectories uniformly across iterations of online gradient descent. Both bounds achieve the optimal Wasserstein rate $n^{-1/d}$ for general CFMs and parametric rate $n^{-1/2}$ for a restricted class of CFMs that includes transformers as a special case. The analysis rests on a new Eulerian adjoint formulation of the loss gradient and stability estimates for the resulting forward--adjoint system, both of which may be of independent interest.

</details>


### [95] [Learning Unbiased Permutations via Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16755)
*Yimeng Min,Carla P. Gomes*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了PermFlow，一种基于条件流匹配的排列学习框架，解决了现有Sinkhorn方法在模糊性下崩溃的问题，能够捕获多模态排列分布。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的基于熵正则化Sinkhorn的可微排列学习方法只能产生单一的软化解，在存在模糊性的情况下会发生模式崩溃，无法处理多模态的排列分布问题。

Method: 提出PermFlow框架，直接在具有单位行和列和的矩阵仿射子空间上运行。通过闭式切空间投影器精确保持约束条件，而非迭代校正；采用最近目标耦合机制，将不同的噪声初始化路由到不同的有效排列。

Result: 在带有混合数字模糊性的视觉排序任务和对称线性分配问题中，PermFlow对明确输入实现高准确率，并在模糊情况下能恢复两个有效排列，而基于Sinkhorn的基线方法在结构上无法处理模糊性。

Conclusion: PermFlow成功解决了排列学习中的多模态分布问题，能够同时捕获多个有效的排列模式，避免了传统方法的模式崩溃，为排序、排名和匹配任务提供了更鲁棒的解决方案。

Abstract: Learning permutations is fundamental to sorting, ranking, and matching, but existing differentiable methods based on entropy-regularized Sinkhorn produce a single softened solution and collapse under ambiguity. We present PermFlow, a conditional flow matching framework that operates directly on the affine subspace of matrices with unit row and column sums. A closed-form tangent-space projector preserves these constraints exactly along every trajectory, by construction rather than through iterative correction, and a nearest-target coupling routes distinct noisy initializations toward distinct valid permutations. The result is a model that captures multimodal permutation distributions rather than collapsing them to a single mode. On a visual sorting task with blended-digit ambiguity and a symmetric linear assignment problem, PermFlow achieves high accuracy on unambiguous inputs and recovers both valid permutations under ambiguity, where Sinkhorn-based baselines structurally fail.

</details>


### [96] [Distinguishable Deletion: Unifying Knowledge Erasure and Refusal for Large Language Model Unlearning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16776)
*Puning Yang,Junchi Yu,Qizhou Wang,Philip Torr,Bo Han,Xiuying Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出D²（可区分删除）新范式及EUA方法，通过能量指标在潜在表示层面擦除不良知识，有效解决现有知识删除和拒绝方法的问题，实验表现优越。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多LLM输出缓解方法存在缺陷：知识删除（KD）方法因抑制特定token序列替代完整知识删除导致偏倚删除；可区分拒绝（DR）方法因底层知识保持完整面临有害知识重新浮现风险。需要一种能有效擦除不良知识同时能安全拒绝的方法。

Method: 提出Distinguishable Deletion (D²)范式，在潜在表示层面而非特定token上限制响应分布来擦除不良知识，并将其与保留知识区分开；引入能量指标量化知识存在及未学习/保留内容分离度；提出Energy-based Unlearning Alignment (EUA)，在训练时强制执行能量边界遗忘，在推理时应用基于能量的拒绝机制。

Result: 数学和实证分析证明能量指标既准确又高效；大量实验表明EUA显著优于先前方法，验证了D²范式的优越性。

Conclusion: D²范式通过潜在表示层面的知识擦除和能量指标引导，有效解决了KD和DR方法的核心缺陷，为LLM安全部署提供了更优的遗忘对齐方案。

Abstract: Mitigating sensitive and harmful outputs is fundamental to ensuring safe deployment of LLMs. Existing approaches typically follow two paradigms: Knowledge Deletion (KD), which erases undesirable information during training, and Distinguishable Refusal (DR), which steers models away from using sensitive knowledge during inference. Despite rapid progress, KD-based unlearning struggles with biased deletion due to suppressing specific token sequences as a substitute for complete knowledge removal, whereas DR-based unlearning risks the re-emergence of harmful knowledge because the underlying knowledge remains intact. To address these issues, we propose Distinguishable Deletion ($\mathrm{D^2}$), a paradigm that restricts the response distribution in the latent representation rather than specific tokens to erase undesirable knowledge, while distinguishing it from retained knowledge, enabling a refusal mechanism to handle unlearned inputs safely and coherently. To implement $\mathrm{D^2}$, we introduce an energy index that quantifies the presence of knowledge and the separation between unlearned and retained content. Mathematical and empirical analyses show that energy is both accurate and efficient, enabling Energy-based Unlearning Alignment (EUA) to enforce energy-boundary unlearning during training and apply an energy-based refusal mechanism at inference. Extensive experiments demonstrate that EUA significantly outperforms previous methods, indicating the superiority of $\mathrm{D^2}$. Our code is available at https://github.com/Puning97/EUA-for-LLM-Unlearning.

</details>


### [97] [Lever: Speculative LLM Inference on Smartphones](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16786)
*Tuowei Wang,Fengzu Li,Yanfan Sun,Wei Gao,Ju Ren*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了Lever系统，通过针对移动端优化推测解码的三个阶段，实现了在智能手机闪存上高效运行大语言模型，将推理延迟平均降低2.93倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高质量大语言模型（LLM）超出智能手机有限的DRAM容量，而基于闪存的推理由于自回归解码需要频繁I/O导致速度缓慢，推测解码虽然适合此场景，但现有方法未考虑移动端的I/O延迟高、计算并行度有限和不规则推测执行等约束。

Method: 提出Lever端到端系统，联合优化推测解码三个阶段：1）构建阶段使用I/O和计算感知的收益-成本目标函数构建令牌树；2）验证阶段通过早退预测剪枝低价值分支以减少目标模型计算；3）执行阶段在移动CPU-NPU硬件上高效映射推测以提高利用率。

Result: 实验评估表明，Lever相比基线闪存卸载推理平均减少2.93倍延迟，相比传统推测解码减少1.50倍延迟，缩小了闪存驻留与内存驻留LLM推理之间的延迟差距。

Conclusion: Lever证明了通过针对移动设备特性系统性地优化推测解码，可以有效解决移动端大模型推理的内存瓶颈问题，为移动设备部署高质量LLM提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly needed for interactive mobile applications, but high-quality models exceed the limited DRAM available on smartphones. Flash storage can hold larger models, yet flash-backed inference is slow because autoregressive decoding repeatedly invokes the target model and incurs costly I/O. We observe that speculative decoding is a natural fit for this setting: a small draft model can remain in DRAM, while a larger flash-resident target model verifies multiple candidate tokens per invocation. However, existing methods assume server-class accelerators and fail to account for prolonged I/O latency, limited computation parallelism, and irregular speculation execution.
  We present Lever, an end-to-end system for efficient flash-backed LLM inference on smartphones. Lever jointly optimizes the three stages of speculative decoding under mobile constraints. For drafting, it builds token trees using an I/O- and compute-aware gain-cost objective. For verification, it prunes low-value branches through early-exit prediction to reduce target-model computation. For execution, it maps speculation efficiently across mobile CPU-NPU hardware to improve utilization. Comprehensive evaluations show that Lever reduces inference latency by an average of 2.93x over baseline flash-offloaded inference and 1.50x over conventional speculative decoding, narrowing the latency gap between flash-backed and memory-resident LLM inference.

</details>


### [98] [The Unlearnability Phenomenon in RLVR for Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16787)
*Yulin Chen,He He,Chen Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现在RLVR训练中，即使存在正确推理路径，仍有大量困难样本无法被模型学习。研究揭示这些不可学习样本存在根本性的表示缺陷，表现为与其余样本的梯度相似度低且推理模式不可泛化，现有优化和采样技术均无法解决该问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管强化学习可验证奖励（RLVR）已被证明能有效提升大语言模型的推理能力，但其学习动态仍未被充分探索。本文旨在揭示RLVR训练中存在的不可学习数据现象，深入分析其成因和现有方法的局限性。

Method: 1. 识别并验证RLVR训练中不可学习样本的存在；
2. 测试现有优化和采样技术对不可学习问题的解决效果；
3. 通过跨样本梯度分析，研究不可学习样本的表示特性；
4. 评估数据增强等干预措施对梯度相似度的影响。

Result: 研究发现：（1）在模型初始难以处理的困难样本中，即使存在正确推理路径，仍有大量子集无法被学习；（2）现有优化和采样技术无法解决不可学习性问题；（3）不可学习样本存在根本性表示缺陷，表现为与其余样本梯度相似度低、推理模式不可泛化；（4）数据增强无法改善梯度相似度，表明表示缺陷在强化学习中难以缓解。

Conclusion: 本文首次系统刻画了RLVR训练中的不可学习数据，揭示了当前强化学习方法在推理任务中的根本局限性。研究为理解和改进RLVR训练提供了重要理论基础，指出了需要从表示层面突破的新研究方向。

Abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Reward (RLVR) has proven effective in improving Large Language Model's (LLM) reasoning ability. However, the learning dynamics of RLVR remain underexplored. In this paper, we reveal a counterintuitive phenomenon: among hard examples that the model initially struggles with, a substantial subset remains unlearnable even when correct rollouts are present. To understand the phenomenon, we first demonstrate that existing optimization and sampling techniques fail to resolve unlearnability. With cross-example gradient analysis, we show that unlearnable examples have fundamental representation issue, characterized by low gradient similarity with the rest of the examples and ungeneralizable reasoning patterns. We further show that representation flaws are difficult to mitigate in RL, as data augmentation does not improve gradient similarity. Our study provides the first systematic characterization of unlearnable data in RLVR training and reveals fundamental limitations in current RL approaches for reasoning tasks. Code and data are available at \url{https://github.com/yulinchen99/unlearnability-rlvr}.

</details>


### [99] [TIER: Trajectory-Invariant Execution Rewards for Multi-Step Tool Composition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16790)
*Anay Kulkarni,ChiaEn Lu,Dheeraj Mekala,Jayanth Srinivasa,Gaowen Liu,Jingbo Shang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出TIER框架，通过从函数模式和运行执行中直接获取监督信号，解决了现有强化学习方法在多步工具组合任务中难以扩展的问题，在深度基准测试中实现了超过90%的准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有强化学习方法在多步组合设置中存在扩展性问题：基于结果的奖励仅提供稀疏反馈，而轨迹监督奖励依赖于标注的参考解决方案，会惩罚有效的替代方案并限制可扩展性。

Method: 提出TIER（轨迹不变执行奖励）框架，直接从函数模式和运行时执行中获取监督信号，而非依赖参考轨迹。奖励分解为格式有效性、模式遵从性、执行成功率和答案正确性，提供密集、可解释的序列级反馈。该设计允许任何有效的执行路径获得信用，自然支持多种解决策略。

Result: 在按深度分层（1到6步）的组合基准DepthBench上，TIER在各步骤均实现超过90%的准确率，而轨迹监督奖励在步骤4之后性能崩溃。在BFCL v3和NestFUL等其他基准上也展现出一致的改进。消融研究证实所有奖励组件都是必要的。

Conclusion: TIER框架成功解决了工具使用中的多步组合推理问题，通过多层次的监督信号实现了轨迹不变的奖励机制，为大型语言模型的复杂任务解决提供了有效的训练方法。

Abstract: Tool use enables large language models to solve complex tasks through sequences of API calls, yet existing reinforcement learning approaches fail to scale to multi-step composition settings. Outcome-based rewards provide only sparse feedback, while trajectory-supervised rewards depend on annotated reference solutions, penalizing valid alternatives and limiting scalability. We propose TIER: Trajectory-Invariant Execution Rewards, a reward framework that derives supervision directly from function schemas and runtime execution, rather than from reference trajectories. The reward decomposes into format validity, schema adherence, execution success, and answer correctness, providing dense, interpretable sequence-level feedback derived from fine-grained verification of individual steps of tool use. This design allows any valid execution path to receive credit, naturally supporting multiple solution strategies and adapting to evolving tool interfaces. On DepthBench, a compositional benchmark stratified by depth (1 to 6 steps), TIER achieves >90% accuracy across steps, where trajectory-supervised rewards collapse beyond step-4. We further demonstrate consistent gains on benchmarks like BFCL v3 and NestFUL. Ablation studies confirm that all reward components are necessary, highlighting the importance of multi-level supervision for compositional reasoning.

</details>


### [100] [PULSE: Generative Phase Evolution for Non-Stationary Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16793)
*Yangyou Liu,Zezhi Shao,Xinyu Chen,Hu Chen,Fei Wang,Yuankai Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对非平稳时间序列预测中的“相位失忆”问题，提出了一个即插即用的物理信息框架PULSE，通过物理假设指导的解耦-演化-模拟设计，使简单MLP模型在12个基准上达到最先进性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非平稳时间序列预测中存在根本性矛盾：如何在捕捉稳定表示的同时适应分布漂移。现有方法隐式依赖静态历史假设，导致模型出现“相位失忆”现象，即对演化的全局上下文变得盲目。

Method: 基于三个物理假设（Wold分解、动态相位演化和异方差流形生成），提出PULSE框架，采用解耦-演化-模拟设计理念：1) 使用相位锚定解耦解决主导趋势引起的优化干扰；2) 部署相位路由器主动生成未来轨迹；3) 引入统计感知混合(SAM)确保对分布外波动的鲁棒性。

Result: PULSE使简单的MLP骨干网络在12个真实世界基准测试中达到最先进或极具竞争力的性能表现。

Conclusion: 对于非平稳预测任务，正确的物理信息归纳偏置比原始架构复杂性更为关键，验证了物理先验知识在时间序列建模中的重要性。

Abstract: Time series forecasting under non-stationarity faces a fundamental tension between capturing stable representations and adapting to distribution shifts. Existing methods implicitly rely on static historical assumptions, leading to a critical failure mode we term Phase Amnesia, where models become blind to the evolving global context. To resolve this, we formalize non-stationary dynamics through three physical hypotheses: wold decomposition, dynamical phase evolution, and heteroscedastic manifold generation. These principles inspire PULSE, a physics-informed, plug-and-play framework adopting a Disentangle--Evolve--Simulate design philosophy. Specifically, PULSE utilizes phase-anchored disentanglement to resolve optimization interference caused by dominant trends, employs a Phase Router to actively generate future trajectories, and introduces Statistic-Aware Mixup (SAM) to ensure robustness against out-of-distribution volatility. Empirically, PULSE enables a simple MLP backbone to achieve state-of-the-art or highly competitive performance across 12 real-world benchmarks. This validates that a correct physics-informed inductive bias is far more critical than raw architectural complexity for non-stationary forecasting. The code is available at: https://github.com/Gemost/PULSE.

</details>


### [101] [Cross-Domain Molecular Relational Learning: Leveraging Chemical Structure-Activity Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16799)
*Peiliang Zhang,Jingling Yuan,Shiqing Wu,Mengqing Hu,Chao Che,Yongjun Zhu,Lin Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了DisTrans方法，通过梯度反转策略和跨域表征引导机制解决分子关系学习中的域封闭效应问题，在跨域适应任务上显著优于16种基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有分子关系学习(MRL)方法专注于域内建模，其固有的域封闭效应限制了对分子科学的应用，特别是在阐明跨域相互作用机制方面存在不足，因此迫切需要跨域分子关系学习方法。

Method: 提出了基于结构-语义迁移差异的域对抗训练网络(DisTrans)：1) 基于域间子结构拓扑差异的梯度反转策略，学习分子结构的域依赖性，引导模型适应目标域的结构邻接模式；2) 应用跨域表征引导机制，对齐源域和目标域之间的官能团语义信息，学习跨域一致性信息。

Result: 在两种典型的跨域策略实验中，DisTrans方法优于16种基线方法，即使在显著的域间差异下也能保持令人满意的性能。

Conclusion: DisTrans方法有效优化了分子结构和视觉图像的跨域自适应表征，成功解决了跨域分子关系学习中的关键挑战，为分子科学中的跨域相互作用机制研究提供了新的解决方案。

Abstract: Recent advances in molecular representation integrates molecular topological and visual modalities, opening new avenues for precise Molecular Relational Learning (MRL). Existing MRL methods focus on intra-domain modeling, and their inherent domain-closed effect limits applicability to molecular science, particularly in elucidating cross-domain interaction mechanisms. Consequently, the imperative for Cross-Domain Molecular Relational Learning has become increasingly pressing. Benefiting from structure-activity analysis, we propose the Domain Adversarial Training Network with Structural-Semantic Transfer Discrepancy (DisTrans) to optimize cross-domain adaptive representation for molecular structures and visual images. 1) We employ the gradient reversal strategy based on substructure topological discrepancies between domains to learn the domain dependence of molecular structures. This strategy guides the model to adapt to the structural adjacency patterns in the target domain, generating domain-separable structural representations. 2) We apply the cross-domain representation guidance mechanism to align the functional-group semantic information between the source and target domains, learning cross-domain consistency information. The experimental results in two typical cross-domain strategies demonstrate that DisTrans outperforms 16 baseline methods, maintaining satisfactory performance even under pronounced inter-domain discrepancy.

</details>


### [102] [FIM-LoRA: Task-Informative Rank Allocation for LoRA via Calibration-Time Gradient-Variance Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16800)
*Ramakrishnan Sathyavageeswaran*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FIM-LoRA通过梯度方差代理层重要性，在微调前动态分配各层秩预算，无需额外参数或训练开销，性能与均匀秩LoRA持平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统LoRA为所有权重矩阵分配统一秩，忽略了不同层对任务适应贡献不均的现实问题。

Method: 在微调前执行8次校准反向传播，计算LoRA-B矩阵的梯度方差作为层信息量代理，通过经验Fisher信息矩阵对角线的高效近似按比例重新分配秩预算。

Result: 在GLUE (DeBERTa-v3-base) 上性能与LoRA持平 (88.6 vs 88.7)，在LLaMA-3-8B常识推理任务上达68.5 (vs LoRA 68.7)，内存成本相比全模型Fisher估计降低约256倍，生成的层级秩图显示value投影和中早期层获得更高秩。

Conclusion: FIM-LoRA提供了一种轻量级工程方案，通过校准阶段确定各层秩分配，形成标准LoRA适配器，无需新增参数或改变服务基础设施，且层级秩分配具有可解释性，符合Transformer层功能的现有认知。

Abstract: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) assigns a uniform rank to every adapted weight matrix - a practical convenience that ignores a fundamental reality: different layers contribute unequally to task adaptation. We address this with a lightweight engineering solution: before fine-tuning begins, run eight calibration backward passes, compute the gradient variance of each LoRA-B matrix as a proxy for layer informativeness, and redistribute the rank budget proportionally. The resulting adapter is a standard LoRA with a per-layer rank pattern - no new parameters, no training overhead, no changes to serving infrastructure. We implement this via an efficient approximation of the empirical Fisher Information Matrix (eFIM) diagonal, restricted to LoRA adapter matrices only, which reduces memory cost by approximately 256x compared to full-model Fisher estimation. On GLUE with DeBERTa-v3-base, FIM-LoRA matches LoRA (88.6 vs. 88.7) at the same parameter budget, and on commonsense reasoning with LLaMA-3-8B reaches 68.5 vs. 68.7 for LoRA. The per-layer rank maps are interpretable: value projections and early-to-middle layers consistently receive higher rank, consistent with established findings on transformer layer roles.

</details>


### [103] [Cross-modal Affinity-aligned Multimodal Learning Analytics for Predicting Student Collaboration Satisfaction in Game-Based Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16806)
*Wen-Hsin Tsai,Chia-Ming Lee,Yuk-Ying Tung*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出AAMLA框架，通过CAMA模块解决多模态学习分析中的模态退化问题，实现了对学生协作满意度的鲁棒预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 协作游戏学习环境中，由于学生群体的差异导致单模态（如眼动）信息量不一致，现有隐式注意力融合方法会产生脆弱的多模态表示，难以准确预测学生协作满意度。

Method: 提出AAMLA框架，核心是跨模态亲和力引导的模态对齐（CAMA）模块：通过亲和力矩阵显式建模模态间关系，利用对比学习强化跨模态一致性，自适应抑制低信息量模态；同时采用模态特定投影层将面部动作单元、头部姿态、眼动和交互日志等异构特征映射到统一语义空间。

Result: 在50名中学生的EcoJourneys协作学习环境实验中，AAMLA在标准条件和模态退化条件下均优于单模态基线和现有交叉注意力方法；SHAP和t-SNE分析证实CAMA模块产生了鲁棒且可解释的跨模态表示。

Conclusion: AAMLA框架通过显式建模跨模态关系和自适应处理模态退化，有效提升了学生协作建模的鲁棒性和可解释性，为教育场景下的多模态学习分析提供了新的解决方案。

Abstract: Collaborative game-based learning environments offer rich opportunities for small-group knowledge construction, yet automatically predicting student collaboration satisfaction remains challenging. A critical barrier is modality degradation: in educational deployments, individual modalities such as eye gaze exhibit inconsistent informativeness across student cohorts, causing implicit attention-based fusion to produce brittle multimodal representations. We propose the Affinity-Aligned Multimodal Learning Analytics (AAMLA) framework, whose core contribution is the Cross-modal Affinity-guided Modality Alignment (CAMA) module, which explicitly models inter-modal relationships via affinity matrices and enforces cross-modal consistency through contrastive learning, enabling adaptive suppression of uninformative modalities without discarding them. AAMLA further applies modality-specific projection layers to map heterogeneous features, including facial action units, head pose, eye gaze, and interaction trace logs, into a unified semantic space prior to alignment. Experiments on 50 middle school students in the EcoJourneys collaborative learning environment demonstrate consistent improvements over unimodal baselines and prior cross-attention approaches under standard and modality degradation conditions, with SHAP and t-SNE analyses confirming that CAMA produces robust, interpretable cross-modal representations for student collaboration modeling.

</details>


### [104] [Informative Graph Structure Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16809)
*Shen Han,Zhiyao Zhou,Jiawei Chen,Sheng Zhou,Canghong Jin,Hai Lin,Da Zhong Li,Bingde Hu,Can Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出InGSL方法，通过联合考虑相似性和多样性来解决图结构学习中边数量急剧扩张的问题，在减少边数量的同时提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图结构学习方法虽然有效，但通常会导致边数量急剧增加，带来显著的存储和计算开销。作者发现这一局限性源于普遍使用的基于相似性的边构建方法，该方法主要连接高度相似的邻居节点，引入了大量结构冗余。

Method: 提出信息丰富的图结构学习方法，通过引入互信息指导的学习策略，在边构建过程中联合考虑相似性和多样性。该方法作为插件模块，可以无缝集成到现有的GSL框架中。

Result: 在六种代表性GSL方法上进行了广泛实验，结果表明InGSL在减少边数量的同时实现了显著的性能提升。

Conclusion: InGSL成功解决了传统GSL方法中结构冗余导致的边数量扩张问题，为图结构学习提供了一种更高效的解决方案，证明了在边构建中同时考虑相似性和多样性的重要性。

Abstract: The quality of graph-structured data is fundamental to the success of modern graph analysis techniques such as Graph Neural Networks (GNNs). However, real-world graph data is often suboptimal, suffering from issues such as noise and incomplete connections. Graph Structure Learning (GSL) has emerged as a promising technique that adaptively optimizes node connections. However, we observe that the effectiveness of GSL often comes at the cost of a dramatic expansion in edge count, resulting in significant storage and computational overhead.
  In this work, we reveal that this limitation stems from the prevalent use of similarity-based edge construction, which predominantly connects highly similar neighbors based on their embeddings, introducing substantial structure redundancy. To address this, we propose a novel Informative Graph Structure Learning method (InGSL), which jointly considers both similarity and diversity in edge construction by incorporating a mutual-information-guided learning strategy. Notably, InGSL serves as a plug-in module that can be seamlessly integrated into existing GSL frameworks. Through extensive experiments on six representative GSL methods, we demonstrate that InGSL achieves significant performance improvements at a reduced number of edges.

</details>


### [105] [Jacobian-Guided Anisotropic Noise Reshaping for Enhancing Representation Utility under Local Differential Privacy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16812)
*Youngmok Ha,Viktor Schlegel,Yidan Sun,Anil Anthony Bharath*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于Jacobian矩阵识别任务关键子空间的方法，通过将各向同性噪声重塑为各向异性分布，在保持隐私预算的同时显著提升了本地差分隐私的数据可用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统本地差分隐私（LDP）机制具有任务无关性，对所有维度均匀注入噪声，忽略了不同维度对下游任务的相对重要性，导致数据可用性严重下降。

Method: 利用公开下游模型的Jacobian矩阵识别任务关键子空间，在这些维度上选择性衰减噪声，将标准LDP的各向同性噪声重塑为各向异性分布，且不改变每维度的隐私预算。该方法适用于线性和非线性模型，并能与现有机制无缝集成。

Result: 在CIFAR-10-C数据集（亮度腐蚀，最高严重等级5）上的实验表明，在ε=7.5时，将该方法与PrivUnit2和PrivUnitG集成，数据可用性提升约20%。

Conclusion: 该方法有效解决了传统LDP机制因均匀噪声注入导致的可用性损失问题，为隐私保护与数据效用之间的平衡提供了一种高效、通用的解决方案。

Abstract: While Local Differential Privacy (LDP) serves as a foundational primitive for distributed data collection, its stringent noise injection requirement often leads to severe degradation in data utility. This degradation stems from the task-agnostic nature of conventional LDP mechanisms, which inject noise uniformly across all dimensions regardless of their relative importance to the downstream objective. To address this issue, we propose a novel approach that mitigates noise in task-relevant subspaces of the data representation. Our method identifies task-critical subspaces via the Jacobian matrix of the public downstream model, selectively attenuates noise along those dimensions, and reshapes the isotropic noise of standard LDP into an anisotropic distribution. This method preserves the uniform per-dimension privacy budget while heterogeneously modulating noise impact across dimensions, thereby substantially enhancing data utility. Furthermore, our approach generalizes to both linear and non-linear models and integrates seamlessly with existing mechanisms. Extensive experiments on CIFAR-10-C (Brightness corruption at the highest severity level 5) demonstrate that integrating our approach improves the utility of PrivUnit2 and PrivUnitG by approximately 20\% at $ε=7.5$. The source code is available at \url{https://github.com/ymha/jacobian-anr-ldp}.

</details>


### [106] [Atoms as Language: VQ-Atom: Semantic Discretization for Molecular Representation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16823)
*Takayuki Kimura*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了VQ-Atom框架，通过向量量化将连续的原子级图表示转换为具有化学语义的离散标记，显著提升了药物发现中的分子表征学习效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的分子标记化方法（如SMILES）主要基于语法层面，缺乏与化学上有意义的子结构的自然对齐，限制了AI驱动药物发现中分子表征学习的效果。

Method: 提出VQ-Atom语义离散化框架，利用图神经网络嵌入和向量量化技术，将原子分配到代表化学上有意义的原子上下文的码本条目中，从而生成适用于Transformer预训练的分子语言。

Result: 在不依赖3D结构信息的蛋白质-配体相互作用预测任务（蛋白质冷启动设置）中，VQ-Atom相比传统标记化方法持续提升了预测性能。

Conclusion: 语义基础的离散化能够显著增强分子表征学习，标记设计本身在化学语言建模中发挥着关键作用。

Abstract: Molecular representation learning has become a central approach in AI-driven drug discovery, yet existing molecular tokenizations such as SMILES remain largely syntactic and do not naturally align with chemically meaningful substructures. In this work, we introduce VQ-Atom, a semantic discretization framework that converts continuous atom-level graph representations into discrete tokens corresponding to local chemical environments. Using graph neural network embeddings and vector quantization, atoms are assigned to codebook entries representing chemically meaningful atomic contexts. These discrete tokens define a molecular language suitable for Transformer-based pretraining.
  We evaluate VQ-Atom in protein-ligand interaction prediction under a protein-cold split setting without relying on 3D structural information. Experimental results show that VQ-Atom consistently improves predictive performance compared to conventional tokenization approaches, suggesting that semantically grounded discretization can substantially enhance molecular representation learning. Our findings indicate that token design itself plays a critical role in enabling effective language modeling for chemistry.

</details>


### [107] [Confidence Geometry Reveals Trace-Level Correctness in Large Language Model Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16824)
*Shuo Liu,Ding Liu,Shi-Ju Ran*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究发现大语言模型（LLM）在推理过程中生成的词元级置信度轨迹包含与最终答案正确性相关的几何特征，无需访问问题内容即可区分正确与错误的推理路径。作者提出的NeuralConf模型利用置信度轨迹改进了答案聚合策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型在推理过程中会产生词元级的置信度轨迹，记录了推理过程中的不确定性变化。然而，这些轨迹是否与推理正确性相关尚不明确。作者旨在探究这些置信度轨迹是否编码了与推理正确性相关的信息，以利用模型内部已有的信息提升推理性能。

Method: 作者首先将置信度轨迹转换为低维表示，在不使用输入问题、推理文本、隐藏状态或外部验证器的情况下，分析其对正确与错误推理路径的分离能力。研究使用了Davies-Bouldin指数量化聚类强度，并在GSM8K、MATH和MMLU数据集上验证了几何分离与下游预测性的关联。随后，作者提出了NeuralConf，一种轻量级估计器，从置信度轨迹中学习以进行正确性评估。

Result: 实验表明，置信度轨迹的低维表示能够有效分离正确与错误的推理路径。在三个基准数据集上，更强的聚类对应更高的正确性判别AUC。研究发现正确性相关信息集中在推理轨迹的尾部，表明后期置信度动态承载关键正确性信号。在固定轨迹预算下，NeuralConf在置信度加权答案聚合上的表现优于多数投票、尾部置信度和其他静态基线。

Conclusion: 研究证明大语言模型通过自身的置信度动态暴露了推理正确性的统计信号，这些信号是内容无关的几何特征。该发现为利用模型生成过程中已有的信息改进推理提供了新途径，无需依赖外部验证器或模型内部状态。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) generate not only reasoning text, but also token-level confidence trajectories that record how uncertainty evolves during inference. Whether these trajectories are relevant to reasoning correctness remains unclear. Here we show that confidence trajectories encode a content-agnostic confidence geometry associated with trace-level final-answer correctness. Using only token-level confidence values, without access to the input question, reasoning text, hidden states, or external verifiers, we find that low-dimensional representations of confidence trajectories separate correct from incorrect reasoning traces. Across GSM8K, MATH, and MMLU, this geometric separation is quantitatively linked to downstream predictability: stronger clustering of correct and incorrect traces, measured by the Davies--Bouldin index, consistently corresponds to higher correctness-discrimination AUC. We further show that correctness-related information is enriched in the tail of reasoning, suggesting that late-stage confidence dynamics carry key correctness signals. We propose NeuralConf, a lightweight estimator that learns from confidence trajectories for correctness evaluation. Under a fixed trace budget, NeuralConf-derived scores improve confidence-weighted answer aggregation over majority voting, tail confidence, and other static baselines. These results reveal that LLMs expose trace-intrinsic statistical signals of correctness through their own confidence dynamics, offering a route to improve inference using information already present within generation.

</details>


### [108] [Decoupling KL and Trajectories: A Unified Perspective for SFT, DAgger, Offline RL, and OPD in LLM Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16826)
*Anhao Zhao,Haoran Xin,Yingqi Fan,Junlong Tong,Wenjie Li,Xiaoyu Shen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文解构了LLM知识蒸馏的设计空间，将传统方法解耦为前缀来源和KL方向两个正交维度，提出四种有效目标函数，并通过实验揭示了三个关键权衡，最终提出KL混合和熵门控长度课程两个实用方法，在提升性能的同时大幅降低计算成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 知识蒸馏在大语言模型后训练中占据核心地位，但其设计空间，特别是与强化学习结合时，仍缺乏深入理解。现有的离策略蒸馏和在线策略蒸馏范式隐式耦合了两个正交选择（前缀来源和token级KL方向），本文旨在解耦这两个维度，建立统一的理论框架。

Method: 1. 理论分析：通过分解自回归响应分布上的序列级KL，揭示前向KL与教师前缀配对、反向KL与学生前缀配对的耦合关系；2. 目标构建：解耦前缀来源和KL方向，构建四种有效目标函数；3. 梯度级恒等式推导：证明前向KL产生SFT风格的交叉熵匹配，反向KL产生RL风格的策略梯度目标；4. 提出新方法：KL混合策略和熵门控长度课程。

Result: 1. 实验揭示了三个关键权衡：KL方向引发准确率-熵权衡，前缀来源导致质量-计算权衡，训练长度产生准确率-稳定性权衡；2. KL混合方法在长序列蒸馏中需要大量前向KL权重以防止熵坍缩和长度膨胀；3. 熵门控长度课程使Avg@k提升3.6分，Pass@k最高提升5.8分，平均响应长度减少约3倍。

Conclusion: 本文为推理蒸馏目标的设计提供了理论框架和实用方法，通过解耦前缀来源和KL方向，研究人员可以更灵活地平衡准确率、多样性、计算成本和RL行为，为LLM后训练中的知识蒸馏提供了更系统的设计指导。

Abstract: Knowledge distillation is central to LLM post-training, yet its design space remains poorly understood, especially alongside reinforcement learning (RL). We show that the prevailing paradigms, off-policy distillation and on-policy distillation (OPD), implicitly couple two orthogonal choices: prefix source and token-level KL direction. This follows from decomposing sequence-level KL over autoregressive response distributions: forward KL pairs teacher prefixes with token-level forward KL, and reverse KL pairs student prefixes with token-level reverse KL. We argue this coupling is not intrinsic: decoupling the two axes yields four valid objectives. We establish gradient-level identities showing forward KL gives SFT-style cross-entropy matching with teacher soft targets, whereas reverse KL gives an RL-style policy-gradient objective with a dense teacher-student log-ratio reward, connecting them to off-policy SFT, DAgger-style on-policy SFT, offline-RL-style distillation, and OPD. We conduct an extensive controlled study on math reasoning, evaluating the four objectives both as standalone methods and as initializations for subsequent RL. The results reveal three tradeoffs: KL direction induces an accuracy-entropy tradeoff, prefix source a quality-compute tradeoff, and training length an accuracy-stability tradeoff. Motivated by these findings, we propose KL mixing and an entropy-gated length curriculum. KL mixing shows long-sequence distillation requires substantial forward-KL weight to prevent entropy collapse and length inflation without sacrificing accuracy. The entropy-gated length curriculum improves Avg@k and Pass@k by 3.6 and up to 5.8 points, and cuts average response length by roughly 3x versus fixed long-horizon training. Our results provide a framework and practical methods for designing reasoning distillation objectives that balance accuracy, diversity, compute, and RL behavior.

</details>


### [109] [PhysioSeq2Seq: A Hybrid Physiological Digital Twin and Sequence-to-Sequence LSTM for Long-Horizon Glucose Forecasting in Type 1 Diabetes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16860)
*Phat Tran,Neville Mehta,Clara Mosquera-Lopez,Robert H. Dodier,Lizhong Chen,Peter G. Jacobs*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出PhysioSeq2Seq混合模型，结合患者特异性生理建模与Seq2Seq LSTM，有效解决了长期血糖预测中的误差累积和负偏差问题，在240分钟预测范围内显著提升了准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 准确的长期血糖预测对1型糖尿病（T1D）患者的自动胰岛素输送系统至关重要。然而，标准递归LSTM网络在长期预测中因误差累积存在系统性负偏差，而纯机制的常微分方程（ODE）模型在群体水平参数化时难以在个体间泛化。

Method: 提出PhysioSeq2Seq混合架构：1) 对每个血糖片段，使用孪生匹配技术从300个参数化数字孪生中搜索最佳生理匹配（基于3小时CGM历史）；2) 将匹配孪生的10个内部ODE状态变量作为外生协变量注入Seq2Seq LSTM的编码器和解码器；3) 采用48步同时预测策略消除递归误差累积，ODE特征提供物理约束以限制长期漂移在生理合理范围内。

Result: 在T1DEXI数据集的348名参与者上训练，74名参与者上评估。在240分钟预测范围内，PhysioSeq2Seq实现平均绝对误差39.28 mg/dL，平均误差-10.62 mg/dL。相比递归LSTM偏差减少13.89 mg/dL，相比ODE数字孪生平均绝对误差减少28.62 mg/dL。

Conclusion: 消除架构反馈并注入患者匹配的生理状态是T1D长期血糖预测的有效且具有临床意义的策略，证明了混合方法在解决长期预测问题上的优越性。

Abstract: Accurate long-horizon glucose forecasting is critical for automated insulin delivery systems, which help people with type 1 diabetes (T1D) manage their glucose and avoid dangerous hypoglycemia. However, standard recursive long short-term memory (LSTM) networks suffer from systematic negative bias at longer horizons due to error compounding, while purely mechanistic ordinary differential equation (ODE) models fail to generalize across individuals when parameterized at the population level. We propose PhysioSeq2Seq, a hybrid architecture that combines patient-specific physiological modeling with a sequence-to-sequence (Seq2Seq) LSTM. For each glucose segment, twin matching searches a population of 300 parameterized digital twins to identify the best-fitting physiological match from a 3-hour continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) history. The 10 internal ODE state variables of the matched twin are injected as exogenous covariates into both the encoder and decoder of the Seq2Seq LSTM. This simultaneous 48-step prediction strategy eliminates recursive error compounding, while the ODE features provide a physics-grounded constraint that bounds long-horizon drift within physiologically plausible ranges. PhysioSeq2Seq was trained on CGM and insulin data from 348 participants in the Type 1 Diabetes Exercise Initiative (T1DEXI) dataset and evaluated on 74 held-out participants. At the 240-minute horizon, PhysioSeq2Seq achieves a mean absolute error of 39.28 mg/dL and a mean error of -10.62 mg/dL, reducing bias by 13.89 mg/dL over the recursive LSTM and reducing mean absolute error by 28.62 mg/dL over the ODE-based digital twin. These results show that eliminating architectural feedback and injecting patient-matched physiological states is an effective and clinically meaningful strategy for long-horizon glucose forecasting in T1D.

</details>


### [110] [SE-GA: Memory-Augmented Self-Evolution for GUI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16883)
*Shilong Jin,Lanjun Wang,Zhuosheng Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SE-GA框架，通过分层记忆结构和自改进机制解决GUI智能体在多步任务中的上下文受限和策略静态问题，在多个基准测试中取得SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的自主GUI智能体在执行多步任务时面临两大瓶颈：受限的上下文窗口导致无法充分利用历史信息；静态策略难以适应动态变化的环境，导致任务完成率受限。

Method: 提出SE-GA框架，包含两个核心组件：(1)测试时记忆扩展(TTME)，通过动态检索情节记忆、语义记忆和经验记忆来提供关键上下文，支持长期规划；(2)记忆增强自进化(MASE)训练流程，利用TTME收集的数据来稳定和增强智能体的基础策略，实现持续学习。

Result: 在离线和在线基准测试中取得SOTA性能：ScreenSpot数据集成功率达89.0%，AndroidControl-High数据集达75.8%；在AndroidWorld基准测试上显著提升，证明了在动态环境中的强泛化能力。

Conclusion: SE-GA框架通过集成分层记忆结构和迭代自改进机制，有效解决了GUI智能体在多步任务中的核心挑战，实现了更好的长期规划和环境适应性，为构建更强大的GUI智能体提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Autonomous Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents often struggle with multi-step tasks due to constrained context windows and static policies that fail to adapt to dynamic environments. To address these limitations, this work proposes the Self-Evolving GUI Agent (SE-GA), a novel framework that integrates hierarchical memory structures with an iterative self-improvement mechanism. At the core of our approach is Test-Time Memory Extension (TTME), which facilitates long-term planning by dynamically retrieving episodic, semantic, and experiential memories to provide salient contexts during inference. To ensure continuous learning, we introduce Memory-Augmented Self-Evolution (MASE), which is a training pipeline that adopts the data collected by TTME to stabilize and enhance the agent's foundational policy. Extensive evaluations across both offline and online benchmarks demonstrate SE-GA achieves state-of-the-art performance, reaching success rates of 89.0\% on ScreenSpot and 75.8\% on the challenging AndroidControl-High dataset. Furthermore, significant improvements on the AndroidWorld benchmark highlight the superior generalization to dynamic environments. Open source code: https://github.com/jinshilong-dev/SE-GA

</details>


### [111] [Tensor Channel Equivariant Graph Neural Networks for Molecular Polarizability Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16891)
*Jean Philip Filling,Daniel Franzen,Michael Wand*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种张量通道等变图神经网络，通过在消息传递过程中传播目标对齐的张量特征来预测分子极化率张量，在保持参数量和推理速度优势的同时，优于现有的PaiNN基线和MACE模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的张量值分子性质预测方法通常仅在输出层构建张量结构，未能充分利用张量目标的对称性和物理特性。对于极化率张量这类具有明确对称性结构的物理量，需要在整个网络中传播目标对齐的张量特征以提高预测精度。

Method: 基于PaiNN架构构建张量通道等变图神经网络。在隐藏表示中引入显式的对称二阶张量通道，与极化率的各向同性和各向异性分量分解对齐。使用几何动机的张量基在消息传递过程中传播张量结构，采用与极化率张量各向异性部分匹配的无迹目标参数化方法。

Result: 在QM7-X优化几何结构上，该方法在全张量和各向异性误差方面均低于PaiNN风格输出基线和介电MACE基线。在相同训练条件和几乎相同的参数数量下，该方法优于MACE且推理速度显著更快。消融研究表明性能提升来源于显式张量传播和无迹目标参数化的组合。在学习方向性特征之间的相互作用中获得了最佳结果。

Conclusion: 对于结构化张量值目标，在整个网络中传播目标对齐的张量特征能够优于仅在输出层构建张量的方法和更通用的更高阶等变模型，为分子性质预测提供了新的架构设计思路。

Abstract: We introduce a tensor-channel equivariant graph neural network for direct prediction of molecular polarizability tensors. Building on the efficient PaiNN architecture, we augment the hidden representation with explicit symmetric rank-2 tensor channels aligned with the decomposition of polarizability into isotropic and anisotropic components. In contrast to approaches that construct tensor outputs only at readout, our model propagates tensor structure throughout message passing using geometrically motivated tensor bases. This yields a target-aligned architecture for tensor-valued molecular prediction.
  On optimized QM7-X geometries, the proposed model achieves lower full-tensor and anisotropic error than both a PaiNN-style readout baseline and a dielectric MACE baseline under matched training conditions and at nearly identical parameter count. In this controlled setting, it also outperforms MACE while remaining substantially faster at inference. Ablation studies show that the gain does not arise from increased capacity alone, but from the combination of explicit tensor propagation and a traceless target parameterization matched to the anisotropic part of the polarizability tensor. Among the tensor bases considered, the strongest results are obtained from interactions between learned directional features, indicating that these are particularly effective for modeling molecular polarizability. Rotational equivariance tests further confirm that all compared models are numerically equivariant, so the observed improvements are attributable to better learning of the target tensor itself. Overall, our results show that for structured tensor-valued targets, propagating target-aligned tensor features can outperform both readout-only tensor construction and a more general higher-order equivariant model in the present training setting.

</details>


### [112] [ArtifactLinker: Linking Scientific Artifacts for Automatic State-of-the-Art Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16902)
*Haofei Yu,Jiaxuan You,Peter Clark,Bodhisattwa Prasad Majumder,Kyle Richardson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ArtifactLinker框架，通过将HuggingFace建模为工件图，利用GNN和LLM自动发现数据集的最先进（SOTA）模型，并构建了ArtifactBench基准进行评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着HuggingFace等平台的快速发展，研究者可以访问大量模型和数据集等科学工件。然而，如何利用现有工件自动发现给定数据集的最先进（SOTA）模型仍是一个关键挑战。

Method: 提出ArtifactLinker两阶段框架：第一阶段使用图神经网络（GNN）或图增强的大语言模型（LLM）对有前景的未观测模型-数据集链接进行排序；第二阶段通过基于LLM的智能体进行编码实验来验证排名靠前的链接。同时构建了包含14,053个工件和51,337个关系的ArtifactBench基准。

Result: 实验结果表明：（1）现有工件之间的图结构对缺失链接预测有效；（2）ArtifactLinker的端到端排序和验证能够发现潜在的SOTA结果和研究见解。

Conclusion: 通过将模型和数据集建模为工件图并结合图结构学习与大语言模型，可以有效解决自动SOTA发现问题，为研究者发现潜在的最先进模型提供了有效途径。

Abstract: Scientific artifacts such as models and datasets are foundations for research. With the rapid growth of platforms like HuggingFace, researchers now have access to a large number of artifacts. Yet, a key challenge remains: how can we automatically discover the state-of-the-art (SOTA) model for a given dataset by fully leveraging existing artifacts? We formalize this task as automatic SOTA discovery by modeling HuggingFace as an artifact graph, where nodes are models/datasets and edges represent evaluations. We propose ArtifactLinker, a two-stage framework: (1) ranking promising unobserved model--dataset links using Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) or graph-augmented Large Language Models (LLMs), and (2) verifying top-ranked links via coding experiments with LLM-based agents. We further introduce a benchmark named ArtifactBench with 14,053 artifacts and 51,337 relations to evaluate the performance of both stages. Results show that (1) graph structures between existing artifacts are effective for missing link prediction; (2) end-to-end ranking and verification with ArtifactLinker help discover potential SOTA results and research insights.

</details>


### [113] [AIM: Adversarial Information Masking for Faithfulness Evaluation of Saliency Maps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16905)
*Chia-Ying Hsieh,Hsin-Yuan Fang,Chun-Shu Wei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了对抗性信息掩码（AIM）框架，用于更可靠地评估显著性方法的忠实度，解决了现有评估方法中掩码操作引入偏差的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的后验显著性方法评估方法存在缺陷：零掩码可能产生分布外伪影，而基于插值的掩码可能保留残差预测信息，导致评估结果不可靠。需要一种能消除掩码操作偏差的评估框架。

Method: 提出对抗性信息掩码（AIM）框架，用输入对抗样本的特征值替换选定的特征，并通过比较互补掩码顺序下的性能退化来评估显著性图的忠实度。同时引入随机归因偏差和解释方法忠实度排名稳定性作为可靠性指标。

Result: 在图像、音频和EEG任务上的实验表明，AIM相比零掩码和插值掩码减少了掩码诱导的偏差，并揭示了有符号和无符号归因之间存在模态依赖性差异。

Conclusion: AIM框架能够更可靠地评估显著性方法的忠实度，减少了传统掩码方法引入的偏差，为跨模态的神经网络解释提供了更准确的评估工具。

Abstract: Post-hoc saliency methods are widely used to interpret deep neural networks, but their faithfulness is difficult to evaluate reliably. Existing evaluations mask features according to saliency-induced feature ordering and measure performance degradation, but this degradation can be confounded by the masking operator: zero masking may create out-of-distribution artifacts, while interpolation-based masking may preserve residual predictive information. We propose Adversarial Information Masking (AIM), a saliency-guided adversarial feature replacement framework for evaluating both saliency-map faithfulness and masking-operator reliability. AIM replaces selected features with values from an adversarial counterpart of the input and compares degradation under complementary masking orders. We assess reliability using random-attribution bias and stability of explanation-method faithfulness rankings. Experiments on image, audio, and EEG tasks suggest that AIM reduces masking-induced bias compared with zero and interpolation-based masking, while revealing modality-dependent differences between signed and unsigned attributions.

</details>


### [114] [Emulating the Forced Response of Climate Models with Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16929)
*Graham Clyne,Julia Kaltenborn,Peer Nowack,Claire Monteleoni,Anasatase Charantonis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究开发了一个深度学习模拟器，能够在多种气候强迫条件下生成全球气候模型的输出，成功预测了训练中未见的SSP情景，并验证了包含多种强迫因子对捕捉长期大气趋势的重要性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全球气候模型是模拟气候变化及其影响的关键工具，但运行成本极高，难以满足大集合模拟的需求以应对内部变率和情景不确定性。尽管近期研究表明机器学习可以捕捉气候模型动态，但需要开发能够处理多种气候强迫（如CO₂、甲烷、气溶胶等）并泛化到未见情景的深度学习模拟器。

Method: 研究团队训练了一个深度学习模型，使用多个共享社会经济路径（SSPs）的数据，并将多种气候强迫因子（包括二氧化碳、甲烷、一氧化二氮、硫酸盐气溶胶和臭氧）作为条件输入。模型通过学习不同情景下的气候模型动态，能够生成训练期间未见的气候情景。研究结果通过与传统统计模拟器MESMER-M进行对比验证。

Result: 深度学习模拟器成功生成了训练期间未见过的SSP情景，验证结果表明其能够有效捕捉气候模型在多种强迫条件下的动态变化。消融实验揭示了包含多种不同强迫因子对于深度学习模拟器准确再现长期大气趋势的重要性，单一或有限的强迫因子不足以完全表征气候系统的长期演变。

Conclusion: 该研究证明了深度学习方法在气候建模领域的潜力，能够以较低的计算成本生成可靠的气候情景模拟。研究强调了在构建气候模拟器时需要综合考虑多种气候强迫因子，这为未来开发高效的气候模型替代工具提供了重要指导，有助于支持气候影响评估和决策制定。

Abstract: Global climate models are essential tools to simulate past and potential future pathways of climate change, as well as associated climate impacts. Shared Socioeconomic Pathways (SSPs) describe a range of future scenarios of global economic and demographic development. These SSPs are intrinsically linked to changes in climate forcings, the external drivers, such as greenhouse gas and aerosol emissions, which in turn lead to the human impact on the energy balance of the Earth over time. These forcings are fundamental boundary conditions in climate models in order to gain insight into the potential climatic impacts of these changes described by each SSP. Running a climate model, however, is extremely computationally expensive, conflicting with the need for large ensembles of simulations for each model to give, e.g., more robust estimates in the presence of internal variability (the inherent, chaotic fluctuations within the climate system) and scenario uncertainty. Recent research has demonstrated the ability to capture climate model dynamics using machine learning when conditioned on forcings from different climatic scenarios. We here train a Deep Learning (DL) model on multiple SSPs and successfully generate scenarios unseen during training. Our emulator is validated against MESMER-M, a statistical emulator of land surface temperature. Our research demonstrates the capacity to generate such changing climate states in response to a variety of simultaneous climate forcings (e.g., carbon dioxide, methane, nitrous oxide, sulphate aerosols, and ozone). In particular, our ablation studies underline a need to include a range of different forcings to represent long-term atmospheric trends with a DL emulator.

</details>


### [115] [Extending Pretrained 10-Second ECG Foundation Models to Longer Horizons](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16975)
