*Wei Tang,Jinpei Han,Kangning Cui,Mattia Carletti,Fredrik K. Gustafsson,Shreyank N Gowda,Patitapaban Palo,Anshul Thakur,Lei Clifton,Jean-michel Morel,Raymond H. Chan,David A. Clifton,Xiao Gu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个参数高效的框架，通过引入轻量级插件模块，将预训练的10秒心电图基础模型扩展到更长且时长可变的心电信号处理任务，在多个长时程任务上优于滑动窗口和池化基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的心电图基础模型通常在标准的10秒心电图片段上预训练，在临床应用中表现出强大的迁移能力。然而，实际应用中常产生更长且时长可变的记录，这些10秒模型缺乏跨时间聚合信息的内置机制。将其扩展到更长时间跨度面临两个挑战：输入长度差异导致的结构不兼容性，以及限制有意义时间聚合的语义挑战。

Method: 作者提出了一个参数高效框架，无需重新训练骨干网络即可扩展预训练的心电图基础模型。在冻结的预训练10秒模型引导下，引入轻量级插件模块，通过两种互补方式扩展模型：（i）结构兼容的长序列处理；（ii）语义驱动的时间建模。

Result: 在多个长时程心电图任务、数据集和基础模型骨干上的实验表明，该方法能够实现从预训练快照模型的稳健长时程扩展，持续优于滑动窗口和池化基线方法，同时保持很强的参数效率。

Conclusion: 该框架成功解决了预训练心电图模型从固定10秒输入向长时程可变长度输入的扩展问题，为实际临床应用中的长时程心电图分析提供了有效的解决方案，且具有良好的参数效率和泛化能力。

Abstract: Electrocardiogram (ECG) foundation models pretrained on typical diagnostic 10-second ECG segments, have demonstrated strong transferability across a range of clinical applications. However, many real-world applications produce recordings that are typically longer, and are varied in duration during inference time. These 10-second models have no built-in way to combine information across time. Extending them to longer horizons introduces two challenges: structural incompatibilities arising from input-length disparities, and semantic challenges that limit meaningful temporal aggregation. We propose a parameter-efficient framework that extends pretrained ECG foundation models to longer and variable-length ECGs without retraining the backbone. Guided by a frozen pretrained 10-second model, we introduce a lightweight plug-in module that extends the model in two complementary ways: (i) structurally compatible long-sequence processing and (ii) semantically informed temporal modeling. Experiments on multiple long-horizon ECG tasks, datasets, and foundation model backbones demonstrate that our method enables robust long-horizon extension from pretrained snapshot models, consistently outperforming sliding-window and pooling-based baselines with strong parameter efficiency.

</details>


### [116] [Decision-Aware Proximal Bridge Learning for Optimal Treatment Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16989)
*Tomàs Garriga,Alejandro Almodóvar,Axel Brando,Gerard Sanz,Eduard Serrahima de Cambra,Juan Parras*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种针对 proximal 因果推断的策略目标加权桥接损失方法，通过强调决策相关区域来改进连续动作下的个体化治疗选择，并在存在隐藏混淆的情况下实现了更优的决策效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在连续动作的个体化治疗选择中，传统方法通常估计全局因果响应面，但在决策相关区域的估计精度不足，导致次优决策。尽管在无混淆设定中已有决策感知方法，但在存在隐藏混淆的 proximal 因果推断场景下，这一问题仍未被充分探索。

Method: 提出策略目标加权桥接损失（policy-targeted weighted bridge loss），重点强调决策相关的治疗区域，同时保持全局稳定性；基于此框架设计了多种 proximal 桥接求解器的决策感知变体，构建了包含加权桥接估计、响应面投影、策略更新和权重精炼的迭代算法。

Result: 理论证明：所提加权桥接损失能够通过加权不适定常数（weighted ill-posedness constant）控制治疗选择后悔（regret）。实验验证：决策感知加权在多种桥接求解器上均降低了后悔值，表明在 proximal 设定下改进了治疗选择效果。

Conclusion: 该研究成功填补了 proximal 因果推断中治疗选择问题的空白，提出的决策感知框架在理论和实验层面均显示出优越性，为存在隐藏混淆场景下的最优决策提供了有效解决方案。

Abstract: Individualized treatment selection with continuous actions requires accurate causal response estimation in decision-relevant regions, rather than uniformly over the entire action space. Estimating a global causal response surface and then choosing the treatment that maximizes it can therefore be suboptimal, since standard estimation objectives allocate modeling effort according to the observed treatment distribution rather than the regions that determine the optimal decision. While decision-aware approaches have been studied in unconfounded settings, this problem remains underexplored in proximal causal inference, where proxy variables and bridge functions enable identification under suitable assumptions even in the presence of hidden confounding. Despite recent progress, proximal methods have primarily focused on treatment-effect and potential-outcome estimation rather than treatment selection and optimal decision-making. To bridge this gap, we introduce a policy-targeted weighted bridge loss that emphasizes decision-relevant treatment regions while retaining global stabilization. We prove a regret bound showing that the proposed weighted bridge loss controls treatment-selection regret through a weighted ill-posedness constant. We instantiate the framework in decision-aware variants of several proximal bridge solvers, yielding practical algorithms that alternate between weighted bridge estimation, response-surface projection, policy update, and weight refinement. Empirically, we find that decision-aware weighting reduces regret across several bridge solvers, suggesting improved treatment selection in proximal settings.

</details>


### [117] [Ranking-Aware Calibration for Reliable Multimodal Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16999)
*Peng Cui,Boyao Yang,Jun Zhu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出RAC框架，利用群组RL训练中已有的比较信号来监督置信度，在无需额外标注的情况下同时提升了多模态推理的准确性和校准性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有强化学习后训练方法虽然提升了视觉语言模型的推理准确性，但置信度校准效果差。正确性奖励无法区分自信错误与不确定错误，也无法将置信度与视觉证据质量关联，在输入受损或模糊时问题尤为严重。

Method: 提出Ranking-Aware Calibration (RAC)框架，包含两个损失函数：(1)排序感知群组损失，强制同一提示下更好的rollout获得更高置信度；(2)干净-受损成对损失，强制置信度随视觉证据退化而衰减。两者无需外部置信度标注，自然集成到群组RL后训练中。

Result: 在Qwen2.5-VL和InternVL-3.5骨干网络上，于6个多模态推理基准（干净和受损输入）评估。排序感知损失通过教导策略区分优劣推理显著提升了任务准确性；成对损坏损失降低了受损输入下的校准误差。二者结合在所有测试骨干上实现最佳校准，同时在多数设置下提升准确性。

Conclusion: RAC框架通过利用群组RL中已有的排序信号，在不增加标注成本的前提下，成功解决了视觉语言模型的置信度校准问题，同时进一步提升了推理准确性。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning post-training has substantially improved the reasoning accuracy of vision-language models, yet the resulting policies remain poorly calibrated. Terminal correctness rewards provide no gradient that penalizes confident errors more than uncertain ones and no signal that ties confidence to the quality of visual evidence, a gap that becomes especially severe under corrupted or ambiguous inputs where models continue to report high confidence on incorrect answers. We introduce Ranking-Aware Calibration (RAC), a training-time framework that supervises confidence using two comparison signals that group-based RL already produces at no additional labeling cost. The ranking-aware group loss enforces that a better rollout receives higher confidence than a worse one within the same prompt. The clean--corrupted pairwise loss enforces that confidence attenuates as visual evidence degrades. Because the ranking signal forces the policy to distinguish between correct and incorrect reasoning paths, it also reinforces task accuracy beyond what correctness rewards alone produce. Both losses require no external confidence annotations and integrate naturally with group-based RL post-training. We instantiate RAC on Qwen2.5-VL and InternVL-3.5 backbones and evaluate on six multimodal reasoning benchmarks under clean and corrupted inputs. Empirical results show that the ranking-aware loss substantially improves task accuracy by teaching the policy to discriminate between better and worse reasoning, while the pairwise corruption loss reduces calibration error under degraded inputs. Their combination achieves the best calibration across all tested backbones while improving accuracy in the majority of settings.

</details>


### [118] [BoLT: A Benchmark to Democratize Black-box Optimization Research for Expensive LLM Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17000)
*Ruth Wan Theng Chew,Zhiliang Chen,Apivich Hemachandra,Bryan Kian Hsiang Low*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了BoLT，首个面向大语言模型（LLM）优化的基准测试，旨在通过轻量级代理模型 democratize LLM 研究给黑盒优化（BBO）社区，发现现有方法在LLM任务上存在不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM训练与推理配置（如超参数、数据混合、提示词）的优化对性能至关重要，但实践中常采用启发式方法导致次优结果。虽然贝叶斯优化等黑盒优化方法具有潜力，但LLM的高昂成本使BBO研究者难以评估新方法，且现有基准多为合成函数或小规模数据集，无法反映现代LLM优化挑战。

Method: 引入BoLT基准，涵盖多保真度、多目标、异方差噪声和高维搜索空间等LLM优化问题。每个问题基于真实实验数据，通过拟合数千次真实LLM实验结果的轻量级代理模型实现，确保可重现性和可访问性，降低研究门槛。

Result: 对广泛的BO和BBO方法进行基准测试，发现选定的贝叶斯优化方法在各项任务中持续优于其他方法，同时揭示了现有BBO方法在LLM任务上的差距，验证了BoLT的有效性和实用性。

Conclusion: BoLT为BBO社区提供了首个LLM中心基准，降低了研究门槛，暴露了现有方法不足，强调了BBO社区需要现代化基准以推动针对现代LLM任务的优化方法发展。

Abstract: Optimization of LLM training and inference configurations, such as hyperparameters, data mixtures, and prompts, is critical to performance, but it is often approached heuristically in practice, leading to potentially suboptimal outcomes. By framing them as noisy, expensive, and derivative-free optimization problems, Bayesian optimization (BO) and other black-box optimization (BBO) methods offer a promising yet underexplored direction for principled, sample-efficient methods. However, LLM training and inference costs are prohibitively high for most of the BBO research community, and new methods are often only evaluated on synthetic test functions and small-scale datasets that fail to capture the challenges of modern LLM optimization problems. This impedes the development of BBO methods and makes it difficult to assess their effectiveness on modern LLM tasks. We introduce BoLT, the first LLM-centric benchmark that democratizes LLM research for the BBO community. BoLT is released at https://github.com/chewwt/bolt. BoLT covers broad and well-motivated LLM optimization problems, involving multi-fidelity, multi-objective, heteroscedastic noise, and high-dimensional search spaces. Each problem in BoLT is grounded in real experimental data and made fully reproducible and accessible through lightweight surrogate models fitted to the results of thousands of real LLM experiments. We benchmark BoLT against an extensive range of BO and BBO methods, showing that selected BO methods consistently outperform others across tasks and highlighting gaps in existing BBO methods on LLM tasks, underscoring the need to modernize benchmarks for the BBO community.

</details>


### [119] [Learning-Zone Energy: Online Data Selection for Efficient RL Post-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17003)
*Peng Cui,Boyao Yang,Jun Zhu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出LZE框架，通过基于学习活跃区的数据选择策略，仅使用40%训练数据即可匹配或超越全量数据基线，同时减少约36%的训练计算量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的强化学习后训练方法（如GRPO和DAPO）在数学推理任务中，将计算资源近乎均匀地分配给所有样本，导致在已掌握样本或远超模型能力样本上浪费大量计算资源，存在根本性的低效问题。

Method: 提出Learning-Zone Energy (LZE)框架：1) 定义一个闭式学习区域能量分数，融合初始难度锚点、归一化结果不确定性和通过率动量三个互补信号，生成与策略梯度更新幅度对齐的标量分数；2) 引入带重放机制的前向剪枝器，跳过持续已解决样本的展开生成，同时周期性检测遗忘现象。

Result: 在Qwen系列模型(1.5B-8B)上，GSM8K、MATH和DAPO-MATH数据集验证表明：每步仅保留40%训练数据，即可匹配或超越全量数据基线；在分布外测试集上提升显著（AIME25 +45.9%，AMC23 +18.2%）；估计减少36%的训练FLOPs。

Conclusion: LZE框架成功实现了强化学习后训练的计算高效化，通过将计算集中在模型的主动学习前沿区域，在不牺牲性能的前提下大幅降低了训练成本，为大规模语言模型数学推理能力的高效训练提供了新范式。

Abstract: Reinforcement Learning (RL) post-training has emerged as the dominant paradigm for eliciting mathematical reasoning in Large Language Models (LLMs), yet prevailing techniques such as GRPO and DAPO distribute rollout and gradient budgets nearly uniformly across prompts, squandering compute on samples that are already mastered or remain far beyond the model's current capability. To address this fundamental inefficiency, we propose Learning-Zone Energy (LZE), a theoretically grounded, fully online data selection framework that concentrates computation on the model's active learning frontier. At its core, we define a closed-form Learning-Zone Energy Score that fuses three complementary signals, an initial-difficulty anchor, a normalized outcome-uncertainty term, and a pass-rate momentum, into a single scalar that is provably aligned with the expected magnitude of group-relative policy gradient updates. A forward pruner with replay further reduces wall-clock time cost by skipping rollout generation for persistently solved prompts while periodically checking for forgetting. Evaluated on Qwen-family models (1.5B-8B) across GSM8K, MATH and DAPO-MATH, our method retains only 40% of the training data per step yet matches or surpasses full-data baselines, with especially pronounced out-of-distribution gains on AIME25 (+45.9%) and AMC23 (+18.2%), alongside an estimated 36% reduction in training FLOPs. Our code is available at https://github.com/Stellaris167/LZE.

</details>


### [120] [When Dynamics Shift, Robust Task Inference Wins: Offline Imitation Learning with Behavior Foundation Models Revisited](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17017)
*Rishabh Agrawal,Rahul Jain,Ashutosh Nayyar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了首个能在任务推理阶段适应动态环境变化的鲁棒行为基础模型框架，无需修改预训练过程，仅利用单一环境离线数据即可实现鲁棒策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的行为基础模型假设环境动力学固定，在现实世界中面临摩擦、驱动或传感器噪声等动态变化时鲁棒性不足。作者旨在解决BFM在动力学偏移下的适应性问题，以提高其在动态环境中的实用性。

Method: 将BFM的任务推理建模为鲁棒极小极大优化问题，使其能够在不修改预训练的情况下适应最坏情况下的动力学扰动。该框架仅依赖来自单一标称环境的离线数据。

Result: 该方法在动力学偏移场景下显著优于标准BFM和鲁棒离线模仿学习基线方法，证明了在任务推理阶段即可实现鲁棒策略的可行性。

Conclusion: 本研究证明了无需修改预训练、仅在任务推理阶段即可获得对动力学偏移鲁棒的策略，提升了行为基础模型在动态环境中的实用性，为BFM的实际应用提供了新思路。

Abstract: Behavior Foundation Models (BFMs) enable scalable imitation learning (IL) by pretraining task-agnostic representations that can be rapidly adapted to new tasks. However, existing BFMs assume fixed environment dynamics, limiting their robustness under real-world shifts such as changes in friction, actuation, or sensor noise. We address this by formulating BFM task-inference as a robust minimax optimization problem, enabling adaptation to worst-case dynamics perturbations without modifying pretraining. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first BFM-based framework that achieves robustness to dynamics shifts while relying solely on offline data from a single nominal environment. Our approach significantly outperforms standard BFM and robust offline IL baselines under dynamics shifts. These results demonstrate that robust policy can be achieved entirely at task-inference time, improving the practicality of BFMs in dynamic settings.

</details>


### [121] [Why Do Reasoning Models Lose Coverage? The Role of Data and Forks in the Road](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17026)
*Ngoc-Hieu Nguyen,Parshin Shojaee,Phuc Minh Nguyen,Nan Zhang,Chandan K Reddy,Khoa D Doan,Rui Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了基于SFT后训练的推理模型中出现的“推理收缩”现象（pass@k性能下降），发现该现象与训练数据中的“决策点”场景密切相关，并提出通过针对性数据合成和多样性解码机制来缓解这一问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近年来，大型语言模型通过专门的微调程序在复杂任务上表现出色，但研究发现这些方法在提高pass@1准确率的同时，会导致pass@k相对于基础模型下降，即“覆盖收缩”现象。本文旨在探究SFT后训练下推理收缩现象的成因。

Method: 提出假设：推理收缩现象由微调数据的特性驱动，特别是“决策点”或“路径分叉”场景，即模型面对具有多条有效推理路径的难以辨别的模式。设计受控案例研究来模拟决策点设置，包括图分支中的难以辨别节点和推理模式，并跟踪这些设置下的后训练动态。

Result: 研究发现收缩现象与训练数据中决策点场景的普遍性密切相关。通过针对性的决策点数据合成设计和更系统的多样性鼓励解码机制，可以部分缓解收缩行为。

Conclusion: 研究确定了以数据为中心的因素是推理模型收缩的关键驱动因素，并强调多样性感知设计是控制该现象的有效手段。

Abstract: Recent progress in large language models has led to the emergence of reasoning models, which have shown strong performance on complex tasks through specialized fine-tuning procedures. While these methods reliably improve pass@1 accuracy, prior works have observed that they show a coverage shrinkage behavior, where pass@k degrades relative to the base model. In this paper, we investigate the reasoning shrinkage arise under SFT-based post-training. We hypothesize that this behavior is driven by properties of the fine-tuning data, specifically related to decision points or "forks in the road" scenarios where model faces indecipherable patterns with multiple valid reasoning paths. To test this hypothesis, we design controlled case studies that simulate such decision-point settings, spanning indecipherable nodes in graph branching, and reasoning modes. By tracking post-training dynamics in these settings, we find that the shrinkage phenomenon is tightly correlated with the prevalence of decision-point scenarios in the training data. We also demonstrate that this shrinkage behavior can be partially mitigated through targeted data synthesis design of decision-points, and a more systematic diversity-encouraging decoding mechanism. Our findings identify data-centric factors as a key driver of shrinkage in reasoning models and highlight diversity-aware designs as an effective lever for controlling it.

</details>


### [122] [Privacy Policy Enforcement Guardrails for Data-Sensitive Retrieval-Augmented Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17034)
*Osama Zafar,Alexander Nemecek,Yiqian Zhang,Wenbiao Li,Debargha Ganguly,Vikash Singh,Vipin Chaudhary,Erman Ayday*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了PPE框架（T3+OCSVM检测器），用于解决RAG系统中标准PII过滤器遗漏上下文数据泄露的问题，在边界安全测试中AUROC达0.93+，误报率降低44-55个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准PII过滤器在RAG系统中经常遗漏上下文数据泄露，例如非受监管的属性簇集体识别个人，传统方法无法有效处理这类边界安全问题。

Method: 提出隐私策略执行（PPE）框架，采用双一类密度估计器配合融合文本嵌入和校准拒绝区域处理分布外输入；使用跨医学、金融、法律领域的轴分层多LLM合成数据管道；训练T3+OCSVM检测器处理安全和边界安全数据。

Result: T3+OCSVM检测器在边界AUROC达0.93+，误报率降低44-55个百分点，保持毫秒级延迟；相比监督MLP分类器的高拒绝率和14B参数LLM评判器的延迟和校准问题，框架具有更优的操作适用性。

Conclusion: 该方法为任何合成数据训练的分类器提供了稳健的压力测试标准，有效解决了RAG系统中上下文数据泄露检测的挑战。

Abstract: Standard PII filters often miss contextual data leakage in RAG systems, such as non-regulated attribute clusters that collectively identify individuals. We introduce a Privacy Policy Enforcement (PPE) framework using dual one-class density estimators with fused text embeddings and a calibrated abstain region for out-of-distribution inputs. Using an axis-stratified, multi-LLM synthetic data pipeline across medicine, finance, and law, we found that traditional Gaussian Mixture baselines fail on borderline-safe stress tests by focusing on linguistic register rather than content.
  Our proposed T3+OCSVM detector, trained on safe and borderline-safe data, achieves a borderline AUROC of 0.93+ while reducing false positives by 44-55 percentage points and maintaining millisecond latency. Compared to supervised MLP classifiers or 14B-parameter LLM judges, our framework offers superior operational suitability, as the former suffers from high abstention rates and the latter from latency and calibration issues. This methodology provides a robust stress-testing standard for any synthetic-data-trained classifier.

</details>


### [123] [D$^2$Evo: Dual Difficulty-Aware Self-Evolution for Data-Efficient Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17037)
*Ru Zhang,Renda Li,Ziyu Ma,Weijie Qiu,Chongyang Tao,Yong Wang,Xiangxiang Chu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了D²Evo框架，通过双重难度感知的自演化强化学习方法，解决了有效数据稀缺和动态难度偏移问题，在数学推理任务上显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强化学习训练大语言模型时，需要中等难度的训练样本，但面临两个核心挑战：1）有效数据稀缺（中等难度样本稀少）；2）动态难度偏移（随着模型能力提升，原本中等难度的样本变得简单）。现有方法通过生成训练样本缓解稀缺问题，但存在无锚点生成、忽略协同演化、难度不匹配等缺陷。

Method: 提出D²Evo（双重难度感知自演化强化学习）框架。该方法采用迭代式策略，在每轮迭代中：1）根据当前Solver的能力挖掘中等难度锚点；2）训练Questioner生成适当难度级别的多样化问题；3）联合优化两个组件以实现渐进式推理能力提升。该方法实现了Solver和Questioner的协同演化。

Result: 在数学推理基准测试中，D²Evo以不到2K的真实数学样本超越了现有方法；在通用推理基准测试上展现出强大的泛化能力。

Conclusion: D²Evo通过双重难度感知的自演化机制，有效解决了强化学习训练样本稀缺和难度动态变化问题，实现了模型推理能力的持续提升，为LLM的强化学习训练提供了新的解决方案。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has demonstrated potential for enhancing reasoning in large language models (LLMs). However, effective RL training, which requires medium-difficulty training samples, faces two fundamental challenges: Effective Data Scarcity and Dynamic Difficulty Shifts, where medium-difficulty samples are scarce and become trivial as models improve. Existing methods mitigate this scarcity to some extent by generating training samples. However, these approaches suffer from anchor-free generation, ignoring co-evolution, and difficulty mismatch. To address these issues, we propose D$^2$Evo, a Dual Difficulty-aware self-Evolution RL framework. In each iteration, our method mines medium-difficulty anchors based on the current Solver's capability, trains the Questioner to generate diverse questions at appropriate difficulty levels, and jointly optimizes both components to enable progressive reasoning gains. Extensive experiments demonstrate that D$^2$Evo outperforms existing methods on mathematical reasoning benchmarks with fewer than 2K real mathematical samples, and exhibits strong generalization on general reasoning benchmarks.

</details>


### [124] [Privacy-Preserving Generation Fraud Detection for Distributed Photovoltaic Systems: A Solar Irradiance-Fused Federated Learning Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17039)
*Xiaolu Chen,Chenghao Huang,Yanru Zhang,Hao Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于联邦学习的隐私保护分布式光伏发电欺诈检测框架，通过共注意力机制融合多源数据，实现了在保护隐私的前提下优于现有最先进方法的检测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 住宅光伏系统的广泛普及带来了新的发电欺诈检测（PVG-FD）挑战。与传统关注用电侧的窃电检测不同，光伏发电固有的间歇性和不确定性使得PVG-FD更为复杂。此外，光伏系统的分布式特性导致集中式检测方法面临可扩展性和隐私泄露的问题，亟需一种既能保护隐私又能有效检测的新型框架。

Method: 提出了一种基于联邦学习（FL）的隐私保护分布式PVG-FD框架。该框架由公用事业公司管理多个家庭社区，每个社区配备本地检测器。技术上，利用共注意力机制融合光伏发电数据与气象数据以检测异常差异。框架通过聚合模型参数和原型实现跨社区协作，利用全局知识共享与本地优化，并通过原型对齐技术解决欺诈样本稀少导致的类别不平衡问题。

Result: 在真实住宅光伏数据集上的广泛实验表明，该方法在多种场景下均优于现有的最先进联邦学习方法。结果还验证了该框架在不同社区规模下具有良好的可扩展性，并且对类别不平衡问题表现出强大的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 所提出的框架成功解决了光伏发电欺诈检测中的隐私保护、可扩展性及数据不确定性难题，证明了分布式联邦学习在光伏系统欺诈检测领域的有效性和实用价值。

Abstract: The wide adoption of residential photovoltaic (PV) systems introduces new challenges for generation fraud detection (FD). Unlike traditional electricity theft detection, which focuses on electricity consumption-side behavior, PV generation fraud detection (PVG-FD) is complicated by the inherent intermittency and uncertainty of PV generation. The distributed nature of PV systems poses further challenges for centralized PVG-FD approaches due to scalability and privacy concerns. This paper develops a privacy-preserving distributed PVG-FD framework based on federated learning (FL). In this framework, a utility company manages multiple household communities, where each of which is equipped with a local detector. The framework integrates a novel detection model architecture with privacy-preserving global collaboration. Each community's local model fuses PV generation and weather data via a co-attention mechanism to detect discrepancies critical for PVG-FD. The FL framework enables cross-community collaboration by aggregating model parameters and prototypes, leveraging global knowledge sharing with local refinement while preserving privacy. It also uses prototype alignment to address class imbalance by enhancing fraud sample representation. Extensive experiments on a real-world residential PV dataset validate the effectiveness of the developed method and demonstrate that it outperforms state-of-the-art FL methods across various scenarios. The results also show its scalability across varying community sizes and strong robustness to class imbalance.

</details>


### [125] [1GC-7RC: One Graphic Card -- Seven Research Challenges! How Good Are AI Agents at Doing Your Job?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17046)
*Robin-Nico Kampa,Fabian Deuser,Anna Bößendörfer,Konrad Habel,Norbert Oswald*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了1GC-7RC基准，用于在单GPU和时间预算限制下评估自主AI编码代理在七个机器学习任务中从零设计、实现和训练模型的能力，并评估了七种编码代理的性能差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管自主AI编码代理在工业界和研究中被广泛采用，但目前缺乏一个标准化的基准来评估它们在不同领域从零开始设计、实现和训练模型的能力。

Method: 提出了1GC-7RC基准，包含七个ML任务（语言建模、图像分类、语义分割、图学习、表格预测、时间序列预测和文本分类）。每个任务提供锁定的数据准备和评估脚本以及基线训练脚本；代理只能修改训练代码，无法访问预训练权重（语义分割除外）和互联网，必须在单GPU上的任务特定时间预算（40-120分钟）内完成任务。评估了七个编码代理（五个专有和两个开源），每个代理-任务对进行5次运行。

Result: 实验结果显示代理之间存在显著的性能差异，揭示了它们在隐式ML知识、规划能力和时间预算管理方面的不同水平。基准、测试工具和所有评估工件已在GitHub上公开。

Conclusion: 该基准设计模块化，可扩展到新任务和领域，适应不同的GPU预算，并可用于研究多代理设置，为未来自主研究代理的研究提供了一个灵活的平台。

Abstract: Autonomous AI coding agents are becoming a core tool for ML practitioners in industry and research alike. Despite this growing adoption, no standardized benchmark exists to evaluate their ability to design, implement, and train models from scratch across diverse domains. We introduce **1GC-7RC** (*Single Graphic Card: Seven Research Challenges*), a benchmark comprising seven ML tasks spanning language modeling, image classification, semantic segmentation, graph learning, tabular prediction, time-series forecasting, and text classification. Each task provides a locked data-preparation and evaluation script together with a baseline training script; the agent may only modify the training code, has no access to pretrained weights (with one controlled exception for semantic segmentation), no internet access, and must complete each task within a task-specific wall-clock budget (40-120 minutes) on a single GPU. We evaluate seven coding agents: five proprietary (Claude Code with Sonnet 4.6, Opus 4.6, and Opus 4.7; Codex CLI with GPT 5.5; and OpenCode with Qwen 3.6+) and two open-source (OpenCode with Kimi K2.5, Kimi K2.6). Across 5 runs per agent-task pair, we report substantial performance differences that reveal varying levels of implicit ML knowledge, planning ability, and time-budget management. The benchmark, harness, and all evaluation artifacts are publicly available on GitHub at https://github.com/Strolchii/1GC-7RC-Benchmark to facilitate reproducible comparison of future agents. Because our benchmark design is modular, the benchmark can be extended to new tasks and domains, adapted to different GPU budgets, and used to study multi-agent settings, making it a flexible platform for future research on autonomous research agents.

</details>


### [126] [Learning Multi-Timescale Abstractions for Hierarchical Combinatorial Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17058)
*Vivienne Huiling Wang,Tinghuai Wang,Joni Pajarinen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于模型的层次化强化学习框架，通过结合潜在空间树搜索规划器和SMDP感知的世界模型，解决了序列随机组合优化(SSCO)问题中动作持续时间可变的挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 序列随机组合优化(SSCO)面临三大挑战：指数级大的动作空间、随机动态以及有限资源下的长视野决策。虽然层次化强化学习(HRL)提供了自然的分解方式，但高级策略处于半马尔可夫决策过程(SMDP)中，动作具有可变持续时间，这使得学习适合规划的世界模型变得困难。

Method: 提出了一种基于模型的层次化框架：1) 结合潜在空间树搜索规划器与SMDP感知的世界模型处理可变持续时间决策；2) 设计多时间尺度目标来构建潜在动态，使转移幅度反映抽象动作的有效时间尺度，实现自适应时间抽象下的高效前瞻；3) 联合学习子目标条件预算策略与世界模型，支持上下文感知的资源分配。

Result: 在具有挑战性的SSCO基准测试中，该方法优于强基线方法。

Conclusion: 该工作成功解决了SSCO问题中可变持续时间动作建模的核心难点，通过SMDP感知的世界模型和多时间尺度潜在动态实现了高效规划，为复杂组合优化问题提供了有效的解决方案。

Abstract: The combination of exponentially large action spaces, stochastic dynamics, and long-horizon decision-making under limited resources makes Sequential Stochastic Combinatorial Optimization (SSCO) particularly challenging for reinforcement learning. Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning (HRL) offers a natural decomposition, but it places the high-level policy in a Semi-Markov Decision Process (SMDP) where actions have variable durations, making it difficult to learn a world model that is suitable for planning. We introduce a model-based hierarchical framework for sequential stochastic combinatorial decision-making that directly addresses this issue. Our method combines a latent-space tree-search planner with an SMDP-aware world model for variable-duration decisions. A multi-timescale objective structures the latent dynamics so that transition magnitudes reflect the effective temporal scales of abstract actions, enabling efficient lookahead under adaptive temporal abstraction. We further learn a subgoal-conditioned budget policy jointly with the world model to support context-aware resource allocation. Across challenging SSCO benchmarks, our method outperforms strong baselines.

</details>


### [127] [Scale Determines Whether Language Models Organize Representation Geometry for Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17084)
*Weilun Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了Subspace PGA指标来测试语言模型表示空间的几何结构是否为预测任务而组织。发现中小模型在后期层丢失这种对齐，而大模型能保留，原因是少数主导方向迁移导致掩盖效应，移除后可恢复对齐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工具仅描述表示空间几何形状，但未探究这种形状的组织目的。距离而非激活承载语义信息，因此需要研究表示几何是否以及如何为预测任务而组织。

Method: 引入Subspace PGA度量指标，测试每层的距离结构是否比同等大小的随机子空间更紧密地对齐于反嵌入矩阵$W_U$的读出子空间。在7个Pythia模型（70M-6.9B参数）和3个跨家族模型上进行实验验证。

Result: 中间层的几何结构显著地为预测而组织（峰值z=9-24）。小模型（d≤1024）在训练后期逐渐丢失这种对齐，即使损失仍在改善；大模型（d≥2048）则在整个过程中保持对齐。这源于容量权衡：少数主导方向从$W_U$读出方向迁移，掩盖而非破坏底层的预测结构，移除这些方向后对齐恢复。

Conclusion: 模型规模不仅决定预测能力，还决定表示几何如何为预测而组织。频谱指标和损失曲线都无法捕捉这一区别，揭示了模型规模对表示几何组织方式的深层影响。

Abstract: In language models, what a representation encodes is determined by the geometry of its representation space: distances, not activations, carry meaning. Existing tools characterize the shape of this geometry but do not ask what that shape is organized for. We introduce Subspace PGA, a metric that tests whether a layer's distance structure aligns with the readout subspace of the unembedding matrix $W_U$ more than with random subspaces of equal size. Across seven Pythia models (70M--6.9B) and three cross-family models, intermediate geometry is significantly organized for prediction (peak $z = 9$--$24$), but the degree is scale-dependent: small models ($d \leq 1024$) progressively lose it at late layers during training -- even as loss keeps improving -- while large models ($d \geq 2048$) preserve it throughout. We trace this to a capacity trade-off: a few dominant directions migrate away from $W_U$'s readout, masking rather than destroying the predictive structure beneath, and removing them restores alignment. Neither spectral metrics nor loss curves capture this distinction. Scale thus determines not only how well a model predicts, but how its representation geometry is organized to do so.

</details>


### [128] [Mechanism Learning: Prototype-Anchored Mechanism Inference for Scientific Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17091)
*Qian Jiang,Liping Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种名为“机制学习”的新预测框架，通过估计当前活跃的局部机制来预测未来状态，在数据稀缺、长时域、非平稳动态等脆弱场景下显著优于直接状态预测方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学预测通常依赖直接状态预测，但该方法在数据稀缺、长时域、非平稳动态或高维复杂性等场景下变得脆弱。虽然原始状态轨迹对这些因素高度敏感，但潜在的局部演化规则往往表现出稳健的可复用性。

Method: 提出机制学习框架，将局部时空片段压缩为机制描述符，构建数据驱动的结构化机制空间；利用原型锚点（一组代表性机制）对局部规则空间进行稀疏覆盖，通过估计当前活跃的局部机制来预测未来状态。

Result: 在Burgers动力学、WeatherBench2和Lorenz96上评估，相比FNO、NODE、LSTM和储备池等方法，在脆弱场景下取得显著改进：提高了Burgers动力学的切换稳定性，在稀缺数据的WeatherBench2协议和中等复杂度Lorenz96中达到最先进性能；消融实验证实改进源于有限原型锚点而非单纯的潜在容量。

Conclusion: 机制学习作为复杂系统预测中有原则、稳健的替代方案，通过机制空间和原型锚点实现了比直接状态预测更可靠的预测，特别是在传统方法失效的脆弱场景下表现出色。

Abstract: Scientific forecasting typically relies on direct state prediction, an approach that grows brittle under data scarcity, extended horizons, non-stationary dynamics, or high-dimensional complexity. While raw state trajectories are highly sensitive in these regimes, underlying local evolution rules often exhibit robust reusability. We introduce mechanism learning, a framework that forecasts future states by estimating the currently active local mechanism. Our method compresses local spatiotemporal fragments into mechanism descriptors, forming a data-driven, structured mechanism space where proximity reflects similar local evolution rules. To ground these estimates in observed data, we utilize prototype anchors, a set of representative mechanisms that sparsely cover the space of local rules. We evaluate this approach on Burgers dynamics, WeatherBench2, and Lorenz96. Empirically, the learned mechanism spaces resist collapse and maintain strong local consistency. Compared to direct prediction and other models including FNO, NODE, LSTM, and reservoir-family methods, our framework demonstrates predictive gains in fragile regimes: it significantly improves switching stability in Burgers dynamics and achieves state-of-the-art performance both under the scarce-data fixed-horizon WeatherBench2 protocol and in intermediate-complexity Lorenz96. Ablation studies and drift diagnostics confirm that these improvements are driven by finite prototype anchoring rather than sheer latent capacity. Together, these results establish mechanism learning as a principled, robust alternative to direct state prediction in forecasting complex systems.

</details>


### [129] [Parallel Recursive LSTM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17108)
*Tristan Gaudreault,Yongyi Mao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出并行递归LSTM（PR-LSTM），通过平衡计算树上的递归非线性状态组合，将循环并行深度从线性降至对数级，在长序列建模中实现了强泛化能力并避免了注意力的二次方复杂度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer的自注意力机制存在二次方时间和内存开销，限制了长上下文场景的效率；而传统循环模型（如LSTM）虽然具有显式非线性状态更新和强状态跟踪能力，但其严格的顺序计算限制了并行性。研究旨在结合两者优势，在保留非线性门控状态表示的同时提升并行计算效率。

Method: 引入PR-LSTM分层循环架构，将传统的从左到右递归替换为平衡计算树上的递归非线性状态组合。首先将词元独立映射到隐状态，然后通过学习的门控组合块递归合并。该结构使用并行扫描的归约模式作为固定执行调度，而非假设关联递归。

Result: PR-LSTM在形式语言基准测试上实现了强序列长度泛化能力，解决了比标准RNN、LSTM和Transformer基线更多的任务，同时避免了注意力的二次方缩放问题。实验表明循环计算可以通过分层重组来暴露并行性，而无需将转移动力学限制为线性或关联形式。

Conclusion: 循环计算可以通过分层重组来暴露并行性，同时保持非线性门控状态表示，这为设计既高效又具有表达力的序列模型提供了新的思路。该工作表明无需将转移动力学限制为线性或关联形式即可实现并行化。

Abstract: Transformers have become the dominant architecture for sequence modeling by using self-attention to enable expressive and highly parallel processing. However, the resulting quadratic time and memory costs limit efficiency in long-context settings. Recurrent models such as LSTMs provide explicit nonlinear state updates and strong state-tracking capabilities, yet their strictly sequential computation limits parallelism. We introduce the Parallel Recursive LSTM (PR-LSTM), a hierarchical recurrent architecture that replaces left-to-right recurrence with recursive nonlinear state composition over a balanced computation tree. Tokens are first mapped independently to latent states, which are then recursively merged by a learned gated composition block. This structure uses the reduction pattern underlying parallel scans as a fixed execution schedule, rather than assuming an associative recurrence. As a result, PR-LSTM retains nonlinear gated state representations while reducing recurrent parallel depth from linear to logarithmic. Empirically, PR-LSTM achieves strong sequence-length generalization on formal-language benchmarks, solving more tasks than standard RNN, LSTM, and Transformer baselines, while avoiding the quadratic scaling of attention. These results suggest that recurrent computation can be reorganized hierarchically to expose parallelism without restricting the transition dynamics to linear or associative forms.

</details>


### [130] [DynMuon: A Dynamic Spectral Shaping View of Muon](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17109)
*Fangzhou Wu,Rikhav Shah,Sandeep Silwal,Qiuyi Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了DynMuon方法，通过动态调整谱参数p（从正值到微负值），在大语言模型训练中相比Muon方法减少10.6-26.5%的训练步数并达到更低的验证损失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Muon方法已成为训练大语言模型的主流方法，其核心是用极分解因子$UV^\top$替代标准更新矩阵$M=U\Sigma V^\top$。然而，该方法在不同训练阶段的适应性尚未被充分研究，需要理解如何根据局部曲率、噪声和训练阶段来优化更新策略。

Method: 提出"谱整形"(spectral-shaping)操作，将更新矩阵替换为$U\Sigma^p V^\top$，其中参数p根据以下因素动态选择：(a)损失函数的局部曲率，(b)随机梯度和标签噪声引起的噪声，(c)训练阶段。基于理论分析，发现正值p在训练早期通过强调高曲率方向加速信号收敛，而微负p在后期通过重新分配更新强度至低曲率方向来提升性能。据此提出DynMuon方法，在训练过程中动态调度p从正值到微负值。

Result: 理论分析和实验揭示了一个新发现：正值p在早期有助于强调高曲率方向并加速信号收敛，而微负p在后期通过将更新强度重新分配至仍包含有用训练信号的低曲率方向来提升性能。跨不同模型规模、架构和训练设置的广泛实验表明，DynMuon相比Muon持续实现更低的验证损失，同时减少10.6-26.5%的训练步数以达到相同目标损失。

Conclusion: DynMuon通过动态谱整形策略，成功改进了Muon方法，为大语言模型训练提供了一种更高效、性能更优的优化方法，证明了谱参数动态调整的重要性。

Abstract: In recent years, Muon has emerged as the dominant method for training large language models, and transformers more broadly. The essential difference, when compared to standard gradient descent methods, is to replace the usual update matrix $M=UΣV^\top$ with its polar factor $UV^\top$. In this work, we consider a class of Muon-like updates, where we replace the update $M$ with $UΣ^p V^\top$ for some parameter $p$. We call this a "spectral-shaping" operation, and develop a theory of how to pick $p$ which depends on (a) local curvature of the loss function, (b) noise stemming from stochastic gradients and label noise, and (c) training stage. Our theory and experimentation reveal a previously overlooked behavior: positive $p$ helps early by emphasizing high-curvature directions and accelerating signal contraction, while mildly negative $p$ helps later by reallocating update strength toward low-curvature directions that still contain useful training signals. Building on the insight, we propose DynMuon, an efficient dynamic spectral shaping method that schedules $p$ from positive to mildly negative over training. Extensive experiments across model sizes, architectures, and training settings show that DynMuon consistently achieves lower validation loss than Muon, while requiring 10.6-26.5% fewer steps to reach the same target loss.

</details>


### [131] [Differentiable Optimization Layers for Guaranteed Fairness in Deep Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17118)
*David Troxell,Noah Roemer,Guido Montúfar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种“公平性层”（fairness layer），即可微分优化层，将其附加到神经网络输出层以保证输出公平性，并设计了在线原始-对偶推理算法为流式预测提供可证明的聚合公平性保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统可微分优化层主要用于预测-然后-优化框架，将神经网络估计的参数作为下游优化问题的固定输入。本文旨在利用可微分优化层直接在模型输出层面强制执行公平性约束，解决传统按批次约束在流式预测和小批量场景下过于限制的问题。

Method: 提出了“公平性层”，即一个附加在神经网络输出层的可微分优化层，用于保证所选择的输出均等性概念得到满足。同时，引入了一种在线原始-对偶推理算法，能够为任意小批量的流式预测提供可证明的聚合公平性保证。论文还对层的可微性和稳定性进行了理论分析。

Result: 数值实验验证了公平性层及相关算法的有效性。理论分析刻画了该层在模型训练和反向传播过程中的可微性和稳定性属性。

Conclusion: 公平性层成功将公平性约束集成到神经网络中，结合在线原始-对偶算法，有效解决了流式预测场景下的公平性问题，并提供了理论保证和实验验证。

Abstract: Differentiable optimization layers are traditionally integrated in predict-then-optimize frameworks where a neural model estimates parameters that subsequently serve as fixed inputs to downstream decision-making optimization problems. In this work, we introduce the concept of a "fairness layer": a differentiable optimization layer appended to a model's output layer that guarantees a chosen notion of output parity is satisfied when integrated into a neural network. Additionally, we introduce an online primal-dual inference algorithm that provides provable aggregate fairness guarantees for streaming predictions with arbitrarily small batch sizes, where traditional per-batch constraints become overly restrictive. Numerical experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the fairness layer and associated algorithm, and theoretical analysis characterizes the layer's differentiability and stability properties during model training and backpropagation. Our code for these experiments is publicly available on GitHub (https://github.com/dtroxell19/FairDL-ICML-2026.git) and our public Python package documentation can be found online: https://dtroxell19.github.io/fairness_training/.

</details>


### [132] [An Analytical Multiple Criteria Framework for Temporal and Dynamic Business-to-Business Customer Segmentation in Manufacturing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17151)
*Muhammad Raees,Konstantinos Papangelis,Vassilis Javed Khan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种动态多准则决策方法用于B2B制造环境下的客户细分，通过扩展RFM模型并整合自适应层次分析法与多元时间序列聚类，在真实制造企业数据集上验证了方法的鲁棒性和有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的客户细分方法主要依赖于有限的标准（如RFM模型：最近购买时间、购买频率、购买金额），往往无法捕捉复杂的商业交互关系，且缺乏对业务目标的动态适应性。

Method: 1) 将RFM模型扩展至稳定性和增长维度；2) 整合自适应分析层次过程以匹配业务目标；3) 评估多元时间序列聚类模型；4) 测量客户稳定性、细分间转换和波动性；5) 应用基于图的共识模型增强分析效果。

Result: 在包含超过3000个B2B客户的真实制造企业数据集上进行了验证，所提方法对时间变化具有强鲁棒性，能够为领域专家提供偏好分析以制定策略。

Conclusion: 该研究为B2B客户细分提供了有效的决策支持工具，使领域专家能够基于偏好分析制定客户服务和供应链管理策略。

Abstract: In sales and marketing, customer segmentation is an important tool for formulating strategies for customer treatment and supply chain management. Most segmentation implementations rely on limited criteria, such as recency, frequency, and monetary (RFM) modeling, which often fail to capture complex business interactions. In this work, we design and evaluate a dynamic multi-criteria decision-making (MCDM) method in a business-to-business (B2B) manufacturing context by 1) extending RFM to dimensions of stability and growth, 2) integrating an adaptive and analytical hierarchical process to match business objectives, and 3) evaluating multivariate time-series clustering models. We then measure customer stability, tracking between-segment transitions, and volatility over time, and apply a graph-based consensus model to further strengthen the analysis. We test the efficacy of the proposed method using a real-world manufacturing company dataset to segment more than 3,000 B2B customers, showing strong robustness to temporal shifts. The implementation enables domain experts with preferential analytics to devise their strategies, providing effective decision support for B2B customer segmentation.

</details>


### [133] [Stress-Testing Neural Network Verifiers with Provably Robust Instances](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17153)
*David Troxell,Yulia Alexandr,Sofia Hunt,Stephanie Lei,Guido Montúfar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个可重用框架，用于生成具有先验已知真值鲁棒性标签的验证实例，解决了现有验证基准缺乏真值标签的问题，并利用该框架发现了流行验证器中的数值容差问题和实现错误。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的神经网络验证器基准测试缺乏真值标签，导致验证器评估依赖于间接启发式方法，无法进行精确评分和系统性地研究验证器失效模式。

Method: 提出了一个可重用的框架，通过解析构造生成先验已知真值鲁棒性标签的验证实例；引入了验证难度概貌，这是一组可估计的量，用于捕捉实例难度的不同来源。

Result: 发现了流行验证器中存在的多个数值容差问题和实现错误；对五个最先进的验证器进行评估，发现不同实例会对验证流程的不同方面施加压力；这些结果为改进数值可靠性、松弛质量和搜索行为提供了可操作的目标。

Conclusion: 真值标签对于验证器评估至关重要，所提出的框架和难度概貌能够系统性揭示验证器失效模式，为未来验证器的改进和发展提供指导。

Abstract: Neural network verifiers aim to provide formal guarantees on model behavior, but existing verification benchmarks are fundamentally limited by their lack of ground-truth labels. As a result, verifier evaluation relies on indirect heuristics, which prevents exact scoring and systematic study of verifier failure modes. We address this gap by introducing a reusable framework for generating verification instances whose ground-truth robustness labels are known a priori through analytic construction. Our framework led to the discovery of multiple numeric tolerance concerns and an implementation bug in popular verifiers, highlighting the need for ground-truth labels. Additionally, to systematically study verifier failure modes, we introduce the verification Difficulty Profile, a collection of estimable quantities capturing distinct sources of instance hardness. Using our framework and these profiles, we evaluate five state-of-the-art verifiers and show that different instances stress distinct aspects of the verification pipeline. We show that these results can aid the future development of verifiers as they provide actionable targets for improving numerical reliability, relaxation quality, and search behavior. Our code is publicly available: https://github.com/dtroxell19/VeriStressGT.git.

</details>


### [134] [When Bits Break Recourse: Counterfactual-Faithful Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17160)
*Chaymae Yahyati,Ismail Lamaakal,Khalid El Makkaoui,Ibrahim Ouahbi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 量化在保持预测精度的同时会破坏算法追索（algorithmic recourse）的稳定性；本文提出CFQ方法，通过训练量化器参数和混合精度位分配来保持反事实行为，有效解决了量化导致的追索失效问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的低比特量化方法虽然能够保持模型的预测精度，但会"悄悄"破坏算法追索（algorithmic recourse）的有效性——即一个在量化前能够翻转决策的可行改变，在量化后可能失效或成本显著增加。这种追索失效问题在传统精度指标下是不可见的，但会严重影响模型的可解释性和实际应用价值。

Method: 1) 形式化定义了量化下的反事实敏感性，提出有效性、成本和方向稳定性三个衡量标准；
2) 引入两个新指标：有效性下降（VD）和反事实追索差距（CRG），用于揭示精度指标无法反映的追索失效问题；
3) 提出反事实忠实量化（CFQ）方法，通过在全局位预算约束下优化量化器参数和混合精度位分配，强制在教师追索点保持目标输出；
4) 基于边界分析给出了有界量化扰动下追索迁移的充分条件。

Result: 在Adult、German Credit和COMPAS三个数据集上的实验表明：(1) 精度匹配的基线方法会显著降低追索稳定性，而CFQ在保持精度的同时；(2) 在不同位预算下显著改善了VD和CRG指标，有效维护了量化后模型的追索能力。

Conclusion: 传统的量化方法会损害算法追索的稳定性，而本研究提出的CFQ方法成功地在保持预测精度的同时，有效维护了反事实行为的忠实性，为低比特部署场景下保障模型可解释性和实用性提供了新思路。

Abstract: Quantization can preserve predictive accuracy under low-bit deployment while silently breaking algorithmic recourse: an actionable change that flips a decision before quantization may fail after quantization, or become substantially more costly. We formalize counterfactual sensitivity under quantization through validity, cost, and direction stability, and introduce two metrics: Validity Drop (VD) and Counterfactual Recourse Gap (CRG) that reveal recourse failures invisible to accuracy. We propose Counterfactual-Faithful Quantization (CFQ), which trains quantizer parameters and mixed-precision bit allocation to preserve counterfactual behavior by enforcing the target outcome at teacher recourse points under a global bit budget. A margin-based analysis gives a sufficient condition for recourse transfer under bounded quantization perturbations. Experiments on Adult, German Credit, and COMPAS show that accuracy-matched baselines can significantly degrade recourse stability, while CFQ maintains accuracy and substantially improves VD and CRG across bit budgets.

</details>


### [135] [TriAxialKV: Toward Extreme Low-Precision KV-Cache Quantization for Agentic Inference Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17170)
*Hanzhang Shen,Haoran Wu,Yiren Zhao,Robert Mullins*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了TriAxialKV，一种针对智能体工作负载的三轴混合精度KV缓存量化方案，通过时间、模态和语义角色三个维度分配INT2/INT4精度，在保持精度的同时支持4.5倍KV缓存大小并提升30%吞吐量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体工作负载与纯聊天工作负载差异显著，具有长上下文、多模态输入和结构化多轮交互特点。其上下文在时间新近性、模态类型和语义角色三个关键轴上表现出不同重要性，导致对KV缓存压缩的敏感度不同。现有量化方法多为同质化或仅利用单一维度异构性，忽略了多维度间的交互作用。

Method: 提出TriAxialKV三轴混合精度KV缓存量化方案。为每个token分配三维标签（时间新近性、模态、语义角色），针对每个标签校准压缩敏感度，在固定内存预算下动态分配INT2/INT4位宽。实现端到端服务系统，包含校准、混合精度量化、内存管理和自定义融合Triton解码内核。

Result: 在使用Qwen3-VL-32B-Thinking作为计算机操作智能体运行OSWorld时，TriAxialKV在BF16 KV缓存精度匹配SGLang准确率的前提下，支持4.5倍KV缓存大小，端到端吞吐量提升30%。

Conclusion: 通过充分挖掘时间、模态和语义角色三个维度的异构性及其交互，TriAxialKV有效平衡了智能体工作负载的精度保持与内存效率，为大规模智能体推理系统提供了实用解决方案。

Abstract: Agentic workloads have emerged as a major workload for LLM inference. They differ significantly from chat-only workloads, requiring long-context processing, the ability to handle multimodal inputs, and structured multi-turn interactions with tool calling capabilities. As a result, their context exhibits structure that can carry different importance along three key axes: temporal recency to the current turn, modality such as text or image tokens, and semantic role such as user queries, tool calls, observations, or reasoning. These axes capture distinct token behaviors and lead to different sensitivities to KV-cache compression. However, existing KV-cache quantization methods are typically homogeneous or exploit only heterogeneity on a single dimension, such as temporal proximity or modality, overlooking the interactions among them. To this end, we introduce TriAxialKV, a novel mixed-precision KV-cache quantization scheme that assigns each token a triaxial tag, calibrates per-tag sensitivity, and allocates INT2/INT4 bitwidths under a fixed memory budget. We implement TriAxialKV as an end-to-end serving system, comprising calibration, mixed-precision quantization and memory management, and custom fused Triton decode kernels. When using Qwen3-VL-32B-Thinking as a computer-use agent operating the OSWorld, TriAxialKV matches the accuracy of SGLang with BF16 KV cache while supporting 4.5$\times$ KV cache size and achieving 30% higher end-to-end throughput, when running on real GPU systems.

</details>


### [136] [OpenJarvis: Personal AI, On Personal Devices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17172)
*Jon Saad-Falcon,Avanika Narayan,Robby Manihani,Tanvir Bhathal,Herumb Shandilya,Hakki Orhun Akengin,Gabriel Bo,Andrew Park,Matthew Hart,Caia Costello,Chuan Li,Christopher Ré,Azalia Mirhoseini*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出OpenJarvis架构，通过分解个人AI栈为五个可独立优化的原语，并利用LLM引导的规范搜索，在推理时完全本地运行的情况下，实现了接近云端模型的准确率，同时大幅降低成本和延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有个人AI栈（如OpenClaw和Hermes Agent）依赖云端模型，涉及敏感数据隐私问题；直接替换为本地模型导致准确率下降25-39个百分点；现有栈缺乏可优化性，仅能调优提示词，且SOTA提示优化器只能弥补5个百分点的差距。

Method: 提出OpenJarvis架构，将个人AI系统表示为五个原语（智能、引擎、代理、工具与记忆、学习）的类型化规范，每个原语可独立编辑；引入LLM引导的规范搜索：云端模型在搜索时提出规范编辑，仅接受非退化的编辑，推理时规范完全在设备端运行。

Result: 在8个基准测试中的4个上，设备端规范匹配或超过云端准确率；平均准确率距离最佳云端基线仅差3.2个百分点；边际API成本降低约800倍，端到端延迟降低4倍。

Conclusion: 通过分解个人AI栈并采用本地-云端协作的优化策略，可以在保持本地模型隐私和效率优势的同时，显著缩小与云端模型的性能差距，为隐私敏感的个人AI应用提供可行方案。

Abstract: Personal AI stacks, like OpenClaw and Hermes Agent, are becoming central to daily work, yet they route nearly every query (often over sensitive local data) to cloud-hosted frontier models. Replacing frontier models with local models inside existing stacks does not work: swapping Claude Opus 4.6 for Qwen3.5-9B drops accuracy by 25-39 pp across personal AI tasks like PinchBench and GAIA. Existing stacks bundle agentic prompts, tool descriptions, memory configuration, and runtime settings around a specific cloud model. Only the prompts can be tuned, and state-of-the-art prompt optimizers close just 5 pp of the local-cloud gap on their own. This motivates a decomposed personal AI stack: one that exposes individual primitives which can be optimized individually or jointly to close the local-cloud gap. We present OpenJarvis, an architecture that represents a personal AI system as a typed spec over five primitives: Intelligence, Engine, Agents, Tools & Memory, and Learning. Each primitive is an independently editable field, making the stack end-to-end optimizable and measurable against accuracy, cost, and latency. Towards closing the local-cloud gap without surrendering local-model properties, OpenJarvis introduces LLM-guided spec search, a local-cloud collaboration in which frontier cloud models propose edits across the spec at search time, only non-regressing edits are accepted, and the resulting spec runs entirely on-device at inference time. With LLM-guided spec search, on-device specs match or exceed cloud accuracy on 4 of 8 benchmarks and land within 3.2 pp of the best cloud baseline on average. They also reduce marginal API cost by ~800x and end-to-end latency by 4x.

</details>


### [137] [The Geometry of Projection Heads: Conditioning, Invariance, and Collapse](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17180)
*Faris Chaudhry*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从黎曼几何视角揭示了投影头在自监督学习中的作用机制：线性头实现隐式子空间白化，非线性头通过局部度量适应拓扑约束；光滑非线性头能产生负曲率逃离坍缩，而线性/ReLU头依赖离散优化和BatchNorm；投影头作为几何缓冲器解耦骨干网络与预训练目标的刚性约束。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自监督学习中投影头的设计对模型性能至关重要，但其内在工作机制缺乏理论解释。现有研究仅通过实验观察投影头的效果，缺乏几何视角的理论框架来理解：1）不同投影头架构如何影响优化动态；2）为何非线性头能缓解维度坍缩；3）投影头为何在下游任务中被丢弃。这些基础问题亟需理论指导。

Method: 建立投影头的几何理论框架，将投影头建模为骨干表示流形上的可训练黎曼度量。理论分析线性头与非线性头的度量特性，证明光滑非线性头在坍缩平衡点诱导负Hessian特征值。通过连续追踪优化几何（Hessian曲率谱）进行实验验证，在对比学习和去相关目标上对比线性头、ReLU头、Swish头的行为。

Result: 1）线性头执行隐式子空间白化，非线性头自适应局部度量以满足损失函数拓扑约束；2）光滑非线性头（Swish）在坍缩点产生显式负曲率逃离坍缩，线性/ReLU头在连续梯度流下无法产生负曲率，依赖离散优化和BatchNorm；3）投影头深度决定拓扑适应能力；4）度量退化主导信息-不变性权衡，解释投影头丢弃的必要性；5）投影头作为几何缓冲器解耦骨干语义与预训练目标的破坏性约束。

Conclusion: 投影头在自监督学习中扮演通用几何缓冲器角色，通过黎曼度量调节骨干表示空间。设计时应考虑：1）光滑激活有助于逃离坍缩；2）头深度决定拓扑适应容量；3）预训练后丢弃投影头符合度量退化与信息保持的理论要求。该理论为投影头架构设计提供几何指导。

Abstract: We develop a geometric theory of projection heads in self-supervised learning by modeling the head as a trainable Riemannian metric on the backbone representation manifold. We show that linear heads perform implicit subspace whitening, while nonlinear heads adapt local metrics to satisfy the specific topological constraints of the loss, with head depth empirically dictating this capacity. Analyzing dimensional collapse, we prove that smooth nonlinear heads natively induce negative eigenvalues in the Hessian at collapsed equilibria, making them unstable. We empirically validate this by continuously tracking the optimization geometry during training, which reveals that smooth activations like Swish can generate explicit negative curvature to escape collapse, whereas linear and ReLU heads under continuous-time gradient flow cannot, relying instead on discrete-time optimization dynamics and BatchNorm. Finally, we geometrically characterize how metric degeneracy governs the information-invariance trade-off, explaining why the head must be discarded. Evaluated across contrastive and decorrelation-based objectives on foundation models, our results demonstrate that the projection head acts as a universal geometric buffer, decoupling the semantic backbone from the rigid, destructive constraints of the pretraining objective.

</details>


### [138] [OPTNet: Ordering Point Transformer Network for Post-disaster 3D Semantic Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17197)
*Nhut Le,Ehsan Karimi,Maryam Rahnemoonfar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了OPTNet，通过引入可学习的Point Sorter模块动态预测最优点云排列顺序，解决了灾后场景点云分割中静态序列化方法次优的问题，在3DAeroRelief数据集上显著超越了现有最佳方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 灾后损毁评估需要快速准确的3D点云语义分割。早期的Point Transformer依赖计算昂贵的k-NN和FPS，而近期的PTv3虽通过希尔伯特曲线或Z-order等静态序列化方法提升了效率，但这些固定排序对于捕捉灾难场景的复杂几何结构并非最优。

Method: 提出OPTNet（Ordering Point Transformer Network），核心是引入了一个可学习的Point Sorter模块。该方法利用自监督的排序损失（self-supervised ordering loss）来动态预测最优排列，从而最大化注意力机制的局部性。

Result: 在3DAeroRelief数据集上进行评估，OPTNet显著优于当前最先进（state-of-the-art）的基线模型。

Conclusion: 通过将静态序列化替换为可学习的动态排序机制，OPTNet成功提升了点云分割在复杂灾后场景中的表现，证明了动态排列策略在捕获场景几何特征上的优越性。

Abstract: Post-disaster damage assessment requires rapid and accurate semantic segmentation of 3D point clouds to identify critical infrastructure such as damaged buildings and roads. Early Point Transformers (e.g., PTv1, PTv2) relied on computationally expensive neighbor searching (k-NN) and Farthest Point Sampling (FPS). To improve efficiency, recent architectures like Point Transformer V3 (PTv3) adopted static serialization methods, such as Hilbert curves or Z-order, to organize unstructured points for window-based attention. However, these fixed orderings are not optimal for capturing the complex geometry of disaster scenes. In this paper, we propose OPTNet (Ordering Point Transformer Network), which introduces a learnable Point Sorter module. OPTNet utilizes a self-supervised ordering loss to dynamically predict an optimal permutation that maximizes the locality of the attention mechanism. We evaluate our method on the 3DAeroRelief dataset, significantly outperforming state-of-the-art baselines.

</details>


### [139] [Anytime and Difficulty-Adaptive PAC-Bayes for Constrained Density-Ratio Network with Continual Learning Guarantees](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17212)
*Paulo Akira F. Enabe*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个统一的协变量偏移学习框架，通过约束密度比网络近似Radon-Nikodym导数，支持重要性加权经验风险，并提供PAC-Bayes泛化证书。实验验证了框架的有效性，并在实际数据上优于传统方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在协变量偏移场景下，源分布Q和目标分布P之间存在分布差异，传统经验风险最小化失效。需要一种统一框架来学习分布间的密度比，并提供理论保证，以解决源分布上的模型在目标分布上泛化性能下降的问题。

Method: 该方法包含三个核心组件：1）利用约束密度比网络近似Radon-Nikodym导数r*=dP/dQ；2）通过变分测度恒等式将目标风险与重要性加权源风险之间的差距分解为比率偏差项和泛化差距项；3）将Radon-Nikodym导数的三个结构恒等式（归一化、矩匹配和二阶矩惩罚）作为硬积分约束，通过增广拉格朗日方案施加；4）在加权风险上实例化PAC-Bayes，提供固定时间和任意时间两种机制下的泛化证书。

Result: 在预注册的双活动协议实验中：1）网络在真实数据上产生校准的协变量比率；2）相较于未加权经验风险最小化和经典直接比率估计基线，目标0/1损失降低；3）成功达到任意时间证书的承诺；4）记录到固定时间覆盖声明的单次预注册失败，每分割覆盖与标签偏移幅度一一对应，证实协变量假设的操作紧密性。

Conclusion: 该框架成功地将密度比估计、重要性加权和泛化保证整合在一个统一框架中，通过结构约束确保了密度比的有效性，并通过PAC-Bayes理论提供了可验证的泛化证书。实验结果表明该方法是有效的，且协变量假设是操作紧密的而非证书缺陷。

Abstract: A unified framework for learning under covariate shift is presented, in which a constrained density-ratio network approximates the Radon-Nikodym derivative $r^\star = dP/dQ$ from source $Q$ to target $P$, supports an importance-weighted empirical risk, and feeds an anytime PAC-Bayes generalization certificate. A change-of-measure identity decomposes the gap between target risk and importance-weighted source risk into a ratio-bias term, controlled by the $L^2(Q)$ closeness of the learned ratio to $r^\star$, and a generalization-gap term, controlled by the variability of the weighted loss. Three structural identities of a Radon-Nikodym derivative, normalization, moment matching, and a second-moment penalty controlling the effective sample size, are imposed as hard integral constraints through an augmented-Lagrangian scheme. PAC-Bayes is then instantiated on the weighted risk in a fixed-time regime that yields Bernoulli-KL bounds, a KL-regularized objective whose minimizer is the network-weighted Gibbs posterior, and a stability statement on $L^2(Q)$ perturbations of the learned ratio, and in an anytime regime that builds a time-uniform certificate by geometric peeling across epochs. A pre-registered two-campaign protocol combining a patch test against analytic ground truth with a real-data deployment under intrinsic distribution shift validates the framework. The network produces a calibrated covariate ratio on real data, reduces the target $0/1$ loss relative to unweighted empirical risk minimization and to classical direct ratio-estimation baselines, and attains the anytime certificate as the construction promises. A single pre-registered failure of the fixed-time coverage claim is recorded, with per-split coverage aligning one-to-one with the magnitude of the label shift, confirming that the covariate-only assumption is operationally tight rather than a defect of the certificate.

</details>


### [140] [FishBack: Pullback Fisher Geometry for Optimal Activation Steering in Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17231)
*Sihan Wang,Jiayi Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出FishBack框架，揭示了现有激活引导方法错误地假设激活空间为欧几里得空间，并通过Fisher信息度量的拉回形式推导出闭式引导方程，在GPT-2上显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的激活引导方法普遍假设模型的激活空间是欧几里得空间，但这一假设缺乏理论依据。作者旨在探索激活空间的真实几何结构，并基于此设计更优的引导方法。

Method: 1. 利用softmax层的Fisher信息度量并通过后续层的雅可比矩阵拉回到激活空间，构建激活空间的固有度量；
2. 从该拉回Fisher度量推导出闭式引导方程，识别任意目标概念的最小失真方向；
3. 提出度量递归分解，揭示现有方法（CAA、ActAdd、ITI等）隐含采用的近似度量及其与最优度量的关系；
4. 实现迭代式拉回引导方法FishBack。

Result: 在GPT-2上的实验表明：
1. 激活空间的局部几何结构与欧几里得度量偏差超过97%（相对谱范数），有效维度仅为环境空间的2-17%；
2. 提出的谱诊断指标能定量预测现有方法的性能差距；
3. FishBack在三个动词形态概念和四个层上一致优于所有欧几里得基线，相比欧几里得梯度上升减少非目标KL散度1.3-2.5倍，相比CAA减少1.5倍（在匹配概念概率下）。

Conclusion: 激活空间的欧几里得假设严重偏离实际几何结构，基于Fisher信息度量的拉回引导方法能够更准确地控制模型输出行为，为理解和改进激活引导方法提供了新的理论基础和实践方法。

Abstract: Activation steering methods modify intermediate representations of language models to control output behavior, but universally assume the activation space is Euclidean. We show this assumption fails drastically: the local geometry induced by the model's own output behavior -- the Fisher information metric of the softmax layer, pulled back through the Jacobian of subsequent layers -- deviates from the Euclidean metric by over 97% in relative spectral norm on GPT-2, with an effective dimensionality of only 2--17% of the ambient space. From this pullback Fisher metric, we derive a closed-form steering equation that identifies the minimum-distortion direction for any target concept, yielding a closed-form optimal direction at each point that can be applied iteratively without manifold fitting or data-driven geometry estimation. We call the resulting framework FishBack. The metric admits a layer-wise recursive decomposition, which reveals that existing methods -- CAA, ActAdd, ITI, and others -- each implicitly adopt a particular approximate metric, and that their performance gaps are quantitatively predicted by a single spectral diagnostic: the ratio of their implicit metric's cost to the Fisher-optimal cost. On GPT-2, iterative pullback steering consistently outperforms all Euclidean baselines across three verb-morphology concepts and four layers, with off-target KL reductions of $1.3\times$--$2.5\times$ relative to Euclidean gradient ascent and $1.5\times$ relative to CAA at matched concept probability.

</details>


### [141] [Dimension-Free Convergence of Discrete Diffusion Models: Adjoint Equations Induce the Right Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17232)
*Kelvin Kan,Xingjian Li,Benjamin J. Zhang,Tuhin Sahai,Stanley Osher,Markos A. Katsoulakis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对离散扩散模型提出了一个基于伴随方程的统一框架，首次建立了完全独立于状态空间大小S的收敛性保证，适用于掩码和均匀先验，解决了现有理论在大词汇量任务中失效的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的离散扩散模型收敛理论存在根本局限性：基于KL的分析在奇异先验（如掩码分布）下会发散，而基于全变差(TV)的界限依赖于状态空间大小S，导致在现代语言任务（词汇量达数十万）中变得无效。

Method: 提出了四种新颖技术：(1)通过伴随方程在可观测空间而非概率测度空间工作；(2)正则性分析以产生任何IPM的界限；(3)耦合论证消除均匀转移下的S依赖；(4)分数-边缘消除技术消除掩码转移下的S依赖。框架仅需单一标准速率矩阵正则性假设，且兼容时间非齐次调度。

Result: 建立了在任何积分概率度量(IPM)下的无维度收敛保证，据知是首个完全独立于S且同时适用于掩码和均匀先验的界限。理论避免了路径空间KL和现有TV方法的缺陷。

Conclusion: 该框架不仅提供了收敛界限，还为离散扩散模型的进一步理论研究提供了多功能工具包，为该领域的理论分析开辟了新路径。

Abstract: Discrete diffusion has become a leading framework for generative modeling in various applications including language, vision, and biology. Existing convergence theory, however, exhibits fundamental limitations. KL-based analyses diverge under singular priors such as the masked distribution, while bounds in total variation (TV) depend on the state space size $S$ and become vacuous for modern language tasks, where vocabularies contain hundreds of thousands of tokens. We develop a unified adjoint-equation-based framework that establishes dimension-free convergence guarantees in any integral probability metric (IPM). To the best of our knowledge, our bounds are the first to be entirely free of $S$ and applicable to both masked and uniform priors. Importantly, our theory relies only on a single standard rate-matrix regularity assumption and is compatible with time-inhomogeneous schedules.
  Four novel techniques drive our improvements: working in the space of observables via adjoint equations rather than directly with probability measures, a regularity analysis that yields bounds on any IPM, a coupling argument that removes $S$-dependence under uniform transitions, and a score-marginal cancellation technique that removes $S$-dependence under masked transitions. Our framework thus sharply departs from prior analyses and avoids the shortcomings of pathspace-KL and existing TV-based approaches. Beyond convergence bounds, our framework provides a versatile toolkit for further theoretical study of discrete diffusion models.

</details>


### [142] [Active Budget Allocation for Efficient Scaling Law Estimation via Surrogate-Guided Pruning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17234)
*Viktoria Schram,Markus Hiller,Daniel Beck,Trevor Cohn*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出将Successive Halving (SH)算法与代理模型相结合，用于优化大规模模型性能预测中的计算资源分配，在保持预测准确性的同时显著降低了计算成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的经验性缩放定律研究通过学习曲线描述损失与计算量之间的关系，以预测更大规模下的模型性能。然而，这种经验方法计算负担巨大，需要策略性的资源分配，但目前该领域研究严重不足。

Method: 探索了Successive Halving (SH)算法的适用性，并将SH与参数化和非参数化代理模型相结合。这种组合方法能够更系统地分配给定的计算预算，生成一组学习曲线。

Result: 在真实世界和合成学习曲线数据集上，该方法相比朴素均匀分配和纯SH方法，平均相对改进分别达到2.84%和5.47%，获得更低的损失-计算值。相比传统穷举方法，节省了高达98.7%的计算成本。

Conclusion: 通过策略性的资源分配方法，能够在显著降低计算成本的同时获得准确的缩放定律，为大规模模型训练策略和架构设计提供了高效的性能预测手段。

Abstract: Predicting model performance at larger scales enables the design of training strategies and architectures tailored to specific performance targets. Empirical scaling law research identifies functional forms to aid this prediction task. These describe the relationship between loss and compute using a loss-compute frontier defined by learning curves. Due to the empirical nature of this approach, the computational burden is substantial, making strategic resource allocation essential - yet it remains surprisingly underexplored. In this work, we address this shortcoming by exploring the suitability of Successive Halving (SH) and SH combined with parametric and non-parametric surrogate models. In addition to enabling a more systematic allocation of a given compute budget, our findings show that SH paired with surrogate models yields a set of learning curves that includes one with a lower loss-compute value than what naive uniform allocation or an SH-only approach can obtain. Our experiments demonstrate mean relative improvements of up to 2.84% and 5.47% on real-world and synthetic learning curve datasets. This strategic resource allocation enables us to obtain accurate scaling laws at significantly reduced computational costs, saving up to 98.7% over the traditional exhaustive approach.

</details>


### [143] [Learning in Position-Aware Multinomial Logit Bandits: From Multiplicative to General Position Effects](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17238)
*Xi Chen,Shibo Dai,Jiameng Lyu,Yuan Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了动态联合品种选择与定位问题，首次在乘积位置效应模型和一般位置效应模型下实现了最优后悔界，并提出了一种高效的每轮优化子程序，在合成数据和Expedia数据集上验证了算法优越性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在现代电商平台中，产品的吸引力不仅取决于其内在属性，还受到展示位置的影响。现有研究在解决联合品种选择与定位问题时，存在性能上的理论缺口（如$\sqrt{K}$差距），且难以满足平台对实时决策的需求。因此，本文旨在填补这些理论空白并提供实用的算法方案。

Method: 本文设计了基于逐轮更新的学习算法：针对乘积位置效应模型，提出了带有截断机制的跨位置成对最大似然估计器（P2MLE-UCB算法）；针对一般位置效应模型，提出了GP2-UCB算法。此外，基于Dinkelbach方法和最大权二部匹配，开发了高效的每轮联合品种与定位优化子程序。

Result: 对于乘积模型，P2MLE-UCB算法实现了$\tilde{O}(\sqrt{NT})$的后悔界，匹配下界并消除了先前研究中的$\sqrt{K}$差距；对于一般模型，建立了极小极大下界并提出了匹配上界的GP2-UCB算法。在合成数据和Expedia真实数据集上的数值实验表明，本文算法持续优于现有基准方法。

Conclusion: 本文成功解决了动态联合品种选择与定位问题中的最优后悔界刻画难题，填补了理论空白。所提出的逐轮算法不仅具备最优的理论保证，还满足了现代平台的实时操作需求，并通过实验验证了其实际优越性。

Abstract: We study the dynamic joint assortment selection and positioning problem, where the attraction of each product depends on both its intrinsic appeal and its display position under a Multinomial Logit (MNL) choice framework. Our study ranges from the multiplicative position effects model, in which each product's attraction is scaled by a position-specific factor, to a general position effects model assigning independent attraction parameters to every product--position pair to capture heterogeneous synergies. For both models, we design round-based learning algorithms that update decisions after every single feedback, and establish the first regret-optimal characterization. Besides, our round-based algorithms provide the prompt operations needed by modern platforms. For the multiplicative model, we develop a cross-position pairwise maximum likelihood estimator with a clipping mechanism, and prove that our algorithm P2MLE-UCB attains a regret of $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{NT})$, matching the lower bound and closing the $\sqrt{K}$ gap left by prior epoch-based analyses. For the general model, we establish a minimax lower bound and propose GP2-UCB with a matching upper bound. Moreover, we design an efficient subroutine for the per-round joint assortment and positioning optimization based on Dinkelbach's method and maximum-weight bipartite matching. Numerical experiments on synthetic data and the Expedia dataset show that our algorithms consistently outperform state-of-the-art benchmarks.

</details>


### [144] [Drift Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17244)
*Chenrui Ma,Xi Xiao,Lin Zhao,Tianyang Wang,Ferdinando Fioretto,Yanning Shen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了Drift Flow Matching (DFM)框架，将高效的直接传输映射与迭代式生成相结合，实现了在单步生成效率与多步生成质量之间的灵活权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的迭代生成模型（如Flow Matching和Diffusion）具有测试时缩放特性，可通过增加推理计算提升生成质量，但计算成本高；而Drift Models虽能高效单步生成，却缺乏这种灵活性。作者旨在弥合这两种范式之间的差距。

Method: 提出Drift Flow Matching (DFM)框架，将漂移生成建模与基于流的迭代生成相连接。该方法在保留直接传输映射高效性的同时，允许通过多次推理步骤对生成结果进行细化，从而实现采样计算对质量-效率需求的适应性调整。

Result: 在多种任务和数据集上进行了广泛实验，验证了该框架的有效性和通用性，证明了其能在保持生成效率的同时提升生成质量。

Conclusion: DFM成功弥合了单步Drift Models与多步Flow Matching方法之间的鸿沟，提供了一种能够根据不同质量-效率需求自适应调整采样计算的新型生成范式。

Abstract: Iterative generative models such as Flow Matching and Diffusion models have demonstrated strong test-time scaling behavior, where additional inference computation can improve generation quality. In contrast, Drift Models offer efficient one-step generation, but their direct generation paradigm limits such flexibility. In this work, we propose Drift Flow Matching (DFM), a framework that connects drifting generative modeling with flow-based iterative generation. DFM preserves the efficiency of direct transport maps while enabling generation to be refined through multiple inference steps when desired. This bridges the gap between one-step Drift Models and multi-step Flow Matching methods, and provides a novel generative paradigm that can adapt sampling computation to different quality--efficiency requirements. Extensive experiments across different tasks and datasets demonstrate the effectiveness and generality of the proposed framework.

</details>


### [145] [Fidelity Probes for Specification--Code Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17246)
*Ferhat Erata,Hao Zhou,Luke Huan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了保真度探针方法，通过从参考工件生成自然语言问题来评估候选规范的质量，在AWS CardDemo基准测试上将规范保真度从0.63提升至0.94，并验证了方法的模型无关性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当存在两个本应描述相同行为的工件（如代码与规范）时，缺乏有效方法来量化它们之间的一致性并指导规范的迭代改进。现有方法难以精确定位规范与代码之间的矛盾点和覆盖缺口。

Method: 引入保真度探针：从参考工件生成带有代码推导真值的自然语言问题，由候选规范作答。定义保真度为一致性探针的比例，分解为矛盾率和覆盖缺口率以驱动定向规范编辑。探针来源包括LLM阅读代码或基于控制流/数据流/系统依赖图的静态分析管道，采用可调混合策略。使用冻结测试集的重采样协议提供Hoeffding有界过拟合判别。

Result: 在15个程序、约12k行的COBOL基准测试（AWS CardDemo）上，经过8次迭代将冻结测试规范保真度从0.63提升至0.94。仅用4次迭代的速率数据即可通过二态马尔可夫不动点预测收敛平台位置。三种图接地混合策略使保真度提升16-30个百分点。LLM和符号通道在跨分布评估中呈现经验互补性。五个独立LLM谱系（Anthropic、DeepSeek、Google、Alibaba、OpenAI）的交叉族生成器扫描证实：五个非Claude生成器中的三个产生的轨迹与马尔可夫不动点预测一致，冻结测试协议主动证伪了两个探针分布在迭代间漂移的生成器。

Conclusion: 保真度探针方法有效实现了规范的迭代改进与收敛，训练/测试差距比过拟合包络低一个数量级以上。该方法适用于任何本应描述相同行为的工件对，收敛行为不依赖于单一模型族，且能有效识别漂移的生成器。

Abstract: We introduce fidelity probes: natural-language questions generated from a reference artifact with code-derived ground-truth answers, answered from a candidate specification. The fraction of agreeing probes, which we call the fidelity, decomposes into contradiction and coverage-gap rates that drive targeted spec edits to convergence. On a 15-program, roughly 12k-line COBOL benchmark (AWS CardDemo), we raise frozen-test specification fidelity from 0.63 to 0.94 over eight iterations, with the plateau location predicted by a two-state Markov fixed point $F^\dagger$ from just four iterations of rate data. Probes come from an LLM reading the code or from a static-analysis pipeline over its control-flow, data-flow, and system-dependence graphs, with a tunable mixture. A probe-resampling protocol with a frozen held-out set gives a Hoeffding-bounded overfitting discriminant; our measured train/test gap stays more than an order of magnitude below this envelope. Three graph-grounded mixtures lift fidelity by +16 to +30 points; cross-distribution evaluation shows the LLM and symbolic channels are empirically complementary. A cross-family generator sweep on five independent LLM lineages (Anthropic, DeepSeek, Google, Alibaba, OpenAI) confirms the convergence behaviour is not tied to any single model family: three of five non-Claude generators produce trajectories consistent with the Markov fixed-point prediction, and the frozen-test protocol actively falsifies the two generators whose probe distributions drift across iterations. The method applies to any pair of artifacts that are supposed to describe the same behaviour.

</details>


### [146] [Towards Principled Test-Time Adaptation for Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17250)
*Haochun Wang,Ruichen Xu,Georgios Kementzidis,Karen Cho,Sebastian Ramirez Villarreal,Yuefan Deng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于成熟真值的测试时适应协议，并诊断出现有方法的预测校正存在频谱修改受限的问题，进而提出了轻量级的频率感知校准方法（FAC），在多数据集上实现了具有竞争力的一致性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的时间序列预测测试时适应（TSF-TTA）方法在使用已揭示目标的方式上存在差异，导致适应协议异构且缺乏统一表述。为解决此问题，作者从协议规范性的角度重新审视TSF-TTA，旨在建立更原则化的适应设置。

Method: 首先提出一种仅基于成熟真值的适应协议；接着在频域诊断现有适配器，发现其预测校正的频谱修改有限且结构弱；据此提出频率感知校准（FAC），这是一种轻量级方法，直接在频域对预测校正进行参数化。

Result: 在多种数据集、预测视界和源预测器上，FAC均取得了具有竞争力且一致的性能表现，同时所需的训练参数量显著少于对比的TSF-TTA适配器。

Conclusion: 通过规范适应协议并从频域视角进行校正，FAC为时间序列预测的测试时适应提供了一种高效、轻量且有效的解决方案。

Abstract: Test-time adaptation (TTA) has recently emerged as a promising approach for improving time series forecasting (TSF) under distribution shift. Existing TSF-TTA methods differ in how they utilize revealed targets, yet the resulting adaptation protocols remain heterogeneous and lack a clearly unified formulation. To address this issue, we revisit TSF-TTA from the perspective of protocol cleanliness and propose an adaptation protocol based solely on matured ground truth, yielding a more principled setting for adaptation. Under this protocol, we further diagnose existing adapters in the frequency domain and find that their prediction corrections often exhibit limited and weakly structured spectral modifications. Motivated by this diagnosis, we propose Frequency-Aware Calibration (FAC), a lightweight calibration method that directly parameterizes prediction corrections in the frequency domain. Across diverse datasets, forecasting horizons, and source forecasters, FAC achieves competitive and consistent performance while requiring substantially fewer trainable parameters than the compared TSF-TTA adapters.

</details>


### [147] [When Molecular Similarity Works: Property Cliffs Reveal Hidden Errors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17265)
*Di Hu,Kun Li,Haojie Rao,Longtao Hu,Jiameng Chen,Wenbin Hu,Yizhen Zheng,Jiajun Yu,Duanhua Cao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对分子性质预测中局部失效模式被整体评估指标掩盖的问题，提出了评估协议CliffSplit和缓解机制CliffLoss，有效揭示了高误差区域并降低了“性质悬崖”处的预测误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在药物发现和材料设计中，现有的先进模型虽然整体性能优越，但容易在局部区域失效。这种现象在“性质悬崖”（Property cliffs）处尤为明显——结构相似的分子其目标性质可能差异巨大，而常规的整体评估指标无法检测到此类高风险局部失效，导致对模型性能的误判。

Method: 本文提出了两个核心方法：1. CliffSplit，一种悬崖感知的评估协议，用于构建具有局部支持且暴露“性质悬崖”的测试案例；2. CliffLoss，一种模型无关的仅训练阶段的缓解机制，专门用于降低模型对悬崖敏感区域的误差。

Result: 在三个QM9目标、三个MoleculeNet任务及五种骨干网络上的实验表明：CliffSplit在悬崖密集的QM9区域揭示了至少15%的更高误差；CliffLoss在Lipophilicity任务上将悬崖与平滑区域的误差差距降低了30%，并将整体平均绝对误差（MAE）提升了9.7%。

Conclusion: 该方法成功将分子相似性失效从一种描述性异常转化为分子机器学习领域中可被基准测试评估的具体问题，为模型在高风险局部邻域的鲁棒性评估与提升提供了有效工具。

Abstract: Accurate prediction of molecular properties underpins drug discovery and material design, yet even state-of-the-art models remain vulnerable to localized failure modes that aggregate metrics cannot detect. The places where molecular similarity should be most helpful are also places where standard evaluation can be most misleading. Property cliffs expose this gap: structurally similar molecules can still differ sharply in target property, so models with competitive overall performance may fail in high-risk local neighborhoods. To expose and mitigate this failure mode, CliffSplit, a cliff-aware evaluation protocol that constructs locally supported, cliff-exposed test cases, and CliffLoss, a model-agnostic train-only mitigation mechanism for cliff-sensitive errors, are introduced. Experiments on three QM9 targets and three MoleculeNet tasks across five backbones show that CliffSplit reveals at least 15% higher error in cliff-heavy QM9 regions, while CliffLoss reduces the cliff-to-smooth error gap by up to 30% on Lipophilicity and improves overall MAE by 9.7%. Together, these results turn molecular similarity failure from a descriptive anomaly into a benchmarked evaluation problem for molecular machine learning. The code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Cliff_Loss.

</details>


### [148] [Calibeating for general proper losses: A Bregman divergence approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17269)
*Maximilian Fichtl,Cristóbal Guzmán,Nishant A. Mehta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个基于遗憾最小化的通用校准击败框架，覆盖了包括α-Tsallis损失和Lipschitz损失在内的大类正规损失函数，获得了U校准结果并展示了Be The Regularized Leader的新遗憾等式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Foster和Hart的原创校准击败工作仅对Brier分数（平方损失）和对数损失进行了专门处理，缺乏统一框架。本文旨在建立一个通用框架，处理更广泛的正规损失函数族，同时改进对维度的依赖关系。

Method: 以Bregman散度视角分析正规损失函数为核心，针对Tsallis损失族进行U校准分析，基于广义方差的在线更新公式推导Be The Regularized Leader的遗憾等式。

Result: 对所考虑的Tsallis损失族获得了U校准结果，对该族中所有损失同时实现对数级遗憾，且相比以往结果具有更弱的维度依赖；建立了适用于一般正规损失的Be The Regularized Leader遗憾等式。

Conclusion: 成功构建了校准击败的通用框架，统一并扩展了现有理论，为Tsallis损失族提供了更优的理论保证，同时发展了广义方差和Bregman散度相关的在线学习理论工具。

Abstract: This work introduces a general framework for calibeating based on regret minimization. As compared to Foster and Hart's seminal calibeating work which had specialized treatments of Brier score (squared loss) and log loss, we consider a large family of proper losses that includes $α$-Tsallis losses (for $α\in [1, 2]$) and Lipschitz losses. Our results for Tsallis losses also hold for an unscaled version of Tsallis loss that recovers log loss. Our analysis is oriented around the Bregman divergence view of a proper loss. Technically, our results for the family of Tsallis losses that we consider are U-calibration results, simultaneously obtaining logarithmic regret for all losses in this family while having a weaker dependence on the dimension compared to previous results. Of potential independent interest, we also show a new regret equality for the regret of Be The Regularized Leader. This regret equality holds for general proper losses and itself is based on two results related to online updating formulas for the generalized variance, the latter being a previously introduced generalization of variance based on Bregman divergences.

</details>


### [149] [State-of-the-Art Claims Require State-of-the-Art Evidence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17273)
*YongKyung Oh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究发现AI领域的“最先进”（SOTA）声明普遍存在证据不足的问题。超过一半的基准测试榜首模型比较中，模型优势缺乏实际意义、一致性或鲁棒性，提升往往由离群数据集驱动。作者建议声明语言应如实反映证据强度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前AI和机器学习研究中充斥着大量基于基准测试排名的“最先进”（SOTA）声明。这些声明通常仅依赖平均分数的微小提升，却隐含了模型在各方面全面超越替代方案的强假设。作者旨在揭示这种声明与证据之间的差距，探究基准测试排名是否真正支持模型优越性的声明。

Method: 作者首先理论分析了SOTA声明背后的隐含假设与实际平均分数排名之间的脱节。随后，从公共排行榜中选取了10个跨领域基准测试进行实证分析，检验顶尖模型比较中是否存在“有意义的效应量”、“跨任务一致性”以及“对数据集移除的鲁棒性”等优越性应具备的属性。

Result: 分析显示，在超过一半的顶尖模型比较中，至少有一项普遍假设的优越性属性不成立。平均分数的边际提升往往仅代表最高的平均排名，而非真正的全面超越。这种聚合分数的提升经常由个别离群数据集驱动，且即便在包含大量任务的基准测试中，这种脆弱性依然存在。

Conclusion: 当前的基准测试证据往往无法有力支持强势的SOTA声明。作者主张研究的声明语言应与底层证据的强度相匹配，无需额外实验，只需诚实地报告结果的真实含义（例如承认提升的局限性或不一致性），从而实现更精确、可解释的模型比较。

Abstract: State-of-the-Art (SOTA) claims pervade Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) research. These claims rest on benchmark evaluations, where models are ranked by aggregate scores across tasks. Public benchmarks or leaderboards are the most visible instance, but the same structure appears in paper tables throughout the literature. However, such minimal evidence often cannot support these strong claims. We identify a widespread claim-evidence gap in AI benchmarking. Claiming SOTA carries implicit assumptions beyond mean score superiority, suggesting that a model meaningfully outperforms alternatives across most tasks. However, a marginal improvement in the mean score merely indicates a top average rank rather than true superiority. Analyzing ten cross-domain benchmarks from public leaderboards, we found that in more than half of top-model comparisons, at least one commonly assumed property of superiority does not hold. These properties include meaningful effect size, consistency across tasks, or robustness to dataset removal. Instead, aggregate gains are frequently driven by outlier datasets. This fragility persists even in benchmarks with many tasks. We argue that claim language should reflect the strength of the underlying evidence. This requires no additional experiments, only honest reporting of what results actually show, enabling more precise and interpretable comparisons across models.

</details>


### [150] [How Do Electrocardiogram Models Scale?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17276)
*Jiawei Li,Fabio Bonassi,Ming Jin,Stefan Gustafsson,Johan Sundström,Thomas B. Schön,Antônio H. Ribeiro*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次系统研究了心电图(ECG)模型的缩放定律，发现自监督学习(SSL)在数据和模型扩展上优于监督学习(SL)，ResNet在分布外泛化上比Transformer更高效，有效ECG基础模型的关键在于架构与范式的策略性对齐而非单纯扩大规模。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管缩放定律为自然语言处理基础模型提供了理论框架，但其在ECG模型中的适用性尚未明确。近期研究发现增加ECG模型的参数量或预训练数据量并不总能带来一致的下游任务提升，架构归纳偏置、预训练范式的作用以及规模增长的预期改进等问题仍待解答。

Method: 在CODE数据集(230万条记录)上预训练超过120个模型(参数范围从2万到2亿)，系统解耦模型架构(ResNet vs. Transformer)和预训练范式(监督学习SL vs. 自监督学习SSL)的影响，研究神经网络缩放定律和损失间缩放关系。

Result: 主要发现：(i) SL模型在分布内受数据瓶颈限制，而SSL模型在模型和数据规模上均能稳健扩展；(ii) 在分布外(OOD)泛化方面，ResNet的参数效率是Transformer的1.3-2.5倍，SSL的数据效率比SL高16倍，在未见临床任务上的迁移效率比SL高7.6倍；(iii) 在观测规模范围内，ResNet模型通常实现最低的OOD损失，SSL在未见临床任务上占优，自监督Transformer在超大模型规模时反超。

Conclusion: 构建有效ECG基础模型的路径在于架构与预训练范式的策略性对齐，而非简单的规模扩展。不同架构和范式在不同场景下各有优势，需要根据具体应用需求选择合适的技术组合。

Abstract: While scaling laws have established a fundamental framework for foundation models in natural language processing, their applicability to electrocardiogram (ECG) models remains poorly characterized. Indeed, recent studies do not always yield consistent downstream gains as one increases the model size or pre-training dataset size of ECG models, leaving the exact roles of architectural inductive biases, pre-training paradigms, and expected improvements with size largely unanswered. In this work, we systematically investigate neural and loss-to-loss scaling laws within the ECG domain. By pre-training over $120$ models (ranging from $20$K to $200$M parameters) on the large-scale CODE dataset ($2.3$M records), we decouple the effects of model architecture (ResNet vs. Transformer) and pre-training paradigm, namely supervised learning (SL) versus self-supervised learning (SSL).
