We found that (i) SL models are data-bottlenecked in-distribution, whereas SSL models scale robustly across both model and data sizes; (ii) for out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization, ResNets are $1.3$ to $2.5$ times more parameter-efficient than Transformers, while SSL is up to $16$ times more data-efficient and achieves up to $7.6$ times higher transfer efficiency than SL on unseen clinical tasks; (iii) across the observed scales, ResNet-based models generally achieve the lowest OOD loss, with SSL dominating on unseen clinical tasks and self-supervised Transformers overtaking at very large model sizes. Our results suggest that the path to effective ECG foundation models lies in the strategic alignment of architecture and paradigm rather than brute-force scaling.

</details>


### [151] [UNR-Explainer: Counterfactual Explanations for Unsupervised Node Representation Learning Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17285)
*Hyunju Kang,Geonhee Han,Hogun Park*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了UNR-Explainer，一种基于蒙特卡洛树搜索(MCTS)的方法，用于生成无监督节点表示学习的反事实解释，通过识别重要子图来理解下游任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 节点表示学习(如图神经网络)已成为机器学习的关键方法，对可解释性生成的需求激增，但无监督模型的解释方法仍未得到充分探索。

Method: 提出UNR-Explainer，基于蒙特卡洛树搜索(MCTS)生成反事实解释；通过扰动识别重要子图，这些子图在学习嵌入空间中会导致目标节点的k近邻发生显著变化。

Result: 该方法在多个数据集上针对无监督GraphSAGE和DGI模型展现了优越的性能，能够为top-k链路预测和聚类等无监督下游任务提供解释。

Conclusion: 基于k近邻的反事实解释方法能够为无监督节点表示学习提供简单而关键的信息，有效填补了无监督模型解释方法的空白。

Abstract: Node representation learning, such as Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), has emerged as a pivotal method in machine learning. The demand for reliable explanation generation surges, yet unsupervised models remain underexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce a method for generating counterfactual (CF) explanations in unsupervised node representation learning. We identify the most important subgraphs that cause a significant change in the k-nearest neighbors of a node of interest in the learned embedding space upon perturbation. The k-nearest neighbor-based CF explanation method provides simple, yet pivotal, information for understanding unsupervised downstream tasks, such as top-k link prediction and clustering. Consequently, we introduce UNR-Explainer for generating expressive CF explanations for Unsupervised Node Representation learning methods based on a Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS). The proposed method demonstrates superior performance on diverse datasets for unsupervised GraphSAGE and DGI.

</details>


### [152] [LEAP: Learnable End-to-End Adaptive Pruning of Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17289)
*Mohammad Mozaffari,Younes Hourri,Mohammad Rastegari,Mahyar Najibi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了LEAP方法，通过Gumbel-Sigmoid松弛实现端到端的非结构化剪枝，在多个LLM上相比ADMM基线平均提升2.59个百分点的零样本准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的非结构化LLM剪枝方法主要基于逐层代理方法（如OBS），在激进稀疏度下会牺牲端到端精度；而现有的端到端方法（如MaskLLM和PATCH）由于参数化方式随每行有效掩码数量扩展，难以应用于非结构化场景。

Method: 提出了LEAP方法，采用逐权重的Bernoulli-via-Gumbel-Sigmoid松弛机制，替代了原有的不可处理参数化方式，使得端到端的非结构化掩码学习变得可行且高效。

Result: 在五个LLM家族（0.5B至8B参数）上，在50%和60%稀疏度下，LEAP在六项任务的平均零样本准确率上相比最佳逐层基线ADMM平均提升2.59个百分点。

Conclusion: LEAP成功弥合了逐层剪枝与端到端剪枝之间的精度差距，为非结构化稀疏剪枝提供了一种可扩展且有效的解决方案，推动了LLM高效推理的发展。

Abstract: Unstructured sparsity is now natively accelerated by recent GPU kernels and dataflow hardware, shifting the bottleneck from inference execution to the pruning algorithm. State-of-the-art methods for unstructured LLM pruning are layer-wise surrogates derived from the Optimal Brain Surgeon principle, and they sacrifice end-to-end accuracy, especially under aggressive sparsity. End-to-end alternatives such as MaskLLM and PATCH show that learnable masks can close this gap, but their categorical-over-patterns parameterization scales with the number of valid masks per row and does not port to the unstructured setting. We introduce LEAP, which replaces this intractable parameterization with a per-weight Bernoulli-via-Gumbel- sigmoid relaxation that makes end-to-end unstructured mask learning tractable. Across five LLM families from 0.5B to 8B parameters at 50% and 60% sparsity, LEAP improves six-task average zero-shot accuracy by +2.59 points on average over ADMM, the best layer-wise baseline in our sweep.

</details>


### [153] [Step-wise Rubric Rewards for LLM Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17291)
*Weichu Xie,Haozhe Zhao,Wenpu Liu,Yongfu Zhu,Liang Chen,Minghao Ye,Zirong Chen,Yuqi Xu,Shuai Dong,Ziyue Wang,Xinbo Xu,Kean Shi,Ruoyu Wu,Xiaoying Zhang,Wenqi Shao,Baobao Chang,Nan Duan,Jiaqi Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Step-wise Rubrics as Rewards (SRaR)框架，通过细粒度的逐步奖励监督解决现有方法中对正确步骤错误惩罚、错误步骤错误奖励的问题，在数学推理任务上显著提升了模型性能和推理忠实度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的可验证奖励强化学习(RLVR)仅关注最终答案正确性，缺乏对中间步骤的监督。虽然基于评分标准的方法(如RaR)引入了更细粒度的监督，但仍将评分聚合为单一标量应用于整个回答，导致三个问题：多标准结构丢失、对正确和错误步骤的统一监督、以及通过无界自我纠正导致的奖励黑客。研究发现，在正确答案的回答中18.2%的步骤是错误的却被正向奖励，而在错误答案的回答中49.9%的步骤是正确的却被惩罚。

Method: 提出Step-wise Rubrics as Rewards (SRaR)框架：(i)使用LLM评判器将每个评分项归因到特定推理步骤；(ii)在不同rollout之间归一化每步的评分标准得分，使得只有质量变化的步骤产生学习信号；(iii)通过解耦优势估计器将每步奖励与结果奖励结合，保持结果基线稳定。此外，通过对比蒸馏方法从强模型采样的正确和错误推理路径中构建了一个16K问题的评分标准数据集。

Result: 在六个数学推理基准测试中，SRaR在Qwen3-8B上平均准确率比RaR提升3.57个百分点，在Qwen3-32B上提升2.75个百分点；在AIME 2025上忠实推理率从34.5%提升至46.7%；自我纠正循环从48.1%降低至26.5%。

Conclusion: SRaR通过细粒度的逐步奖励监督有效解决了现有方法的局限性，显著提升了大语言模型的推理能力和忠实度，同时减少了奖励黑客现象。

Abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) is widely used to improve reasoning in large language models, but rewards only final-answer correctness with no supervision over intermediate steps. Rubric-based methods such as Rubrics as Rewards (RaR) introduce finer-grained supervision by scoring rollouts against structured criteria, yet the rubric scores are still aggregated into a single scalar applied to the entire response, causing three weaknesses: loss of multi-criterion structure, uniform supervision of correct and incorrect steps, and reward hacking through unbounded self-correction. On 1,000 problems, we find 18.2% of steps in correct-answer responses are wrong yet positively rewarded, while 49.9% of steps in incorrect-answer responses are correct yet penalized. We introduce Step-wise Rubrics as Rewards (SRaR), an RLVR framework that (i) uses an LLM judge to attribute each rubric item to a specific reasoning step, (ii) normalizes per-step rubric scores across rollouts so only steps whose quality varies produce a learning signal, and (iii) combines the per-step reward with the outcome reward through a decoupled advantage estimator that keeps the outcome baseline stable. We further build a 16K-problem rubric dataset by contrastively distilling rubric items from correct and flawed reasoning paths sampled from a strong model. Across six mathematical reasoning benchmarks, SRaR improves average accuracy over RaR by 3.57 points on Qwen3-8B and 2.75 points on Qwen3-32B, raises the Faithful Reasoning Rate on AIME 2025 from 34.5% to 46.7%, and reduces self-correction looping from 48.1% to 26.5%.

</details>


### [154] [DISA: Offline Importance Sampling for Distribution-Matching LLM-RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17295)
*Shaobo Wang,Yujie Chen,Yafeng Sun,Wenjie Qiu,Zhihui Xie,Sihang Li,Yucheng Li,Huiqiang Jiang,Xingzhang Ren,Xuming Hu,Dayiheng Liu,Linfeng Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出DISA方法，通过离线解耦重要性采样估计配分函数，解决了分布匹配强化学习中配分函数校准误差难以诊断的问题，在数学和代码基准上表现优异并保持了更高的策略多样性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代推理代理需要生成多条有效解路径，标准奖励最大化强化学习倾向于坍缩到最易强化的高奖励模式，而分布匹配强化学习旨在在整个奖励形成的解集上分配概率质量。然而现有分布匹配方法在线学习配分函数，其校准误差会直接扭曲策略更新且无法独立诊断。

Method: 提出DISA（解耦重要性采样锚定）方法：离线绘制提议轨迹，通过重要性采样估计配分函数，并在策略优化开始前冻结配分函数估计。这种解耦在数据、梯度、损失和诊断方面严格分离了配分函数估计与策略学习，同时保持分布匹配目标。

Result: 在两个开源骨干网络的六个数学和三个代码基准上，DISA匹配或超越在线耦合的分布匹配基线FlowRL，在数学平均上优于奖励最大化基线GRPO和GSPO，相比LoRASFT蒸馏在相同离线轨迹上提升高达13.8 Mean@8分。LLM评估显示DISA比奖励最大化基线保留更多策略级多样性，敏感度研究遵循分析预测的偏差-方差模式。

Conclusion: DISA成功将配分函数校准问题移出强化学习循环，通过解耦方式实现了分布匹配目标，同时解决了现有方法中配分函数估计与策略学习相互干扰的问题，为多样性保持的推理代理训练提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Modern reasoning agents are increasingly evaluated on their ability to generate multiple valid solution paths, plans, or tool-use traces for a given input. Standard reward-maximizing RL tends to collapse onto the most easily reinforced high-reward mode, whereas distribution-matching RL aims to allocate probability mass across the entire reward-shaped solution set. Achieving this objective requires computing a prompt-dependent partition function over the trajectory space. Because existing distribution-matching methods learn this partition function online alongside the policy, calibration errors in the partition function directly distort policy updates and remain impossible to diagnose independently. We introduce DISA, short for Decoupled Importance-Sampled Anchoring, which moves this calibration problem outside the RL loop. DISA draws proposal trajectories offline, estimates the partition function via importance sampling, and freezes the resulting partition-function estimate before policy optimization begins. This decoupling preserves the distribution-matching objective while strictly separating partition-function estimation from policy learning in data, gradients, loss, and diagnostics. Empirically, on two open-weight backbones across six math and three code benchmarks, DISA matches or exceeds the online-coupled distribution-matching baseline FlowRL, outperforms rewardmaximization baselines GRPO and GSPO on math averages, and exceeds LoRASFT distillation by up to 13.8 Mean@8 points on the same offline trajectories. An LLM-as-judge evaluation further shows that DISA retains substantially more strategy-level diversity than reward-maximization baselines, and sensitivity studies on the proposal strength and inverse temperature follow the bias-variance pattern predicted by the analysis.

</details>


### [155] [Compress the Context, Keep the Commitments: A Formal Framework for Verifiable LLM Context Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17304)
*Natalia Trukhina,Vadim Vashkelis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Context Codec框架，将对话上下文视为语义承诺集合而非简单的token序列，实现承诺级别的可验证压缩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有上下文管理方法（截断、检索、摘要等）缺乏对语义承诺保留的明确规范和测量标准，无法确保压缩后关键目标、约束、决策、安全边界等信息完整保留。

Method: 提出承诺级压缩框架Context Codec，将对话状态表示为类型化、可溯源的语义原子，具备规范身份、等价性、冲突、置信度、风险和证据跨度；分离提取、规范化、表示、渲染和验证五个关注点；引入Critical Atom Recall等评估指标；定义语义压缩错误分类法和保守回退规则；设计ASCII优先的紧凑渲染格式CCL。

Result: 小规模诊断研究表明，CCL-Core在结构化散文和JSON之间取得平衡：比散文更明确可审计，比JSON更紧凑，比高度精简符号风险更低。

Conclusion: 该框架使上下文压缩可验证，确保压缩对话的同时保留语义承诺，为承诺保留提供了系统化的度量标准和规范流程。

Abstract: LLM context is not just tokens; it is a set of commitments. Long-running conversations accumulate goals, constraints, decisions, preferences, tool results, retrieved evidence, artifacts, and safety boundaries that future responses must preserve. Existing context-management methods reduce length through truncation, retrieval, summarization, memory systems, or token-level prompt compression, but they rarely specify which semantic commitments must survive compression or how their preservation should be measured. We propose Context Codec, a commitment-level framework for compressing prompts and chat histories.
  Context Codec represents dialogue state as typed, source-grounded semantic atoms with canonical identity, equivalence, conflict, confidence, risk, and evidence spans. It separates five concerns - extraction, normalization, representation, rendering, and verification - and introduces metrics for Critical Atom Recall, Weighted Atom Recall, Commitment Density, and round-trip recoverability. It also defines a taxonomy of semantic compression errors, a concrete normalization procedure, conservative fallback rules for low-confidence and safety-critical atoms, and Context Compression Language (CCL), an ASCII-first compact rendering of canonical JSON atoms. In a small diagnostic study, CCL-Core occupies a useful middle ground between structured prose and JSON: more explicit and auditable than prose, usually more compact than JSON, and less risky than heavily minified notation. The result is not a claim that shorthand solves compression, but a framework for making context compression verifiable: compress the conversation, keep the commitments.

</details>


### [156] [Learning Higher-Order Structure from Incomplete Spatiotemporal Data: Multi-Scale Hypergraph Laplacians with Neural Refinement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17316)
*Keshu Wu,Sixu Li,Zihao Li,Zhiwen Fan,Xiaopeng Li,Yang Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了多尺度超图拉普拉斯算子（MSHL）框架，用于处理传感器网络中非随机缺失的结构化数据，在交通网络实验中表现出优于传统成对图方法的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传感器网络中的数据缺失往往呈现结构化模式（如校准期间离线、区域集群静默、新设备无历史数据等），这种缺失受到传感器组之间高阶关系的约束。现有的低秩和基于图的方法通常忽略这种集体结构，在缺失数据具有一致性时容易失效。

Method: 提出两阶段框架MSHL：发现阶段从拓扑和残差相关性证据构建多尺度超图，使用仅观测选择器自适应支持的交互尺度；精细化阶段添加小型超图条件残差网络，在有信息的残差特征处学习非线性修正，否则退化为线性估计。

Result: 在两个真实交通网络上，针对分散缺失、连续块缺失和全传感器中断三种场景及五种缺失率进行评估。MSHL在可识别高阶结构时优于成对图基线，其他情况下在采样噪声范围内匹配基线性能。理论证明了MSHL能表示成对图先验无法捕获的组守恒模式，并以对数因子自适应最佳固定尺度。

Conclusion: 研究结果指出了可靠基础设施学习的更广泛原则：缺失数据不应被视为需要填充的孤立条目，而应作为待发现结构的证据。这一原则为处理具有结构性缺失的传感器网络数据提供了新视角。

Abstract: Sensor networks increasingly govern modern infrastructure, yet the data they lose are rarely missing in the uniform-random patterns assumed by standard imputation benchmarks. Loop detectors go offline during calibration, roadside cabinets silence clusters of nearby sensors, and newly installed instruments provide no history. Such failures create structured absences whose values are constrained by higher-order relations among groups of sensors, not merely by pairwise proximity. Existing low-rank and graph-based methods often miss this collective structure and can fail when missingness becomes coherent. We introduce Multi-Scale Hypergraph Laplacians (MSHL), a two-stage framework for learning higher-order structure from incomplete spatiotemporal observations. The Discovery stage builds a multi-scale hypergraph from complementary topology and residual-correlation evidence, with an observation-only selector that adapts to the supported interaction scale. The Refinement stage adds a small hypergraph-conditioned residual network that is safe by construction: it learns nonlinear corrections where informative residual features exist and defers to the linear estimate where they do not. We prove that MSHL represents group-conservation patterns inaccessible to pairwise graph priors, adapts to the best fixed scale up to a logarithmic factor, transfers this advantage to held-out imputation error, and admits a one-sided refinement guarantee. On two real traffic networks evaluated across scattered cell missingness, contiguous block outages, and whole-sensor blackouts at five rates, MSHL improves over a pairwise-graph baseline whenever higher-order structure is identifiable and otherwise matches it within sampling noise. The results point to a broader principle for reliable infrastructure learning: missing data should be treated not as isolated entries to fill, but as evidence of structure to discover.

</details>


### [157] [Leveraging Error Diversity in Group Rollouts for Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17333)
*Wenpu Liu,Yuqi Xu,Weichu Xie,Yongfu Zhu,Shuai Dong,Ziyue Wang,Wenqi Shao,Xiaoying Zhang,Tong Yang,Nan Duan,Jiaqi Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出EDAS方法，通过利用群体输出中的错误多样性信息来增强RLVR训练，在7个数学基准上平均提升6.29分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR通常对每个提示采样多个响应并基于个体正确性分配二元奖励，但群体输出的集体结构（特别是错误分布）被大量忽略。实证分析发现，组内错误多样性是训练成功的强预测因子：产生多样化错误答案的问题比产生同质化失败的问题从RLVR中获益更多。

Method: 提出错误多样性优势整形（EDAS），一种轻量级、算法无关的技术，根据组内错误多样性调整错误rollout的优势信号。EDAS放大对占主导地位的重复错误的惩罚，减弱对罕见探索性错误的惩罚，从而鼓励模型保持多样化推理路径并抑制错误持续。该方法作为简单的后验调整，可无缝集成到任何RLVR算法中。

Result: 在多个主流RLVR方法、一系列模型和七个挑战性数学基准上验证EDAS，展示了一致的改进。值得注意的是，EDAS在Qwen3-8B上七个基准测试中相比DAPO平均提升6.29分。

Conclusion: 利用群体rollout中的潜在信息是增强RLVR的广泛有效策略，证明了错误多样性对强化学习训练的重要价值。

Abstract: Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) typically samples multiple responses per prompt and assigns binary rewards based on individual correctness, yet the collective structure of the group output, specifically the distribution of errors, is largely discarded. We identify this as a missed opportunity: empirical analysis reveals that error diversity within a group is a strong predictor of training success, with problems eliciting diverse wrong answers benefiting substantially more from RLVR than those producing homogeneous failures. Motivated by this observation, we propose Error Diversity Advantage Shaping (EDAS), a lightweight, algorithm-agnostic technique that modulates the advantage signal for incorrect rollouts based on intra-group error diversity. EDAS amplifies penalties for dominant, repeated errors and attenuates penalties for rare, exploratory ones, thereby encouraging the model to maintain diverse reasoning paths and discouraging error perseveration. Crucially, EDAS operates as a simple post-hoc adjustment that can be seamlessly integrated into any RLVR algorithm. We validate EDAS on top of several mainstream RLVR methods across a series of models and seven challenging math benchmarks, demonstrating consistent improvements. Notably, EDAS yields an average improvement of 6.29 points over DAPO on Qwen3-8B across seven benchmarks, confirming that exploiting the latent information in group rollouts is a broadly effective strategy for strengthening RLVR.

</details>


### [158] [Bridging the Gap between Sparse Matrix Reordering and Factorization: A Deep Learning Framework for Fill-in Reduction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17339)
*Ziwei Li,Tao Yuan,Shuzi Niu,Huiyuan Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个基于深度学习的稀疏矩阵重排序框架，通过学习填充近似函数来缩小重排序与分解之间的差距，实现了与传统图论算法和深度学习方法相当的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏矩阵重排序可以显著减少矩阵分解过程中的填充元，从而降低计算和存储需求。然而，寻找最小填充排序是一个NP难问题，且存在一个悖论：矩阵重排序应用于矩阵分解之前，但其目标减少的填充元却是在矩阵分解过程中产生的。这导致了重排序与分解之间存在差距。

Method: 提出了一种基于谱嵌入的深度学习框架来最小化填充近似函数。首先，采用类多重网格图神经网络（GNN）架构来近似图拉普拉斯矩阵的最小特征向量（即谱嵌入），从而捕获矩阵的全局结构信息。然后，利用另一个类多重网格GNN架构，基于秩分布来最小化可能发生填充的潜在空间。

Result: 实验结果表明，该方法与传统图论算法和现有深度学习方法相比，取得了具有竞争力的性能。

Conclusion: 该研究成功弥合了矩阵重排序与分解之间的差距，证明了基于深度学习和谱嵌入的方法在解决稀疏矩阵填充最小化问题上的有效性，为稀疏矩阵计算提供了新的解决思路。

Abstract: Sparse matrix reordering can significantly reduce the fill-in during matrix factorization, thereby decreasing the computational and storage requirements in sparse matrix computations. Finding a minimal fill-in ordering is known to be an NP-hard problem. Moreover, there is a paradox: matrix reordering is applied before matrix factorization, but fill-ins that matrix reordering methods aim at are generated from matrix factorization. To bridge the gap between reordering and factorization, we propose a deep learning framework to minimize a fill-in surrogate function based on spectral embedding. First, we employ a multi-grid-like GNN architecture to learn to approximate the smallest eigenvectors of its graph Laplacian matrix, i.e. spectral embedding, and capture the global structural information of the matrix. Then, another multi-grid-like GNN architecture is used to minimize the potential space where fill-in can occur based on the rank distribution. Experimental results indicate that our approach achieves competitive performance compared with traditional graph-theoretic algorithms and deep learning methods.

</details>


### [159] [Olivia: Harmonizing Time Series Foundation Models with Power Spectral Density](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17340)
*Jingru Fei,Kun Yi,Alex Xing Wang,Qingsong Wen,Xiangxiang Zhu,Wei Fan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Olivia时间序列基础模型，通过Harmonizer模块在频谱域协调不同数据集的功率谱密度(PSD)，解决数据集异构性问题，并设计HarmonicAttention实现高效注意力机制，在多个基准测试中达到SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列基础模型依赖于跨域大规模预训练，但不同数据集间时间模式的异构性会阻碍训练效果和可迁移时间序列表示的学习。为解决数据集不匹配问题，作者受信号处理中归一化功率谱密度概念启发，假设在频谱域通过PSD协调数据集可以减少不匹配并增强预训练效果。

Method: 1. 提出Harmonizer模块：重塑频谱结构，隐式协调跨数据集的PSD，理论对应于二阶时间相关性的共享重参数化；
2. 设计HarmonicAttention：基于理论分析，通过紧凑的谐振器集高效调节token交互，在低维交互空间执行自注意力；
3. 构建Olivia时间序列基础模型：集成上述协调机制。

Result: 在TSLib和GIFT-Eval两个大规模基准测试以及GluonTS的额外6个数据集上进行广泛实验，结果表明Olivia在零样本、少样本和全样本预测场景下均持续达到最先进性能。

Conclusion: 通过在频谱域协调数据集异构性，所提出的协调机制能有效提升时间序列基础模型的预训练效果，Harmonizer模块和HarmonicAttention设计为解决数据集不匹配问题提供了理论支撑和实践方案。

Abstract: Time series foundation models rely on large-scale pretraining over diverse datasets across domains, yet their heterogeneity in temporal patterns could hinder the effectiveness of training and learning transferable time series representations. Inspired a fundamental concept, normalized power spectral density (PSD) in signal processing, we assume harmonizing datasets via PSDs in the spectral domain could reduce mismatches and enhance pretraining. We then go beyond the direct intractable minimization optimization and innovatively reformulate it as a principled harmonization approach. Specifically, we propose Harmonizer, a module that reshapes spectral structures and implicitly harmonizing PSDs across datasets, which theoretically corresponds to a shared reparameterization of second-order temporal correlations. Our theoretical analysis further reveals token interactions with Harmonizer can be efficiently mediated by a compact set of resonators, motivating a HarmonicAttention design that performs self-attention in a low-dimensional interaction space. Then, we propose Olivia, a novel time series foundation model built upon these harmonization mechanisms. Extensive experiments on two large-scale benchmarks (TSLib and GIFT-Eval) and extra 6 datasets from GluonTS, demonstrate Olivia consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance under zero-shot, few-shot, and full-shot forecasting scenarios. Our code is available at \url{https://github.com/aikunyi/Olivia}.

</details>


### [160] [\textsc{MasFACT}: Continual Multi-Agent Topology Learning via Geometry-Aware Posterior Transfer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17361)
*Xuefei Wang,Jialu Wang,Fengbo Zhang,Yihan Hu,Di Zhang,Yutong Ye,Yikun Ban,Jun Han,Ruijie Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型驱动的多智能体系统在持续学习场景下的**拓扑遗忘**问题，提出了**MasFACT**框架，通过几何感知的后验迁移方法保留历史协作知识，有效平衡了新任务适应与旧知识保留，显著提升了持续学习性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的多智能体系统拓扑生成方法主要针对孤立任务进行优化，但在实际部署中面临连续演变的任务流。本文首次识别并提出**拓扑遗忘（Topology Forgetting）**这一失败模式：在适应新任务时，拓扑生成器会偏离早期任务所需的通信结构，导致历史有效协作模式丢失。这一问题的根源在于跨任务间智能体功能语义和关系通信结构的错位。

Method: 提出**MasFACT**（几何感知后验迁移框架）：1) 将历史协作知识作为可迁移的拓扑先验进行保存和复用；2) 利用**融合Gromov-Wasserstein最优传输**在任务特定的智能体空间之间迁移先验；3) 采用**PAC-Bayes引导的保守后验适应**策略，平衡任务特定的可塑性与结构稳定性。该方法可与不同的MAS拓扑生成器无缝集成。

Result: 在类别级、领域级和任务级三种持续学习设置下的实验表明：MasFACT相比强基准拓扑生成方法和基于回放的方法，持续提升了平均准确率，同时显著降低了拓扑遗忘现象。

Conclusion: MasFACT为多智能体系统的持续学习提供了一种有效的解决方案，通过几何感知的知识迁移机制成功解决了拓扑遗忘问题，证明了在动态任务流中保留和复用历史协作模式的重要性，具有良好的泛化性和即插即用特性。

Abstract: Multi-agent systems (MAS) powered by large language models (LLMs) have emerged as a powerful paradigm for complex problem solving, where performance critically depends on the underlying inter-agent communication topology. However, existing topology generation methods mainly optimize for isolated tasks, while real-world deployments involve streams of evolving tasks, requiring previously effective collaboration patterns to be retained and reused rather than rediscovered or overwritten. We identify a previously underexplored failure mode, \emph{topology forgetting}, in which adapting to new tasks shifts the topology generator away from communication structures required by earlier tasks. This issue stems from cross-task misalignment in both agent-level functional semantics and relational communication structures. To address this challenge, we propose \textbf{\textsc{MasFACT}}, a geometry-aware posterior transfer framework that preserves and reuses historical collaboration knowledge as transferable topology priors. We transfer these priors across task-specific agent spaces through Fused Gromov-Wasserstein optimal transport and perform PAC-Bayes-guided conservative posterior adaptation to balance task-specific plasticity with structural stability. Experiments across class-, domain-, and task-level continual settings demonstrate that \textsc{MasFACT} consistently improves average accuracy while reducing topology forgetting compared to strong topology generation and replay-based baselines, and can be seamlessly integrated with different MAS topology generators.

</details>


### [161] [Learning Fill-in Reduction Ordering via Graph Policy Optimization for Sparse Matrices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17362)
*Ziwei Li,Shuzi Niu,Huiyuan Li,Tao Yuan,Wenjia Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种图策略优化方法，通过全局和局部视角建模填充元，在稀疏矩阵重排序问题上实现了显著的性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模稀疏求解器中的矩阵重排序旨在寻找一种排列以最小化分解填充元，从而减少内存和计算开销。然而，最小填充元排序问题是NP完全的，且填充元隐含于稀疏模式中，现有强化学习方法要么忽略稀疏模式（错失全局填充信息），要么缺乏局部精确填充反馈。

Method: 提出了一种图策略优化方法，从全局和局部视角建模填充元：策略网络和价值网络均采用多跳图神经网络骨干来嵌入全局填充信息；策略网络进一步与图上的符号分解交互以提取局部、步骤级的填充元，所得反馈通过自适应饱和函数与价值网络对齐以改善收敛性。

Result: 在SuiteSparse矩阵集合上，该方法相比最先进的基线方法，填充元平均减少29.3，峰值内存使用量平均减少31.3。

Conclusion: 该研究成功地将全局和局部视角的填充元信息融合到强化学习框架中，为稀疏矩阵重排序这一NP完全问题提供了有效的解决方案，在减少填充元和内存使用方面取得了显著改进。

Abstract: Matrix reordering in large sparse solvers seeks a permutation that minimizes factorization fill-in to reduce memory and computation. Because the minimum fill-in ordering problem is NP-complete and fill-in is implicit in the sparsity pattern, graph-theoretic heuristics are used. Existing reinforcement learning methods either ignore sparsity patterns--missing the global fill-in--or lack local exact fill-in feedback. We propose a graph policy optimization method, modeling fill-ins from global and local views: both the policy and value networks use a multi-hop graph neural backbone to embed global fill-in; the policy further interacts with symbolic factorization over graphs to extract local, step-level fill-ins, and the resulting feedback is aligned with the value network via an adaptive saturation function to improve convergence. On the SuiteSparse Matrix Collection, our method achieves mean reductions of 29.3 in fill-ins and 31.3 in peak memory usage over state-of-the-art baselines.

</details>


### [162] [FML-bench: A Controlled Study of AI Research Agent Strategies from the Perspective of Search Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17373)
*Qiran Zou,Hou Hei Lam,Wenhao Zhao,Tingting Chen,Yiming Tang,Samson Yu,Yingtao Zhu,Srinivas Anumasa,Zufeng Zhang,Tianyi Zhang,Chang Liu,Zhengyao Jiang,Anirudh Goyal,Dianbo Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了FML-Bench基准，用于分离评估AI研究智能体的策略与基础设施。实验发现策略复杂度不保证高性能，贪心搜索在密集机会下有效，树搜索在稀疏机会下有效；提出了基于此洞察的自适应智能体，表现最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的AI研究智能体策略（如贪心爬山、树搜索、进化优化）性能差异的原因尚不明确。为了回答这个问题，需要一个能够分离智能体策略与执行基础设施、并提供过程级指标以分析探索行为的基准测试，而现有基准对此支持有限。

Method: 提出了FML-Bench基准，包含跨10个领域的18个基础ML研究任务。该基准将智能体策略与执行基础设施分离，并定义了12个过程级行为指标。在此基础上评估了六种代表性智能体，并设计了一种能够检测改进停滞并切换探索策略的自适应智能体。

Result: （1）策略复杂度不保证高性能：简单的贪心爬山算法性能接近表现最好的树搜索智能体；（2）发现改进机会的结构影响策略有效性：贪心搜索在机会密集时更有效，树搜索和进化策略在机会稀疏时更有效，基于此洞察的自适应智能体优于其他六种智能体；（3）过程级分析表明，早期收敛和方向性聚焦探索与最终性能显著相关，而解决方案多样性和计算成本则无关。

Conclusion: 通过FML-Bench基准的分析，揭示了不同智能体策略在不同改进机会结构下的适用性，并证明了基于过程级指标构建自适应策略的有效性，为AI研究智能体的策略选择和优化提供了新的见解。

Abstract: AI research agents accelerate ML research by automating hypothesis generation, experimentation, and empirical refinement. Existing agent strategies range from greedy hill-climbing to tree search and evolutionary optimization, yet which strategy choices drive performance remains unclear. Answering this question requires a benchmark that separates agent strategy (e.g., search topology) from execution infrastructure (e.g., code editor), so that performance differences are attributable to strategy rather than infrastructure, and that provides process-level metrics beyond final scores to analyze exploration behaviors. Existing benchmarks offer limited support. We propose FML-Bench, a benchmark of 18 fundamental ML research tasks across 10 domains that separates agent strategy from execution infrastructure and defines 12 process-level behavioral metrics. Evaluating six representative agents, we find that: (1) strategy complexity alone does not guarantee strong performance: a simple greedy hill-climber nearly matches the best-performing tree-search agent, both well above the remaining agents; (2) our analysis suggests this pattern relates to improvement opportunity structure: greedy search tends to be more effective when opportunities are dense, while tree-search and evolutionary strategies tend to be more effective when opportunities are sparse; an adaptive agent built on this insight switches to broader exploration upon detecting improvement stagnation and outperforms the other six agents, lending initial support to this observation; and (3) process-level analysis reveals that early convergence and directionally focused exploration are significantly associated with final performance, while solution diversity and compute cost are not. Our benchmark is available at: https://github.com/qrzou/FML-bench.

</details>


### [163] [Self-Supervised Learning for Sparse Matrix Reordering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17403)
*Ziwei Li,Tao Yuan,Fangfang Liu,Shuzi Niu,Huiyuan Li,Wenjia Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于填充路径定理的深度学习方法，通过多重网格图网络和三元组采样策略优化稀疏矩阵排序，有效减少LU分解中的填充元数量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏矩阵的行或列排序可显著减少矩阵分解过程中的填充元（新引入的非零元），从而降低内存使用和运行时间。然而，最小化填充元的排序问题是NP完全问题，现有方法（包括图论和深度学习方法）依赖代理目标，缺乏理论保证。

Method: 1. 利用多重网格图网络捕获每个顶点的结构信息；2. 基于填充路径定理揭示的路径三元组不等式，推导出三元组采样策略；3. 引入末端最大链损失函数，以减少预测分数满足这些不等式的三元组数量。

Result: 在公开的SuiteSparse矩阵集合上的实验评估表明，该方法在填充元减少和LU分解时间加速方面均优于现有方法。

Conclusion: 所提出的方法通过直接利用填充路径定理的理论关系，实现了填充元减少的理论指导，实验验证了其在稀疏矩阵排序任务中的优越性。

Abstract: Rearranging the rows or columns of a sparse matrix using an appropriate ordering can significantly reduce fill-ins, i.e., new nonzeros introduced during matrix factorization, decreasing memory usage and runtime. However, finding an ordering that minimizes fill-ins is NP-complete. Existing approaches, including graph-theoretic and deep learning methods, rely on surrogate objectives without theoretical guarantees. The Fill-Path Theorem reveals a direct and intrinsic relationship between fill-in generation and the sparse structure of the matrix as path triplet inequalities. Here we first employ a multigrid graph network to capture structural information for each vertex. We then derive a triplet sampling strategy based on inequalities. Finally, we introduce an end-max chain loss function to reduce the number of triplets whose predicted scores satisfy these inequalities. Experimental evaluations on the publicly available SuiteSparse matrix collection demonstrate the superiority of the proposed method in terms of both fill-in reduction and speedup in LU factorization time.

</details>


### [164] [IVF-TQ: Streaming-Robust Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search via a Codebook-Free Residual Layer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17415)
*Tarun Sharma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出IVF-TQ索引，通过无码本残差量化层解决了训练码本方法（PQ/OPQ/ScaNN）在流式摄入中的性能退化问题，在流式场景下保持稳定性能而无需重新训练码本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于训练码本的ANN索引（如PQ、OPQ、ScaNN）在流式数据摄入场景下存在码本过时问题，即使进行重新训练也无法有效恢复性能退化。

Method: 设计IVF-TQ索引，包含固定随机旋转和预计算的Lloyd-Max标量量化（仅依赖参数b和d），只需训练IVF粗分区；提出自适应IVF-TQ通过仅刷新分区来应对旋转偏移。

Result: 在Deep-10M流式场景下，IVF-TQ召回率从87.4%微降至86.6%（-0.80pp），而IVF-PQ下降3.23pp；在SIFT-1M混洗控制实验中IVF-PQ损失3.9pp；自适应IVF-TQ在最坏旋转偏移下恢复至97.8%（带重排序）。

Conclusion: IVF-TQ在流式操作场景下提供了鲁棒的性能稳定性，虽然在高内存预算下PQ绝对召回率更高，但IVF-TQ的操作优势在于无需码本重训练，适合流式数据管理。

Abstract: We propose IVF-TQ, an IVF index with a codebook-free residual layer: a fixed random rotation followed by precomputed Lloyd-Max scalar quantization depending only on (b, d). Only the IVF coarse partition is trained. Building on TurboQuant (Zandieh et al., 2025), the design substantially reduces a key failure mode of trained-codebook ANN indexes (PQ, OPQ, ScaNN): staleness under streaming ingestion.Empirical (3 seeds): Per-batch PQ retraining does not recover the streaming gap at any tested bit budget (paired-t p > 0.28 everywhere). On streaming Deep-10M, IVF-TQ holds at 87.4% -> 86.6% (Delta = -0.80 +/- 0.10pp) while IVF-PQ degrades -3.23pp. A shuffled-i.i.d. control on SIFT-1M shows IVF-PQ losing -3.9pp without distribution shift. At higher PQ bit budgets (~1.5x IVF-TQ memory), absolute recall favors PQ as expected from rate-distortion (+6.1pp Deep-10M; +2.0pp SIFT-10M); the durable IVF-TQ benefit is operational (no codebook to retrain), robust across memory regimes.Prior art: IVF around a codebook-free residual quantizer is architecturally not new -- IVF-RaBitQ ships in Milvus, cuVS, LanceDB, Weaviate; Shi et al. (2026) is concurrent GPU work. TurboQuant itself tests only flat-rotation ANN.Contributions: (i) A multi-seed streaming-operational story for codebook-free IVF: 10M-scale evidence across PQ memory budgets. (ii) A uniform-over-sphere IP-error bound for the TQ residual quantizer with one fixed rotation (proof sketch in v1; rigorous in v2). (iii) Adaptive IVF-TQ: a partition-only refresh recovering 67% -> 97.8% under worst-case rotation shift with re-ranking (90.3% without).Code, data: https://github.com/tarun-ks/turboquant_search

</details>


### [165] [Learning Displacement-Robust Representations for Landslide Early Warning under Rainfall Forecast Uncertainty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17419)
*Ren Ozeki,Hamada Rizk,Hirozumi Yamaguchi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对降雨预报中存在的空间位移误差会导致滑坡预测精度下降的问题，本文提出了一种基于降雨运动感知对比学习（RMCL）的滑坡预警系统，通过学习在降雨场运动位移下保持稳定的潜在表征，显著提升了预测精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的滑坡预测方法大多假设降雨输入是准确的，但在实际业务运行中，预测依赖于往往包含降雨场空间位移不确定性的降雨预报。这种位移会改变局部的累积降雨量，从而严重降低滑坡预测的准确性。为了解决这一挑战，需要开发一种对降雨场位移具有鲁棒性的预警系统。

Method: 提出了一种对降雨场位移具有鲁棒性的新型滑坡预警系统。其核心思想是从降雨和地形数据中学习在降雨场运动位移下仍保持稳定的潜在表征。具体采用了降雨运动感知对比学习（RMCL）方法，通过引入时间相关的降雨场扰动，来模拟预报引起的降雨驱动时空环境数据流中的位移情况，从而实现可靠的地理空间数据集成。

Result: 在日本19个发生过滑坡事件的区域，利用两年的降雨和地形数据进行了实验。结果表明，与最先进的基线方法相比，该系统实现了高达37%的精度提升。

Conclusion: 将降雨建模为移动的空间场，并在学习过程中解决降雨场位移问题，能显著提高业务化早期预警系统中短期滑坡预测的可靠性。

Abstract: Rainfall-induced landslides pose a growing risk worldwide as climate change intensifies extreme rainfall events. To provide sufficient evacuation time, landslide early warning systems (LEWS) for real-time disaster monitoring must estimate near-future landslide risk by integrating observed rainfall with short-term rainfall forecasts from spatio-temporal environmental data streams. Although recent landslide prediction methods have improved predictive performance using statistical and deep learning approaches, most assume accurate rainfall inputs. In operational settings, however, landslide prediction relies on rainfall forecasts, which often contain spatial displacement of rainfall fields due to forecasting uncertainties. Such displacement can alter local accumulated rainfall and degrade prediction accuracy. To address this challenge, we propose a novel LEWS robust to rainfall field displacement. The key idea is to learn latent representations from rainfall and terrain data that remain stable under displacement in rainfall field motion, enabling reliable geospatial data integration for landslide risk estimation. The landslide prediction model is trained using Rainfall-Motion-Aware Contrastive Learning (RMCL), which introduces temporally correlated rainfall field perturbations to emulate forecast-induced displacement in rainfall-driven spatio-temporal environmental data streams. Experiments were conducted using two years of rainfall and terrain data across Japan, covering 19 regions with landslide events. The proposed system achieved up to 37% higher precision than state-of-the-art baselines. These results demonstrate that modeling rainfall as a moving spatial field and addressing rainfall field displacement during learning significantly improve the reliability of short-term landslide prediction in operational early warning systems.

</details>


### [166] [Progressive Generalization Augmentation with Deeply Coupled RND-PPO and Domain-Prioritized Noise Injection for Robust Crop Management Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17428)
*Wu Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对农业强化学习系统在实际部署中的鲁棒性问题，提出了PGA、深度耦合RND-PPO架构和领域优先噪声注入三项创新，在玉米灌溉任务中实现了产量提升和更强的抗干扰能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有PPO策略在gym-DSSAT玉米灌溉任务中，当存在±2°C温度噪声时，经济收益下降11.9%，暴露出系统鲁棒性不足。现有研究未充分解决早期学习效率与后期泛化能力的权衡、内在与外在奖励的简单加性组合、以及忽略农业状态变量敏感性差异的均匀噪声注入策略这三个关键局限。

Method: 提出三项系统性创新：1）渐进泛化增强（PGA），实施三阶段课程学习（清洁训练0-800轮次、渐进阶段800-1200、完全增强1200-2000）；2）深度耦合RND-PPO架构，采用双通道GAE归一化、进度衰减内在系数和语义离散化；3）领域优先噪声注入与分层激活机制。

Result: 在佛罗里达实验中，相比SOTA BERT-DQN实现产量提升8.43%、氮素利用效率提升16.42%；在萨拉戈萨实现产量提升5.61%（受地中海气候挑战影响，经济得分低3.67%）；在组合扰动下性能保持率达94.4% vs 80.0%。实验使用5个随机种子，在NVIDIA A100 GPU上运行，单次耗时4.2±0.3小时（2000轮次，2048步缓冲区，64批次大小）。

Conclusion: 所提出的方法有效解决了农业强化学习系统的鲁棒性缺陷，显著提升了在噪声干扰下的性能保持能力，为实际农业部署提供了更可靠的解决方案。

Abstract: Our preliminary experiments on gym-DSSAT maize irrigation tasks revealed that +/-2 degrees C temperature noise causes an 11.9% reduction in economic returns for PPO policies trained under clean conditions - a systematic robustness deficit that existing research has not adequately addressed.
  This paper tackles three interconnected limitations impeding practical deployment of agricultural RL systems: the trade-off between early-stage learning efficiency and late-stage generalization capability; the naive additive combination of intrinsic and extrinsic rewards in exploration-augmented PPO; and uniform measurement noise injection strategies that disregard empirically validated differential sensitivity across agricultural state variables.
  We introduce three systematic innovations: Progressive Generalization Augmentation (PGA) implementing a three-phase curriculum (clean training 0-800 episodes, progressive 800-1200, full augmentation 1200-2000); a deeply coupled RND-PPO architecture with dual-channel GAE normalization, progress-decayed intrinsic coefficients, and semantic discretization; and domain-prioritized noise injection with hierarchical activation.
  Our experimental evaluation demonstrates: 8.43% yield improvement and 16.42% nitrogen use efficiency improvement over SOTA BERT-DQN in Florida; 5.61% yield improvement in Zaragoza (though 3.67% lower economic score due to challenging Mediterranean climate); and 94.4% vs 80.0% performance retention under combined perturbations.
  All experiments used 5 random seeds on NVIDIA A100 GPUs with 4.2+/-0.3 hours per run (2000 episodes, 2048-step buffer, 64 mini-batch size).

</details>


### [167] [Radial-Angular Geometry for Reliable Update Diagnosis in Noisy-Label Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17429)
*Ningkang Peng,Jingyang Mao,Xiaoqian Peng,Weiguang Qu,Yanhui Gu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出相对几何冲突（RGC）方法，通过对比观测标签梯度与EMA教师梯度的冲突程度来区分困难干净样本和误标注样本，有效提升噪声标签学习性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有噪声标签方法主要依赖损失、置信度等前向空间信号来估计样本可靠性，但这类信号无法直接测试观测标签是否产生可靠的参数更新。困难干净样本和误标注样本可能具有相似的损失值，却诱导不同的参数更新，导致传统方法难以有效区分。

Method: 将可靠性估计重新定义为观测标签更新的诊断过程。首先利用样本经验Fisher迹作为后向空间的更新能量度量，其分解为预测残差项和特征敏感度项，包含比标量损失更丰富的信息。进而提出相对几何冲突（RGC），通过比较观测标签梯度与EMA教师诱导的参考梯度之间的冲突程度，区分大但对齐的困难干净更新与大但冲突的误标注更新。

Result: 在合成和真实噪声标签基准数据集上，RGC方法在所提评估协议下有效提升了困难干净样本的保留率和分类准确率。

Conclusion: 通过从后向空间视角分析参数更新并结合梯度间的几何冲突信息，RGC能够更有效地区分困难干净样本与误标注样本，为噪声标签学习提供了新的可靠性估计范式。

Abstract: Noisy-label methods often estimate sample reliability from forward-space signals such as loss, confidence, or entropy. These signals indicate whether a sample is difficult to predict, but they do not directly test whether its observed label induces a reliable parameter update. This gap matters because hard clean samples and mislabeled samples can have similar loss while inducing different updates. We recast reliability estimation as diagnosis of the observed-label update. The sample-wise empirical Fisher trace gives a backward-space measure of update energy: for the classifier layer, it factorizes into a prediction-residual term and a feature-sensitivity term, so it captures information beyond scalar loss. Trace, however, is still a radial magnitude signal and cannot decide whether a large update is useful or harmful. We therefore propose Relative Geometric Conflict (RGC), which compares the observed-label gradient with a reference gradient induced by an EMA teacher. The conflict term helps distinguish large but aligned hard-clean updates from large conflicting updates caused by corrupted labels. Across synthetic and real-world noisy-label benchmarks, RGC improves hard-clean preservation and accuracy under our evaluation protocol.

</details>


### [168] [MATE: Solving Contextual Markov Decision Processes with Memory of Accumulated Transition Embeddings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17431)
*Himchan Hwang,Hyeokju Jeong,Gene Chung,Seungyeon Kim,Sangwoong Yoon,Frank Chongwoo Park*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了MATE，一种简单高效的内存架构，用于求解上下文马尔可夫决策过程（CMDPs），通过置换不变性避免了Transformer的计算开销和RNN的梯度问题，在保持性能的同时实现了显著的计算优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在上下文马尔可夫决策过程（CMDPs）中，最优智能体需要通过维护上下文的后验信念来实现在线适应，但计算该后验分布通常是不可行的。现有的内存架构如Transformer存在逐步增长的计算开销，而循环神经网络（RNN）则面临梯度问题，因此需要一种既能避免这些缺陷又能保持足够表达能力的内存架构。

Method: MATE利用后验分布的置换不变性，将不可行的后验分布替换为求和聚合内存（sum-aggregated memory）。这种设计使得MATE能够在保持理论上充足表达能力的同时，避免Transformer随序列长度增长的计算开销，以及RNN常见的梯度问题，实现了一种简单而有效的内存架构。

Result: 在多个多样化基准测试上的广泛评估表明，MATE相较于标准序列模型基线提供了明显的计算优势，同时在性能上能够达到与这些基线相当的水平。该方法在计算效率和性能之间取得了良好的平衡。

Conclusion: MATE成功地为解决CMDPs提供了一种实用的内存架构方案，通过巧妙利用置换不变性，在不牺牲性能的前提下显著提升了计算效率，为相关领域的研究提供了新的思路和方法。

Abstract: We propose MATE, a simple yet effective memory architecture for solving Contextual Markov Decision Processes (CMDPs), a family of MDPs parameterized by an unobserved context. In CMDPs, an optimal agent can adapt online by maintaining the posterior belief over contexts. MATE replaces this intractable posterior with a sum-aggregated memory, leveraging the posterior's permutation invariance to retain provably sufficient expressiveness. Compared to prior memory architectures, MATE avoids the growing per-step rollout cost of Transformers and the gradient issues commonly associated with Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs). Extensive evaluations across diverse benchmarks demonstrate that MATE provides clear computational advantages while achieving performance comparable to standard sequence-model baselines.

</details>


### [169] [DP-SelFT: Differentially Private Selective Fine-Tuning for Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17432)
*Haichao Sha,Zihao Wang,Yuncheng Wu,Hong Chen,Wei Dong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出DP-SelFT框架，通过选择性微调（约束更新位置）来改善大模型差分隐私微调的效用损失。该方法在合成数据上进行参数选择，避免了额外隐私成本，并通过匹配DP噪声的扰动训练策略选出对噪声鲁棒的参数子集，在相同隐私保证下显著提升了隐私-效用权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型的差分隐私微调因梯度裁剪和噪声注入导致严重的效用下降。现有工作主要通过结合参数高效微调方法（如LoRA）来约束更新形式以改善权衡，本文探索一个互补方向：选择性微调，即约束更新的应用位置。然而，DP环境下的参数选择面临三个挑战：避免重复隐私成本、在噪声估计下保持稳定性、以及选择在裁剪和噪声更新下仍有用的参数。

Method: 提出DP-SelFT框架：1）首先构建轻量级DP合成数据集，选择阶段仅在此合成数据上进行，不产生额外隐私成本；2）进行层级选择，在合成训练集上临时训练候选层子集，在合成验证集上评估；3）关键创新：临时训练采用与下游DP微调匹配的扰动机制，其最坏情况扰动与DP噪声同规模，从而选择出既可学习又对噪声私有更新鲁棒的层子集。

Result: 在基准任务上的实验表明，DP-SelFT在相同隐私保证下，相比现有DP微调基线方法，持续改善了隐私-效用权衡。

Conclusion: 选择性微调是改善LLM差分隐私微调效用的有效互补方向。通过在合成数据上进行选择、采用匹配DP噪声的扰动训练策略，DP-SelFT成功解决了DP环境下参数选择的三大挑战，为隐私保护的模型适配提供了新思路。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are commonly adapted to downstream tasks through fine-tuning, but fine-tuning data often contains sensitive information that may be leaked by the resulting model. Differential privacy (DP) offers formal protection against such leakage, yet DP fine-tuning of LLMs still suffers from substantial utility degradation due to gradient clipping and noise injection. Existing work improves this trade-off by combining DP with parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods such as LoRA, which constrain the form of updates. In this work, we study a complementary direction: selective fine-tuning, which constrains where updates are applied.
  We propose DP-SelFT, a framework for differentially private selective fine-tuning of LLMs. DP-SelFT addresses three DP-specific challenges in parameter selection: avoiding repeated privacy cost, improving stability under noisy estimates, and selecting parameters that remain useful under clipped and noisy updates. It first constructs a lightweight DP synthetic dataset and performs selection only on this synthetic data, so the selection stage incurs no additional privacy cost. It then conducts layer-level selection by temporarily training candidate layer subsets on a synthetic training split and evaluating them on a synthetic validation split. Crucially, this temporary training is performed under a perturbation regime matched to downstream DP fine-tuning, with worst-case perturbations of the same scale as DP noise. This favors layer subsets that are not only learnable but also robust to noisy private updates. Experiments on benchmark tasks show that DP-SelFT consistently improves the privacy--utility trade-off over existing DP fine-tuning baselines under the same privacy guarantees.

</details>


### [170] [ClaHF: A Human Feedback-inspired Reinforcement Learning Framework for Improving Classification Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17458)
*Tianxiang Xu,Xiaoyan Zhu,Xin Lai,Jiayin Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了ClaHF框架，将人类反馈启发的强化学习引入文本分类，通过构建偏好建模和强化学习优化，在无需额外人工标注的情况下，显著提升了分类性能和置信度校准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的文本分类模型主要依赖监督微调（SFT），其本质上是对实例级标签的行为克隆，未能充分捕捉样本间的相对偏好关系。这限制了模型塑造决策边界和校准预测置信度的能力，因此需要一种新的方法来引入偏好信号以优化分类效果。

Method: 提出了ClaHF框架，这是一种受人类反馈启发的强化学习框架。该方法构建多个候选预测及其相对排序关系，在奖励模型（RM）中联合建模Top-1偏好和非最优候选之间的排序，将传统的标签监督转换为可直接应用于策略优化的偏好信号，并将偏好建模和强化学习优化集成到分类流程中。

Result: 在跨越三类场景的八个分类任务上进行了系统评估，结果表明ClaHF在不同语言模型上都能持续提升分类性能和置信度校准效果，验证了该方法的有效性。

Conclusion: ClaHF成功地将偏好建模和强化学习优化集成到文本分类流程中，在无需额外人工标注的前提下，有效改进了传统SFT方法的局限性，为文本分类任务提供了一种新的优化思路。

Abstract: Text classification models are typically trained via supervised fine-tuning (SFT). However, SFT essentially performs behavior cloning from instance-wise labels and thus fails to adequately capture relative preference relations among samples, which limits the model's ability to shape decision boundaries and calibrate predictive confidence. In this paper, we propose ClaHF, a human feedback-inspired reinforcement learning (RL) framework for text classification that integrates preference modeling and RL optimization into the classification pipeline without requiring additional human annotations. Unlike prior work that relies solely on instance-wise supervision, ClaHF constructs multiple candidate predictions together with their relative ranking relations, and jointly models the Top-1 preference and the ordering among non-optimal candidates within a reward model (RM). This design converts conventional label supervision into preference signals that are directly applicable to policy optimization. We conduct systematic evaluations on eight classification tasks spanning three categories of scenarios. Results demonstrate that ClaHF consistently improves both classification performance and confidence calibration across diverse language models (LMs). The data and code are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ClaHF.

</details>


### [171] [TriOpt: A Scalable Algorithm for Linear Causal Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17465)
*Rafat Ashraf Joy,Elena Zheleva*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出TriOpt算法，通过将排序方法与连续优化方法紧密结合，实现了线性因果发现的高效可扩展求解，在高维场景下比现有方法快数个数量级且精度相当或更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有因果发现方法在高维场景下面临显著的可扩展性瓶颈：基于排序的方法虽降低了搜索空间但仍受限；基于连续优化的方法虽概念上有吸引力，但需处理昂贵的无环性约束。两种范式各自存在局限性，亟需一种能兼顾效率与精度的新方法。

Method: TriOpt采用两阶段分解策略：第一阶段利用Sherman-Morrison秩-1降阶结合线性核的加性结构，快速可扩展地恢复拓扑排序；第二阶段在给定排序的前提下，将结构学习重构为凸连续优化问题，完全避免昂贵的无环性约束。

Result: 在理论上证明了在真实排序下，TriOpt能够精确恢复底层线性DAG；在实验方面，通过合成数据、半合成数据和真实数据集验证，TriOpt在高维场景下比最先进的线性因果发现方法实现了数量级的加速，同时保持相当或更优的准确率。

Conclusion: TriOpt成功地将排序方法与连续优化方法紧密集成，在保证准确率的前提下大幅提升了可扩展性，为高维线性因果发现提供了一个高效的理论与实践解决方案。

Abstract: Learning causal relations from observational data is challenging because the graph search space grows super-exponentially with the number of variables. Ordering-based methods reduce this space by first identifying the topological ordering, whereas continuous optimization methods explore most likely regions of the space by casting DAG learning as a differentiable objective with an acyclicity constraint. Despite their conceptual appeal, both paradigms face significant scalability limitations in high-dimensional settings, restricting their practical applicability. In this work, we introduce a new formulation for linear causal discovery that tightly integrates these two paradigms to achieve substantial gains in scalability without sacrificing accuracy. Our approach, TriOpt, decomposes the problem into two efficient stages. First, it recovers the topological ordering by exploiting the Sherman-Morrison rank-1 downdate together with the additive structure of linear kernels, enabling fast and scalable ordering estimation. Second, given this ordering, we reformulate structure learning as a convex continuous optimization problem that entirely avoids the need for enforcing costly acyclicity constraints. We theoretically show that, under the true ordering, TriOpt exactly recovers the underlying linear DAG. Empirically, across synthetic, semi-synthetic, and real-world datasets, TriOpt achieves orders-of-magnitude speedups over state-of-the-art linear causal discovery methods in high-dimensional regimes, while maintaining comparable or superior accuracy.

</details>


### [172] [WinQ: Accelerating Quantization-Aware Training of Language Models Around Saddle Points](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17471)
*Dongyue Li,Zechun Liu,Kai Yi,Zhenshuo Zhang,Changsheng Zhao,Raghuraman Krishnamoorthi,Harshit Khaitan,Hongyang R. Zhang,Steven Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示了量化感知训练（QAT）收敛慢的原因在于权重陷入鞍点附近的平坦区域，并提出WinQ算法，通过周期性权重重置和噪声注入梯度正则化，将训练速度提升最多4倍，在同等成本下将最先进亚4位量化性能提升最多8.8%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量化感知训练（QAT）在低比特宽度（尤其是低于4比特）下面临收敛缓慢和性能过早停滞的问题，虽然这一现象已被观察到，但其根本原因尚不明确。本文旨在深入分析QAT收敛困难的内在机制，并针对性地提出加速方案。

Method: 首先通过估算损失曲面Hessian矩阵的谱来分析QAT收敛特性，发现权重收敛至鞍点附近的平坦区域，且低比特宽度下Hessian特征值幅度显著减小。基于此发现，提出WinQ算法：（1）周期性地将权重重置为全精度权重与量化权重的线性插值，以减少与量化格点的距离并增大特征值幅度；（2）对注入噪声的权重计算梯度以正则化Hessian矩阵。

Result: WinQ算法将QAT训练速度提升最多4倍，且适用于多种量化方法和模型。在相同训练成本下，WinQ将最先进亚4位量化的性能提升最多8.8%，该结论在涵盖不同语言模型、量化方法和比特宽度的16种设置中均得到验证。

Conclusion: QAT收敛困难的根本原因在于权重陷入鞍点附近的平坦区域，Hessian谱特征值向零集中。WinQ算法通过周期性权重重置和噪声注入梯度正则化有效缓解了这一问题，显著加速了收敛并提升了低比特量化性能，具有广泛的适用性。

Abstract: Quantization-aware training (QAT) is widely adopted to quantize language models by training full-precision weights using gradients from the quantized model. The main bottleneck is its slow convergence and early performance plateau, particularly below 4-bit-widths. While this problem has been observed in prior work, its precise cause remains unclear. In this paper, we analyze the convergence of QAT by estimating the spectrum of the loss-surface Hessians. We find that the weights converge to flat regions around saddle points, where a large fraction of the Hessian eigenvalues are both positive and negative. During training, an increasing fraction of Hessian eigenvalues concentrates around zero, whose magnitude decreases. At lower bit-widths, the magnitude of eigenvalues in the Hessian spectrum is significantly smaller. To mitigate these issues, we propose an algorithm called WinQ to accelerate QAT, which involves: (1) periodically resetting weights to the linear interpolation of full-precision and quantized weights, reducing the distance to the quantization grid and increasing eigenvalue magnitude, and (2) computing gradients of noise-injected weights to regularize the Hessian. Extensive experiments show that WinQ accelerates QAT by up to 4 times across various quantization methods and models. Under the same training cost, WinQ improves state-of-the-art sub-4-bit quantization by up to 8.8%. These results are consistent across 16 settings with different language models, quantization methods, and bit widths.

</details>


### [173] [Beyond Linear Superposition: Discovering Climate Features in AI Weather Models with KAN-SAE](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17493)
*Minjong Cheon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出KAN-SAE，一种采用可学习B样条激活函数的稀疏自编码器，用于深度学习天气预报模型的可解释性分析，在Sonny模型上发现975个活跃特征（比线性基线提升72%），并成功识别出欧洲热浪和西太平洋台风等气候特征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习天气预报模型虽然预测能力出色，但内部表示仍不透明，缺乏对物理气候现象表示机制的理解。现有的稀疏自编码器（SAE）假设严格的线性特征叠加，这一约束不适合现代Transformer中编码的高度非线性大气动力学。

Method: 提出KAN-SAE稀疏自编码器，其编码器用基于Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KAN）的可学习逐特征B样条激活函数替代标准ReLU，允许每个潜在维度发展自己的非线性门控轮廓。该方法应用于Sonny天气预报模型进行分析。

Result: KAN-SAE发现975个活跃特征，相比线性基线的566个特征提升72%，特征间冗余度降低20%，重建保真度相当。在无气候监督条件下，成功识别出空间上集中于西欧的可解释欧洲热浪特征，以及经因果引导实验证实的西太平洋台风追踪器。

Conclusion: 非线性激活对于深度学习天气预报模型的机制可解释性至关重要，能够恢复线性基线无法检测到的气候特征，证明了KAN-SAE在捕捉大气非线性动力学方面的有效性。

Abstract: Deep learning weather prediction models achieve remarkable predictive skill yet remain largely opaque: we know little about how they represent physical climate phenomena internally. Mechanistic interpretability through Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) offers a principled route to decomposing these representations, but existing SAEs assume strictly linear feature superposition - a constraint ill-suited for the highly nonlinear atmospheric dynamics encoded in modern transformers. We introduce KAN-SAE, a sparse autoencoder whose encoder replaces the standard ReLU with learnable per-feature B-spline activations drawn from Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs), allowing each latent dimension to develop its own nonlinear gating profile. Applied to Sonny, KAN-SAE discovers 975 alive features (vs. 566 for a linear baseline, a 72% improvement) with 20% lower inter-feature redundancy and comparable reconstruction fidelity. Without any climate supervision, KAN-SAE identifies an interpretable European heatwave feature spatially concentrated over western Europe, and a western Pacific typhoon tracker confirmed by causal steering experiments. Our results demonstrate that nonlinear activations are essential for mechanistic interpretability of deep learning weather prediction models, recovering climate features that remain invisible to linear baselines.

</details>


### [174] [Self-Supervised On-Policy Distillation for Reasoning Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17497)
*Zhiquan Tan,Yinrong Hong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SSOPD方法，利用同组正确/错误样本对比实现密集过程监督，在多个推理基准上优于GRPO。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有GRPO风格的RLVR方法在多个策略尝试中仅使用最终奖励，忽略了对组内正确和错误完成样本中蕴含的丰富过程信号的利用。

Method: 提出自监督策略蒸馏（SSOPD）：将条件于最短正确完成样本的教师分布蒸馏到最长错误完成样本的前缀中，将组内正确-错误对比转化为无外部解轨迹的密集过程监督；引入提示级前沿权重集中辅助损失。

Result: 在AIME 2024、AIME 2025和HMMT 2025的9个模型-基准设置中，SSOPD均优于GRPO。Qwen3-8B上达到Macro Avg@12为65.6，分别超越GRPO 1.6分、超越OPS D基线0.8分。

Conclusion: SSOPD通过挖掘组内样本对比信号，有效提升了推理模型的性能，验证了无需外部解轨迹的自监督过程监督的有效性。

Abstract: GRPO-style RLVR trains reasoning models from multiple on-policy attempts per prompt, but typically uses these attempts only through terminal rewards. We show that a mixed group contains a richer process signal: a correct completion is a self-generated witness of how the current policy can solve the problem, while a wrong completion provides on-policy prefixes where the policy needs correction. We introduce \emph{Self-Supervised On-Policy Distillation} (SSOPD), which distills a teacher distribution conditioned on the shortest correct completion into prefixes of the longest wrong completion. This converts intra-group correct--wrong contrast into dense process supervision without external solution traces. A stopping-time view motivates the shortest-correct / longest-wrong rule as a finite-group approximation to editing persistent failures toward fast-success actions, and a prompt-level frontier weight concentrates the auxiliary loss where correct and wrong branches coexist. Across AIME 2024, AIME 2025, and HMMT 2025, SSOPD improves over GRPO in all nine model-benchmark settings. On Qwen3-8B, it reaches a macro Avg@12 of 65.6, outperforming GRPO by 1.6 points and the solution-conditioned OPSD baseline by 0.8 points. Code will be released at https://github.com/tzq1999/SSOPD.

</details>


### [175] [t-gems: text-guided exit modules for decreasing clip image encoder](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17499)
*Alberto Presta,Grzegorz Stefanski,Michal Byra,Krzysztof Arendt*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了文本引导的退出模块（T-GEMs），通过利用中间层语义分布来实现多模态模型的早期退出，在保持跨模态理解性能的同时降低计算成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态深度神经网络通过整合多种数据模态增强深度理解，但将不同模态数据投影到共享潜在空间进行相似性计算的过程资源消耗大。早期退出方法可通过利用中间层减少计算负载，但针对图像-文本对等多模态数据开发此类方法具有挑战性。

Method: 研究编码器（如CLIP）中间层存在的语义内容分布（可从文本描述中推导），引入文本引导的退出模块（T-GEMs）和基于速率的正则化器来控制编码器使用成本。

Result: 成功开发了T-GEMs方法，能够在维持跨模态理解性能的同时，有效控制编码器的使用成本和计算资源消耗。

Conclusion: 通过文本引导的退出机制和速率正则化，实现了多模态模型计算效率与理解性能的有效平衡，为多模态模型的资源优化提供了新思路。

Abstract: Multimodal deep neural networks enhance deep comprehension by integrating diverse data modalities. Data from different modalities are typically projected into a shared latent space for similarity computation, but this process is resource intensive due to large image encoders and equal processing of test data during prediction. Early exit methods reduce computational load by utilizing intermediate layers, saving time and memory. However, developing such methods is challenging for multimodal data like image-text pairs. This study investigates the semantic content distributions present in intermediate layers of encoders such as CLIP, which can be derived from textual descriptions. We introduce Text-Guided Exit Modules (T-GEMs) and a rate-based regularizer to control encoder usage costs while maintaining cross-modal understanding performance.

</details>


### [176] [The Silent Brush: Evaluating Artistic Style Leakage in AI Art Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17500)
*Ninad Joshi,Ashutosh Ranjan,Vivek Srivastava,Shirish Karande*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了“无声画笔”（The Silent Brush）现象，即文生图模型会在未被提示的情况下复现训练数据中的艺术风格。为此建立了评估原则，并提出了Art Arena评估协议，在多个扩散模型上揭示了风格编码强度差异与不对称混合现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的文本到图像生成模型大多在大规模网络抓取数据集上训练，其中包含受版权保护的艺术作品。核心关切在于模型可能学习特定的艺术风格，并在生成输出中复现这些风格，而提示词中并未明确引用。现有的评估方法（如近重复检索或成员推断）无法捕捉这种跨提示词的非预期风格重现问题，因此需要新的评估框架来系统性地衡量这一现象。

Method: 首先制定了评估“无声画笔”现象的指导原则；随后提出了Art Arena评估协议，该协议通过三个维度进行评估：艺术品被编码的强度、艺术品之间的交互方式、以及其风格特征在生成输出中非预期重现的频率。该协议在Stable Diffusion v1.5、SDXL和SANA-1.5等主流扩散模型上进行了测试，并被设计为可泛化至各类文本到图像生成系统。

Result: 实验结果表明，“无声画笔”现象源于艺术品之间表征强度的差异和交互动态的不同，这导致模型生成中出现不对称的风格混合。部分艺术作品的风格特征被更强烈地编码，并在生成过程中更容易被非预期地复现。

Conclusion: 本文首次系统性地定义并评估了文本到图像模型中的非预期风格重现问题，Art Arena为衡量模型对艺术风格的记忆与泄露提供了标准化工具。研究揭示了不同艺术作品在模型表征中的不对称性，为后续解决版权侵权、归属认定等伦理与法律问题提供了重要的技术基础。

Abstract: Generative text-to-image models are typically trained on large-scale web-scraped datasets that include diverse visual content such as copyrighted and stylistically distinctive artworks, raising concerns about ownership, attribution, and the unintended reuse of protected visual expressions. A key issue is that models can learn stylistic patterns from this data and reproduce them in generated outputs without any explicit reference in the prompt. We refer to this phenomenon as The Silent Brush, where such learned styles reappear even when they are not requested. Existing evaluation methods mainly focus on near-duplicate retrieval or membership inference and do not account for this form of unintended stylistic resurfacing across prompts. To address these gaps, we first formulate guiding principles for evaluation of The Silent Brush. We then introduce Art Arena, an evaluation protocol that measures how strongly artworks are encoded, how they interact, and how frequently their stylistic traits reappear in generated outputs without explicit mention in prompts. We evaluate Art Arena on widely used text-to-image diffusion models, including Stable Diffusion v1.5, Stable Diffusion XL (SDXL), and SANA-1.5, and design it to generalize across text-to-image generative systems. Our results show that The Silent Brush arises from differences in representational strength and interaction dynamics between artworks, leading to asymmetric blending in model generations. Code and evaluation resources are available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ArtArena-EBE4.

</details>


### [177] [BESplit: Bias-Compensated Split Federated Learning with Evidential Aggregation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17508)
*Yuhan Xie,Chen Lyu,Jingrong Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了BESplit框架，通过架构感知的证据聚合、偏差补偿协作和双教师蒸馏三种策略，有效解决了分割联邦学习在非独立同分布数据下的偏差优化和不稳定收敛问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分割联邦学习（SFL）在非独立同分布（non-IID）数据分布下常面临偏差优化和不稳定收敛问题，而现有解决方案主要借鉴传统联邦学习技术，未能充分利用SFL分割架构的独特性质。研究者发现SFL的分割架构本质上改变了客户端信息的表示和协调方式，这为在参数级聚合之外进行偏差补偿提供了契机。

Method: 提出BESplit架构感知框架，包含三个核心组件：(1) 证据聚合（EA）：基于证据不确定性对客户端贡献进行细粒度重加权，防止有偏的本地数据主导全局更新；(2) 偏差补偿协作（BCC）：通过配对互补客户端来对齐分割层表示，进一步减少分布偏斜；(3) 双教师蒸馏（DTD）：在解耦的客户端和服务器模型之间同步知识，实现独立的本地推理。

Result: 在五个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，BESplit在各种非独立同分布设置下，在准确性、收敛稳定性和计算效率方面始终优于最先进的方法。

Conclusion: BESplit通过利用SFL内在结构特性，成功实现了超越参数级聚合的偏差补偿，为非独立同分布场景下的分割联邦学习提供了有效的解决方案，显著提升了模型性能和训练稳定性。

Abstract: Split Federated Learning (SFL) enables privacy-preserving collaborative training by partitioning models between clients and a server. However, under non-IID data distributions, SFL often suffers from biased optimization and unstable convergence, while existing solutions largely adapt techniques from conventional federated learning. In this work, we observe that the split architecture of SFL inherently alters how client information is represented and coordinated, opening opportunities for bias compensation beyond parameter-level aggregation. Based on this insight, we propose BESplit, an architecture-aware framework that exploits the intrinsic structure of SFL to mitigate non-IID effects. First, to prevent biased local data from dominating global updates, we introduce Evidential Aggregation (EA) to perform fine-grained reweighting of client contributions based on evidential uncertainty. Second, to further reduce distributional skew, we develop Bias-Compensated Collaboration (BCC) to align split-layer representations by pairing complementary clients. Finally, Dual-Teacher Distillation (DTD) is incorporated to synchronize knowledge between decoupled client and server models, enabling independent local inference. Extensive experiments on five benchmark datasets demonstrate that BESplit consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods in accuracy, convergence stability, and computational efficiency under diverse non-IID settings.

</details>


### [178] [Coordinate Heterogeneity Governs Binary Quantization: From InfoNCE to Recall](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17524)
*Wenxuan Xiao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过坐标异质性理论解决了二值量化(BQ)在不同嵌入上表现差异的谜题，推导出排序保真度的闭式表达式，建立了首个BQ系统设计指南。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 二值量化在对比学习嵌入上表现优异但在其他嵌入上效果不佳，且现有系统采用截然相反的策略（随机旋转vs保留坐标轴），缺乏统一理论解释这些现象，需要建立理论框架指导BQ设计。

Method: 将InfoNCE训练表示的高斯结构与BQ质量分析框架相连接，通过坐标异质性（各坐标方差不均匀性）这一核心概念分析BQ性能，推导排序保真度的闭式表达式，建立双参数缩放定律。

Result: 发现坐标异质性是决定BQ性能的关键因素：幅度比特携带与异质性成正比的信息量；随机旋转破坏了轴对齐范式所需的信号，同时创造了各向同性范式所需的条件；双参数缩放定律能准确预测跨模型和维度的保真度。

Conclusion: 在13个数据集和6个嵌入家族上验证了所有理论预测，提供了首个基于原理的二值量化系统设计指南，解决了不同策略适用性难题。

Abstract: Binary quantization (BQ) compresses high-dimensional embeddings into one or two bits per coordinate, enabling nearest neighbor search at extreme speed. Yet a striking puzzle persists: BQ achieves competitive recall on contrastive embeddings but fails on others -- and two leading systems adopt diametrically opposite strategies (random rotation vs. preserving coordinate axes) without a common theory explaining when each is appropriate. We resolve this puzzle by connecting the Gaussian structure recently established for InfoNCE-trained representations to a complete analytical framework for BQ quality. The key insight is that coordinate heterogeneity -- the non-uniformity of per-coordinate variances -- governs the key aspects of BQ performance. We derive closed-form expressions for ranking fidelity, prove that the magnitude bit carries information proportional to heterogeneity, and show that random rotation destroys precisely the signal that one paradigm exploits while creating the isotropy that the other requires. A two-parameter scaling law predicts fidelity across models and dimensions. Experiments on 13 datasets and 6 embedding families validate all predictions and provide the first principled design guide for binary quantization systems.

</details>


### [179] [CasualSynth: Generating Structurally Sound Synthetic Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17528)
*Zehua Cheng,Wei Dai,Jiahao Sun,Thomas Lukasiewicz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出CausalSynth框架，通过解耦因果结构生成与语义实现，解决了大语言模型生成合成数据时无法保证因果有效性的问题，在保持条件独立性的同时实现了高质量的文本合成数据生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型能够生成逼真的合成数据，但无法保证其输出遵循目标领域的因果机制，存在用预训练先验覆盖施加的因果事实的"语义后门"问题，导致生成的数据在因果层面无效。

Method: 提出三阶段框架：1）使用结构因果模型（SCM）通过祖先采样生成满足全局马尔可夫性质的因果骨架；2）利用LLM作为约束实现器，将骨架映射为高维文本观测；3）通过迭代一致性验证模块检测结构违规并反馈修正，形成闭环优化，同时支持干预和反事实生成。

Result: 在ASIA、ALARM和MIMIC-Struct三个因果基准测试中，CausalSynth保持条件独立性的假阳性率接近名义α=0.05水平，使用70B参数LLM骨干网络时实现率超过96%，并证明迭代机制相比标准拒绝采样能降低选择偏差。

Conclusion: CausalSynth成功实现了因果有效性与语言丰富性的统一，为大语言模型在因果敏感领域的合成数据生成提供了可靠解决方案，在医疗和金融等需要因果一致性的应用场景具有重要价值。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) generate realistic synthetic data but offer no guarantee that their outputs respect the causal mechanisms governing the target domain. We introduce CausalSynth, a framework that decouples causal structure generation from semantic realization, yielding synthetic data that is both causally valid and linguistically rich. The framework operates in three phases. First, a Structural Causal Model (SCM) - a tuple of structural equations defined over a directed acyclic graph (DAG) generates causal skeletons, i.e., variable assignments that satisfy the Global Markov Property of the governing DAG, via ancestral sampling. Second, an LLM acts as a constrained \emph{realizer}, a conditional translator that maps each skeleton to a high-dimensional observation such as a clinical note or a transaction log. Third, an Iterative Consistency Verification module detects structural violations through deterministic extraction and feeds targeted corrections back to the LLM, forming a closed-loop refinement process. We identify the Semantic Backdoor problem the systematic tendency of LLMs to override imposed causal facts with pre-training priors -- and prove that our iterative mechanism reduces the resulting selection bias relative to standard rejection sampling. On three causal benchmarks (ASIA, ALARM, and MIMIC-Struct), CausalSynth preserved conditional independencies with false-positive rates near the nominal $α=0.05$ level and achieved realizability rates above 96% with 70B-parameter LLM backbones. The framework additionally supports principled interventional and counterfactual generation through noise retention and graph mutilation.

</details>


### [180] [Q-LocalAdam: Memory-Efficient Client-Side Adaptive Optimization for Edge Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17552)
*Vedant Waykole,Haroon R. Lone*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Q-LocalAdam，一种面向联邦学习的分布感知8位量化Adam优化器，通过分析动量和方差的统计特性差异（动量对称有界、方差跨八个数量级呈对数正态分布），分别采用块线性编码和对数空间编码，在CIFAR-10/100上实现3.37倍优化器内存压缩，中等异质性下无精度损失，极端异质性下精度提升高达5.74个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习在边缘设备上面临非IID数据和内存受限的双重挑战。Adam等自适应优化器虽能稳定异构数据训练，但需存储全精度动量和方差状态，使客户端内存开销增加约三倍，限制了资源受限设备上的可部署模型规模和并发联邦任务数量。

Method: 作者首先实证观察到联邦Adam中动量和方差具有根本不同的统计特性：动量值对称且有界，方差跨越八个数量级并呈对数正态结构。基于此不对称性，提出Q-LocalAdam：对动量采用分布感知的8位块级线性编码，对方差采用对数空间编码，同时保持模型参数为全精度。

Result: 在CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100数据集上，针对不同数据异质性程度（α∈{0.1, 0.5, 1.0, IID}）进行测试。Q-LocalAdam实现3.37倍优化器内存压缩，中等异质性下无精度损失，极端异质性下显著提升（CIFAR-100、α=0.1时提升5.74个百分点）。多种子验证确认统计显著性（p<0.01）。对比实验表明，朴素均匀量化会导致性能退化至随机水平，验证了分布感知设计的必要性。

Conclusion: Q-LocalAdam无需修改联邦协议即可在内存受限的边缘设备上启用更大模型和更多并发工作负载。该工作揭示了优化器状态压缩中分布感知设计的关键作用，为资源受限场景下的联邦学习部署提供了实用解决方案。

Abstract: Federated learning on edge devices must cope with non-IID client data and tight memory budgets. Adaptive optimizers like Adam stabilize training under data heterogeneity but require storing full-precision momentum and variance states, often tripling client memory overhead. This limits deployable model sizes and concurrent federated jobs on resource-constrained devices.
  We empirically observe that momentum and variance in federated Adam exhibit fundamentally different statistical properties: momentum values are symmetric and bounded, while variance spans eight orders of magnitude with log-normal structure. Motivated by this asymmetry, we propose \textbf{Q-LocalAdam}, which applies distribution-aware 8-bit quantization block-wise linear encoding for momentum and log-space encoding for variance while keeping model parameters in full precision.
  Across CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 under varying data heterogeneity ($α\in \{0.1, 0.5, 1.0, \text{IID}\}$), Q-LocalAdam achieves $3.37\times$ optimizer memory reduction with no accuracy loss under moderate heterogeneity and significant improvements under extreme heterogeneity (e.g., +5.74pp on CIFAR-100, $α=0.1$). Multi-seed validation confirms statistical significance ($p<0.01$). In contrast, naive uniform quantization degrades to random performance, demonstrating that distribution-aware design is essential. Q-LocalAdam enables larger models and more concurrent workloads on memory-constrained edge devices without modifying the federated protocol.

</details>


### [181] [PFlow-T: A Persistence-Driven Forward Process for Topology-Controlled Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17555)
*Snigdha Chandan Khilar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了PFlow T，首个完全基于持久同调前向过程的生成模型，用拓扑特征破坏作为时间度量替代高斯噪声，在生成指定Betti数和分布外任务上显著优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前拓扑感知扩散模型存在架构不匹配问题：使用高斯噪声进行破坏，却通过条件侧通道恢复结构特征。这种不一致性促使研究者设计一个前向过程完全基于拓扑结构的生成模型。

Method: PFlow T的前向过程完全基于持久同调，时间度量定义为H1拓扑特征（如孔洞）的破坏程度，根据持久性消除特征。逆向网络直接反转这种结构化破坏，一步预测干净状态。

Result: 在MNIST数字0、1、8上的测试表明，PFlow T在生成请求的Betti数和处理分布外任务方面显著优于基线模型。

Conclusion: PFlow T是首个使用持久同调进行前向过程的生成架构，证明了拓扑驱动前向过程的可行性，但目前限于低分辨率像素空间代理。

Abstract: Current topology aware diffusion models face an architectural mismatch by using Gaussian noise for corruption while recovering structural features through conditional side channels To fix this we introduce PFlow T a generative model that bases its forward process entirely on persistent homology In PFlow T time measures the destruction of H1 topological features like holes rather than Gaussian noise injection This forward process eliminates features based on their persistence The reverse network then directly inverts this structured corruption to predict the clean state in one step Tests on MNIST digits zero one and eight show PFlow T significantly outperforms a baseline model in generating requested Betti numbers and handling out of distribution tasks PFlow T is the first generative architecture using persistent homology for the forward process although we note it is currently limited to low resolution pixel space proxies

</details>


### [182] [Beyond Accuracy: Robustness, Interpretability and Expressiveness of EEG Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17562)
*Urban Širca,Maryam Alimardani,Stefanos Zafeiriou,Konstantinos Barmpas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次系统评估了六个EEG基础模型在鲁棒性、可解释性和表达能力方面的表现，发现单一模型无法在所有故障模式下都占主导，模型能够正确定位大脑区域但在扰动下解码失败，且EEG-FMs具有足够的表征能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的EEG基础模型评估主要集中在干净的、分布内数据的准确率上，而对其鲁棒性、可解释性和表征质量的评估严重不足，存在研究空白。

Method: 在八个数据集上对六个EEG基础模型与基线深度学习模型进行基准测试，进行三层分析：(i) 应用加性噪声、随机和区域通道丢失、区域特定噪声注入等测试时扰动来评估鲁棒性；(ii) 首次应用注意力感知层相关性传播(AttnLRP)来评估可解释性；(iii) 使用分块探测来评估表达能力。

Result: (1) 没有单一模型在所有故障模式下都占主导；噪声鲁棒性最强的模型在通道丢失时表现脆弱；(2) 模型能够将相关性集中在符合已知神经生理学的任务相关大脑区域，但在扰动下归因图空间稳定而预测退化；(3) 晚期块在微调时被重新利用，早期块已包含任务相关信息；仅头部性能差主要归因于池化操作而非预训练表征质量低。

Conclusion: 本研究提供了EEG基础模型鲁棒性、可解释性和表达能力的首次系统评估，揭示了关键的开发考虑因素，并为未来EEG-FMs的发展提供了重要指导。

Abstract: EEG foundation models (EEG-FMs) have been evaluated predominantly on clean, in-distribution accuracy, leaving their robustness, interpretability and representational quality largely unexamined. This study addresses these gaps by benchmarking six EEG-FMs against a baseline deep learning model across eight datasets. Beyond clean accuracy, we conduct three layers of analysis: (i) Robustness: we apply test-time perturbations including additive noise, random and region-based channel dropout and region-specific noise injection. Our analyses show that no single model dominates all failure modes. The most noise-robust model is among the most fragile under channel dropout and much of the dropout fragility disappears when channels are removed rather than zero-padded. (ii) Interpretability: we present the first application of Attention-Aware Layer-Wise Relevance Propagation (AttnLRP) to EEG-FMs and show that models broadly concentrate relevance on task-appropriate brain regions consistent with known neurophysiology. However, attribution maps remain spatially stable under perturbation while predictions degrade, suggesting that the models attend to the correct brain regions but decode corrupted content. (iii) Expressiveness: With block-wise probing we show that late blocks are repurposed during fine-tuning, while early blocks already hold task-related information. Furthermore, we demonstrate that the poor head-only performance previously attributed to low-quality pre-trained representations is largely explained by pooling and that EEG-FMs possess sufficient representational capacity when their token-level embeddings are preserved. Together, these findings provide the first systematic assessment of robustness, interpretability and expressiveness for EEG-FMs and highlight critical considerations for their development.

</details>


### [183] [Structured Neural Marked Point Processes for Interpretable Event Interaction Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17568)
*Zhitong Xu,Qiwei Yuan,Yinghao Chen,Shandian Zhe,Bin Shen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出结构化神经标记点过程(SNMPP)模型，通过构建乘积形式的神经影响核，在保持高预测性能的同时，实现了多类事件流中事件间和类别间显式关系结构的发现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的神经点过程模型虽然具有高度表达能力，但以黑盒方式编码事件交互，无法显式发现结构化依赖关系。在多类事件流的实际应用中，发现结构化、可解释的事件间关系并保持准确预测仍是一个核心挑战。

Method: 构建乘积形式的神经影响核，由事件类型的符号交互网络和延迟感知的单调时间网络组成。该设计能够显式刻画类间影响拓扑（包括激发、抑制和中性），同时灵活捕获各种时间衰减模式和潜在影响延迟。开发分层蒙特卡洛估计器用于随机训练的高效学习。

Result: 在合成数据集和真实基准数据集上的大量实验验证了该方法能够发现结构化关系并实现强预测性能。

Conclusion: SNMPP模型成功解决了神经点过程中黑盒建模与可解释性之间的矛盾，为多类事件流分析提供了一种既能保持高预测精度又能显式揭示事件依赖结构的有效方法。

Abstract: Multi-class event streams arise in numerous real-world applications, where uncovering structured, interpretable inter-event relationships, together with accurate prediction, remains a central challenge. Existing neural point process models are highly expressive but encode event interactions in a black-box manner, preventing explicit discovery of structured dependencies. In this paper, we propose a structured neural marked point process (SNMPP) that achieves high modeling flexibility while enabling explicit event-wise and class-wise relationship discovery from data. Our model constructs a product-form neural influence kernel composed of a signed interaction network over event types and a delay-aware monotonic temporal network. This design enables explicit characterization of inter-class influence topology -- including excitation, inhibition, and neutrality -- while flexibly capturing diverse temporal decay patterns and potential influence delays. For efficient learning, we develop a stratified Monte Carlo estimator for stochastic training. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world benchmark datasets validate the ability of our approach to uncover structured relationships and deliver strong predictive performance.

</details>


### [184] [How Off-Policy Can GRPO Be? Mu-GRPO for Efficient LLM Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17570)
*Minghao Tian,Yunfei Xie,Chen Wei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Mu-GRPO框架，通过允许更大的数据过期度并减少系统开销，在保持或提升性能的同时将训练速度提高约2倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准的GRPO算法需要在低过期度、近在线策略的机制下训练，这导致了显著的系统开销（频繁的生成-优化切换），作者希望探索GRPO能容忍多大程度的数据过期性，以改善性能与效率的权衡。

Method: 提出Mu-GRPO框架，将训练组织为少量（如四个）大的顺序生成-优化阶段，引入高过期度的数据生成；为稳定学习，结合了宽松裁剪以保留有用的过期梯度，以及负优势否决机制以移除不稳定的后触发后缀更新。

Result: 在五个语言模型和多个数学推理基准测试中，Mu-GRPO性能与标准GRPO持平或更优，同时实现了约2倍的挂钟训练时间加速，显著改善了LLM强化学习的性能-效率权衡。

Conclusion: GRPO类算法能够容忍比先前假设大得多的数据过期度；Mu-GRPO通过巧妙的设计实现了高效稳定的训练，为LLM强化学习提供了更优的训练范式。

Abstract: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has been a key driver of recent progress in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) for large language models, but it is typically trained in a low-staleness, near-on-policy regime that incurs substantial system overhead. We ask a simple question: How off-policy can GRPO be? We show that GRPO-style algorithms can tolerate substantially larger rollout staleness than previously assumed, and propose Mu-GRPO, an RL training framework that organizes training into a small number (e.g., four) of large sequential generation-optimization stages. This design induces high rollout staleness while greatly reducing rollout-optimization switching overhead. To stabilize learning under stale data, Mu-GRPO combines relaxed clipping, which preserves useful stale-rollout gradients, with negative-advantage veto, which removes destabilizing post-trigger suffix updates in negative-advantage responses. Across five language models and multiple math reasoning benchmarks, Mu-GRPO matches or exceeds the performance of standard GRPO while achieving around 2x speedup in wall-clock training time, establishing a substantially improved performance-efficiency trade-off for LLM reinforcement learning.

</details>


### [185] [UniAlign: A Model-Agnostic Framework for Robust Network Traffic Classification under Distribution Shifts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17575)
*Tongze Wang,Xiaohui Xie,Wenduo Wang,Chuyi Wang,Yong Cui*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了UniAlign框架，一种模型无关的方法，通过结合域对齐微调和稳定模型集成，有效提升了网络流量分类模型在分布偏移下的鲁棒性，且训练成本显著低于现有基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的网络流量分类模型在实际部署时，常因网络条件变化导致的分布偏移而出现性能严重下降；而现有的增强鲁棒性的方法往往依赖特定模型架构、难以泛化到最先进的原始字节模型，或训练开销过大。

Method: 提出了UniAlign框架，包含两个核心组件：一是域对齐微调，旨在跨异构网络条件学习域不变的流量表示；二是稳定模型集成，通过聚合平坦损失区域内的检查点来增强推理鲁棒性。该框架与模型架构无关，可无缝集成到现有监督学习模型中。

Result: 在三个公共数据集（涵盖加密方案、数据收集设备和攻击行为等多种分布偏移）上的实验结果表明，相比标准训练，UniAlign平均分类准确率提升2.51%，F1分数提升2.71%；相比最强基线，准确率和F1分数分别提升1.45%和1.69%，且仅需基线方法12.4%--53.9%的训练时间。

Conclusion: UniAlign作为一种高效、模型无关的框架，成功解决了网络流量分类中因分布偏移导致的性能下降问题，在提升模型鲁棒性的同时大幅降低了训练开销，具有良好的实用性和泛化能力。

Abstract: Network traffic classification (NTC) models often suffer severe performance degradation when deployed in real-world environments due to distribution shifts caused by changing network conditions. Existing robustness-enhancing approaches are commonly coupled to specific model architectures or data settings, fail to generalize to state-of-the-art raw-byte-based NTC models, or incur significant training overhead. In this paper, we propose UniAlign, a novel model-agnostic framework that improves the robustness of deep learning-based NTC models under distribution shifts. UniAlign combines \emph{domain alignment fine-tuning}, which encourages the learning of domain-invariant traffic representations across heterogeneous network conditions, with \emph{stable model ensembling}, which enhances inference robustness by aggregating checkpoints within a flat loss region. The framework can be seamlessly integrated into existing supervised NTC models without requiring specific feature modalities or introducing non-constant additional training costs. We evaluate UniAlign on three public datasets covering diverse distribution shifts, including encryption schemes, data collection devices, and attack behaviors. Experimental results on two representative NTC models demonstrate that, compared with standard training, UniAlign improves average classification accuracy by 2.51\% and average F1 score by 2.71\%, outperforming the strongest baseline by 1.45\% in accuracy and 1.69\% in F1 score, while requiring only 12.4\%--53.9\% of the training time of all NTC-specific baselines.

</details>


### [186] [Scale-Equivariant Generative Forecasting: Weight-Tied Dilated Convolutions, Wavelet Scattering Inputs, and Spectral-Consistency Training for Self-Similar Time Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17582)
*Andrea Morandi*

Main category: cs.LG
