TL;DR: 提出了一种尺度等变小波网络(SE-WaveNet)，通过跨层级共享卷积核参数将自相似性作为归纳偏置引入模型。在S&P 500数据上，以更少参数实现了比标准WaveNet更优的尺度特性建模能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 股票收益、气候异常、湍流速度等时间序列具有自相似性（尺度不变性），但现有的深度生成模型（Transformer、TCN、WaveNet）忽略此特性，仅构建多尺度架构而非尺度等变架构。

Method: 1) 定义一维因果网络的离散尺度等变性，证明跨层级共享卷积核参数可实现（近似）尺度等变；2) 构建SE-WaveNet骨干网络；3) 集成三个组件：Daubechies-4小波输入、Hurst-FiLM块（暴露局部标度指数）、谱一致性训练项（针对幂律谱）；4) 使用条件归一化流作为输出头以保持等变性。

Result: 在30年S&P 500日对数收益数据上：SE-WaveNet样本成功复现Allan-Variance诊断的尺度塌缩（中位C*=0.020），而相同容量的标准WaveNet失败（≥0.06）；NLL、KS校准和尾能量距离与基线持平或更优，且卷积参数减少L倍。

Conclusion: 通过硬编码尺度等变性作为归纳偏置，SE-WaveNet能够以更少参数有效捕获自相似时间序列的尺度特性，为建模此类数据提供了有效范式。

Abstract: Many natural and engineered time series -- equity returns, climate anomalies, turbulent velocities, neural recordings, packet-level network traffic -- are approximately self-similar: their horizon-$T$ distribution is tied to the horizon-$1$ distribution by one scaling exponent $H$. Standard deep generative sequence models (transformers, dilated TCNs, the WaveNet family) ignore this. Their receptive fields are wide, but kernel parameters live independently at every dilation level, yielding a multi-scale architecture, not a scale-equivariant one. We make three contributions. First, we give a precise definition of discrete scale equivariance for 1D causal networks and prove that dyadic dilation commutes (up to boundary effects) with any dilated-convolution stack whose kernel weights are shared across levels. Tying the kernel shrinks the convolutional parameter budget by an $L$-fold factor (where $L$ is depth) and hard-wires self-similarity in as an inductive bias. Second, we wrap this Scale-Equivariant WaveNet (SE-WaveNet) backbone in three components that carry the same prior: a one-level Daubechies-4 wavelet input, a Hurst-FiLM block exposing the local scaling exponent, and a spectral-consistency training term targeting the $|f|^{-(2H+1)}$ power-law spectrum. The head is a conditional normalising flow, chosen to preserve equivariance. Third, on 30 years of S&P 500 daily log-returns, SE-WaveNet samples reproduce the empirical scaling-collapse diagnostic on the Allan-Variance top-25 universe (median $\mathcal{C}^\star = 0.020$), while a vanilla WaveNet at matched capacity does not ($\geq 0.06$). NLL, KS-calibration, and tail energy distance tie or beat the baseline, with $L\times$ fewer convolutional parameters.

</details>


### [187] [Form and Function: Machine Unlearning as a Problem of Misaligned States](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17590)
*Kennon Stewart*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将在线L-BFGS的机器遗忘问题形式化为反事实状态对齐问题，提出了一套状态感知评估指标，证明了仅修正参数不足以实现有效遗忘，必须对齐优化器状态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的机器遗忘研究主要关注参数修正，但在在线L-BFGS这类具有内部状态（内存缓冲区存储曲率信息）的优化器中，遗忘的目标应该是：若被删除样本从未被处理过，优化器状态本应呈现的样子。因此需要重新形式化遗忘问题并设计合适的评估指标。

Method: 1. 将在线L-BFGS的机器遗忘形式化为反事实状态对齐问题，对比实际事件流与删除编辑后的反事实流；
2. 提出状态感知评估指标：参数误差、内存算子误差、组合状态误差和更新方向误差，其中内存指标比较逆Hessian作用而非将曲率对视为有限影响；
3. 在凸性假设下推导反事实状态偏差的递归界限；
4. 设计状态感知基准测试，评估多种删除干预策略（包括仅内存修正、仅参数修正等），并与反事实预言机模型对比。

Result: 实验结果表明：在线L-BFGS的机器遗忘不仅仅是参数修正问题，单纯的参数校正无法有效实现遗忘；有效的遗忘需要对齐一个可实现的反事实优化器状态，这要求同时考虑参数和内存状态的修正。

Conclusion: 本文建立了在线L-BFGS机器遗忘的理论框架，提出的状态感知指标能够更准确地评估遗忘效果，证明了遗忘问题的本质是反事实状态对齐而非简单的参数修正，为后续研究提供了理论基础和评估基准。

Abstract: We formulate machine unlearning for online L-BFGS as a counterfactual state-alignment problem. Given an actual event stream and a deletion-edited counterfactual stream, the target of unlearning is the optimizer state that would have arisen had the deleted samples never been processed. We introduce state-aware metrics that separately measure parameter error, memory-operator error, combined state error, and update-direction error. The memory metric compares the inverse-Hessian actions induced by the o-L-BFGS memory, rather than treating curvature pairs as of finite influence. Under convexity assumptions, we derive a recursive bound on counterfactual state deviation. We then evaluate a state-aware benchmark of deletion interventions, including memory-only and parameter-only corrections, against an counterfactual oracle model. These results show that unlearning for online L-BFGS is not merely a parameter-correction problem: it requires alignment with a realizable counterfactual optimizer state.

</details>


### [188] [Venom: A PyTorch Generative Modeling Toolkit](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17605)
*Liang Yan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文介绍了VENOM，这是一个基于PyTorch的教育性工具包，旨在统一实现多种主流生成模型范式（如扩散模型、流匹配、VAE、GAN等），通过一致的接口降低初学者的学习门槛。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代生成模型领域虽然发展迅速，但各种范式（扩散模型、流匹配、VAE、GAN、能量模型等）通常分散实现，缺乏统一的代码库。这种碎片化使得初学者难以在同一框架下对比不同模型的训练目标、推理过程、采样算法和条件机制，阻碍了学习与研究。

Method: 提出了VENOM工具包，这是一个基于PyTorch的教育性工具箱。它采用统一的、以MNIST为优先的接口，实现了多种生成模型家族。该工具强调广度、可读性、可复现性以及一致的训练和采样API，而非大规模性能工程。包含了独立的训练与采样脚本、分类器与无分类器引导示例、双语教程笔记本，并按模型家族进行组织。

Result: VENOM成功集成了扩散与分数模型、流匹配与单步生成器、变分自编码器、归一化流、生成对抗网络和能量模型等主要生成模型范式。工具包提供了清晰的文档、一致的API接口和可复现的入口点，支持教学、原型设计和轻量级基准测试。

Conclusion: VENOM通过提供一个统一、易读且教育友好的工具包，有效解决了生成模型领域碎片化的问题，为教学、学习和快速原型设计提供了有价值的资源，有助于新手更好地理解和比较不同的生成建模方法。

Abstract: Modern generative modeling has grown into a broad collection of related but often separately implemented paradigms, including denoising diffusion models, score-based stochastic differential equations, flow matching, variational autoencoders, normalizing flows, adversarial models, and energy-based models. For newcomers, this fragmentation makes it difficult to compare training objectives, inference procedures, sampling algorithms, and conditioning mechanisms within a single coherent codebase. We introduce V ENOM, an educational PyTorch toolkit that implements representative generative modeling families under a unified, MNIST-first interface. V ENOM emphasizes breadth, readability, reproducible entry points, and consistent training and sampling APIs rather than large-scale performance engineering. The package currently includes diffusion and score-based models, flow matching and one-step generators, variational autoencoders, normalizing flows, generative adversarial networks, and energy-based models. It provides separate training and sampling scripts, classifier and classifier-free guidance examples, bilingual tutorial notebooks, and a model-family organization that supports teaching, prototyping, and lightweight benchmarking.

</details>


### [189] [The Neural Tangent Kernel for Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17606)
*Jonathan Plenk,Sergio Calvo-Ordonez,Alvaro Cartea,Yarin Gal,Mark van der Wilk,Kamil Ciosek*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将神经正切核（NTK）理论扩展至分类任务，证明了在参数空间正则化或非退化目标条件下，宽神经网络在交叉熵损失训练中仍保持核近似恒定，从而可用线性化模型精确刻画训练动力学。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的NTK理论主要局限于回归损失，普遍认为分类损失（涉及非线性输出变换）会导致逻辑值发散并破坏线性化假设。本文旨在突破这一限制，将NTK理论推广至分类及更一般的非线性损失场景。

Method: 作者识别了宽神经网络保持“惰性训练”的条件：对于交叉熵损失，引入参数空间正则化可确保NTK恒定；若无正则化，则在目标为非退化（各类别概率严格为正）时仍能维持该机制。在此条件下，训练过程可由线性化模型近似，从而基于NTK显式表达解的形式。

Result: 在上述条件下，训练后的预测器可由NTK显式刻画。此外，作者分析了随机初始化诱导的训练预测器分布，并将这种模型不确定性与贝叶斯方法建立了联系。

Conclusion: 本文成功将NTK理论拓展至分类任务，揭示了在特定条件下宽神经网络在分类损失下仍处于惰性训练区域，为理解分类问题的训练动力学、泛化性质及与贝叶斯方法的联系提供了理论基础。

Abstract: In wide neural networks, the Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK) remains approximately constant during training, providing a powerful theoretical tool for studying training dynamics, generalization, and connections to kernel methods. However, this theory is largely restricted to regression losses. It was previously thought that training on a classification loss, or more generally losses involving nonlinear output transformations, breaks this property, leading to divergent logits and a breakdown of the linearization. In this paper, we extend NTK theory to classification by identifying conditions under which wide neural networks remain in the lazy training regime. We show that parameter-space regularization ensures a constant NTK during training for cross-entropy loss, while in the absence of regularization the regime is recovered when targets are non-degenerate, i.e. when all classes have strictly positive probability. Under these conditions, training is well-approximated by the linearized model, yielding an explicit characterization of the solution in terms of the NTK. We further analyze the distribution of trained predictors induced by random initialization and relate this notion of model uncertainty to Bayesian methods.

</details>


### [190] [Adaptive Generate-Rank-Verify: Inference-Time Search with Costly Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17609)
*Shaddin Dughmi,Mahdi Haghifam,Yusuf Hakan Kalayci*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了生成式主动搜索框架，并设计了ADAP算法，在奖励模型与验证器结合的场景下，以近似最优的成本找到正确答案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多推理时的语言模型流程将廉价的奖励信号与昂贵的验证器（如数学推理中的精确答案检查或代码生成中的隐藏测试执行）相结合。现有方法缺乏理论指导，需要一种形式化的框架来在成本与效率之间取得平衡。

Method: 将问题形式化为生成式主动搜索：一种成本敏感的首次正例搜索问题。在已知分数分布和成功函数的情况下，使用动态规划推导分布感知最优策略。针对两者未知的现实场景，提出ADAP算法，通过逐步增加采样响应数量和top-ranked验证次数来自适应调整策略。该方法在单调性假设（更高的奖励分数更可能通过验证）下运行。

Result: 证明了ADAP算法的期望成本在分布感知最优解的一个常数因子范围内。基于中心星数给出了学习理论下界，表明对分数-标签关系的结构假设是必要的。在数学推理和竞争性编程实验中，ADAP优于固定非自适应策略和难度自适应基线。

Conclusion: 本文为廉价奖励信号与昂贵验证器结合的推理时流程提供了学习理论视角的形式化框架，证明了所提ADAP算法的近似最优性，并通过实验验证了其有效性，为该类问题的算法设计提供了理论基础和实践指导。

Abstract: Many inference-time language-model pipelines combine a cheap reward signal with an expensive verifier, such as exact answer checking in mathematical reasoning or hidden-test execution in code generation.
  We formalize this setting using a learning-theoretic lens as generative active search: a cost-sensitive first-positive search problem in which a policy adaptively samples candidates from an unknown distribution, observes cheap scores, and pays for verifier labels until it finds a positive example. For a fixed prompt, the generator and reward model induce two unknown objects: a distribution over reward scores and a score-conditioned success function. When these quantities are known, we characterize the distribution-aware optimal policy using a dynamic programming approach. In the realistic and practical setting where both the score distribution and success function are unknown, we propose ADAP, a shellwise adaptive generate-rank-verify algorithm that progressively increases the number of sampled responses and top-ranked verifications. Under the monotonicity assumption that higher reward scores are no less likely to pass verification, we show that ADAP achieves expected cost within a constant factor of the distribution-aware optimum. We complement this result with learning-theoretic lower bounds, based on a centered star number, showing that structural assumptions on the score--label relationship are necessary. Experiments on mathematical reasoning and competitive programming validate the predicted advantage over both fixed non-adaptive policies and difficulty-adaptive baselines.

</details>


### [191] [Verifier-Guided Code Translation via Meta-Step Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17626)
*Tianyang Zhou,Somesh Jha,Mihai Christodorescu,Kirill Levchenko,Varun Chandrasekaran*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了DTV框架，通过在解码过程中实时调用验证器，显著提升了代码翻译任务的通过率，同时降低了计算成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的测试时扩展方法通常仅在生成完成后应用验证器（如编译器、类型检查器），这种方式效率低下，因为早期的生成错误会污染自回归上下文，且在后续生成中难以被纠正。作者希望利用代码翻译任务中源程序对输出的约束特性，在生成过程中就引入验证反馈。

Method: 提出了解码时验证（DTV）框架。该框架将代码的结构边界（如语句、函数块）视为元步骤，使用状态机控制器在生成过程中交错进行生成与验证器调用。通过结构边界检查和结构感知的回滚机制，DTV能够强制执行有效的前缀生成，防止错误传播并减少无效token的浪费。

Result: 在C到Rust和JavaScript到TypeScript翻译任务上，使用Qwen3-4B模型并在匹配的token预算下，DTV将通过率分别从72.3%提升至82.0%，以及从33.3%提升至46.0%（相对于匹配的自精炼基线）。同时，DTV在每个案例中使用了更少的token，实现了比后验验证或采样扩展更优的通过率-成本权衡。

Conclusion: 验证器引导的解码是利用推理时计算进行代码翻译的有效方式，DTV证明了在生成过程中即时利用结构化验证反馈能够显著提升模型性能与效率。

Abstract: Test-time scaling is an important mechanism for improving large language models, especially on tasks with deterministic verifiers. Code translation is a canonical example: the source program constrains valid outputs, while compilers, type check- ers, and behavioral checks provide exact pass/fail feedback. Existing approaches typically apply these verifiers only after generation, which is inefficient because early errors corrupt the autoregressive context and are rarely corrected later. We introduce Decoding Time Verification (DTV), a framework that treats structural boundaries as meta steps for verifier-guided decoding. DTV interleaves generation with verifier calls under a state-machine controller that enforces valid prefixes, using structural-boundary checks and structure-aware rollback to prevent error propagation while reducing wasted tokens. We evaluate DTV on C-to-Rust and JavaScript-to-TypeScript translation. Using Qwen3-4B as the primary generator under matched token budgets, DTV improves pass rates from 72.3% to 82.0% on C-to-Rust and from 33.3% to 46.0% on JavaScript-to-TypeScript relative to matched self-refinement baselines, while using fewer tokens per case; the same trend largely transfers to Gemma-4-E4B. In the evaluated cost-matched grid, DTV achieves a more favorable pass-rate-cost tradeoff than post-hoc verification or sampling-based scaling. These results show that verifier-guided decoding is an effective use of inference-time compute for code translation.

</details>


### [192] [TabKDE: Simple and Scalable Tabular Data Generation with Kernel Density Estimates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17642)
*Meysam Alishahi,Yan Zheng,Junpeng Wang,Chin-Chia Michael Yeh,Jeff M. Phillips*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于Copula变换和核密度估计的表格数据生成方法，在准确性和隐私保护方面接近现有先进方法，同时大幅降低了训练时间和存储空间，具有良好的可扩展性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的表格数据生成方法（如基于one-hot编码、VAE和扩散模型的方法）虽然取得了显著进展，但存在计算成本高、训练时间长的问题，且难以处理大规模数据集。因此，需要一种高效、可扩展且存储友好的新方法。

Method: 采用Copula变换处理表格数据的边缘分布，并利用核密度估计（KDE）建模数据分布。通过将模型存储为原始数据的coreset，实现了生成模型的紧凑表示。这种方法避免了复杂的神经网络训练过程。

Result: 该方法在准确性和避免信息泄露方面几乎匹配了现有最先进方法的性能，但训练时间几乎为零。它具有极强的可扩展性，可以在普通笔记本电脑上处理比现有方法大数个数量级的数据集，同时需要更少的存储空间。

Conclusion: 所提出的方法为表格数据生成提供了一种高效、可扩展的解决方案，是首个将生成模型表示为数据coreset的方法，在保持生成质量的同时显著提升了计算效率和存储效率。

Abstract: Tabular data generation considers a large table with multiple columns -- each column comprised of numerical, categorical, or sometimes ordinal values. The goal is to produce new rows for the table that replicate the distribution of rows from the original data -- without just copying those initial rows. The last 4 years have seen enormous progress on this problem, mostly using computational expensive methods that employ one-hot encoding, VAEs, and diffusion.
  This paper describes a new approach to the problem of tabular data generation. By employing copula transformations and modeling the distribution as a kernel density estimate we can nearly match the accuracy and leakage-avoidance achievements of the previous methods, but with almost no training time. Our method is very scalable, and can be run on data sets orders of magnitude larger than prior state-of-the-art on a simple laptop. Moreover, because we employ kernel density estimates, we can store the model as a coreset of the original data -- we believe the first for generative modeling -- and as a result, require significantly less space as well. Our code is available here: \url{https://github.com/tabkde/tabkde-main}

</details>


### [193] [Counterfactual Explanations Under Concept Drift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17651)
*Marcin Kostrzewa,Jerzy Stefanowski,Maciej Zięba*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对数据流环境中的概念漂移问题，提出了轻量级模型无关的反事实解释维护方案，通过局部采样修复现有解释，避免了解释失效问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的反事实解释方法假设静态的数据环境和固定的分类器，但在数据流等动态环境中，模型会因概念漂移而持续更新。作者发现了一个被忽视的问题：初始有效的反事实解释会随模型演化而悄然失效，包括那些原本设计为鲁棒的反事实解释，因为它们并非为持续漂移而设计。

Method: 提出一种轻量级、模型无关的更新方案来修复现有的反事实解释。该方法使用局部采样来估计有效性和合理性方向，同时保持与原始实例的邻近性。通过监控和调整机制，在概念漂移发生时对已有解释进行维护而非重新生成。

Result: 在合成漂移数据流上的实验表明：（1）初始创建的反事实解释会快速失去有效性；（2）维护后的反事实解释能够保持有效性和局部合理性；（3）相比重复重新生成解释，维护方案的成本更低。

Conclusion: 该研究填补了动态数据环境中反事实解释维护的空白，证明了在概念漂移场景下，主动维护现有解释比被动重新生成更具优势，为实际应用中的解释可持续性提供了有效解决方案。

Abstract: Counterfactual explanations (CFEs) provide actionable recourse, but most methods assume a static framework with fixed data and a trained classifier. This assumption breaks in evolving data environments, such as data streams, where online models are repeatedly updated under concept drift. We identify CFE maintenance in this setting as a previously overlooked problem: explanations that are valid when generated may silently become invalid as the model evolves, including robust CFEs, which are not designed for continuous drift. We propose a lightweight, model-agnostic update scheme that repairs existing CFEs using local sampling to estimate validity and plausibility directions while preserving proximity to the original instance. Experiments on synthetic drifting streams show that initially created CFEs rapidly lose validity, whereas maintained CFEs preserve validity and local plausibility at a lower cost than repeated regeneration.

</details>


### [194] [LLMForge: Multi-Backend Hardware-Aware Neural Architecture Search with Infinite-Head Attention for Edge Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17653)
*Xinting Jiang,Junyi Luo,Ruichen Qi,Kauna Lei,Ben Laurie,Gregory Kielian,Mehdi Saligane*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出LLMForge框架，针对边缘设备进行硬件感知的神经架构搜索，通过扩展注意力配置空间和构建硬件成本模型，成功搜索出在准确率、能效和延迟方面各有优势的模型变体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 十亿参数以下的Transformer语言模型在边缘设备部署时面临内存带宽、能耗和散热预算的严格限制，不同硬件平台具有不同的成本瓶颈，传统架构设计无法高效适配多样化的边缘硬件环境，需要硬件条件化的架构搜索方法。

Method: 提出LLMForge框架，包含三个核心组件：1）Infinite-Head Attention（IHA）将查询头数、KV组和头维度解耦，使搜索空间扩展约400倍；2）Forge-Former作为编码器代理模型用于架构候选排序；3）Forge-DSE基于NSGA-II的设计空间探索引擎，配合跨GPU、脉动加速器和环形数据流边缘加速器的多后端硬件成本模型进行联合优化。

Result: 在四种不同硬件平台上收敛到架构形态各异的模型，其形状与各平台的成本瓶颈相匹配；在多芯片环形平台上获得三个300M规模的帕累托前沿变体：准确率优化版本验证损失最低（2.798）且参数更少；能效优化版本每token能耗降低40%；延迟优化版本TTFT和TPOT降低43%。

Conclusion: LLMForge证明了硬件感知的神经架构搜索能够针对不同硬件平台的成本瓶颈自动生成适配的架构，所发现的模型在准确率、能效和延迟方面均显著优于基线架构，为边缘设备语言模型的高效部署提供了有效的自动化解决方案。

Abstract: Sub-billion-parameter Transformer language models are increasingly deployed on edge devices, where the privacy, latency, and operating-cost advantages of on-device inference are constrained by tight memory-bandwidth, energy, and thermal budgets that make architectural choice and accelerator-specific cost central to efficient inference. We present LLMForge, a hardware-aware neural architecture search (NAS) framework whose three composable contributions together make edge-LM architecture search hardware-conditioned, since different substrates impose different hardware cost bottlenecks. Infinite-Head Attention (IHA) decouples the number of query heads, KV groups, and per-head query/key and value dimensions, expanding the feasible per-layer attention configuration space by approximately 400x over grouped-query attention within our search-space ranges. Forge-Former, an encoder-based surrogate for ranking architectural candidates, outperforms MLP and random-forest baselines. Forge-DSE, an NSGA-II-based design-space-exploration engine, pairs Forge-Former with a multi-backend hardware cost model spanning GPUs, systolic accelerators, and ring-dataflow edge accelerators. Across four different hardware substrates, the searches converge to visibly different architectures whose shapes track each substrate's cost bottleneck. On the multi-chip ring substrate, our co-search returns three 300M-scale deployment-aware variants on the Pareto front. Each is re-trained on FineWeb-Edu-10BT under matched recipe against SmolLM2-360M and Qwen-0.5B architecture baselines. The accurate variant has the lowest validation loss 2.798 and competitive benchmark performance with fewer parameters, the energy-optimized variant lowers energy per token by 40%, and the latency-optimized variant lowers TTFT and TPOT by 43%.

</details>


### [195] [When a Zero-Shooter Cheats: Improving Age Estimation via Activation Steering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17658)
*Erik Imgrund,Pia Hanfeld,Klim Kireev,Konrad Rieck*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现视觉语言模型（VLM）在年龄估计任务中存在“身份捷径”问题，即通过识别名人并调用记忆知识而非视觉特征来估计年龄。提出的激活干预方法有效抑制了该捷径，将平均绝对误差降低了25%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究主要关注VLM在年龄估计上的高性能表现，但忽视了其零样本特性可能带来的副作用。作者旨在探究VLM在年龄估计中是否存在非预期的推理机制，以及这种机制如何影响模型在真实场景下的可靠性与鲁棒性评估。

Method: 作者首先定义并验证了“身份捷径”现象，即模型倾向于识别图像中的人物并调用记忆中的年龄信息。针对这一问题，提出了一种激活干预方法，通过在VLM的隐藏状态上进行操作，抑制模型对身份捷径的依赖，迫使其更多地基于视觉特征进行年龄推断。

Result: 实验表明，身份捷径导致模型在将非名人误识别为名人时产生显著错误，并在名人图像上表现出虚假的高鲁棒性。所提出的干预方法在多个主流基准测试上取得了显著效果，将平均绝对误差降低了25%，同时提升了模型对已知和未知身份的年龄估计准确性。

Conclusion: VLM在年龄估计任务中的高性能可能部分源于利用身份捷径而非真正的视觉理解，这揭示了当前基准测试的局限性。所提出的激活干预方法不仅能有效缓解此问题，还提升了模型的泛化能力与可靠性，为构建更公平的年龄验证系统提供了新思路。

Abstract: Different age-related regulations have been proposed to protect minors from harmful content and interactions online. Automated age estimation is central to enforcing such regulations, and vision-language models (VLMs) achieve state-of-the-art performance on this task. However, we find that the zero-shot nature of VLM-based age estimation produces an unexpected side effect we call the identity shortcut: Instead of estimating age from visual features, VLMs tend to identify the depicted person and infer their age from memorized knowledge. This phenomenon leads to substantially incorrect predictions when non-celebrities are misidentified as celebrities. It also produces deceptively high robustness to noise and adversarial perturbations on celebrity images, which dominate popular benchmarks. To mitigate this, we propose an activation steering method that suppresses the shortcut by intervening on the hidden states of the VLM. This method improves age estimation accuracy for both memorized and unseen identities, reducing mean absolute error by up to 25% across popular benchmarks.

</details>


### [196] [Bug or Feature$^2$: Weight Drift, Activation Sparsity, and Spikes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17659)
*Egor Shvetsov,Aleksandr Serkov,Shokorov Viacheslav,Redko Dmitry,Vladislav Goloshchapov,Evgeny Burnaev*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示了标准损失函数与非对称激活函数交互产生的负权重漂移现象，该现象导致激活稀疏性并影响模型性能，提出了裁剪ReLU²和GELU²作为解决方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代神经网络架构设计虽已趋于成熟，但其训练动态的机制仍未被完全理解。作者旨在研究标准损失函数与偏正激活函数之间的交互如何影响权重更新和训练动态。

Method: 1. 理论分析：证明在MSE或交叉熵损失下，正预激活梯度的期望值在初始化时非负，驱动下游权重向负值漂移。
2. 实验验证：跨多种架构（MLP、ResNet、ViT、GPT-nano、MP-SENe）和非对称激活函数（ReLU、GELU、SiLU）验证漂移现象。
3. 系统评估：在79种配置下表征稀疏性-准确性权衡关系。
4. 解决方案：提出裁剪ReLU²和GELU²缓解激活尖峰问题。

Result: 1. 负权重漂移是优化过程的内在特性，而非数据依赖。
2. 与ReLU结合时，权重漂移在GPT-nano中产生高达90%的激活稀疏性。
3. 发现约70%激活稀疏度以上存在明显的准确性悬崖。
4. 裁剪ReLU²优于未裁剪版本，GELU²在GPT-nano上实现最低验证损失。

Conclusion: 负权重漂移是神经网络训练中的固有现象，既可被视为"Bug"导致过度稀疏，也可被视为"Feature"提供稀疏性优势。通过适当的激活函数设计（裁剪ReLU²或GELU²），可以在保持表示能力的同时有效平衡稀疏性与准确性。

Abstract: The design of modern neural architectures has converged through incremental empirical choices, yet the mechanisms governing their training dynamics remain only partially understood. We identify and analyze a negative weight drift induced by the interaction between standard losses and positively biased activation functions. We prove that under MSE or cross-entropy loss, the gradient with respect to positive pre-activations is non-negative in expectation at initialization, driving downstream weights toward negative values during early training. The drift is intrinsic to optimization rather than data, and persists across architectures (MLP, ResNet, ViT, GPT-nano, MP-SENe) and asymmetric activation functions (ReLU, GELU, SiLU). Coupled with ReLU, weight drift produces activation sparsity reaching up to 90\% in GPT-nano. We characterize the sparsity-accuracy tradeoff across 79 configurations and identify a sharp accuracy cliff above $\sim$70\% activation sparsity. While ReLU$^2$ achieves a good sparsity--accuracy ratio in GPT-nano, it pathologically amplifies identified activation spikes in intermediate transformer layers. Clipping resolves this while preserving the representational benefits of squaring: clipped ReLU$^2$ outperforms its unclipped version, and GELU$^2$ achieves the lowest validation loss on GPT-nano. Code is available at https://github.com/On-Point-RND/BugOrFeature.

</details>


### [197] [PEIRA: Learning Predictive Encoders through Inter-View Regressor Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17671)
*Michael Arbel,Basile Terver,Jean Ponce*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过理论分析揭示了非对比自监督学习（如SimSiam、BYOL）的动力学机制，发现其稳定平衡点与典型相关分析子空间对齐，据此提出了具有显式目标函数的PEIRA方法，避免了表示坍塌问题，在ImageNet和CIFAR-10上取得了与VICReg等基线方法相当的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非对比自监督学习方法（如SimSiam、BYOL、I-JEPA、DINO）虽然在实践中表现有效，但依赖于自蒸馏的教师-学生网络训练框架，缺乏明确定义的目标函数，导致这些方法的理论理解不足。本文旨在揭示这类方法的工作机制和动力学特性。

Method: 1. 分析联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）变体的动力学特性，使用正则化线性回归器在两个数据视图的表示之间进行预测；
2. 理论推导并完全刻画系统的稳定性：非坍塌稳定平衡点与主导非线性典型相关子空间对齐，而坍塌平衡点也可能是稳定吸引子；
3. 基于理论发现提出PEIRA方法：通过最优线性回归器的迹定义显式目标函数，其唯一的稳定平衡点是非平凡的全局最小化器，恢复相同的典型相关子空间。

Result: 1. 理论上证明了非对比SSL方法的稳定平衡点与典型相关分析（CCA）子空间的联系；
2. PEIRA方法的理论保证：只有非平凡的全局最小化器是稳定平衡点，正则化参数选择有效维度；
3. 在ImageNet-1K和CIFAR-10上的实验表明PEIRA与VICReg和LeJEPA基线方法具有竞争力的性能；
4. 定性实证结果支持理论分析结论。

Conclusion: 本文为非对比自监督学习提供了理论解释，揭示了其与典型相关分析的联系，并据此设计了具有理论保证的PEIRA方法，解决了表示坍塌问题，为非对比SSL方法的设计提供了理论指导。

Abstract: Non-contrastive self-supervised learning (SSL) is an effective framework for predictive representation learning, but popular (and in practice effective) methods such as SimSiam, BYOL, I-JEPA or DINO, which rely on a form of self-distillation to train a teacher-student network, remain poorly understood as they typically do not minimize a well-defined objective. We analyze the dynamics of a variant of the Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) using a regularized linear regressor to predict the learned representations of two views of the data from one another, and fully characterize its stability: non-collapsed stable equilibria align with leading nonlinear canonical correlation subspaces, while collapsed equilibria may also be stable attractors. Motivated by this result, we introduce PEIRA, a non-contrastive SSL method with an explicit objective defined through the trace of the optimal linear regressor. We show that its only stable equilibria are nontrivial global minimizers and recover the same canonical correlation subspaces, with regularization selecting the effective dimension. Experiments on ImageNet-1K and CIFAR-10 show PEIRA is competitive with VICReg and LeJEPA baselines, and qualitative empirical results support the theory.

</details>


### [198] [Exact Convex Reformulations of Linear Neural Networks via Completely Positive Lifting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17692)
*Karthik Prakhya,Alp Yurtsever*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明了深度线性神经网络训练问题可被精确重构为凸优化问题，揭示了线性分解引起的非凸性的本质结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度线性神经网络的训练问题本质上是非凸的，这给理论分析和优化求解带来了巨大挑战。研究者希望建立该问题与凸优化之间的精确联系，从而获得理论洞察和可能的求解途径。

Method: 首先将多层参数化简化为双线性分解，然后将其提升为秩约束的半正定规划，接着通过互补条件表达秩约束，最后应用完全正锥提升技术，将问题重构为广义完全正锥上的凸优化问题。

Result: 成功获得了原非凸问题的精确凸重构，该重构与原问题具有相同的最优值。提升空间的维度仅依赖于输入输出维度，与网络深度和数据点数量无关，瓶颈宽度仅通过标量约束进入。所有非凸性被编码在锥约束中。

Conclusion: 该工作建立了线性神经网络训练与共正规划之间的精确联系，给出了线性分解诱导的非凸性的精确锥表示。虽然计算上一般仍不可行，但为理解线性神经网络优化的本质提供了重要理论基础。

Abstract: We show that the training problem of a deep linear neural network under the squared loss admits an exact convex reformulation in a lifted space over a generalized completely positive cone. The reformulation has the same optimal value as the original nonconvex problem and is linear in the lifted variables, with all nonconvexity encoded in the cone constraint. Its ambient lifted dimension depends only on the input and output dimensions, independent of the network depth and the number of data points, and the bottleneck width enters only through scalar constraints. The construction proceeds by reducing the multilayer parameterization to a bilinear factorization, lifting it to a rank-constrained semidefinite program, expressing the rank constraint via a complementarity condition, and applying a completely positive lifting. While the resulting formulation is computationally intractable in general, it gives an exact conic representation of the nonconvexity induced by linear factorization and connects linear neural network training with copositive programming.

</details>


### [199] [Fine-tuning Pocket-Aware Diffusion Models via Denoising Policy Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17693)
*Yuan Xue,Daniel Kudenko,Megha Khosla*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了DEPPA，一种基于去噪扩散策略优化的基于结构分子优化（SBMO）新方法。通过将预训练口袋感知扩散模型的反向去噪过程建模为多步马尔可夫决策过程，并利用强化学习进行微调，实现了对结合亲和力、类药物性、可合成性和多样性等多重性质的同时优化，在CrossDocked2020基准测试中取得了最优的结合亲和力（-8.5 kcal/mol）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的基于结构的3D生成模型主要拟合训练数据分布，难以满足现实药物发现中对多重分子性质（如结合亲和力、类药物性、可合成性、多样性）的综合优化需求。近期研究开始关注基于结构的分子优化（SBMO）问题，旨在实现对多个指定分子性质的细粒度控制。

Method: 提出DEPPA方法，基于去噪扩散策略优化（DDPO）框架：1）将预训练的口袋感知扩散模型的反向去噪过程形式化为多步马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）；2）采用强化学习对预训练模型进行微调；3）将期望优化的分子性质（结合亲和力、类药物性、可合成性、多样性）作为奖励信号，在最终生成的配体分子上进行评估；4）引入粗粒度去噪调度器以实现高效且有效的分子优化。

Result: 在CrossDocked2020基准测试集上，DEPPA在结合亲和力方面达到Vina Score -8.5 kcal/mol，超越所有基线方法；同时在类药物性和多样性方面表现优异，在可合成性方面具有竞争力。

Conclusion: DEPPA成功地将强化学习与扩散模型相结合，为基于结构的分子优化问题提供了一种有效的解决方案，能够在保持生成多样性和可合成性的同时显著提升结合亲和力和类药物性，具有实际药物发现应用价值。

Abstract: Structure-based drug design has been accelerated by pocket-aware 3D generative models, yet most methods primarily fit the training distribution and may fall short of satisfying multiple properties required in real-world therapeutic drug discovery. Recently, increasing attention has focused on structure-based molecule optimization (SBMO), which targets fine-grained control over multiple specified molecular properties. In this paper, we present DEPPA, a novel SBMO approach building upon Denoising Diffusion Policy Optimization for fine-tuning a pre-trained pocket-aware diffusion model via reinforcement learning. DEPPA enables optimization over multiple properties, including binding affinity, drug-likeness, synthesizability and diversity. We formulate the reverse denoising process of the pretrained pocket-aware diffusion model as a multi-step Markov Decision Process, where the desired properties that serve as reward signals are evaluated on the final generated ligand molecules. DEPPA incorporates a coarse denoising scheduler during the RL fine-tuning to achieve efficient and effective molecule optimization. Experimental results on the CrossDocked2020 benchmark demonstrate that DEPPA outperforms baselines in binding affinity (Vina Score -8.5 kcal/mol), drug-likeness and diversity while exhibiting competitive performance in synthesizability. The source code is available at https://github.com/xy9485/DePPA .

</details>


### [200] [Toy Combinatorial Interpretability Models Reveal Lottery Tickets in Early Feature Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17704)
*Alon Bebchuk,Nir Shavit*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究彩票假说中“中奖彩票”保留的内在对象，发现在组合玩具设置中，中奖彩票在特征空间上对应于初始化时已接近最终特征码的前驱位置，其结构由隐藏的特征空间几何而非权重空间子网络身份决定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 彩票假说指出稠密网络中存在稀疏子网络（中奖彩票），但缺乏对其内在机制的深入理解。现有研究主要关注权重空间，作者希望从机制性视角回答：中奖彩票究竟保留了什么内部对象？

Method: 在可解释的子句结构玩具设置中工作，该设置允许明确定义特征间的组合距离；通过特征空间距离和运动的轻量级探针分析中奖彩票；对比权重空间与特征空间的关系；使用稀疏重训练验证保留对象的性质。

Result: 中奖彩票在权重空间中对应特征空间中的前驱位置，这些位置在初始化时已接近最终特征通道码；稠密SGD通过结构化选择解决这些位置：近端位置要么收敛到最终码，要么被拒绝，拒绝集中在更拥挤的神经元上，暗示叠加下的竞争；中奖彩票是一族兼容的码位置，联合平衡与最终码的邻近度和低特征间干扰；稀疏重训练常在不同行上重新表达相同的子句/模板族，保留的是族级对象而非微观行身份；基于特征空间的探针在准确性和精确码恢复方面优于权重空间方法。

Conclusion: 彩票假说中的中奖彩票结构受隐藏的特征空间几何支配，而非权重空间的子网络身份。这一发现虽基于玩具设置，但为理解神经网络剪枝和稀疏子网络的本质提供了新的视角，挑战了传统权重空间的解释框架。

Abstract: The lottery ticket hypothesis posits that dense networks contain sparse subnetworks, ``winning tickets,'' that, when rewound to their initial weights and retrained in isolation, match the performance of the full model. We ask a more mechanistic question: what internal object does a winning ticket preserve? We work in a combinatorial, clause-structured toy setting that admits an interpretable feature-space representation with well-defined combinatorial distances between features. We show that winning tickets in weight space correspond to precursor locations in feature space that are already near, at initialization, to the final feature-channel codes. Dense SGD resolves these locations through structured selection: proximal locations either converge to final codes or are rejected, with rejection concentrated at more crowded neurons, implicating competition under superposition. A winning ticket is thus a family of compatible code locations that jointly balance proximity to final codes with low inter-feature interference. Sparse retraining often re-expresses the same clause/template family on a different row, so the preserved object is family-level rather than microscopic row identity. We validate this account with lightweight probes based on feature-space distance and motion; in our setting, these probes frequently outperform established weight-based ticket discovery methods in both accuracy and exact code recovery. Although these findings are grounded in a toy setting, they suggest that the lottery ticket structure is governed by hidden feature-space geometry rather than weight-space subnetwork identity.

</details>


### [201] [L-Drive: Beyond a Single Mapping-Latent Context Drives Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17730)
*Fan Zhang,Shijun Chen,Hua Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了L-Drive，一种面向多变量时间序列预测的变化感知框架。通过引入潜在上下文（Latent-Context）显式刻画高层动态演变，并采用门控机制调节增量表示，缓解了传统直接映射范式在分布漂移和状态切换点响应滞后的问题，同时引入分块共享相对位置基函数增强段内结构建模，实现了预测精度与计算效率的更好权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主流多变量时间序列预测方法主要采用直接映射范式，学习从历史到未来的统一映射以拟合数值级依赖关系。然而，现实世界系统经常经历分布漂移和状态切换，在此情况下统一映射会在转折点附近表现出响应滞后，导致切换窗口内的误差累积，降低预测可靠性。

Method: 提出L-Drive变化感知预测框架：1) 引入潜在上下文（Latent-Context）显式刻画随时间演变的高层动态；2) 使用门控机制调节增量表示，提供更及时的变化线索并改善对变化段的适应；3) 结合分块共享相对位置基函数，增强段内结构建模并减少由绝对位置记忆引起的过拟合。

Result: 广泛实验验证了L-Drive的有效性，在预测精度与计算效率之间取得了更好的整体权衡。

Conclusion: L-Drive通过潜在上下文和门控机制有效缓解了统一映射在分布漂移和状态切换时的响应滞后问题，为实际系统中存在频繁变化的时间序列预测提供了一种可靠且高效的解决方案。

Abstract: Mainstream methods for multivariate time-series forecasting largely follow the Direct-Mapping paradigm. They learn a unified mapping from history to the future in the observation space to fit value-level dependencies. However, real-world systems often undergo distribution shifts and regime changes. In such cases, a unified mapping can exhibit response lag around turning points, causing error accumulation within the switching window and reducing forecasting reliability. To address this issue, we propose L-Drive, a change-aware forecasting framework. L-Drive introduces a Latent-Context, to explicitly characterize high-level dynamics evolving over time, and uses gating to modulate increment representations. This provides more timely change cues and improves adaptation to changing segments. In addition, it incorporates patch-shared relative positional basis functions to strengthen intra-segment structural modeling and reduce overfitting caused by absolute-position memorization. Extensive experiments validate the effectiveness of L-Drive and show a better overall trade-off between forecasting accuracy and computational efficiency.

</details>


### [202] [Testable and Actionable Calibration for Full Swap Regret](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17749)
*Konstantina Bairaktari,Lunjia Hu,Huy L. Nguyen,Jonathan Ullman*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种新的校准度量方法——Soft-Binned Calibration Decision Loss (SCDL)，首次同时满足了可操作性（actionability）和可测试性（testability）两个基本要求，解决了现有方法必须在此两者间妥协的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在关键任务的AI决策中，校准（calibration）是衡量预测可信度的重要指标。然而，现有的校准度量方法存在根本性缺陷：无法同时满足可操作性（能够告知决策者将预测视为真实概率时的效用损失，即swap regret）和可测试性（能够从有限样本中估计校准误差）。所有现有方法要么通过约束较弱的swap regret来放宽可操作性要求，要么通过接受次优估计误差来放宽可测试性要求。

Method: 作者提出了一种新的校准度量方法：Soft-Binned Calibration Decision Loss (SCDL)。该方法的核心创新在于：
1. 使用软分箱（soft-binning）技术，避免了硬分箱带来的不连续性问题
2. 在理论上证明了SCDL在满足可操作性的同时，无需放宽任何要求，即可以精确反映决策者的swap regret
3. 在可测试性方面，证明了SCDL具有接近最优的估计误差率
4. 此外，SCDL还满足连续性和一致性等其他期望性质

Result: 理论结果表明：
1. SCDL是完全可操作的，即可以直接约束真实的swap regret，无需使用较弱的概念
2. SCDL是可测试的，具有接近最优的估计误差率
3. SCDL满足连续性和一致性等期望性质
实验验证表明，相比其他度量方法，SCDL的理论优势在实际应用中带来了更好的性能表现。

Conclusion: 本文填补了校准度量领域的重要空白，首次提出了一种同时满足可操作性和可测试性的校准度量方法。SCDL不仅在理论上具有优越性，在实际应用中也展现出更好的性能。这一成果为AI系统的可信度评估提供了更加可靠和实用的工具，对于推动AI在关键任务中的安全应用具有重要意义。

Abstract: AI generated predictions increasingly inform decision making in critical tasks, and therefore must be trustworthy. One widely used measure of trustworthiness is calibration, which requires that the predictions match the true frequencies and can be treated like real probabilities of a given outcome. However, defining calibration is subtle, and designing good measures of calibration error has been an active topic of recent research. The first goal is to find calibration measures that are actionable, meaning they can inform decision makers about their utility loss when predictions are treated as true probabilities, which is known as swap regret. The second goal is to find calibration measures that are testable, meaning that calibration error can be measured from a small sample of predictions and outcomes. Although these are very basic requirements, there is no existing calibration measure that fully satisfies both properties, and all existing measures relax actionability by bounding a weaker notion of swap regret, or relax testability by having suboptimal estimation error. We introduce a new calibration measure, Soft-Binned Calibration Decision Loss (SCDL), which we prove is fully actionable without weakening either requirement, and testable with nearly optimal error rate. In addition, SCDL satisfies other desired properties such as continuity and consistency. We also provide a set of experiments confirming that the theoretical advantages of SCDL compared to other measures lead to better performance in practice.

</details>


### [203] [Memisis: Orchestrating and Evaluating Synthetic Data for Tabular Health Datasets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17758)
*Nitish Nagesh,Mahdi Bagheri,Arshia Harish Puthran,Pengbao Zhou,Muhjaazee Love,Aadi Sharma,Ian Harris,Amir M. Rahmani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文介绍了Memisis工具，用于编排和评估医疗合成数据，整合现有工具、大语言模型和评估指标，在隐私、效用和公平性方面提供统一工作流，并在精神分裂症数据集上验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 合成数据在医疗领域被广泛用于在保护隐私的前提下生成与原始数据相似的替代数据集。然而，如何在隐私保护、数据效用和公平性等多个维度上系统地生成和评估合成数据，对于确保下游预测任务和临床决策所需的高质量数据可用性至关重要。现有工具缺乏统一的流程和智能化的编排能力。

Method: 提出Memisis工具，通过集成现有合成数据工具、大语言模型（LLM）和最先进的评估指标，构建统一的数据生成、验证和评估工作流。用户可控制训练规模、训练轮数和合成样本数量，并通过交互式智能体指定合成数据生成目标，由工具自动编排工作流并执行必要的评估。演示中使用了开源精神分裂症数据集（包含种族和性别受保护属性）、三种不同的合成器（CTGAN、TVAE、GaussianCopula）和本地语言模型。

Result: 在演示实验中，CTGAN、TVAE和GaussianCopula三种合成器在公平性和效用指标上表现相当。该工作流为用户提供了数据生成和评估过程的灵活性和控制力。

Conclusion: Memisis工具成功实现了合成数据生成与评估的智能化编排，为医疗数据隐私保护与可用性平衡提供了有效的解决方案，支持用户灵活控制并自动化完成从目标设定到评估的全流程。

Abstract: Synthetic data is widely used in healthcare to create datasets that are similar to original data but without the privacy concerns. Generating and evaluating synthetic data across privacy, utility and fairness is crucial for facilitating high quality data availability for downstream prediction tasks and clinical decision making. We present Memisis, a tool that orchestrates and evaluates synthetic data by leveraging existing synthetic data tools, the power of large language models and state-of-the-art evaluation metrics. Our tool creates a unified workflow for data generation, validation and evaluation. Users have control over the training size, training epochs and the number of synthetic rows to sample. Instead of knobs to tune synthetic data, the interactive agent allows users to specify their synthetic data generation goals and the tool will orchestrate the workflow by leveraging existing tools while performing the requisite evaluation. For the demo, we use an open source schizophrenia dataset with protected attributes related to race and gender, three different synthesizers and a local language model to orchestrate the workflow. We observe that CTGAN, TVAE and GaussianCopula have comparable performance across fairness and utility metrics. The workflow allows users flexibility and control over the data generation and evaluation process.

</details>


### [204] [AURORA: Contextual Orthogonalization for Geometric Representation Learning in Healthcare Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17765)
*Yuanyun Zhang,Shi Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了AURORA框架，通过将医疗基础模型的潜在表示分解为正交语义子空间，解决了现有模型表示语义模糊和分布偏移下不稳定的问题，在多项任务中表现优异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有医疗基础模型虽然预测性能强，但其潜在表示常将生理严重程度、干预强度、观察结构和机构工作流程等因素纠缠在一起，导致表示语义不透明且在上下文变化时不稳定，缺乏可解释性。

Method: 提出AURORA框架，基于上下文潜在几何进行医疗表示学习。该方法不优化单一统一嵌入流形，而是将表示分解为对应不同上下文因素的正交语义子空间，并在每个子空间内学习关系一致性目标，从而构建语义解耦且几何可解释的潜在空间。

Result: 在多项临床预测和检索任务中，AURORA持续优于重构、对比学习和自蒸馏基线模型，并显著提升了上下文解耦度、邻域纯度以及在机构分布偏移下的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 潜在几何结构是医疗基础模型设计的重要维度，依据上下文语义显式构建表示空间，为传统预测压缩目标之外提供了一种互补的设计方向。

Abstract: Recent healthcare foundation models have achieved strong predictive performance through large scale self supervised learning, yet their latent representations frequently entangle physiologic severity, intervention intensity, observational structure, and institutional workflow into shared embedding directions. While effective for downstream prediction, such representations remain semantically opaque and unstable under contextual shift. We introduce AURORA, Adaptive Uncertainty aware Representations through Orthogonalized Relational Alignment, a new framework for healthcare representation learning based on contextual latent geometry. Rather than optimizing a single unified embedding manifold, AURORA decomposes representations into orthogonal semantic subspaces corresponding to distinct contextual factors and learns relational consistency objectives within each subspace. This induces latent spaces that are both semantically disentangled and geometrically interpretable. Across multiple clinical prediction and retrieval tasks, AURORA consistently outperforms reconstruction, contrastive, and self distillation baselines while substantially improving contextual disentanglement, neighborhood purity, and robustness under institutional distribution shift. Our results suggest that latent geometry itself constitutes an important axis of healthcare foundation model design and that explicitly structuring representation space according to contextual semantics provides a complementary direction beyond conventional predictive compression objectives.

</details>


### [205] [Learning Variable-Length Tokenization for Generative Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17779)
*Minhao Wang,Bowen Wu,Wei Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出VarLenRec框架，通过发现流行度-长度悖论（流行物品用短ID效果最佳，长尾物品需要更长编码），引入基于双曲残差量化和软长度控制器的变长tokenization方法，显著提升生成式推荐的准确性和效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的生成式推荐方法对所有物品采用固定长度的tokenization，隐含假设所有物品具有相同的编码容量。然而，本文通过系统实验发现了流行度-长度悖论：流行物品拥有丰富的协同信号，仅需较短的语义ID即可达到最优性能；而长尾物品由于交互数据稀疏，必须依赖细粒度的内容特征，因此需要显著更长的编码来捕获有区分性的语义。这一发现揭示了现有固定长度方法与物品特性之间的关键错配。

Method: 提出VarLenRec框架实现变长tokenization。核心包括：(1) **PIBA（流行度加权信息预算分配）**：基于信息论证明最优ID长度应按流行度的负幂次缩放；(2) **双曲残差量化**：利用Poincaré球的指数体积增长特性，自然分层编码容量，解决标准欧氏残差量化缺乏支持多样化码长几何容量的问题；(3) **软长度控制器**：通过连续层保留概率实现可微分的长度预测，并用PIBA导出的先验进行正则化，解决离散长度决策不可微的问题。

Result: 在四个数据集上的广泛实验表明，VarLenRec在推荐准确性和训练/推理效率方面均显著优于最先进的方法，证明了自适应编码容量在生成式推荐中的重要性。

Conclusion: 该研究首次揭示了生成式推荐中流行度-长度悖论的存在，证明了变长编码的理论必要性和实践有效性。VarLenRec通过创新的双曲空间量化和可微长度控制机制，成功实现了根据物品流行度自适应分配编码容量，为生成式推荐系统的设计提供了新的理论洞见和技术方案。

Abstract: Generative recommendation reformulates recommendation as next-token prediction over discrete semantic identifiers (IDs). A fundamental yet unexplored design choice is that existing methods employ fixed-length tokenization for all items, implicitly assuming uniform encoding capacity regardless of item characteristics. Through systematic experiments across four datasets, we discover the Popularity-Length Paradox: popular items achieve optimal performance with short IDs, while tail items require substantially longer codes to capture discriminative semantics. This reveals a critical mismatch where popular items benefit from abundant collaborative signals and require minimal semantic detail, whereas tail items must rely on fine-grained content features due to sparse interaction data.
  To address this, we propose VarLenRec, a framework for learning variable-length tokenization. We develop Popularity-Weighted Information Budget Allocation (PIBA), an information-theoretic framework proving that optimal ID length should scale as a negative power of popularity. Directly implementing variable-length allocation faces two technical challenges: standard Euclidean residual quantization lacks geometric capacity to support diverse code lengths without distortion, and discrete length decisions are non-differentiable. We address these through Hyperbolic Residual Quantization, which leverages the exponential volume growth of the Poincaré ball to naturally stratify encoding capacity, and a Soft Length Controller, which enables differentiable length prediction via continuous layer retention probabilities regularized by PIBA-derived priors. Extensive experiments demonstrate that VarLenRec achieves significant improvements over state-of-the-art methods in recommendation accuracy and training/inference efficiency, revealing the importance of adaptive encoding capacity in generative recommendation.

</details>


### [206] [Revisiting the Adam-SGD Gap in LLM Pre-Training: The Role of Large Effective Learning Rates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17787)
*Athanasios Glentis,Dawei Li,Chung-Yiu Yau,Mingyi Hong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示了SGD在大语言模型预训练中表现不如Adam的核心原因在于无法维持大学习率，并提出通过简单的梯度裁剪机制使SGD性能逼近Adam。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 业界普遍认为随机梯度下降（SGD）在大语言模型（LLM）预训练任务中的表现显著逊色于Adam等自适应优化器，但造成这一性能差距的根本原因尚不明确。本文旨在探究该差距的深层原因并寻求解决方案。

Method: 通过实证与理论分析LLM预训练动态，发现训练过程具有梯度范数小、权重-梯度比大的特点，且在大批量训练中更为显著。研究识别出输出层梯度幅度在不同词元类别间高度不均，且训练中频繁出现梯度尖峰，这些因素严重限制了SGD的可容许学习率。基于此，引入简单的梯度裁剪机制以稳定大学习率下的SGD训练。

Result: 在大规模实验中，预训练1B参数的LLaMA模型（批量大小为1M词元）时，采用大学习率SGD与Adam之间的验证损失差距从超过50%缩小至仅约3.5%。

Conclusion: SGD在LLM预训练中的劣势主要源于其在维持大学习率方面的困难，通过引入梯度裁剪等稳定机制，SGD能够恢复大部分Adam的性能，显著缩小两者之间的差距。

Abstract: It is widely believed that stochastic gradient descent (SGD) performs significantly worse than adaptive optimizers such as Adam in pre-training Large Language Models (LLMs). Yet the underlying reason for this gap remains unclear. In this work, we attribute a large part of the discrepancy to SGD's inability to sustain learning rates comparable to Adam's much larger effective learning rates. Through empirical and theoretical analysis of LLM pre-training dynamics, we identify that training is characterized by small gradient norms and large weight-to-gradient ratios, an effect that becomes more pronounced with larger batch sizes typical in pre-training, necessitating such large effective learning rates. However, we find that output-layer gradient magnitudes become highly uneven across token classes, and that large gradient spikes frequently occur during training. Together, these effects severely restrict the admissible learning rate of SGD. Guided by this understanding, we show that simple clipping mechanisms that stabilize SGD at large learning rates enable it to recover most of Adam's performance. In our large-scale experiments, the validation loss gap between large-learning-rate SGD and Adam shrinks from more than 50% to only about 3.5% when pre-training a 1B-parameter LLaMA model with a 1M-token batch size.

</details>


### [207] [HydroAgent: Closing the Gap Between Frontier LLMs and Human Experts in Hydrologic Model Calibration via Simulator-Grounded RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17792)
*Zhi Li,Songkun Yan,Jie Cao,Mofan Zhang,Anjiang Wei,Jinwoong Yoo,Yang Hong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文评估了9个前沿LLM在分布式水文模型校准任务上的表现，发现其最佳NSE为0.65-0.75但仍不及人类专家。作者提出HYDROAGENT，通过领域微调和仿真反馈强化学习(RLSF)，证明小规模领域专用智能体比通用大模型扩展更具计算效率和物理可信度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分布式水文模型校准是水资源管理的关键瓶颈，传统方法依赖专家将水文特征转化为高维参数调整，工作流难以跨流域迁移。研究旨在探索前沿LLM能否替代人类水文建模者，并识别其局限性根源。

Method: （1）基准测试：在NWS使用的CREST分布式水文模型上评估9个前沿LLM（Claude Opus 4.6/4.7、Sonnet 4.6、GPT-5/5.4/5.4-pro、Gemini 2.5-pro/3.1-pro/3-flash），采用Best-of-20策略在4个独立测站进行校准；（2）提出HYDROAGENT：基于Qwen3-4B，使用2576条专家校准轨迹进行监督微调，结合Group-Relative Policy Optimization和以NSE为可验证奖励的在线CREST仿真反馈（RLSF框架）。

Result: （1）前沿LLM最佳NSE在0.65-0.75区间（Sonnet 4.6达0.75），三厂商模型表现相近，但仅Opus-4.7在一个测站达到人类专家基准；（2）性能差距源于领域知识缺失而非参数规模限制；（3）HYDROAGENT证明小规模领域微调策略结合仿真反馈RL是更优路径。

Conclusion: 对于地球系统科学，采用领域微调策略并结合仿真器在环的强化学习，相比单纯扩展通用前沿模型，在计算效率和物理一致性方面更具优势。地球数据的多模态特性（遥感、现场时序、预报员叙事）使领域智能体成为AI赋能物理科学的有力方向。

Abstract: Calibrating distributed hydrologic models is a critical bottleneck across operational water resources management - streamflow prediction, reservoir operation, drought monitoring, infrastructure design, and flood forecasting all depend on it. Each basin demands an expert to translate hydrograph signatures into adjustments of a high-dimensional parameter vector, and the resulting workflow does not transfer between watersheds. We ask: can frontier large language model (LLM) agents replace the human hydrologic modeler, and if not, what would it take? We benchmark nine frontier LLM agents - Claude Opus 4.6/4.7, Sonnet 4.6, GPT-5/5.4/5.4-pro, and Gemini 2.5-pro/3.1-pro/3-flash - on the operational CREST distributed hydrologic model used by the U.S. National Weather Service for flash-flood forecasting. Best-of-twenty-rounds Nash-Sutcliffe Efficiency (NSE) across four held-out gauges spanning 329-40,792 km2 ranges from -0.16 (GPT-5.4) to 0.75 (Sonnet 4.6); the ceiling reproduces across all three vendors and capability tiers, with the strongest models concentrating in the 0.65-0.75 band, and no model reaches the human-expert reference except Opus-4.7 on one gauge. We argue this gap is not a parameter-count problem but a domain-grounding problem. We then propose HYDROAGENT, fine-tuning open-weight Qwen3-4B with supervised fine-tuning on 2,576 expert calibration trajectories and Group-Relative Policy Optimization using NSE as a verifiable reward from online CREST simulations - reinforcement learning with simulation feedback (RLSF). For Earth system science, a small domain-tuned policy with simulator-in-the-loop RL is a more compute-efficient and physically faithful path than scaling generic frontier models, and the multi-modal richness of Earth data - remote sensing, in-situ time series, and forecaster narrative - makes domain agents a leveraged direction for AI in physical science.

</details>


### [208] [When Accuracy Is Not Enough: Uncertainty Collapse between Noisy Label Learning and Out-of-Distribution Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17795)
*Ningkang Peng,Jingyang Mao,Runhan Zhou,Peirong Ma,Yanhui Gu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个名为ACC-OOD的新基准测试，发现在噪声标签学习（LNL）中，高闭集准确率并不能保证OOD检测的可靠性，这种故障模式被称为“不确定性塌缩”。作者提出了虚拟边际正则化（VMR）作为轻量级修复方案，能部分缓解该问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的噪声标签学习（LNL）基准测试主要关注闭集分类准确率，但在实际部署中，分类器通常需要拒绝分布外（OOD）输入。目前缺乏一个统一的基准来评估LNL方法在OOD检测方面的表现，且不清楚高闭集准确率是否能确保OOD可靠性。

Method: 1. 提出了一个学习器无关的ACC-OOD基准，通过冻结LNL检查点，使用标准化的近/远OOD路由和事后评分，在合成和真实标签噪声下进行评估。\n2. 提出了虚拟边际正则化（VMR），这是一种轻量级修复探针，主要与PSSCL结合使用，在可信的ID批次上合成边界虚拟离群值，并扩大能量边际。

Result: 1. 发现了一个反复出现的故障模式：高闭集准确率并不能确保OOD可靠性。\n2. 揭示了“不确定性塌缩”现象：低置信度、错误分类的分布内样本在噪声训练下会与OOD输入占据的评分和特征区域重叠。\n3. 这种结构重叠会导致高准确率的LNL方法在标准OOD评分下失去ID-error/OOD接口处的可分性。\n4. VMR在不替换主机目标或牺牲闭集准确率的情况下，部分减少了塌缩引起的远OOD故障。

Conclusion: 研究结果支持LNL基准测试应共同报告闭集泛化能力、开放世界可靠性和结构重叠诊断指标。VMR作为一种干预措施，能够部分缓解不确定性塌缩问题，但需要进一步研究以完全解决该问题。

Abstract: Learning with noisy labels (LNL) is typically benchmarked by closed-set classification accuracy, yet deployment often requires classifiers to reject out-of-distribution (OOD) inputs. We present a learner-agnostic ACC-OOD benchmark that freezes LNL checkpoints and evaluates them with standardized near-/far-OOD routing and post-hoc scores across synthetic and real label noise. The benchmark reveals a recurring failure mode: high closed-set accuracy does not ensure OOD reliability, because low-confidence, misclassified in-distribution samples can overlap the score and feature regions occupied by OOD inputs under noisy training. We term this pathology uncertainty collapse. This structural overlap can make high-accuracy LNL methods lose separability at the ID-error/OOD interface under standard OOD scores. As an intervention, we study Virtual Margin Regularization (VMR), a lightweight repair probe demonstrated mainly with PSSCL that synthesizes boundary virtual outliers on trusted ID batches and widens the energy margin. VMR partially reduces the collapse-induced far-OOD failure without replacing the host objective or sacrificing closed-set accuracy in the tested settings. These results support LNL benchmarks that co-report closed-set generalization, open-world reliability, and structural overlap diagnostics.

</details>


### [209] [GenTS: A Comprehensive Benchmark Library for Generative Time Series Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17804)
*Chenxi Wang,Xiaorong Wang,Peiyang Li,Yi Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了GenTS，一个专为时间序列生成模型设计的综合基准库，解决了现有库主要面向判别式模型、难以适配生成模型范式的问题，提供了统一的数据处理管道、丰富的模型集合和全面的评估指标，并基于该库进行了多任务基准测试。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的时间序列库主要针对判别式模型设计，具有针对特定任务（如预测）的标准化流程，这种僵化的结构与生成模型独特且复杂的范式（如对抗训练、扩散过程）根本不兼容。生成模型学习底层数据分布而非直接的输入-输出映射，因此需要一个专门针对其特性的评估框架。

Method: 提出了GenTS基准库，包含三个核心组件：统一的数据预处理管道、一系列多功能模型集合、全景式评估指标。该库采用模块化设计，允许研究人员灵活定制内置数据集和模型之外的内容，从而支持系统性的生成式时间序列模型评估。

Result: 基于GenTS库，在多种任务下（如合成、预测、插补等）进行了基准测试实验，并据此提供了模型选择建议，同时识别了未来研究的潜在方向。代码已在GitHub开源，并提供了官方教程和文档。

Conclusion: GenTS填补了时间序列生成模型领域缺乏专门基准库的空白，为研究人员提供了一个标准化、可扩展的评估平台，有助于推动生成模型在时间序列分析中的发展和应用。

Abstract: Generative models have demonstrated remarkable potential in time series analysis tasks, like synthesis, forecasting, imputation, etc. However, offering limited coverage for generative models, existing time series libraries are mainly engineered for discriminative models, with standardized workflows for specific tasks, such as optimizing Mean Squared Errors for time series forecasting. This rigid structure is fundamentally incompatible with the distinct and often complex paradigms of generative models (e.g., adversarial training, diffusion processes), which learn the underlying data distribution rather than a direct input-output mapping. To this end, we proposed GenTS, a comprehensive and extensible benchmark library designed for systematic assessment on generative time series models. GenTS features a unified data preprocessing pipeline, a collection of versatile models, and panoramic evaluation metrics. Its modular design also enables the researchers to flexibly customize beyond our built-in datasets and models. Based on GenTS, we conducted benchmarking experiments under diverse tasks, accordingly offering suggestions for model selection and identifying potential directions for future research. Our codes are open-source at https://github.com/WillWang1113/GenTS. The official tutorials and document are available at https://willwang1113.github.io/GenTS/.

</details>


### [210] [AMO: Adaptive Muon Orthogonalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17806)
*Xinlin Zhuang,Panyi Ouyang,Yichen Li,Jiangming Shi,Yizhang Chen,Shuman Liu,Ying Qian,Weiyang Liu,Haibo Zhang,Imran Razzak*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出AMO（自适应Muon正交化）方法，通过根据参数矩阵几何特性自适应分配Newton-Schulz迭代预算，解决了Muon优化器中统一正交化调度导致的性能不均问题，在Llama3.1-1.4B和Qwen3-1.7B上分别提升+0.76和+0.51的平均下游性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Muon优化器变体对所有参数矩阵应用统一的Newton-Schulz迭代调度，忽视了不同矩阵在正交化难度上的差异。本文通过系统实证研究发现，这种矩阵异质性普遍存在，主要由矩阵几何特性决定，并随算子类型、训练阶段和网络深度动态演化，统一调度会导致模型各部分正交化质量不均。

Method: 提出Adaptive Muon Orthogonalization (AMO)方法，采用"观察-提交"(observe-then-commit)策略：在训练早期测量不同算子类型的权重几何特性，然后利用这些信号在剩余训练过程中自适应分配Newton-Schulz迭代预算。

Result: AMO在标准预训练、延长预训练和持续预训练场景下均持续优于统一调度的Muon。在Llama3.1-1.4B模型上，12个评估任务的平均下游性能超越最强基线+0.76分；在Qwen3-1.7B模型上提升+0.51分。

Conclusion: 矩阵几何特性决定了正交化难度的异质性，自适应分配正交化预算能够有效提升Muon优化器的性能，证明了考虑参数矩阵差异化特性的重要性。

Abstract: Muon has recently emerged as a competitive alternative to AdamW for large-scale pre-training, with orthogonalization via Newton-Schulz (NS) iterations as its core operation. Existing Muon variants apply a uniform NS schedule to all parameter matrices, overlooking possible differences in orthogonalization difficulty and its impact on performance. Through a systematic empirical study, we show that this per-matrix heterogeneity is pervasive and largely determined by matrix geometry, which evolves dynamically across operator types, training stages, and network depths. As a result, uniform NS schedules can lead to uneven orthogonalization quality across the model. Motivated by these findings, we propose Adaptive Muon Orthogonalization (AMO), an observe-then-commit method that measures weight geometry by operator type early in training and then uses these signals to allocate the NS budget for the remainder of training. AMO delivers consistent improvements over uniform-schedule Muon across standard, prolonged, and continual pre-training, surpassing the strongest baseline by +0.76 on Llama3.1-1.4B and +0.51 on Qwen3-1.7B in average downstream performance of 12 evaluation tasks.

</details>


### [211] [A Unified Framework for Data-Free One-Step Sampling via Wasserstein Gradient Flows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17808)
*Chenguang Wang,Tianshu Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了基于Wasserstein梯度流的无数据单步采样统一理论框架，揭示了标准f-散度目标下速度场的通用形式，并导出了压缩-弹性恒等式来刻画散度选择与质量传输几何的关系，最终通过实验验证了该方法的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的无数据采样方法缺乏统一的理论框架来理解不同散度目标之间的关系和差异。作者旨在建立一个统一的理论视角，以揭示不同f-散度方法在速度场结构上的共性与差异，并理解散度选择如何影响质量传输几何，从而指导更有效的采样方法设计。

Method: 作者基于Wasserstein梯度流开发了统一理论框架。对于标准f-散度，证明诱导速度场具有通用形式V(x)=w(r(x))β(x)，其中β(x)=∇log(p(x)/q(x))在所有目标间共享，权重w仅由散度选择决定。作者进一步推导了针对软覆盖不足泛函的单步区域响应理论，获得了压缩-弹性恒等式。此外，框架扩展至对数方差（LV）散度，分析了参考分布对漂移结构的影响，并提出了实用的LV启发式代理方法。在实现上，采用基于核密度估计（KDE）的方法和互补的归一化流路径。

Result: 理论分析表明，标准f-散度漂移共享相同的渐近目标分布p，主要区别在于如何在覆盖不足区域重新分配瞬态修复努力。压缩-弹性恒等式明确建立了散度选择与进入覆盖不足区域的质量传输几何之间的联系。在多模态高斯混合基准上的实验结果与理论预测一致，验证了该框架能够在这些目标上实现有效的单步采样。

Conclusion: 本文成功建立了无数据单步采样的统一理论框架，深刻揭示了f-散度方法的结构共性与差异本质，为理解和设计采样方法提供了新的理论工具。该框架不仅解释了现有方法的行为，还指导了新方法的设计（如LV启发式代理），实验验证了其理论预测的准确性和实际应用的有效性。

Abstract: We develop a unified theoretical framework for data-free one-step sampling from unnormalized target distributions based on Wasserstein gradient flows. For a broad class of standard f-divergence objectives, we show that the induced velocity field admits the universal form $\mathbf{V}(x)=w(r(x))\,β(x)$, where $β(x)=\nabla \log (p(x)/q(x))$ is shared across objectives and $w$ is determined solely by the choice of divergence. This decomposition shows that standard f-divergence drifts share the same asymptotic target distribution $p$ and differ primarily in how they redistribute transient repair effort across under-covered regions. To formalize this distinction, we derive a one-step regional-response theory for a soft under-coverage functional and obtain a compression--elasticity identity that links divergence choice to the geometry of mass transport into under-covered regions. We further extend the framework beyond the f-divergence family to the Log-Variance (LV) divergence, analyze how the reference distribution alters the resulting drift structure, and motivate a practical LV-inspired surrogate for data-free training. Based on this theory, we instantiate the framework with a KDE-based implementation and describe a complementary normalizing-flow route, enabling one-step inference after training. Experiments on multimodal Gaussian-mixture benchmarks are consistent with the theoretical predictions and demonstrate effective one-step sampling on these targets.

</details>


### [212] [One Model, Two Roles: Emergent Specialization in a Shared Recurrent Transformer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17811)
*Jucheng Shen,Barbara Su,Anastasios Kyrillidis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在共享权重的循环Transformer中，通过引入非对称输入机制，可以使模型自发分化出具有不同功能角色的内部状态，而无需显式模块划分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究在不进行显式模块划分的情况下，共享权重的循环Transformer是否能够发展出截然不同的内部功能角色。

Method: 提出了一种名为非对称输入循环（AIR）的最小化双状态推理架构。该架构复用同一个Transformer模型进行两种状态更新（L和H），唯一的内置差异是在L更新时注入编码输入，而在H更新时不注入。研究通过解码展开、冻结实验、消融实验和注意力分析等方法，在Sudoku-Extreme和Maze任务上进行验证。

Result: 实验揭示了一个一致的分化现象：$\zH$表现得像一个完全提交的提议状态，而$\zL$保留了局部不确定性和变化的中间结构。冻结实验表明这种分化与模型的状态动力学相关；消融实验证明模型需要能区分两种更新类型才能诱导特化；注意力分析显示L更新始终比H更新更局部化。

Conclusion: 在双状态循环设置中，一个清晰的状态身份信号可以在共享参数的循环Transformer内部诱导出稳定且相关的功能角色分工。

Abstract: Can a shared-weight recurrent Transformer develop distinct internal roles without being partitioned into separate modules? We study this in Asymmetric Input Recurrence (AIR), a minimal two-state reasoning architecture in which the same Transformer model is reused for both updates (per literature, L and H) and the only built-in difference in the update rule is that the encoded input is injected during L-updates but not H-updates. Across Sudoku-Extreme and Maze, decoded rollouts reveal a consistent split: $\zH$ behaves like a fully committed proposal state, whereas $\zL$ retains local uncertainty and shifting intermediate structure. Freeze experiments show that this split is, in practice, related to the model's state dynamics: in Sudoku, freezing $\zH$ reduces $\zL$'s content changes whereas freezing $\zL$ increases $\zH$'s, while in Maze, freezing either state increases content changes in the other state. Ablations show that to induce specialization, the shared model needs to be able to tell the two update types apart, either from input injection asymmetry or from a separate level token. Mechanistically, attention analysis shows that L-updates are consistently more local than H-updates in both Sudoku and Maze. Together, these results show that, in a two-state recurrent setting, a clear state-identity signal can induce stable, related functional roles inside a shared-parameter recurrent Transformer. Code is available at \href{https://github.com/juchengshen/air}{\textcolor{blue}{https://github.com/juchengshen/air}}.

</details>


### [213] [Content-Style Identification via Differential Independence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17827)
*Subash Timilsina,Hoang-Son Nguyen,Sagar Shrestha,Xiao Fu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种新的结构条件——内容-风格微分独立性（CSDI），用于解决生成模型中内容与风格变量的可辨识性问题，该方法放宽了以往对统计独立性和雅可比矩阵稀疏性的严格要求，并在反事实生成和域翻译任务中取得了良好效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的生成分析方法在识别多域观测中的域不变内容变量和域特定风格变量时，通常依赖于内容与风格之间的块统计独立性或非线性混合函数的稀疏雅可比矩阵假设。然而，这些条件在实际应用中往往过于严格，限制了模型的适用范围。因此，本文旨在寻找一种更宽松、更实用的结构条件来实现内容与风格的可辨识性。

Method: 本文引入了内容-风格微分独立性（CSDI）这一新的结构条件。该条件要求内容和风格的微小变化在数据流形上引起正交的方向变化，从而即使内容与风格存在依赖关系且雅可比矩阵是稠密的，也能实现可辨识性。作者通过在内容与风格相关的雅可比子空间上施加块正交约束来实现这一条件。针对高维生成模型，设计了一种基于数值雅可比近似的随机正则化器，使得该框架能够扩展到高分辨率图像生成等大规模训练场景。

Result: 在多个数据集上的实验验证了基于CSDI的可辨识性理论分析。实验结果表明，该方法在反事实数据生成和域翻译任务中具有实际优势，证明了该理论框架的有效性和实用性。

Conclusion: 本文提出的CSDI条件及相应的块正交约束方法，成功放宽了以往可辨识性理论的限制条件，为非配对域的内容与风格解耦提供了一种新的解决方案。该方法不仅具有理论支撑，且通过随机正则化器实现了良好的可扩展性，在实际应用中表现出优越的性能。

Abstract: Generative analysis often models multi-domain observations as nonlinear mixtures of domain-invariant content variables and domain-specific style variables. Identifying both factors from unpaired domains enables tasks such as domain transfer and counterfactual data generation. Prior work establishes identifiability under (block-wise) statistical independence between content and style, or via sparse Jacobian assumptions on the nonlinear mixing function, but such conditions can be restrictive in practice. In this work, we introduce content-style differential independence (CSDI), an alternative structural condition requiring that infinitesimal variations in content and style induce orthogonal directions on the data manifold, thereby enabling identifiability even when content and style are dependent and the Jacobian is dense. We operationalize this condition through a blockwise orthogonality constraint on the Jacobian subspaces associated with content and style. To support high-dimensional generative models, we design a stochastic regularizer based on numerical Jacobian approximation, enabling scalable training in settings such as high-resolution image generation. Experiments across multiple datasets corroborate the identifiability analysis and demonstrate practical benefits on counterfactual generation and domain translation.

</details>


### [214] [Agentic Cost-Aware Query Planning with Knowledge Distillation for Big Data Analytics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17831)
*Mahdi Naser-Moghadasi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种结合规则教师规划器、UCB1老虎机探索、代价感知预测和知识蒸馏的智能体查询规划系统。在NYC Taxi和IMDB数据集上，相比默认规划器实现了23%的延迟降低，约束满足率达94%，学生规划器以15倍的推理速度提升达到89%的最优计划复现准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大数据分析中的查询优化仍然计算成本高昂，特别是在资源受限环境中，传统优化器无法满足内存和延迟约束，亟需一种能够在资源限制下高效工作的查询优化方案。

Method: 系统包含四个核心组件：(1) 基于规则的教师规划器，使用六种关键优化策略生成SQL计划；(2) UCB1老虎机搜索在明确的资源约束下高效探索计划空间；(3) 随机森林代价模型从计划特征预测查询延迟，实现代价感知决策；(4) 知识蒸馏得到轻量级学生规划器（逻辑回归或梯度提升），学习模仿教师-老虎机决策以实现快速推理。

Result: 在NYC Taxi和IMDB数据集上的评估表明：相比默认规划器实现23%的延迟降低，同时保持94%的约束满足率；学生规划器在复制最优计划方面达到89%的准确率，推理时间快15倍。

Conclusion: 该系统通过单文件实现使得资源受限机器上的可重现大数据分析成为可能，代码已公开发布在GitHub，为资源受限环境下的查询优化提供了实用解决方案。

Abstract: Query optimization in big data analytics remains computationally expensive, particularly for resource-constrained environments where traditional optimizers fail to satisfy memory and latency constraints. We present an agentic query planning system that combines a rule-based teacher planner, UCB1 bandit exploration, cost-aware prediction, and knowledge distillation to a lightweight student planner. Our teacher planner generates SQL plans using six key optimization strategies, while UCB1 bandit search efficiently explores the plan space under explicit resource constraints. A Random Forest cost model predicts query latency from plan features, enabling cost-aware decisions. A distilled student planner (Logistic Regression or Gradient Boosting) learns to mimic teacher-bandit decisions for fast inference. Evaluation on NYC Taxi and IMDB datasets demonstrates 23% latency reduction compared to default planners while maintaining 94% constraint satisfaction. The student planner achieves 89% accuracy in replicating optimal plans with 15x faster inference time. Our single-file implementation enables reproducible big-data analytics on resource-limited machines and is publicly available at https://github.com/mahdinaser/agentic-kd-planner.

</details>


### [215] [Efficient Bilevel Optimization for Meta Label Correction in Noisy Label Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17833)
*Ba Hoang Anh Nguyen,Viet Cuong Ta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了EBOMLC方法，通过引入动态障碍梯度下降及三项关键改进，在保持模型性能的同时显著降低了元标签修正方法的训练开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的元标签修正方法虽然能利用少量干净数据修正大规模噪声标签，但元模型的更新需要在主模型内部步骤计算超梯度，导致计算成本显著增加，训练效率低下。

Method: 本文首先将动态障碍梯度下降引入标准元标签修正框架以加速训练。在此基础上，提出了EBOMLC方法，包含三项关键改进：一步内部循环更新、混合上层损失以及对齐感知动态障碍，旨在防止噪声信号泄漏并稳定元模型学习。

Result: 在CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100数据集上的实验结果表明，EBOMLC在各种噪声率设置下均持续优于其他基线方法，在高噪声率场景下优势尤为明显，同时有效减少了元标签修正方法的训练时间。

Conclusion: EBOMLC方法成功解决了传统元标签修正方法计算成本高的问题，在保证模型鲁棒性和性能的前提下，实现了训练效率的显著提升，为噪声标签学习提供了一种高效可行的解决方案。

Abstract: Training a deep neural network with noisy labels could reduce data annotation cost but may introduce noise into the learned model. In meta label correction approaches, an additional meta model besides the main model is trained with a small, clean dataset to correct the large, noisy dataset. However, the update of the meta model requires the computation of hypergradients at the inner step of the main model which signif- icantly increases the computational cost. To improve the training efficiency, we first introduce the dynamic barrier gradient descent into standard meta label correction. While this naive extenstion is able to speed up the training process to approximately first- order complexity, it lacks mechanisms to prevent the leakage of noisy signals to the main model and to stabilize the learning of the meta model. Based on this observation, we propose the EBOMLC method, which is designed with three key improvements including one-step inner loop update, mixture upper loss and alignment- aware dynamic barrier. Empirical results on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 demonstrate that EBOMLC consistently outperforms other baselines, especially under high noise rate settings, while reducing training time of the meta label correction approach.

</details>


### [216] [Balancing Knowledge Distillation for Imbalance Learning with Bilevel Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17839)
*Anh B. H. Nguyen,Ba Tho Phan,Viet Cuong Ta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了BiKD，一种双层优化框架，通过权重生成网络在样本级别动态平衡硬标签损失和软标签损失，有效解决了长尾数据分布下知识蒸馏中固定损失权重易碎的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在数据不平衡（长尾分布）的情况下，知识蒸馏中硬标签损失和软标签损失的固定权重组合在学习过程中变得脆弱。现有方法虽然尝试重新加权，但大多未能在样本级别进行自适应调整，也未考虑学生模型在训练过程中的行为变化。

Method: 提出了BiKD（Bilevel Knowledge Distillation）框架。该框架引入一个权重生成网络，在小型平衡验证集的指导下，为每个样本动态生成自适应的权重，从而实现对硬标签损失和软标签损失的样本级平衡。学生模型通过加权损失的 unconstrained 组合进行训练。此外，提出了多步SGD策略，以更准确、高效地优化权重模型。

Result: 在长尾分布的CIFAR-10/100数据集上进行了实验。结果显示，该方法在不同的不平衡因子下均超越了近期的平衡蒸馏方法。

Conclusion: BiKD框架通过样本级别的动态权重分配和双层优化策略，有效解决了长尾数据分布下知识蒸馏的损失平衡问题，显著提升了模型性能，验证了该方法的有效性和优越性。

Abstract: Knowledge distillation transfers knowledge from a high capacity teacher to a compact student using a mixture of hard and soft losses. On imbalanced data, a fixed weighting between hard and soft losses becomes brittle the learning process. Recent studies try to reweight these components in long-tailed settings. However, most of these meth- ods do not adapt weights at the sample-wise level and do not take into account the students behavior during training. To address this, we pro- pose BiKD - a bilevel framework that dynamically balances hard and soft losses for each sample. We employ a weight generation network that produces adaptive per-sample weights, guided by a small balanced vali- dation set. The student is now trained with an unconstrained combina- tion of weighted hard and soft losses, allowing the student to relax both terms. We further propose a multi-step SGD strategy to optimize the weight model more accurately and efficiently. Experiments on long-tailed CIFAR-10/100 show that our approach surpasses recent balanced distil- lation methods across imbalance factors.

</details>


### [217] [SNLP: Layer-Parallel Inference via Structured Newton Corrections](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17842)
*Ligong Han,Kai Xu,Hao Wang,Akash Srivastava*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出结构化牛顿层并行框架（SNLP），通过并行牛顿式更新放松自回归Transformer的层间依赖，在训练和推理中实现实际加速，最高可达2.3倍且提升困惑度6.1%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归语言模型顺序执行Transformer层造成延迟瓶颈，传统张量或流水线并行无法消除此问题。研究者探索是否可以通过将跨层隐藏状态轨迹视为非线性残差方程的解，用并行牛顿式更新放松这种层间依赖。

Method: 引入结构化牛顿层并行（SNLP）框架：用廉价的架构诱导代理动力学替代精确层雅可比矩阵。对于残差Transformer提出Identity Newton（IDN），类似前缀和更新；对于mHC架构提出HC Newton（HCN）。进一步引入SNLP感知正则化，训练模型使少量结构化牛顿迭代能准确逼近顺序前向传播。

Result: 在nanochat规模Transformer上：SNLP正则化提升层并行兼容性并改善顺序困惑度（降低4.7%-23.4%）；推理时结合层融合和分块分解，0.5B模型实现2.3倍加速同时困惑度提升6.1%。发现层并行推理不仅是顺序执行的数值近似，还可作为有用的求解器诱导推理偏置。

Conclusion: SNLP框架成功实现了层并行推理的实际加速，证明了层并行方法的可行性。但也存在局限：现成预训练模型对此方法适用性较差，精确收敛会恢复顺序计算而非提供单调推理时扩展。

Abstract: Autoregressive language models execute Transformer layers sequentially, creating a latency bottleneck that is not removed by conventional tensor or pipeline parallelism. We study whether this layerwise dependency can be relaxed by treating the hidden-state trace across layers as the solution of a nonlinear residual equation and solving it with parallel Newton-style updates. While this view is principled, exact Newton corrections require expensive Jacobian-vector products and naive fixed-point iterations are unstable on trained Transformers. We introduce Structured Newton Layer Parallelism (SNLP), a training and inference framework that replaces exact layer Jacobians with cheap architecture-induced surrogate dynamics. In residual Transformers, this yields Identity Newton (IDN), where the correction reduces to a prefix-sum-like update; in mHC-style architectures, HC Newton (HCN) uses the model's residual mixing matrix. We further introduce SNLP-aware regularization, which trains models to make one or a few structured Newton iterations accurately approximate the sequential forward. Experiments on nanochat-scale Transformers show that SNLP regularization improves layer-parallel compatibility and can also improve standard sequential perplexity, reducing baseline PPL by 4.7%-23.4%. At inference time, SNLP combined with layer fusion and chunkwise decomposition achieves practical wall-clock speedups: on a 0.5B Nanochat model, it reaches 2.3x speedup while still improving PPL by 6.1%. These results suggest that layer-parallel inference is not merely a numerical approximation to sequential execution, but can act as a useful solver-induced inference bias. We also characterize limitations: off-the-shelf pretrained models are less amenable to this procedure, and exact convergence recovers the sequential computation rather than providing monotonic inference-time scaling.

</details>


### [218] [Learning over Positive and Negative Edges with Contrastive Message Passing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17854)
*Peter Pao-Huang,Charilaos I. Kanatsoulis,Michael Bereket,Jure Leskovec*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出对比消息传递（CMP）架构，通过同时利用正负边信息，在低标签率、高同质性和高边密度的场景下显著提升图神经网络性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统图学习方法仅沿现有（正）边进行消息传递，忽略了缺失边（负边）中潜在的宝贵信息。本文旨在理论分析负边的价值，并探索如何利用负边信息来增强图表示学习。

Method: 提出对比消息传递（CMP）架构，使GNN层能够同时推理正边和负边。通过对可学习权重施加软半正定约束，对正连接节点应用相似性保持变换，对负连接节点应用不相似性诱导变换。

Result: 理论证明在低标签率、高同质性和高边密度的设置下，访问负边相比仅使用正边可提供显著的信息增益。在模拟和真实数据集的实验中，CMP在负边具有信息性的低标签设置下一致优于基线方法。

Conclusion: 负边包含重要的互补信息，特别是在低标签场景下。CMP架构成功利用了这一信息，为图表示学习提供了一个通用且有效的解决方案。

Abstract: Conventional approaches to learning on graphs involve message passing along existing (i.e., positive) edges to update node features. However, these approaches often disregard the potentially valuable information contained in the absence (i.e., negative) of edges. Here, we theoretically analyze the value of negative edges in graph representations and prove that in settings of low label rates, high homophily, and high edge density, access to negative edges provides significant information gain over using only positive edges. Motivated by this insight, we introduce Contrastive Message Passing (CMP), a general message passing architecture that enable graph neural network layers to reason over positive and negative edges. By imposing soft positive semidefinite constraints on the learnable weights, our approach differentially applies similarity-preserving transformations to positively connected nodes and dissimilarity-inducing transformations to negatively connected nodes. Over simulated and real datasets in varying data regimes, CMP consistently outperforms baselines in low-label settings when negative edges are informative.

</details>


### [219] [$\boldsymbol{f}$-OPD: Stabilizing Long-Horizon On-Policy Distillation with Freshness-Aware Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17862)
*Xianwei Chen,Shimin Zhang,Jibin Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出f-OPD框架，通过样本级新鲜度评分量化并缓解异步执行带来的目标偏差，在保持系统吞吐量的同时实现了与同步优化相当的性能，为大语言模型的长程智能体后训练提供了首个性能-效率平衡方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型（LLM）的on-policy蒸馏（OPD）在规模化时面临根本性矛盾：异步执行对系统效率至关重要，但会在结构上偏离理想的on-policy目标。这一矛盾限制了长程智能体任务的规模化后训练。

Method: 本文从理论上将目标偏差分解为rollout漂移和监督漂移，分别对应学生rollout和教师上下文的滞后性。基于此，引入样本级新鲜度评分来量化缓冲样本相对于on-policy目标的可靠性，并提出f-OPD框架，自适应调节过时样本的影响，约束异步训练中累积的策略漂移。

Result: 在推理、工具使用和编程智能体任务（交互范围递增）上，f-OPD持续实现与同步优化相当的任务性能，同时基本保留异步执行的吞吐量优势。实验表明f-OPD在性能-效率权衡方面显著优于现有方法。

Conclusion: 本研究确立了在OPD中实现性能-效率权衡的首个方案，为大规模长程智能体后训练铺平了道路，证明了通过理论驱动的偏差量化与自适应调节可以有效解决异步执行与on-policy目标之间的根本矛盾。

Abstract: Scaling on-policy distillation (OPD) for large language models (LLMs) confronts a fundamental tension: asynchronous execution is necessary for system efficiency, but structurally deviates from the ideal on-policy objective. To address this challenge, we theoretically decompose the objective discrepancy into rollout drift and supervision drift, capturing staleness in student rollout and teacher context, respectively. Building on this, we introduce a sample-level freshness score that quantifies the reliability of a buffered sample with respect to the on-policy objective. Guided by this signal, we further propose f-OPD, a novel framework that adaptively regulates stale-sample influence and constrains policy drift accumulated under asynchronous training. Across reasoning, tool-use, and coding-agent tasks of increasing interaction horizon, f-OPD consistently achieves task performance comparable to synchronous optimization while largely retaining the throughput advantages of asynchronous execution. Our results establish the first recipe for achieving a performance-efficiency trade-off in OPD, paving the way for long-horizon agentic post-training at scale.

</details>


### [220] [DAD4TS: Data-Augmentation-Oriented Diffusion Model for Time-Series Forecasting with Small-Scale Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17866)
*Masahiro Suzuki,Bohui Xia,Hiroto Yamamoto,Masanori Miyahara*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了DAD4TS，一种基于扩散模型和强化学习的数据增强方法，旨在解决小样本时间序列预测问题，并在多个真实数据集上验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列预测任务常面临小规模数据稀缺的问题。尽管数据增强是解决此问题的有效策略，但现有方法在生成有意义数据方面存在局限性，无法有效提升预测性能。

Method: 提出DAD4TS框架，利用扩散模型进行数据增强。该框架包含三个核心组件：1）数据生成器与时间序列预测模型同时训练；2）引入强化学习模型控制数据生成过程，以高效生成能提升预测精度的样本；3）为支持小规模数据，摒弃传统VAE方法，转而采用数学方法将时间序列数据投影到几何空间来训练扩散模型。

Result: 在六个真实世界数据集和八种时间序列模型上，与七种对比方法进行了定性和定量实验。结果显示，DAD4TS在五个数据集上被验证有效，证明了其能够生成高质量的增强数据以提升预测准确率。

Conclusion: DAD4TS成功地将扩散模型与强化学习结合用于时间序列数据增强，有效克服了小样本数据的限制，显著提升了时间序列预测模型的性能，证明了该方法在小规模数据场景下的优越性和实用价值。

Abstract: Small-scale data is a critical problem in time-series forecasting tasks. Data augmentation is an effective strategy for this task, but it has a limitation in generating meaningful data. To address this limitation, we propose DAD4TS, a diffusion-model-based data augmentation method with reinforcement learning, designed for time-series forecasting with small-scale data. In DAD4TS, a data generator is simultaneously trained with a time-series model and controlled by a reinforcement learning model to efficiently generate samples that improve the forecast accuracy of the time-series model. To support small-scale data, we use mathematical methods instead of conventional VAE methods to train the diffusion model by projecting the time-series data into the geometric space. We validated the effectiveness of DAD4TS with seven comparative methods through qualitative and quantitative experiments on six real-world datasets and eight time-series models. As a result, DAD4TS was validated on five datasets.

</details>


### [221] [HINT-SD: Targeted Hindsight Self-Distillation for Long-Horizon Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17873)
*Woongyeng Yeo,Yumin Choi,Taekyung Ki,Sung Ju Hwang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了HINT-SD框架，通过利用全轨迹后见之明选择与失败相关的动作，仅对目标动作区间进行反馈条件自蒸馏。该方法在BFCL v3和AppWorld上相比密集每轮反馈基线提升了高达18.80%，且每步训练时间降低2.26倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 训练长视界LLM智能体面临稀疏结果奖励问题：仅知道任务是否成功，无法得知哪些中间动作导致了失败或如何纠正。现有方法（每轮生成奖励或提示、反馈条件自蒸馏）效率低下，因为许多中间轮次本就成功或中性，且在固定或错位的轮次应用反馈无法有效监督导致失败的动作。

Method: HINT-SD（针对性自蒸馏框架）：利用全轨迹后见之明（full-trajectory hindsight）识别并选择与失败相关的动作；仅对选定的目标动作区间应用反馈条件蒸馏，而非对所有轮次进行密集反馈。

Result: 在BFCL v3和AppWorld基准测试上，相比密集每轮反馈基线性能提升高达18.80%；每步训练时间降低2.26倍，验证了选择蒸馏位置对有效性和效率均至关重要。

Conclusion: 选择性地对失败相关动作进行蒸馏是长视界智能体训练的关键因素，HINT-SD实现了效果与效率的双重提升，解决了现有密集反馈方法的低效和错位问题。

Abstract: Training long-horizon LLM agents with reinforcement learning is challenging because sparse outcome rewards reveal whether a task succeeds, but not which intermediate actions caused the outcome or how they should be corrected. Recent methods alleviate this issue by generating rewards or textual hints from turn-level action-output signals, or by using feedback-conditioned self-distillation. However, generating feedback at every turn is inefficient when many intermediate turns are already successful or neutral, and applying feedback at a fixed or misaligned turn often fails to supervise the actions that contributed to the failure. To bridge this gap, we propose HINT-SD, a targeted self-distillation framework that uses full-trajectory hindsight to select failure-relevant actions and applies feedback-conditioned distillation only on targeted action spans.
