Method: 将时变精度矩阵序列建模为由潜在椭圆图因子模型控制的低秩加对角结构，大幅减少有效参数数量；在Grassmann流形上定义黎曼测地线惩罚项以强制时序相干性；推导了保持流形结构的黎曼梯度下降算法来求解该非凸优化问题。

Result: 在合成基准测试和真实数据集上的大量实验表明，DEGFM在所有评估指标上始终优于最先进的基线方法，验证了所提框架的实用有效性。

Conclusion: 通过在Grassmann流形上建模并结合因子模型，成功同时解决了时变图推断中的时间相干性和几何约束问题，算法收敛性得到严格证明，实验证明了其优越性。

Abstract: Inferring time-varying graph structures from high-dimensional nodal observations is a fundamental problem arising in neuroscience, finance, climatology, and beyond. Two intrinsic challenges govern this problem: maintaining the \emph{temporal coherence} of the latent graph across successive observation windows, and respecting the \emph{intrinsic Riemannian geometry} of the symmetric positive definite manifold on which precision matrices naturally reside, a curved space whose geodesic structure departs fundamentally from that of the ambient Euclidean space. In this paper we propose dynamic estimation on the Grassmann manifold with a factor model (\textsc{Degfm}), a novel algorithm that jointly addresses both challenges. We model the time-varying precision matrix sequence as a low-rank-plus-diagonal structure governed by a latent elliptical graph factor model, which drastically reduces the effective parameter count and enables reliable estimation in the challenging small-sample regime. Temporal coherence is enforced through a Riemannian geodesic penalty defined on the Grassmann manifold, ensuring that the estimated graph trajectory is smooth with respect to the intrinsic geometry rather than the ambient Euclidean space. To solve the resulting non-convex optimization problem over Grassmann-manifold-valued sequences subject to the LRaD constraint, we derive an efficient Riemannian gradient descent algorithm that respects the manifold structure at every iterate and rigorously establish its convergence to a stationary point. Extensive experiments on both synthetic benchmarks and real-world datasets demonstrate that \textsc{Degfm} consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across all evaluation metrics, confirming the practical effectiveness of the proposed framework.

</details>


### [259] [The Symmetries of Three-Layer ReLU Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18319)
*Johanna Marie Gegenfurtner,Moritz Grillo,Guido Montúfar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了分析深度ReLU网络参数对称性的框架，完整刻画了三层瓶颈架构的参数纤维，并给出了判断功能等价性的多项式时间算法，同时揭示了对称性与梯度流守恒律之间的关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度神经网络中存在大量参数对称性，即不同参数配置可以实现相同的输入输出映射，这给参数识别、模型比较和优化动态分析带来了根本性挑战。理解这些对称性的结构对于解决参数可识别性问题和理解优化过程具有重要意义。

Method: 作者建立了分析参数对称性的理论框架，采用代数几何方法，针对三层瓶颈架构获得了参数纤维（即映射到相同函数的参数集合）的显式半代数描述。通过分析层间组合产生的离散和连续变换，以及深层网络隐藏或保留几何结构的条件，完整刻画了对称性的来源和性质。

Result: 主要结果包括：(1) 三层瓶颈架构参数纤维的完整刻画和显式半代数描述；(2) 判断两个参数是否功能等价的多项式时间算法；(3) 发现对称性包括离散变换和连续变换，取决于深层是否隐藏或保留前层的几何结构；(4) 证明部分对称性沿梯度流诱导局部守恒律，而其他对称性则不会。

Conclusion: 该工作为深度ReLU网络的参数对称性提供了系统的理论分析工具，特别是在三层瓶颈架构下实现了完整刻画。研究结果不仅解决了功能等价性判断的计算问题，还揭示了对称性与优化动态之间的深层联系，为理解神经网络的参数空间结构和优化行为提供了新视角。

Abstract: We develop a framework for analyzing parameter symmetries in deep ReLU networks and obtain a complete characterization of the generic parameter fibers for three-layer bottleneck architectures. Our approach provides explicit semi-algebraic descriptions of these fibers and yields a polynomial time algorithm for deciding functional equivalence of two parameters. The symmetries include discrete and continuous transformations arising from layer composition, and depend on whether deeper layers hide or preserve geometric structure from preceding layers. Finally, we show that some of these symmetries induce local conservation laws along gradient flow, while others do not.

</details>


### [260] [ISEP: Implicit Support Expansion for Offline Reinforcement Learning via Stochastic Policy Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18320)
*Yifei Chen,Shaoqin Zhu,Xiaoqiang Ji*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出ISEP框架，通过插值价值函数隐式扩展可行动作支持，并采用随机动作选择策略解决多模态优化问题，在保证理论误差有界的前提下突破离线RL的安全刚性约束。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有离线强化学习方法为确保安全性通常强制执行严格约束，这种刚性限制了策略在行为策略支持集之外发现最优行为的能力，阻碍了策略改进。

Method: 提出ISEP（Implicit Support Expansion via stochastic Policy optimization）框架：1) 利用行为策略样本和策略样本之间的插值价值函数隐式扩展可行动作支持，使高奖励区域密集化；2) 采用随机动作选择策略，在保守克隆和乐观扩展信号之间随机交替优化，解决多模态优化中的模式崩溃问题；3) 基于条件流匹配和无分类器引导实现ISEP-FM具体实例。

Result: 所提方法能够在理论上保证价值误差有界的前提下，为策略改进创建可导航路径，有效捕捉插值价值信号并解决多模态优化问题。

Conclusion: ISEP成功平衡了离线RL中的安全约束与策略优化需求，通过隐式支持扩展和随机优化策略突破了传统方法的刚性限制，为离线强化学习提供了新的解决方案。

Abstract: Offline reinforcement learning methods typically enforce strict constraints to ensure safety; yet this rigidity often prevents the discovery of optimal behaviors outside the immediate support of the behavior policy. To address this, we propose Implicit Support Expansion via stochastic Policy optimization (ISEP), which leverages a value function interpolated between in-distribution data and policy samples to implicitly expand the feasible action support. This mechanism "densifies" high-reward regions, creating a navigable path for policy improvement while theoretically guaranteeing bounded value error. However, optimizing against this expanded support creates a multimodal landscape where standard deterministic averaging leads to mode collapse and invalid actions. ISEP mitigates this via a stochastic action selection strategy, optimizing the policy by stochastically alternating between conservative cloning and optimistic expansion signals. We instantiate this framework as ISEP-FM using Conditional Flow Matching utilizing classifier-free guidance to effectively capture the interpolated value signal.

</details>


### [261] [Prune, Update and Trim: Robust Structured Pruning for Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18331)
*Diego Coello de Portugal Mecke,Tom Hanika,Lars Schmidth-Thieme*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Putri，一种针对大语言模型的结构化剪枝方法，通过更新未剪枝权重、顺序剪枝FFN层及细粒度剪枝注意力头，实现了在极高稀疏度下的优异性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型（LLM）的推理成本高昂，尤其在长上下文推理或资源受限设备上。现有的训练后剪枝（PTP）方法主要通过移除FFN层中信息量较少的隐藏节点和最不重要的注意力层来压缩模型，但仍有改进空间。

Method: 提出Putri方法，包含三个创新点：1) 更新FFN中未剪枝的权重以补偿剪枝误差；2) 顺序剪枝FFN层，考虑前序层的更新；3) 移除单个注意力头而非整个注意力层，并支持分组查询注意力（Grouped-Query Attention）。

Result: 在多种模型、稀疏度范围和数据集上的实验验证了Putri的泛化性。实验表明，Putri能在极高稀疏度比率下成功剪枝LLM，性能优于现有方法。

Conclusion: Putri作为一种简单的结构化剪枝方法，在保持模型性能的同时显著降低了LLM的资源需求，达到了SOTA性能，并解决了以往方法无法处理极端稀疏度的问题。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have experienced significant growth and development in recent years. However, performing inference on LLMs remains costly, especially for long-context inference or in resource-constrained devices. This motivates the development of new post-training pruning (PTP) methods. These methods reduce LLMs' requirements by removing a substantial part of the model's parameters. The discarded weights are selected depending on their impact on the models performance. Current PTP methods prune the models by removing the less informative hidden nodes from the FFN layers, and the least important attention layers. We propose Putri, a PTP method that introduces three changes to the State- of-the-art. First, we update the un-pruned weights of the FFN to compensate for the introduced pruning error. Second, the FFN layers are pruned sequentially, taking into account the updates done to the previous layers. Third, instead of removing full attention layers, we remove individual attention-heads. We extend this method such that it can also address Grouped-Query Attention. In summary, Putri is a structure pruning method which remains simple while showing SOTA performance. Pruning experiments on multiple models with a wide variety of sparsity ranges and on different datasets, validate the generality of Putri. Notably, we demonstrate that, unlike previous methods, Putri can prune LLMs on extreme sparsity ratios. The code is available at: https://github.com/Coello-dev/Putri.

</details>


### [262] [Decoupled Conformal Optimisation: Efficient Prediction Sets via Independent Tuning and Calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18354)
*Fanyi Wu,Lihua Niu,Samuel Kaski,Michele Caprio*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出解耦共形优化（DCO），通过独立的调优集和校准集实现更高效的预测集，在保持有限样本边缘覆盖保证的同时显著减小预测集大小。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有贝叶斯共形优化方法使用同一保留数据集同时搜索高效预测集并认证覆盖率，这种耦合虽然适用于高概率风险控制，但对于标准的有限样本边缘共形覆盖并非必要。

Method: 提出解耦共形优化（DCO），采用训练-调优-校准的设计原则：使用独立的调优分割进行效率导向的结构选择，使用新的校准分割进行最终的共形分位数计算。在调整后的结构条件下，标准的分割共形可交换性为任何候选类别提供有限样本边缘覆盖，无需置信参数或多重检验校正。

Result: 在分类和回归基准测试（包括ImageNet-A、CIFAR-100、Diabetes、California Housing和Concrete）上，DCO紧密跟踪名义覆盖水平，同时相比PAC式校准经常减少平均预测集大小或区间宽度。在ImageNet-A上，平均集合大小从26.52降至25.26，第95百分位集合大小从58.95降至53.73；在Diabetes上，平均区间宽度从2.098降至1.914。

Conclusion: DCO目标不同于PAC式方法：提供边缘共形覆盖而非高概率风险控制。在对耦合风险界限的一致性假设下，两种方法收敛到相同的总体阈值。DCO实现了更高效的预测集，同时保持有限样本覆盖保证。

Abstract: Bayesian conformal optimisation methods often use the same held-out data both to search for efficient prediction sets and to certify coverage or risk. This coupling is natural for high-probability risk-control guarantees, but it is not necessary when the target is standard finite-sample marginal conformal coverage. We propose Decoupled Conformal Optimisation (DCO), a train-tune-calibrate design principle that uses an independent tuning split for efficiency-oriented structural selection and a fresh calibration split for the final conformal quantile. Conditional on the tuned structure, standard split-conformal exchangeability yields finite-sample marginal coverage for any candidate class, without a confidence parameter or multiple-testing correction. DCO therefore targets a different finite-sample guarantee from PAC-style methods: marginal conformal coverage rather than high-probability risk control. Under consistency assumptions on the coupled risk bound, the two approaches nevertheless converge to the same population threshold. Across classification and regression benchmarks, including ImageNet-A, CIFAR-100, Diabetes, California Housing, and Concrete, DCO tracks the nominal coverage level closely while often reducing average prediction-set size or interval width relative to PAC-style calibration. On ImageNet-A, for example, the average set size decreases from $26.52$ to $25.26$ and the 95th-percentile set size from $58.95$ to $53.73$; on Diabetes, the average interval width decreases from $2.098$ to $1.914$.

</details>


### [263] [Proximal basin hopping: global optimization with guarantees](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18364)
*Guillaume Lauga,Cesare Molinari,Samuel Vaiter*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了近端盆地跳跃（PBH）框架，结合近端优化与局部最小化，实现了以高概率收敛至全局最小解，并在高维问题上显著优于现有理论算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全局优化问题具有挑战性，现有算法虽然经验上表现成功，但理论支撑匮乏。本文旨在建立一个既有理论保证又具实际效能的优化框架。

Method: 提出近端盆地跳跃（Proximal Basin Hopping, PBH）理论框架，将近端优化与局部最小化策略进行结合，并基于有限样本构建可实际运行的算法。

Result: 所提算法在有限样本下以高概率收敛到全局最小解；在标准合成难优化函数与深度学习缩放定律拟合等真实问题上，性能优于已知有理论支撑的算法，且维度越高，性能优势越明显。

Conclusion: PBH框架成功融合理论与实践，为全局优化提供了具有收敛性保证且在高维场景下性能优异的新方法，有效弥补了现有算法理论不足的问题。

Abstract: Global optimization is a challenging problem, with plenty of algorithms displaying empirical success, but scarce theoretical backing. In this work, we propose a new theoretical framework called Proximal Basin Hopping (PBH), carefully tailored to combine proximal optimization and local minimization. We use it to construct a practical algorithm that converges to the global minimizer with high probability, when using a finite amount of samples. Proximal Basin Hopping outperforms well known algorithms with theoretical backing on standard synthetic hard functions, and real problems such as fitting scaling laws for deep learning. Furthermore, the higher the dimension, the better the performance gap.

</details>


### [264] [Beyond Inference-Time Search: Reinforcement Learning Synthesizes Reusable Solvers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18374)
*Soheyl Massoudi,Gabriel Apaza,Milad Habibi,Mark Fuge*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出通过强化学习将组合优化的推理成本转移到代码大模型的权重中，使其能够为整个问题族合成可重用的求解器。在协同依赖选择（SDS）问题上，GRPO微调后的模型达到5.0%的VBS差距，比Best-of-64方法便宜91倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大语言模型（LLMs）在组合优化问题上通常将推理过程作为推理时程序，通过采样、搜索或重复提示分别解决每个实例，计算成本高昂。作者探索是否可以通过强化学习将部分推理成本转移到代码LLM的权重中，使模型能够为整个问题族合成可重用的求解器，而非针对每个实例单独求解。研究选择协同依赖选择（SDS）问题作为测试平台，该问题是带约束二次背包问题的受控变体，其局部信号和严格可行性约束使得贪婪启发式算法具有吸引力但不可靠，能够有效暴露模型的失败模式。

Method: 研究框架包括以下核心方法：1）问题设计：构建协同依赖选择（SDS）问题作为测试平台，暴露贪婪启发式算法的不可靠性；2）基线分析：在相同脚手架下使用Best-of-64基础模型采样，发现模型经常检索模拟退火模板但错误实现Metropolis接受规则；3）训练方法：使用群组相对策略优化（GRPO）对Qwen2.5-Coder-14B-Instruct进行微调，采用可行性门控奖励和轻量级结构脚手架；4）评估设置：包括在SDS测试集上的零样本重用评估，以及在作业车间调度问题上的跨域迁移评估；5）消融实验：系统分析标准稳定器、软可行性门控、奖励归一化和领域特定设计选择的影响。

Result: 主要实验结果包括：1）性能提升：微调后的策略在99.8%的可行SDS输出中收敛到约束感知的模拟退火模板，达到5.0%的VBS差距，而Best-of-64基础模型采样在28.7%差距处饱和；2）成本效益：在生成后执行/搜索成本上比累积Best-of-64评估便宜91倍；3）可重用性：编译一次检查显示，每个种子选取一个最佳冻结求解器在SDS测试集上保持高度竞争力；4）迁移性：在作业车间调度问题的额外域评估中提供了较窄但积极的迁移证据；5）消融结果：标准稳定器降低性能，软可行性门控失效，结果对奖励归一化和领域特定设计选择敏感。

Conclusion: 研究证明了通过强化学习将组合优化的推理成本转移到模型权重的可行性，使得代码LLM能够为整个问题族合成可重用的求解器。约束感知的模拟退火模板的成功合成表明，强化学习可以有效纠正基础模型的实现错误。显著的成本降低（91倍）和良好的跨问题重用性能展示了该方法在实际应用中的潜力。然而，消融实验揭示的敏感性（对稳定器、可行性门控、奖励归一化的依赖）表明该方法仍需要仔细的领域特定调优，限制了其即插即用的通用性。研究结果为LLMs在组合优化领域的应用提供了新的视角，即从逐实例推理转向问题族级别的求解器合成。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) typically approach combinatorial optimization as an inference-time procedure, solving each instance separately through sampling, search, or repeated prompting. We ask whether reinforcement learning can instead shift part of this reasoning cost into the weights of a code LLM, so that the model synthesizes a reusable solver for an entire problem family. We study this question on Synergistic Dependency Selection (SDS), a controlled variant of constrained Quadratic Knapsack designed to expose a specific failure mode: local signals and strict feasibility constraints make greedy heuristics attractive but unreliable. Under identical scaffolding, Best-of-64 base-model sampling saturates at an approximately 28.7% gap to the global Virtual Best Solver (VBS); code audits show that the base model often retrieves Simulated Annealing templates but misimplements the Metropolis acceptance rule. We fine-tune Qwen2.5-Coder-14B-Instruct with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) using a feasibility-gated reward and light structural scaffolding. The resulting policy converges to a constraint-aware Simulated Annealing template in 99.8% of feasible SDS outputs, achieves a 5.0% gap to that VBS, and is 91 times cheaper in post-generation execution/search cost than cumulative Best-of-64 evaluation. A compile-once check shows that one best frozen solver per seed remains highly competitive when reused unchanged across the SDS test set, while an additional-domain evaluation on Job Shop Scheduling provides narrower but positive evidence that the scaffold transfers beyond SDS. Negative ablations reveal the limits of this recipe: standard stabilizers degrade performance, a soft feasibility gate fails, and results remain sensitive to reward normalization and domain-specific design choices.

</details>


### [265] [Beyond Square Roots: Explicit Memory-Efficient Factorization for Multi-Epoch Private Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18379)
*Nikita P. Kalinin,Aki Rehn,Joel Daniel Andersson,Antti Honkela,Christoph H. Lampert*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出γ-BIFR方法，统一了现有DP-λCGD和BISR两种相关噪声分解方法，在低内存低带宽场景下显著提升差分隐私模型训练的效用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 差分隐私训练中的相关噪声机制需要在效用与内存成本之间权衡：DP-λCGD内存效率高但效用提升有限，BISR在大带宽下渐进最优但低带宽时性能差。现有方法无法同时满足低内存条件下的高效用需求。

Method: 提出γ-BIFR方法，作为DP-λCGD和BISR分解方法的统一推广。通过引入参数γ调节因子分解特性，在低带宽条件下优化噪声相关性结构，同时保持内存效率。

Result: 在低内存低带宽场景下，γ-BIFR显著降低了RMSE和放大RMSE，提升了私有训练性能，并为多轮训练中的多次参与误差提供了更紧的理论保证。

Conclusion: γ-BIFR成功统一并改进了现有相关噪声分解方法，为资源受限场景下的差分隐私训练提供了更优的效用-内存权衡解决方案。

Abstract: Correlated-noise mechanisms are among the most promising approaches for improving the utility of differentially private model training, but rigorous guarantees require explicit, analyzable factorizations, and practical deployment requires memory efficiency. Recent works have developed banded inverse factorizations, which address both requirements by exploiting a banded structure in the correlation matrix. The bandwidth controls the size of the noise buffer used to correlate noise across iterations, and thus governs the tradeoff between utility and memory cost. Existing factorizations highlight this tradeoff: DP-$λ$CGD achieves high memory efficiency by using only a one-step noise buffer, but this limits its utility gains, while the banded inverse square root (BISR) factorization exploits larger correlation windows and is asymptotically optimal for large bandwidths but performs poorly at low bandwidths. We propose $γ$-BIFR, a unified generalization of both factorizations. In the low-memory, low-bandwidth regime, $γ$-BIFR significantly improves RMSE, amplified RMSE, and private training performance, while yielding tighter theoretical guarantees for multi-participation error in multi-epoch training.

</details>


### [266] [Generating Physically Consistent Molecules with Energy-Based Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18381)
*Christoph Griesbacher,Lea Bogensperger,Andreas Habring,Thomas Pock*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了EBMol，首个在3D分子生成任务上达到SOTA性能的能量模型，通过恢复能量归纳偏置实现了高质量分子生成和可控设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 平衡态分子遵循玻尔兹曼分布，能量景观是物理驱动的建模目标。但能量景观难以从数据中学习，且学习后难以采样。现有的扩散和流匹配模型通过学习噪声与数据间的时间条件分数或传输场来规避这些困难，但以牺牲能量归纳偏置为代价换取更易处理的训练目标。

Method: 提出EBMol能量模型：1）学习原子加性标量势能，训练时无需显式模拟；2）采用流启发的恢复场匹配目标来近似能量景观；3）使用Mirror-Langevin算法进行采样，实现原子位置和类型的统一更新；4）引入并行回火技术以实现推理时计算扩展。

Result: EBMol是首个在3D分子生成任务上达到SOTA性能的能量模型，在QM9和GEOM-Drugs数据集上取得最优表现。学习到的能量景观可作为排序和过滤构型的原则性质量指标，并展示了无需重训练的可控生成能力（通过势能组合的形状导向采样和零样本连接子设计）。

Conclusion: EBMol成功地将能量归纳偏置重新引入分子生成模型，在保持生成性能的同时提供了物理可解释性，学习到的能量景观不仅用于生成，还可作为质量评估指标和支持可控生成的工具，为分子设计提供了新的范式。

Abstract: Molecules in equilibrium follow a Boltzmann distribution, making the underlying energy landscape a physically grounded modeling objective. However, such landscapes are difficult to learn from data and, once learned, hard to sample from. Diffusion and flow-matching models sidestep these difficulties by learning a time-conditional score or transport field between noise and data, losing the energy inductive bias in exchange for a more tractable training objective. We introduce EBMol, an energy-based model (EBM) that restores this inductive bias by learning an atom-additive scalar potential without explicit simulation during training. Our method employs a flow-inspired Restoring Field Matching objective to approximate the energy landscape. We adopt the Mirror-Langevin algorithm for sampling, enabling unified updates of atomic positions and types, and incorporate parallel tempering for inference-time compute scaling. EBMol is the first EBM for 3D molecular generation to achieve state-of-the-art performance on QM9 and GEOM-Drugs. Moreover, we show that the learned energy landscape serves as a principled quality metric for ranking and filtering configurations, and demonstrate controllable generation without retraining through shape-steered sampling via potential composition and zero-shot linker design.

</details>


### [267] [TabH2O: A Unified Foundation Model for Tabular Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18383)
*Pascal Pfeiffer,Dmitry Gordeev,Mathias Müller,Laura Fink,Joan Salvà Soler,Mark Landry,Branden Murray,Marcos V. Conde,Sri Satish Ambati*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了TabH2O，一个用于表格数据的基础模型，通过上下文学习在单次前向传播中执行分类和回归任务，在TALENT基准测试中表现优异，超越了CatBoost和H2O AutoML等主流方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有表格数据处理方法存在局限性：需要分别为分类和回归任务训练独立模型，训练成本高；现有方法依赖多阶段课程学习，训练流程复杂；模型对无关特征和噪声缺乏鲁棒性。因此需要开发一个统一、高效且鲁棒的表格数据基础模型。

Method: TabH2O基于TabICL架构进行改进：1) 统一训练：采用双头架构，单一模型同时处理分类和回归任务；2) 单阶段预训练：引入有界可扩展softmax、阶段间归一化、可学习残差缩放和logit软限制等稳定性改进，消除多阶段课程学习需求；3) 噪声感知预训练：在合成数据集中加入显式噪声维度以增强模型对无关特征的鲁棒性。

Result: TabH2O v1（29.2M参数）在TALENT基准测试（300个数据集）上的平均排名为2.55/6，超越了调优后的CatBoost（4.07）、H2O AutoML（4.18）和LightGBM（5.08），与TabPFN v2.6（2.74）性能相当，仅次于TabICL v2（2.12），在81%的测试数据集上位列前三。

Conclusion: TabH2O成功实现了表格数据分类和回归任务的统一建模，通过架构创新和训练策略优化，显著降低了预训练成本并提升了模型鲁棒性，为表格数据基础模型的发展提供了有效解决方案。

Abstract: We present TabH2O, a foundation model for tabular data that performs classification and regression in a single forward pass via in-context learning. TabH2O builds on the TabICL architecture with several key modifications: (1) unified training, a single model handles both classification and regression via a dual-head architecture, eliminating the need for separate models and reducing total pretraining cost; (2) single-stage pretraining, training stability improvements (bounded scalable softmax, inter-stage normalization, learnable residual scaling, logit soft-capping) eliminate the need for multi-stage curriculum learning, enabling training with full-length sequences from the start; and (3) noise-aware pretraining, synthetic datasets include explicit noise dimensions to teach the model robustness to irrelevant features. We evaluate TabH2O v1 (29.2M parameters) on the TALENT benchmark (300 datasets), where it achieves an average rank of 2.55 out of 6 evaluated methods, outperforming tuned CatBoost (4.07), H2O AutoML (4.18), and LightGBM (5.08), competitive with TabPFN v2.6 (2.74), and behind TabICL v2 (2.12), while placing in the top-3 on 81% of the testing datasets across classification and regression tasks.

</details>


### [268] [Graph Hierarchical Recurrence for Long-Range Generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18387)
*Stefano Carotti,Marco Pacini,Alessio Gravina,Davide Bacciu,Bruno Lepri,Sebastiano Bontorin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出图层次递归（GHR）框架，解决了图神经网络和图Transformer在长距离依赖和超范围泛化上的局限性，在基准测试中以仅1%的参数量实现了优于当前最先进模型的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的图神经网络和图Transformer在需要捕获图中远距离区域之间相关性的任务中存在根本局限性，特别是在超范围泛化（测试实例涉及比训练时观察到的更长距离的交互）方面表现更为严重。

Method: 引入图层次递归（GHR）框架，该框架在输入图和通过池化获得的层次抽象上联合操作。通过在图结构及其层次抽象上同时进行处理，实现对长距离依赖的有效捕获。

Result: 在广泛的长距离基准测试中，GHR始终优于现有的图模型，同时使用的参数量仅为当前最先进模型的1%。表现出三个关键优势：长距离依赖的强性能、改进的超范围泛化能力以及高参数效率。

Conclusion: 研究结果表明了与当前扩展架构以获得图基础模型的趋势互补的方向，表明仅增加模型容量可能不足以实现泛化，为图学习模型的设计提供了新的思路。

Abstract: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) and Graph Transformers (GTs) are now a fundamental paradigm for graph learning, combining the representation-learning capabilities of deep models with the sample efficiency induced by their inductive biases. Despite their effectiveness, a large body of work has shown that these models still face fundamental limitations in tasks that require capturing correlations between distant regions of a graph. To address this issue, we introduce Graph Hierarchical Recurrence (GHR), a novel framework that operates jointly on the input graph and on a hierarchical abstraction obtained through pooling. We also show that the limitations of existing models are even more pronounced in out-of-range generalization, where test instances involve interactions over distances longer than those observed during training. By contrast, despite its simple design, GHR provides three key advantages: strong performance on long-range dependencies, improved out-of-range generalization, and high parameter efficiency. To corroborate these claims, we show that across a broad set of long-range benchmarks, GHR consistently outperforms existing graph models while using as little as 1% of the parameters of current state-of-the-art models. These results suggest a complementary direction to the current trend of scaling architectures to obtain graph foundation models, indicating that increased model capacity alone may not be sufficient for generalization.

</details>


### [269] [Spherical Harmonic Optimal Transport: Application to Climate Models Comparisons](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18389)
*Pierre Houédry,Iskander Legheraba,Léo Buecher,Nicolas Courty*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明了基于热核的卷积算法能够逼近最优传输代价，并为球面流形设计了一种快速、GPU友好的Sinkhorn算法，应用于全球气候模型评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 最优传输方法在比较度量时能够保持支撑集的几何特性，但计算成本昂贵，限制了其在实际场景中的应用。虽然已有基于热核的卷积算法来降低计算成本，但其理论性质尚未被充分探索。

Method: 作者建立了热核代价在平衡和非平衡情形下随时间趋于零时收敛到最优传输代价的理论结果；利用球面的调和结构，推导出一种仅需O(n)内存和O(n^{3/2})时间每次迭代的快速Sinkhorn算法，并实现了全密集的GPU友好操作。

Result: 在二维球面S^2上，确保了相关的Sinkhorn散度保留经典最优传输差异的几何和分析性质；实验验证了算法的计算效率，并展示了其在全球气候模型评估中的潜在应用价值。

Conclusion: 该工作为基于热核的最优传输方法提供了理论基础，并展示了其在球面数据处理和气候模型评估中的实用性和有效性。

Abstract: Optimal transport provides a powerful framework for comparing measures while respecting the geometry of their support, but comes with an expensive computational cost, hindering its potential application to real world use cases. On manifolds, convolutional algorithms based on the heat kernel have been proposed to alleviate this cost, but their theoretical properties remain largely unexplored. We establish that the heat kernel cost converges to the optimal transport cost as time vanishes in the balanced and unbalanced cases. In the specific case of the 2-sphere $\mathbb{S}^2$, we ensure that the associated Sinkhorn divergences retains the desirable geometric and analytic properties of classical optimal transport discrepancies. Moreover, we leverage the harmonic structure of the sphere to derive a fast Sinkhorn algorithm, requiring only $\mathcal{O}(n)$ memory and $\mathcal{O}(n^{3/2})$ time per iteration, with fully dense GPU-friendly operations. We validate its computational efficiency on synthetic data, and discuss its potential use in the evaluation of global climate models, providing both spatial and seasonal insights into models performances.

</details>


### [270] [Modelling Customer Trajectories with Reinforcement Learning for Practical Retail Insights](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18449)
*Ken Ming Lee,Paul Barde,Maxime C. Cohen,Derek Nowrouzezahrai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于最大熵强化学习的智能体建模框架，用于预测零售空间内的顾客轨迹，相比传统启发式方法（TSP、PNN）更贴近真实顾客行为，能够有效支持店铺布局优化决策。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解顾客在零售空间内的移动对于优化店铺布局至关重要。虽然真实轨迹数据能提供高精度洞察，但采集成本高昂且对许多零售商而言不可行。现有的低成本启发式方法（如旅行商问题TSP和概率最近邻PNN）与实际顾客轨迹平均偏差达28%，在准确性和实用性之间存在权衡。

Method: 提出一个基于智能体的建模框架，将顾客轨迹预测建模为最大熵强化学习问题。该方法在奖励最大化与随机性之间取得平衡，以更好地反映具有有限理性的顾客行为特征。研究使用便利店的真实轨迹数据，对比分析了RL方法与TSP、PNN方法的性能差异。

Result: 实验结果表明：1）RL生成的轨迹与顾客实际行为的吻合度高于TSP和PNN；2）RL方法提供了更准确的冲动购买率和货架客流密度估计；3）只有基于RL的预测得出的冲动商品重新定位决策与基于真实轨迹数据的决策相一致，并产生了相当的预估利润增长。

Conclusion: 该研究证明强化学习提供了一种实用且具有行为学基础的替代方案，有效弥合了过于简化的启发式方法与数据密集型方法之间的差距，使准确的布局优化更加普及和可及。源代码已在GitHub上开源以促进后续研究。

Abstract: Understanding customer movement within retail spaces is essential for optimizing store layouts. Real-world trajectory data can provide highly accurate insights, but collecting it is costly and often infeasible for many retailers. Heuristics such as Travelling Salesman Problem (TSP) and Probabilistic Nearest Neighbours (PNN) are commonly used as inexpensive approximations, but actual customer trajectories deviate by an average of 28% from shortest paths, highlighting a tradeoff between accuracy and practicality. We propose an agent-based modelling framework that casts customer trajectory prediction as a maximum entropy reinforcement learning (RL) problem, balancing reward maximization with stochasticity to better reflect customers with bounded rationality. Using real-world trajectory data from a convenience store, we show that RL-generated trajectories align more closely with customer behaviour than TSP and PNN, providing more accurate estimates of impulse purchase rates and shelf traffic densities. Furthermore, only RL-based predictions yield repositioning decisions for impulse products that align with those derived from actual trajectory data, resulting in comparable estimated profit gains. Our work demonstrates that RL provides a practical, behaviourally grounded alternative that bridges the gap between oversimplified heuristics and data-intensive approaches, making accurate layout optimization more accessible. To encourage further research, the source code is available on GitHub.

</details>


### [271] [Generative Adversarial Learning from Deterministic Processes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18425)
*Joris C. Kühl,Hanno Gottschalk*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明了生成对抗网络能够从单一确定性混沌时间序列中学习系统的不变分布，为物理AI在非独立同分布数据上的成功提供了理论依据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 物理AI在处理非独立同分布（non-i.i.d.）数据方面取得了显著成功，尤其是在处理来自湍流等混沌动力系统的数据时。现有的统计学习理论主要基于i.i.d.假设，难以解释这一经验现象。本文旨在以生成对抗网络（GAN）为例，为该现象提供理论解释。

Method: 提出了一个无限维的生成对抗学习（GAL）模型，用于建模生成对抗学习过程。在理论分析中，放弃传统的i.i.d.假设，转而考虑从单一确定性演化时间序列中学习的设定，并利用混沌动力系统的特性进行分析。

Result: 证明了对于足够混沌的动力系统，可以从其状态或测量的单一确定性演化时间序列中学习到系统的不变分布。论文给出了以Jensen-Shannon散度衡量的收敛速率的显式表达。

Conclusion: 本研究将GAN的理论理解扩展到了非i.i.d.数据场景，证明了在混沌动力系统背景下从单一轨迹学习不变分布的可行性，为物理AI在处理确定性混沌数据时的成功提供了坚实的理论基础。

Abstract: Physical AI is being successfully applied to data which does not follow the traditional paradigm of independent and identically distributed (i.i.d.) samples. In fact, physical AI is often trained on data which is not random at all, and is instead derived from chaotic dynamical systems like turbulence.
  We aim to explain the empirical success of these methods using the example of generative adversarial networks (GANs), whose statistical learning theory under the i.i.d. assumption is generally well understood. We prove that it is possible, using an infinite-dimensional model of generative adversarial learning (GAL), to learn the invariant distribution of a sufficiently chaotic dynamical system from a single deterministically evolving time series of its states or measurements thereof, and give explicit rates for the convergence to the solution in terms of the Jensen-Shannon divergence.

</details>


### [272] [Scheduling That Speaks: An Interpretable Programmatic Reinforcement Learning Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18454)
*Chengpeng Hu,Yingqian Zhang,Hendrik Baier*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出ProRL框架，通过学习人类可读、可编辑的程序化策略来解决作业车间调度问题，在保持高性能的同时实现了可解释性，并在资源受限环境下表现优异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的深度强化学习方法在解决组合优化问题时存在两个关键局限：深度神经网络的黑盒特性导致策略决策不可解释，引发信任和可用性问题；DNN的计算需求限制了在资源受限环境中的实际部署。

Method: 提出ProRL（Programmatic Reinforcement Learning）框架：1）设计调度领域特定语言（DSL-S）将调度策略表示为结构化程序；2）使用局部搜索探索程序空间识别不完整程序；3）通过贝叶斯优化学习参数以完成程序；4）学习选择调度启发式规则，自然融合工业场景中已有的启发式方法。

Result: 在广泛使用的基准实例上，ProRL在性能上优于现有启发式方法和DRL基线；在强计算资源约束下表现良好（如仅需100个回合训练）；生成的策略具有人类可读性和可编辑性。

Conclusion: ProRL成功弥合了高性能与可解释性之间的鸿沟，为作业车间调度问题提供了一种实用、可解释且高效的解决方案，特别适用于对可解释性和计算资源有严格要求的工业应用场景。

Abstract: Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) has recently emerged as a promising approach to solve combinatorial optimization problems such as job shop scheduling. However, the policies learned by DRL are typically represented by deep neural networks (DNNs), whose opaque neural architectures and non-interpretable policy decisions can lead to critical trust and usability concerns for human decision makers. In addition, the computational requirements of DNNs can further hinder practical deployment in resource constrained environments. In this work, we propose ProRL, a novel interpretable programmatic reinforcement learning framework that achieves high-performance scheduling with human-readable and editable programmatic policies (i.e., programs). We first introduce a domain-specific language for scheduling (DSL-S) to represent scheduling strategies as structured programs. ProRL then explores the program space defined by DSL-S using local search to identify incomplete programs, which are subsequently completed by learning their parameters via Bayesian optimization. ProRL learns which scheduling heuristic rules to select, and hence, it naturally incorporates existing heuristics already used in industrial scenarios. Experiments on widely used benchmark instances demonstrate the strong performance of ProRL against existing heuristics and DRL baselines. Furthermore, ProRL performs well under strongly constrained computational resources, such as training with only 100 episodes. Our code is available at https://github.com/HcPlu/ProRL.

</details>


### [273] [Text2CAD-Bench: A Benchmark for LLM-based Text-to-Parametric CAD Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18430)
*Liang Wang,Heng Meng,Zekai Xiang,Jin Liu,Pingyi Zhou,Litao Chen,Yongqiang Tang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出了Text2CAD-Bench，这是首个系统评估文本到CAD生成任务的基准，涵盖不同几何复杂度和应用领域。研究发现现有模型在基础几何上表现尚可，但在复杂拓扑和高级特征上性能显著下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的文本到CAD生成基准主要关注基本图元和简单的草图-拉伸序列，缺乏实际应用所需的高级特征，且仅覆盖传统的机械零件。这种局限性无法全面评估模型在真实场景中的表现能力，因此需要建立更全面的评估体系。

Method: 构建了包含600个人工策划示例的Text2CAD-Bench基准，分为四个复杂度级别：L1-L2涵盖具有标准特征的基础几何；L3引入复杂拓扑和自由曲面；L4扩展到机械零件之外的真实世界领域。每个示例配备双风格提示词——模仿非专家用户的几何描述和符合专家级惯例的程序序列。对主流通用大语言模型和领域特定模型进行系统性评估。

Result: 当前模型在基础几何任务上表现合理，但在复杂拓扑和高级特征方面性能大幅下降。这表明现有文本到CAD生成技术在处理真实世界复杂设计任务时仍面临重大挑战。

Conclusion: Text2CAD-Bench基准揭示了当前文本到CAD生成方法的关键局限性，特别是在处理高级几何特征和非机械领域设计方面的不足。该基准的发布旨在推动文本到CAD研究领域的发展，为未来改进提供系统性评估框架。

Abstract: Text-to-CAD generation aims to create parametric CAD models from natural language, enabling rapid prototyping and intuitive design workflows. However, existing benchmarks focus on basic primitives and simple sketch-extrude sequences, lacking advanced features essential for real-world applications and covering only traditional mechanical parts. We introduce Text2CAD-Bench, the first benchmark systematically evaluating text-to-CAD across geometric complexity and application diversity. Our benchmark comprises 600 human-curated examples spanning four levels: L1-L2 cover fundamental geometry with standard features, L3 introduces complex topology and freeform surfaces, and L4 extends to real-world domains beyond mechanical parts. Each example pairs dual-style prompts -- geometric descriptions mimicking non-expert users, and procedural sequences aligned with expert-level conventions. Evaluating mainstream general LLMs and domain-specific models, we find that current models perform reasonably on basic geometry but degrade substantially on complex topology and advanced features. We release our benchmark to drive progress in text-to-CAD research.

</details>


### [274] [GAMMA: Global Bit Allocation for Mixed-Precision Models under Arbitrary Budgets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18475)
*Zhangyang Yao,Haiyan Zhao,Haoyu Wang,Tianbo Huang,Lihua Zhang,Xu Han*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出GAMMA框架，通过后训练流程学习模块级精度偏好并投影为精确预算分配，单次训练即可快速适应任意部署预算，在Llama和Qwen模型上显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的LLM混合精度量化方法存在明显局限：基于学习的方法需要量化感知训练（对十亿参数模型不可行）；无训练方法依赖静态代理指标且忽略模块间交互，需针对每个预算重新计算；基于搜索的方法计算昂贵且无法保证精确满足预算约束。需要一种能在LLM规模下自动化分配精度且高效准确的方法。

Method: GAMMA是一种量化器无关的框架，完全在后训练管道内学习模块级精度偏好。核心方法包括：(1) 在增广拉格朗日约束下优化教师强迫的隐藏状态重构目标；(2) 通过整数规划将学习到的偏好投影为精确满足预算的离散分配。关键特性是分数复用：学习到的偏好编码了稳定的敏感度排序而非特定预算权重，因此单次训练即可通过重新求解整数规划来服务任意部署目标。

Result: 在Llama和Qwen模型（8B-32B）上的实验表明：GAMMA优于固定精度基线（最高提升+12.99 Avg.）和基于搜索的混合精度方法（最高提升+7.00 Avg.）；能在2.5位平均精度下匹配固定3位质量，大幅减少内存占用；将每个预算的适应时间从数小时减少到几分钟。

Conclusion: GAMMA成功解决了LLM规模下混合精度量化的关键挑战，实现了高效、精确且通用的自动化精度分配，使得大模型能在显著更小的内存占用下部署，同时保持模型性能。

Abstract: Mixed-precision quantization improves the budget--accuracy trade-off for large language models (LLMs) by allocating more bits to sensitive modules. However, automating this allocation at LLM scale faces a unique combination of constraints: learnable approaches require quantization-aware training, which is infeasible for billion-parameter models; training-free alternatives rely on static proxy metrics that miss cross-module interactions and must be recomputed per target budget; and search-based methods are expensive without guaranteeing exact budget compliance. We propose GAMMA, a quantizer-agnostic framework that learns module-wise precision preferences entirely within a post-training pipeline. GAMMA optimizes a teacher-forced hidden-state reconstruction objective under an augmented Lagrangian constraint, and projects the learned preferences into exact budget-feasible discrete assignments via integer programming. A key property is score reuse: because the learned preferences encode a stable sensitivity ranking rather than budget-specific weights, a single training run serves arbitrary deployment targets by re-solving only the integer program, reducing per-budget adaptation from hours to a few minutes. Across Llama and Qwen models (8B--32B), GAMMA outperforms both fixed-precision baselines (up to +12.99 Avg.) and search-based mixed-precision methods (up to +7.00 Avg.), and can match fixed 3-bit quality at 2.5-bit average precision, enabling deployment at substantially smaller memory footprints.

</details>


### [275] [Modality vs. Morphology: A Framework for Time Series Classification for Biological Signals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18483)
*Jordan Tschida,Matthew Yohe,Edward Kane,Gavin Jager,Emma J. Reid,Tony G. Allen,Mark Story,Leanne Thompson,Joe Hoskins,Brandon Schreiber,Stan Seiferth,Scott Dolvin,David Cornett*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本综述提出了统一的形态学-模态框架，揭示了生物信号（如EEG、EMG、ECG等）的波形结构（形态学）比模型类别更能决定时间序列分类的性能和可解释性，并指出形态学感知建模是开发通用且可解释模型的核心原则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生物信号的时间序列分类已从手工特征方法演进至深度学习架构，但目前缺乏一个统一框架来连接波形结构（形态学）与模型设计。作者旨在阐明不同生理过程的波形特征（如尖峰、爆发、振荡等）如何指导预处理和建模策略的选择。

Method: 通过分析脑电图(EEG)、肌电图(EMG)、心电图(ECG)、光电容积脉搏波(PPG)及眼部信号(EOG、瞳孔测量、眼动追踪)等多种模态，建立了形态学-模态统一框架，系统性地将波形结构特征（尖峰、爆发、振荡、慢漂移、层级节律）与方法论设计相关联。

Result: 跨生物信号的综合证据表明，波形形态学而非模型类别是决定分类性能和可解释性的最主要因素。当深度模型的归纳偏置与潜在波形动态特性相匹配时，模型表现优异。同时识别了形态学数据增强和评估指标作为未来研究方向。

Conclusion: 形态学感知建模应作为开发跨生物信号的通用、可解释且具有生理意义的时间序列分类模型的统一原则。这为理解深度模型成功原因提供了理论基础，并为未来研究指明了方向。

Abstract: Time series classification (TSC) of biological signals has progressed from handcrafted, modality-specific approaches to deep architectures capable of representing the diverse waveform structures of underlying physiological processes (i.e., morphology). This review introduces a unified morphology--modality framework that connects waveform structure to a methodological design, revealing how spikes, bursts, oscillations, slow drift, and hierarchical rhythms inform model design. By analyzing electroencephalography, electromyography, electrocardiography, photoplethysmography, and ocular modalities (electrooculography, pupillometry, eye-tracking), the review demonstrates how morphology determines preprocessing and modeling strategies. Integrating evidence across these biological signals, the framework reveals that morphology, not model class, most strongly determines performance and interpretability. This provides insight into why deep models succeed when their inductive biases align with underlying waveform dynamics. This review also identifies future work including morphological data augmentation and evaluation metrics to improve generalization. Together, these insights position morphology-aware modeling as a unifying principle for developing generalizable, interpretable, and physiologically meaningful TSC models across biological signals.

</details>


### [276] [DBES: A Systematic Benchmark and Metric Suite for Evaluating Expert Specialization in Large-Scale MoEs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18498)
*Jing Wang,Hongxuan Lu,Jazze Young,Shu Wang,Zhimin Xin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了DBES诊断框架，用于系统评估MoE模型中的专家专业化现象，并验证了该指标在领域特定后训练中的有效性，仅用15%的训练资源即可实现高达94.48%的性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前对Mixture-of-Experts (MoE)模型中专家专业化的理解仍然不足，传统评估方法往往将架构层面的负载均衡与功能专业化混为一谈，缺乏独立于准确性指标的系统性评估方法。

Method: 引入DBES诊断框架，包含多领域基准测试和五个理论支撑的评估指标：路由专业化、归一化有效秩、领域隔离度、路由刚性与N元组专业知识度量。

Result: 揭示了不同模型的专业化范式差异：Qwen系列呈现高领域隔离的模块化专业化，而DeepSeek和GLM采用分布式协作模式；通过DBES指导领域特定后训练，仅用原训练资源15%即在专业化领域实现了66%至94.48%的性能提升。

Conclusion: 专业化是诊断维度而非下游性能的充分条件；本文首次提供了独立于准确性指标评估专家专业化的系统方法论，证明了诊断指标可转化为具体的优化算子，为下一代MoE系统的设计与后训练优化提供了关键洞察。

Abstract: Expert specialization in Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models remains poorly understood, with traditional evaluations conflating architectural load-balancing with functional specialization. We introduce DBES, a comprehensive diagnostic framework combining a multi-domain benchmark with five theoretically grounded metrics: Routing Specialization, Normalized Effective Rank, Domain Isolation, Routing Stiffness Score, and N-gram Expertise measures.
  Critical findings demonstrate distinct specialization paradigms across models: Qwen-series exhibit modular specialization with high domain isolation, while DeepSeek and GLM employ distributed collaboration. However, we emphasize that specialization is a diagnostic dimension, necessary but not sufficient for downstream performance. Most crucially, interventional evidence validates the actionability of these metrics: by using DBES to identify high-specialization expert paths during domain-specific post-training, we achieved 66% to 94.48% improvement in specialized domains with only 15% of original training resources, demonstrating that these diagnostic tools can be converted into concrete optimization operators. This work provides the first systematic methodology for evaluating expert specialization independently of accuracy metrics, offering crucial insights for the design and post-training optimization of next-generation MoE systems.

</details>


### [277] [DiPRL: Learning Discrete Programmatic Policies via Architecture Entropy Regularization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18508)
*Chengpeng Hu,Yingqian Zhang,Hendrik Baier*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了DiPRL方法，通过在训练过程中引入程序架构熵正则化，使策略在训练时就趋于离散，从而避免了传统梯度方法在事后离散化时的性能下降问题，实现了可解释的程序化强化学习策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的程序化强化学习（PRL）方法采用梯度优化连续松弛的程序，但在将连续松弛转换回离散程序时面临严重的性能下降问题。事后离散化会丢弃优化后的分支和参数，导致策略表达能力崩溃和任务性能降低，需要额外的微调阶段。

Method: 提出了可微分离散程序化强化学习（DiPRL）方法。首先分析了基于梯度方法的事后离散化带来的性能下降风险；然后引入程序架构熵正则化，实现平滑的可微分训练，鼓励模型收敛到离散程序。该方法在训练过程中使程序逐渐变为几乎离散的状态，避免了单独的事后微调阶段。

Result: 在多个离散和连续强化学习任务上的实验表明，DiPRL能够通过可解释的程序化策略实现强大的性能，同时保持了基于梯度优化的效率，缓解了事后离散化的风险。

Conclusion: DiPRL成功解决了传统PRL方法中连续到离散转换的性能瓶颈，在保持梯度优化效率的同时实现了高质量的可解释程序化策略，为程序化强化学习提供了一种更优的解决方案。

Abstract: Programmatic reinforcement learning (PRL) offers an interpretable alternative to deep reinforcement learning by representing policies as human-readable and -editable programs. While gradient-based methods have been developed to optimize continuous relaxations of programs, they face a significant performance drop when converting the continuous relaxations back into discrete programs. Post-hoc discretization can discard optimized branches and parameters in a program, which results in a collapse of policy expressivity and lowered task performance, leading in turn to a need for additional fine-tuning. To overcome these limitations, we propose Differentiable Discrete Programmatic Reinforcement Learning (DiPRL), a method that learns programmatic policies that become nearly discrete during training, avoiding a separate post-hoc fine-tuning stage. We first analyze the inherent risks of performance drop introduced by post-hoc discretization of gradient-based methods. Then, we introduce programmatic architecture entropy regularization, which enables smooth, differentiable training that encourages convergence toward a discrete program. DiPRL maintains the efficiency of gradient-based optimization while mitigating the risks of post-hoc discretization. Our experiments across multiple discrete and continuous RL tasks demonstrate that DiPRL can achieve strong performance via interpretable programmatic policies.

</details>


### [278] [Adaptive Experimentation for Censored Survival Outcomes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18459)
*Yuxin Wang,Dennis Frauen,Jonas Schweisthal,Maresa Schröder,Emil Javurek,Stefan Feuerriegel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了自适应生存估计器（ASE），这是首个针对右删失生存数据的自适应实验框架，通过推导半参数效率界获得了闭式最优分配策略，实现了比均匀随机化更高效的因果效应估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的自适应实验方法无法处理存在删失的生存数据（如癌症试验中因脱落导致的总生存期部分观察），而此类数据在医学研究中广泛存在，亟需开发能够高效估计生存数据因果效应的自适应实验方法。

Method: 首先推导了平均生存效应曲线作为处理分配策略函数的半参数效率界，获得了闭式效率最优分配策略，该策略通过优先考虑事件和删失动态均导致高不确定性的患者分层，将经典Neyman分配推广到生存设置；在此基础上提出ASE框架，采用任意机器学习模型进行干扰估计，序贯地学习分配策略并估计平均生存效应曲线。

Result: 框架具有三个主要优势：（i）可采用任意机器学习模型进行干扰估计；（ii）由闭式效率最优分配策略指导；（iii）通过鞅中心极限定理获得强理论保证，包括渐近正态性。数值实验表明该方法相比均匀随机化和忽略删失的基线方法具有一致的效率提升。

Conclusion: 本研究成功填补了自适应实验方法在右删失生存数据领域的空白，为癌症试验等存在脱落和删失的临床研究提供了理论基础坚实且实用性强的因果效应估计工具，显著提升了估计效率。

Abstract: Adaptive experimentation enables efficient estimation of causal effects, but existing methods are not designed for survival data with censoring, where event times are only partially observed (e.g., overall survival in cancer trials but with dropout). In this paper, we develop a novel framework for adaptive experimentation to estimate causal effects under right censoring. For this, we derive the semiparametric efficiency bound for the average survival effect curve as a function of the treatment allocation policy and thereby obtain a closed-form efficiency-optimal allocation policy. The policy generalizes classical Neyman allocation to survival settings by prioritizing patient strata where both event and censoring dynamics induce high uncertainty. Building on this, we propose the Adaptive Survival Estimator (ASE), an adaptive framework that learns the allocation policy and estimates the average survival effect curve sequentially. Our framework has three main benefits: (i) it accommodates arbitrary machine learning models for nuisance estimation; (ii) it is guided by a closed-form efficiency-optimal allocation policy; and (iii) it admits strong theoretical guarantees, including asymptotic normality via a martingale central limit theorem. We demonstrate our framework across various numerical experiments to show consistent efficiency gains over uniform randomization and censoring-agnostic baselines.

</details>


### [279] [Probing for Representation Manifolds in Superposition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18537)
*Alexander Modell*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了流形探针（Manifold Probe），一种用于发现叠加中表示流形的监督方法，并在Llama 2-7b中成功识别了时间与空间的流形，证实了其因果干预能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究多假设概念以单一方向编码，但实际表示可能更为复杂。本文旨在提出一种方法，能够发现并表示概念特征的全空间（即流形），而非仅寻找单一方向。

Method: 提出流形探针（Manifold Probe），该方法推广了线性回归探针。它分两步工作：首先学习可以从表示中线性预测的概念特征空间，然后学习用于编码这些特征的具体方向。

Result: 在Llama 2-7b模型中，该方法发现了能够线性表示时间和空间概念的流形。特别在时间概念上，沿流形进行引导可以成功改变模型关于著名歌曲、电影和书籍发行年份的补全结果。

Conclusion: 流形探针能够有效发现与模型行为因果相关的流形，为理解大型语言模型内部复杂的概念表示机制提供了新工具。

Abstract: This paper introduces the Manifold Probe, a supervised method for discovering representation manifolds in superposition. The method generalizes linear regression probes by learning the space of features of a concept that can be linearly predicted from the representations, and then learning the directions used to encode them. We demonstrate the probe on representations of time and space in Llama 2-7b, finding manifolds which linearly represent an interpretable set of features in each case. In the case of time, we show that by steering along the manifold, we can influence the model's completions about the years in which famous songs, movies and books were released, providing evidence that the Manifold Probe can discover manifolds which are causally involved in model behaviour.

</details>


### [280] [Randomized Advantage Transformation (RAT): Computing Natural Policy Gradients via Direct Backpropagation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18591)
*Mingfei Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出RAT方法，通过Woodbury公式将正则化自然策略梯度重构为带有变换优势函数的普通策略梯度，利用随机块Kaczmarz迭代高效计算，避免了显式Fisher矩阵构建，在保持实现简单的同时性能匹配或超越现有自然梯度方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自然策略梯度虽然通过考虑分布空间几何特性改进优化，但其实际应用受限于Fisher矩阵估计和求逆的高昂计算成本，限制了其在实际强化学习任务中的使用。

Method: 提出随机优势变换（RAT）：1）应用Woodbury公式将Tikhonov正则化自然策略梯度重构为带有变换优势函数的普通策略梯度；2）通过随机块Kaczmarz迭代在策略小批量数据上高效计算变换；3）避免显式Fisher矩阵构建、共轭梯度求解器和架构特定近似；4）支持直接反向传播。

Result: 提供了RAT的收敛性保证；在连续控制和视觉控制基准测试上，RAT匹配或超越已建立的自然梯度方法性能；方法实现简单且兼容多种网络架构。

Conclusion: RAT成功解决了自然策略梯度计算成本高的问题，通过巧妙的数学重构和随机优化算法，实现了计算效率与性能的良好平衡，为自然梯度方法在实际强化学习应用中的广泛采用提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Natural policy gradients improve optimization by accounting for the geometry of distribution space, but their practical use is limited by the cost of estimating and inverting the Fisher matrix. We present Randomized Advantage Transformation (RAT), a method for estimating Tikhonov-regularized natural policy gradients via direct backpropagation. By applying the Woodbury formula, we reformulate the regularized natural policy gradients as vanilla policy gradients with a transformed advantage. RAT computes this transformation efficiently via randomized block Kaczmarz iterations on on-policy mini-batches, avoiding explicit Fisher construction, conjugate-gradient solvers, and architecture-specific approximations. We provide convergence guarantees for RAT and demonstrate empirically that it matches or exceeds established natural-gradient methods across continuous and visual control benchmarks, while remaining simple to implement and compatible with various architectures.

</details>


### [281] [AMARIS: A Memory-Augmented Rubric Improvement System for Rubric-Based Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18592)
*Peilin Wu,Xinlu Zhang,Kun Wan,Wentian Zhao,Gang Wu,Xinya Du,Zhiyu Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: AMARIS通过引入持久化评估记忆机制，将基于评分规则（rubric）的奖励塑造从无状态的单步启发式方法转变为证据驱动的循环，仅增加约5%的时间开销便显著提升了RL微调LLM的效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的自适应评分规则方法仅利用当前的局部信号（如当前步的rollout或成对比较），在使用后即丢弃评估诊断信息。这导致系统无法长期积累和战略性地重用评估知识，必须从头重新推导评估原则，难以检测重复出现的次优行为，也无法形成类似课程学习的训练进度。

Method: 提出AMARIS框架，将评分规则修改建立在长期训练历史之上。具体包括：（1）分析每个rollout并将发现聚合为步骤级摘要；（2）通过静态（近期步骤）和动态（语义匹配）检索从持久化评估记忆中获取相关历史上下文；（3）基于积累的分析更新评分规则。整个过程以异步方式与正常RL循环并行运行，开销极小。

Result: 在封闭域和开放域的实验中，AMARIS一致性地优于基线方法。消融研究表明：静态和动态记忆检索都对性能提升有贡献，两者结合效果最佳；中等检索预算即可获得大部分增益；整个流程通过异步执行仅增加约5%的时间开销。

Conclusion: 持久化评估记忆能够将基于评分规则的奖励塑造从无状态、逐步的启发式方法转变为RL训练中证据驱动的闭环，证明了长期积累和重用评估知识对LLM微调的有效性和实用性。

Abstract: Rubric-based reward shaping is an effective method for fine-tuning LLMs via RL, where structured rubrics decompose standard outcome rewards into multiple dimensions to provide richer reward signals. Recent works make the rubrics adaptive based on local signals such as the rollouts from the current step or pairwise comparisons. However, these methods discard the diagnostics produced during evaluation after immediate use and prevent the long-term accumulation and strategic reuse of evaluation knowledge. This forces the system to re-derive evaluation principles from scratch, limits its ability to detect recurring suboptimal behaviors, and forfeits the curriculum-like progression that a persistent training history would naturally support. To address these limitations, we introduce AMARIS, which grounds rubric modifications in long-term training history. At each training step, AMARIS analyzes individual rollouts, aggregates findings into step-level summaries, retrieves relevant historical context from a persistent evaluation memory through both static (recent steps) and dynamic (semantically matched) retrieval, and updates rubrics based on these accumulated analyses. This procedure runs asynchronously alongside the normal RL loop with minimal overhead. Experiments across both closed and open-ended domains show that AMARIS consistently outperforms the baselines. Ablation studies show that static and dynamic memory retrieval contributes to the performance gain and their combination provides the strongest results with moderate retrieval budgets sufficient to provide most of the gain, and that the entire pipeline adds only ~5\% time overhead through asynchronous execution. These results show that persistent evaluation memory can transform rubric-based reward shaping from a stateless, per-step heuristic into an evidence-driven loop for RL training.

</details>


### [282] [Stochastic Penalty-Barrier Methods for Constrained Machine Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18618)
*Adam Bosák,Andrii Kliachkin,Jana Lepšová,Gilles Bareilles,Jakub Mareček*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了随机惩罚-障碍法（SPBM），这是首个能够处理深度学习中非凸、非光滑、随机约束优化问题的通用方法，在多达10,000个约束下仅引入线性运行开销，性能匹配或优于现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 约束机器学习在公平性训练、物理信息神经网络和符号知识融合中至关重要，但现有方法无法有效处理深度学习中自然产生的非凸、非光滑、随机约束优化场景，缺乏通用的求解方法。

Method: 通过指数对偶平均、稳定化的惩罚调度以及Moreau包络技术，将经典的惩罚和障碍方法扩展到非凸、非光滑、随机设置，从而能够有效处理约束违规和非光滑性。

Result: 在多个实验场景中，SPBM的性能匹配或超越现有的约束优化基线方法；相比无约束Adam优化器，在处理多达10,000个约束时仅产生线性运行时间开销。

Conclusion: SPBM为深度学习中的约束优化问题提供了一个通用、高效且可扩展的解决方案，填补了非凸、非光滑、随机环境下约束优化的方法空白。

Abstract: Constrained machine learning enables fairness-aware training, physics-informed neural networks, and integration of symbolic domain knowledge into statistical models. Despite its practical importance, no general method exists for the non-convex, non-smooth, stochastic setting that arises naturally in deep learning. We propose the Stochastic Penalty-Barrier Method (SPBM), which extends classical penalty and barrier methods to this setting via exponential dual averaging, a~stabilized penalty schedule, and the Moreau envelope to handle non-smoothness. Experiments across multiple settings show that SPBM matches or outperforms existing constrained optimization baselines while incurring only linear runtime overhead compared to unconstrained Adam for up to 10,000 constraints.

</details>


### [283] [Position: Weight Space Should Be a First-Class Generative AI Modality](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18632)
*Zhangyang Wang,Peihao Wang,Kai Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文主张将神经网络检查点视为一等数据模态，并将权重空间的生成式建模标准化为核心机器学习原语，以实现从“逐任务优化模型”到“从学习到的权重分布中采样模型”的范式转变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数百万已训练的模型权重向量已成为大规模数据资源，且最新研究表明可按需合成神经权重，在匹配微调性能的同时大幅降低适配成本。作者认为高性能模型在权重空间中占据低维、高度结构化的区域，因此应将模型检查点作为核心数据模态进行系统研究与标准化。

Method: 基于高性能模型在权重空间中的结构特性（对称性、平坦性、模块化、共享子空间等），提出将现有方法组织为五阶段流水线框架，并对适配器规模和条件生成等已具实用性的应用进行系统综述，同时明确当前方法在无限制前沿规模检查点合成方面的局限性。

Result: 系统梳理了权重空间生成式建模的理论基础与五阶段流水线方法论，总结了在适配器规模与条件生成领域的实用进展，并明确指出无限制的前沿规模检查点合成仍为开放问题。

Conclusion: 呼吁研究社区将默认思维从“逐任务优化模型”转向“从学习到的权重分布中采样模型”，加速迈向AI系统常规性地改进或创造其他AI系统的新时代。

Abstract: Neural network checkpoints have quietly become a large-scale data resource: millions of trained weight vectors now exist, each encoding task-, domain-, and architecture-specific knowledge. This position paper argues that model checkpoints should be treated as a first-class data modality, and that generative modeling in weight space should be standardized as a core machine learning primitive. Recent advances demonstrate that neural weights can be synthesized on demand, often matching fine-tuning performance while reducing adaptation cost by orders of magnitude. We contend that these results reflect an underlying structural fact: high-performing models occupy low-dimensional, highly structured regions of weight space shaped by symmetry, flatness, modularity, and shared subspaces. Building on this view, we organize existing methods into a five-stage pipeline, survey applications where the approach is already practical, and clarify current limits: adapter-scale and conditional generation are advancing rapidly, while unrestricted frontier-scale checkpoint synthesis remains open. Our goal is to shift the community's default mindset from optimizing models per task to sampling models from learned weight distributions, accelerating toward an era in which AI systems routinely improve or create other AI systems.

</details>


### [284] [Offline Contextual Bandits in the Presence of New Actions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18509)
*Ren Kishimoto,Tatsuhiro Shimizu,Kazuki Kawamura,Takanori Muroi,Yusuke Narita,Yuki Sasamoto,Kei Tateno,Takuma Udagawa,Yuta Saito*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对离线策略学习（OPL）中新动作（部署后新增的动作）无法有效选择的问题，提出了PONA算法。该算法通过融合LCPI估计器和DR估计器，实现了对现有动作和新动作的联合优化选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的离线策略学习（OPL）方法旨在从已有动作集中选择最优动作，但在实际应用（如推荐系统、搜索引擎）中，动作空间会随时间持续变化，部署后出现的新动作由于缺乏历史数据，现有方法无法有效学习和选择这些新动作。

Method: 作者首先提出了局部组合伪逆（LCPI）估计器，用于估计策略梯度，它推广了原本用于板岩老虎机离线评估的伪逆估计器，通过控制奖励建模条件与动作特征数据收集条件之间的权衡，捕捉动作特征不同维度间的交互效应。随后，提出了名为“面向有效新动作的策略优化”（PONA）的广义算法，将擅长新动作选择的LCPI与擅长现有动作学习的双重稳健（DR）估计器进行加权求和融合，通过权重参数调节新动作选择的比例。

Result: 大量实验表明，PONA算法能够高效地选择新动作，同时保持整体策略性能。相比之下，大多数现有方法因无法选择新动作而导致性能受限。

Conclusion: 本研究成功解决了离线策略学习中动态动作空间下新动作选择的关键难题，所提出的PONA算法通过整合LCPI和DR估计器的优势，在实际应用中展现了良好的有效性与实用性。

Abstract: Automated decision-making algorithms drive applications such as recommendation systems and search engines. These algorithms often rely on off-policy contextual bandits or off-policy learning (OPL). Conventionally, OPL selects actions that maximize the expected reward from an existing action set. However, in many real-world scenarios, actions, such as news articles or video content, change continuously, and the action space evolves over time after data collection. We define actions introduced after deploying the logging policy as new actions and focus on OPL with new actions. Existing OPL methods identify optimal actions from the existing set effectively but cannot learn and select new actions because no relevant data are logged. To address this limitation, we propose a new OPL method that leverages action features. We first introduce the Local Combination PseudoInverse (LCPI) estimator for the policy gradient, generalizing the PseudoInverse estimator initially proposed for off-policy evaluation of slate bandits. LCPI controls the trade-off between reward-modeling condition and the condition for data collection regarding the action features, capturing the interaction effects among different dimensions of action features. Furthermore, we propose a generalized algorithm called Policy Optimization for Effective New Actions (PONA), which integrates LCPI, a component specialized for new action selection, with Doubly Robust (DR), which excels at learning within existing actions. We define PONA as a weighted sum of the LCPI and DR estimators, optimizing both the selection of existing and new actions, and allowing the proportion of new action selections to be adjusted by the weight parameter. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate that PONA efficiently selects new actions while maintaining the overall policy performance as opposed to most existing methods that cannot select new actions.

</details>


### [285] [Data Presentation Over Architecture: Resampling Strategies for Credit Risk Prediction with Tabular Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18635)
*Aditya Tanna,Mitul Solanki,Mohamed Bouadi,Nassim Bouarour,Pratinav Seth,Vinay Kumar Sankarapu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在信用违约预测任务中，上下文构建策略（如平衡采样）比表格基础模型（TFM）的架构选择对性能影响更大，合理构建上下文可使TFM达到全量数据训练的经典模型水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 信用违约预测是一个具有严重类别不平衡、异构特征和严格延迟要求的表格学习问题。表格基础模型（TFM）通过上下文学习解决此问题，但其预测结果对上下文窗口的构建方式非常敏感。为了理解如何有效部署TFM，需要系统研究上下文构建策略对模型性能的影响。

Method: 在Home Credit和Lending Club两个数据集上，对四种经典模型和五种TFM进行基准测试。实验变化维度包括：七种上下文构建策略、上下文规模从1K到50K样本。通过方差分析量化不同因素对AUC-ROC的贡献度，并比较不同采样策略与模型架构的性能差异。

Result: 上下文策略选择对AUC-ROC的方差贡献超过TFM模型家族的选择：平衡采样和混合采样比均匀采样提升3-4个AUC点，该差距超过不同TFM模型间的性能差异。使用5K到10K样本的平衡上下文，最强TFM可达到在全量数据上训练的经典基线模型的AUC水平，同时还能恢复默认阈值GBDT无法达到的有意义的违约类召回率。

Conclusion: 在不平衡信用风险场景中，上下文构建（而非架构选择）是TFM部署的主要调节杠杆。这为TFM在实际信用评估任务中的应用提供了重要指导，强调了数据采样策略优化的关键作用。

Abstract: Credit default prediction is a tabular learning problem with severe class imbalance, heterogeneous features, and tight latency budgets. Tabular Foundation Models (TFMs) approach this problem through in-context learning, which makes their predictions sensitive to how the context window is built. We benchmark four classical models and five TFMs on the Home Credit and Lending Club datasets, varying the context-construction strategy (seven options) and the context size (1K to 50K). On both datasets, the choice of context strategy explains more variance in AUC-ROC than the choice of TFM family: balanced and hybrid sampling add 3 to 4 AUC points over uniform sampling, and the gap exceeds the spread between TFMs. With a balanced context of 5K to 10K examples, the strongest TFMs reach the AUC of classical baselines trained on the full data, while also recovering meaningful default-class recall that default-threshold GBDTs do not. We frame this as evidence that context construction, rather than architecture choice, is the primary deployment lever for TFMs in imbalanced credit-risk settings.

</details>


### [286] [XCTFormer: Leveraging Cross-Channel and Cross-Time Dependencies for Enhanced Time-Series Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18534)
*Israel Zexer,Omri Azencot*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对通道独立模型在多变量时间序列分析中表现优于通道依赖模型的反常现象，本文提出XCTFormer模型，通过显式建模跨时间和跨通道依赖关系，在填充任务上达到SOTA性能，MSE和MAE分别比次优方法平均提升20.8%和15.3%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多变量时间序列变量通常来自共享上下文，理论上存在可利用的潜在依赖关系。然而研究发现通道独立(CI)模型常优于显式建模依赖关系的通道依赖(CD)模型，表明现有CD模型在捕获依赖关系方面存在局限，且近期方法多采用间接建模策略导致遗漏有意义的依赖关系。

Method: 提出基于Transformer的通道依赖模型XCTFormer，包含三个核心组件：(i)数据处理模块，(ii)新型跨关系注意力块(CRAB)，通过增强注意力机制以token-to-token方式显式建模跨时间和跨通道的成对依赖关系，提升模型容量和表达能力，(iii)可选的依赖压缩插件(DeCoP)以提高可扩展性。

Result: 在三个时间序列基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，XCTFormer相比广泛认可的基线模型取得优异结果。特别在填充任务上达到SOTA性能，MSE平均比次优方法提升20.8%，MAE平均提升15.3%。

Conclusion: 通过显式建模跨时间和跨通道依赖关系，XCTFormer成功解决了现有通道依赖模型的局限性，证明了充分挖掘变量间依赖关系可以显著提升多变量时间序列分析性能，为通道依赖建模提供了新的有效范式。

Abstract: Multivariate time-series analysis involves extracting informative representations from sequences of multiple interdependent variables, supporting tasks such as forecasting, imputation, and anomaly detection. In real-world scenarios, these variables are typically collected from a shared context or underlying phenomenon, suggesting the presence of latent dependencies across time and channels that can be leveraged to improve performance. However, recent findings show that channel-independent (CI) models, which assume no inter-variable dependencies, often outperform channel-dependent (CD) models that explicitly model such relationships. This surprising result indicates that current CD models may not fully exploit their potential due to limitations in how dependencies are captured. Recent studies have revisited channel dependence modeling with various approaches; however, these methods often employ indirect modeling strategies, which can lead to meaningful dependencies being overlooked. To address this issue, we introduce XCTFormer, a transformer-based channel-dependent (CD) model that explicitly captures cross-temporal and cross-channel dependencies via an enhanced attention mechanism. The model operates in a token-to-token fashion, modeling pairwise dependencies between every pair of tokens across time and channels. The architecture comprises (i) a data processing module, (ii) a novel Cross-Relational Attention Block (CRAB) that increases capacity and expressiveness, and (iii) an optional Dependency Compression Plugin (DeCoP) that improves scalability. Through extensive experiments on three time-series benchmarks, we show that XCTFormer achieves strong results compared to widely recognized baselines; in particular, it attains state-of-the-art performance on the imputation task, outperforming the second-best method by an average of 20.8% in MSE and 15.3% in MAE.

</details>


### [287] [Post-Trained MoE Can Skip Half Experts via Self-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18643)
*Xingtai Lv,Li Sheng,Kaiyan Zhang,Yichen You,Siyan Gao,Xueheng Luo,Yuxin Zuo,Yuchen Fan,Junlin Yang,Ganqu Cui,Bingning Wang,Fan Yang,Youbang Sun,Ning Ding,Bowen Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ZEDA框架，通过注入零输出专家和两阶段自蒸馏，将已训练的静态MoE模型低成本转换为动态MoE模型，在保持精度的同时消除超过50%的专家FLOPs并实现约1.20倍推理加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的动态MoE方法通常需要从头预训练或针对特定任务进行适应，而对于将已完全训练的MoE模型转换为动态版本的研究不足。实现这种转换可以直接降低推理成本，让简单token在服务过程中绕过不必要的专家。

Method: 提出Zero-Expert Self-Distillation Adaptation (ZEDA)框架：1) 向每个MoE层注入无参数的零输出专家以稳定架构转换；2) 采用两阶段自蒸馏方法，将原始MoE作为冻结教师模型；3) 应用组级平衡损失来适应增强后的模型。

Result: 在Qwen3-30B-A3B和GLM-4.7-Flash模型上，跨越数学、代码和指令遵循等11个基准测试：1) 以极小的精度损失消除了超过50%的专家FLOPs；2) 在两个模型上分别超越最强动态MoE基线6.1和4.0个百分点；3) 实现约1.20倍的端到端推理加速。

Conclusion: ZEDA成功实现了静态MoE到动态MoE的低成本转换，为降低已部署MoE模型的推理成本提供了实用解决方案，在多个基准和模型上验证了其有效性和实用性。

Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) scales language models efficiently through sparse expert activation, and its dynamic variant further reduces computation by adjusting the activated experts in an input-dependent manner. Existing dynamic MoE methods usually rely on pre-training from scratch or task-specific adaptation, leaving the practical conversion of fully trained MoE underexplored. Enabling such adaptation would directly alleviate the inference costs by allowing easy tokens to bypass unnecessary expert during serving. This paper introduces Zero-Expert Self-Distillation Adaptation (ZEDA), a low-cost framework that transforms post-trained static MoE models into efficient dynamic ones. To stabilize this architectural conversion, ZEDA injects parameter-free zero-output experts into each MoE layer and adapts the augmented model through two-stage self-distillation, utilizing the original MoE as a frozen teacher and applying a group-level balancing loss. On Qwen3-30B-A3B and GLM-4.7-Flash across 11 benchmarks spanning math, code, and instruction following, ZEDA eliminates over 50% of expert FLOPs at marginal accuracy loss. It outperforms the strongest dynamic MoE baseline by 6.1 and 4.0 points on the two models, and delivers ~1.20$\times$ end-to-end inference speedup.

</details>


### [288] [An Assessment of Human vs. Model Uncertainty in Soft-Label Learning and Calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18648)
*Maja Pavlovic,Silviu Paun,Massimo Poesio*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过受控实验发现，人类软标签的主要价值在于作为正则化器改善模型校准和训练稳定性，而非之前研究认为的隐式纠正标签错误。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究将人类软标签带来的校准改善与隐式的标签错误纠正（模式偏移）混淆，导致无法确定软标签本身的真实效果。作者旨在解耦这两个因素，厘清人类软标签相较于合成标签的实际价值。

Method: 在MNIST及其合成变体数据集上重新标注子集以获取人类不确定性，通过控制实验将软标签监督与底层标签模式偏移解耦，并使用数据集制图技术分析模型与人类不确定性的对齐程度。

Result: 人类软标签确实能带来准确率提升，但其更大价值在于作为正则化器：改善模型在困难样本上的校准性能，并促进不同训练轮次间的稳定收敛。基于人类软标签训练的模型能够反映人类不确定性，而合成标签训练的模型则无法与人类对齐。

Conclusion: 人类软标签的核心价值在于促进人机不确定性对齐，而非简单纠正错误标签。本研究提供了一个人机不确定性对齐的诊断测试平台，为构建人类对齐的AI系统提供了方法论基础。

Abstract: Central to human-aligned AI is understanding the benefits of human-elicited labels over synthetic alternatives. While human soft-labels improve calibration by capturing uncertainty, prior studies conflate these benefits with the implicit correction of mislabeled data (mode shifts), obscuring true effects of soft-labels. We present a controlled audit of soft-label learning across MNIST and a synthetic variant, re-annotating subsets to extract human uncertainty. By decoupling soft-label supervision from underlying label mode shifts, we show that while human soft-labels do provide accuracy gains, their larger value lies in acting as a regularizer that improves model calibration on difficult samples and promotes stable convergence across training runs. Dataset cartography reveals models trained on human soft-labels mirror human uncertainty, whereas those trained on synthetic labels fail to align with humans. Broadly, this work provides a diagnostic testbed for human-AI uncertainty alignment.

</details>


### [289] [Pocket Foundation Models: Distilling TFMs into CPU-Ready Gradient-Boosted Trees](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18654)
*Aditya Tanna,Nassim Bouarour,Mohamed Bouadi,Vinay kumar Sankarapu,Pratinav Seth*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种将表格基础模型（TFM）蒸馏为XGBoost/CatBoost的方法，解决了欺诈检测等实时场景下的推理速度瓶颈，在CPU上实现了38x-860x的加速，同时保持了教师模型96.5%的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表格基础模型（TFM）虽然性能优越，但推理速度慢（151-1275ms），无法满足欺诈检测等实时应用场景的毫秒级响应需求（<2ms）。现有的蒸馏方法直接应用于TFM时，由于上下文学习（ICL）教师在评分自身训练集时存在标签泄露问题，导致软目标退化为近似独热向量，无法有效传递类别间的结构信息。

Method: 提出分层袋外（Stratified Out-of-Fold, OOF）教师标注方法解决ICL教师的标签泄露问题。具体做法是：1）将训练数据分层划分为多个折（fold）；2）对每个折，使用其他折训练的教师模型进行预测标注；3）确保教师模型不对自身训练数据进行评分，从而避免标签泄露。在此框架下，将TabICLv2等TFM教师模型蒸馏为XGBoost或CatBoost学生模型，学生模型可原生运行在CPU上。

Result: 在153个分类数据集（来自TALENT、OpenML-CC18、TabZilla和TabArena）上进行了广泛实验：1）蒸馏后的XGBoost达到0.882 macro-mean AUC（教师AUC的96.5%），CPU推理时间仅1.9ms，实现38x到860x的加速；2）统计显著性优于调优的CatBoost基线（Wilcoxon p=0.0008，胜率51%）；3）低维数据（<21特征）上增益更明显（+0.011 vs +0.001）；4）多教师平均对MLP学生有帮助（+0.006），但对树模型学生增益微弱；5）在高维任务上，当教师本身不如CatBoost时，蒸馏反而会降低性能。

Conclusion: 分层OOF蒸馏方法成功解决了ICL教师的标签泄露问题，使得表格基础模型能够高效迁移到轻量级树模型中。该方法在保持高预测性能的同时实现了大幅推理加速，尤其适用于低维数据的实时应用场景。完整流程已在TabTune库中开源。

Abstract: A fraud scorer needs to answer in under 2 ms. The best tabular foundation models (TFMs) take 151-1,275 ms on GPU. We close this gap by distilling the TFM offline into an XGBoost or CatBoost student that runs natively on CPU. The central obstacle is specific to in-context learning (ICL) teachers: they leak labels when scoring their own training set, so the soft targets collapse to near-one-hot vectors with no inter-class structure left to distill. Stratified out-of-fold (OOF) teacher labeling prevents this. Across 153 classification datasets drawn from TALENT, OpenML-CC18, TabZilla, and TabArena, distilling TabICLv2 into XGBoost gives 0.882 macro-mean AUC (96.5% of teacher AUC) at 1.9 ms on CPU, a 38x to 860x speedup across teacher-student pairs with a statistically significant edge over a tuned CatBoost baseline (Wilcoxon p = 0.0008; 51% win rate). Four further findings: teacher rank transfers exactly to student rank; gains concentrate on low-dimensional data (< 21 features: +0.011 over CatBoost vs. >21 features: +0.001); multi-teacher averaging helps MLP students (+0.006, p = 0.003) but adds less than 0.001 for tree students; and on high-dimensional tasks where the teacher itself trails CatBoost, distillation makes things worse rather than better. The full pipeline is open-sourced as part of the TabTune library.

</details>


### [290] [Protein Fold Classification at Scale: Benchmarking and Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18552)
*Dexiong Chen,Andrei Manolache,Mathias Niepert,Karsten Borgwardt*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文构建了大规模、无冗余的蛋白质折叠分类基准TEDBench，并提出自监督框架MiAE，通过高达90%的掩码比例和SE(3)不变编码器实现高效学习，显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 蛋白质拓扑分类对理解生物功能至关重要，但该领域的发展受限于两个瓶颈：一是缺乏避免重复的大规模基准数据集，二是现有模型难以有效扩展。

Method: 提出掩码不变自编码器（MiAE），一种用于蛋白质结构表示学习的自监督框架。MiAE采用高达90%的极高掩码比例，结合SE(3)不变编码器和轻量级解码器，从潜在表示和掩码令牌重建骨架坐标。

Result: 在TEDBench上，MiAE扩展性良好，性能优于监督学习方法和最先进的基线模型。在基于CATH v4.4实验结构的精选数据集上的迁移测试也验证了其有效性。

Conclusion: TEDBench填补了大规模无冗余基准的空白，MiAE为蛋白质折叠分类提供了一种强有力的解决方案，证明了高掩码比例与SE(3)不变性结合的有效性。

Abstract: Classifying protein topology is essential for deciphering biological function, but progress is held back by the lack of large-scale benchmarks that avoid duplicates and by models that do not scale well. We introduce TEDBench, a large-scale, non-redundant benchmark for protein fold classification constructed from the Encyclopedia of Domains (TED) and Foldseek-clustered AlphaFold structures. We show that on TEDBench, current protein representation learning methods either require very large models or fail to deliver strong performance. To address this challenge, we propose Masked Invariant Autoencoders (MiAE), a self-supervised framework for protein structure representation learning. MiAE uses an extremely high masking ratio of up to 90% with an $\mathrm{SE(3)}$-invariant encoder and a lightweight decoder that reconstructs backbone coordinates from the latent representation and mask tokens. MiAE scales well and outperforms supervised counterparts and state-of-the-art baselines on TEDBench, establishing a strong recipe for protein fold classification. To test transfer beyond AlphaFold structures, we further benchmark on a curated dataset from experimental structures of CATH v4.4. TEDBench is available at https://github.com/BorgwardtLab/TEDBench.

</details>


### [291] [KairosHope: A Next-Generation Time-Series Foundation Model for Specialized Classification via Dual-Memory Architecture](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18657)
*Luis Balderas,José Alberto Rodríguez,Miguel Lastra,Antonio Arauzo-Azofra,José M. Benítez*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了KairosHope模型，通过引入HOPE块（双记忆系统）和混合决策头（融合深度特征与统计特征），解决了时间序列基础模型在分类任务中计算成本高和缺乏统计归纳偏置的问题，在严格时间因果性的领域表现出色。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的时间序列基础模型（TSFMs）在通用预测任务上表现成功，但在适应专业化分类问题时面临两大瓶颈：标准注意力机制的计算复杂度高（二次方增长），以及在模型设计中系统性忽略了经典统计知识，限制了模型的性能和泛化能力。

Method: 提出了KairosHope模型，其核心包含：(1) HOPE块架构，用双记忆系统替代二次注意力机制：Titans模块负责动态短期记忆保留，连续记忆系统（CMS）负责长期历史上下文抽象；(2) 混合决策头，将深度潜在表示与通过tsfeatures包提取的确定性统计特征相融合；(3) 采用自监督预训练（结合掩码时间序列建模MTSM和对比学习InfoNCE）于Monash数据集，并通过线性探测与全量微调（LP-FT）协议在UCR基准数据集上进行适配，以防止灾难性遗忘。

Result: 在具有严格时间因果性的领域（如人类活动识别HAR和传感器数据）的实证结果显示，KairosHope取得了优越的分类性能，证明了该方法在平衡大规模泛化能力与分析精度方面的有效性。

Conclusion: KairosHope建立了一个稳健且高效的框架，成功实现了基础模型向时间序列分类任务的适配，为解决计算效率与统计知识融合问题提供了新的技术路径。

Abstract: Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) have demonstrated notable success in general-purpose forecasting tasks; however, their adaptation to specialized classification problems remains constrained by the computational bottleneck of standard attention and the systematic omission of classical statistical knowledge. This technical report introduces KairosHope, a next-generation TSFM designed to reconcile massive generalization with analytical precision in classification tasks. The core of the proposal is the HOPE block, an architecture that replaces quadratic attention with a dual-memory system: Titans modules for dynamic short-term retention and a Continuum Memory System (CMS) for the abstraction of long-term historical context. To enrich the inductive bias, a Hybrid Decision Head is introduced, which fuses deep latent representations with deterministic statistical features extracted via tsfeatures package. KairosHope undergoes self-supervised pre-training on the massive Monash archive, combining Masked Time Series Modeling (MTSM) and contrastive learning (InfoNCE). Its subsequent adaptation to the UCR benchmark datasets is conducted through a rigorous Linear Probing and Full Fine-Tuning (LP-FT) protocol to prevent catastrophic forgetting. Empirical results demonstrate superior performance in domains characterized by strict temporal causality such as HAR or Sensor data. Consequently, KairosHope establishes a robust and efficient framework for the adaptation of foundation models to time series analysis.

</details>


### [292] [Federated Martingale Posterior Samping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18554)
*Boning Zhang,Matteo Zecchin,Mingzhao Guo,Dongzhu Liu,Osvaldo Simeone*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出联邦鞅后验（FMP）采样方法，通过让客户端上传可训练的数据嵌入到服务器，实现了无需共享原始数据的分布式贝叶斯推断，显著提升了模型校准性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦贝叶斯神经网络在确定参数先验和似然时面临困难，特别是对于现代过参数化模型，先验设定不当会严重影响模型的准确性和校准。虽然鞅后验（预测贝叶斯）方法可以避免先验-似然对的设定，但直接将其应用于联邦学习需要客户端共享本地数据集，这违反了隐私保护原则。

Method: 提出联邦鞅后验（FMP）采样方法，这是一种一次性、高度并行的协议。具体而言，每个客户端上传一组小的可训练数据嵌入（embeddings），服务器端集中运行预测采样器，从而避免了直接共享本地数据，实现了隐私保护下的分布式贝叶斯推断。

Result: 在MNIST、CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100数据集上的实验表明，FMP能够紧密匹配集中式对应方法的性能，并且相较于共识式（consensus-style）基线方法，显著提升了模型的校准能力。

Conclusion: FMP成功地将鞅后验采样扩展到联邦学习场景，在保护数据隐私的同时，解决了传统联邦贝叶斯神经网络先验设定困难的问题，并有效提升了模型的校准性能。

Abstract: Federated Bayesian neural networks require fixing a prior on the model parameters together with a likelihood. Eliciting meaningful priors on the weight space of modern overparameterized models is notoriously difficult, and misspecification of either component can severely degrade accuracy and calibration. Motivated by the rapid progress of predictive models such as large language models, the martingale posterior, also known as predictive Bayes, replaces the prior--likelihood pair with a predictive distribution and recovers parameter uncertainty by repeatedly drawing predictive samples and refitting the model. A direct federated implementation, however, would require clients to share the local data sets. This letter proposes {federated martingale posterior} (FMP) sampling, a one-shot embarrassingly parallel protocol in which each client uploads a small set of trainable data embeddings and the server runs the predictive sampler centrally. Experiments on MNIST, CIFAR-10, and CIFAR-100 show that FMP closely matches the centralized counterpart and significantly improves calibration over consensus-style baselines.

</details>


### [293] [COOPO: Cyclic Offline-Online Policy Optimization Algorithm](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18675)
*Qisai Liu,Zhanhong Jiang,Joshua Russell Waite,Aditya Balu,Cody Fleming,Soumik Sarkar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了COOPO框架，通过在离线约束训练和在线微调之间循环迭代，解决了混合离线-在线强化学习中的分布漂移和灾难性遗忘问题，在减少在线交互次数的同时提升了最终性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离线强化学习受限于静态数据集，存在分布偏移和性能受限问题；在线强化学习需要大量环境交互；现有的混合离线-在线方法在过渡阶段存在分布漂移和离线知识灾难性遗忘的问题。

Method: COOPO采用循环框架，交替进行两个阶段：（1）通过KL正则化的优势加权离线更新，将策略锚定到数据集以最小化分布偏移；（2）使用任意策略优化方法进行在线微调以实现稳定探索。周期性地返回离线训练可消除遗忘和漂移，最大化数据集重用。

Result: 在标准覆盖假设下，COOPO理论上保证了单调改进和更好的在线样本效率。在D4RL基准测试中，相比最先进的混合方法，COOPO减少了在线交互次数，同时提高了最终回报，并在不同的离线算法和在线优化器间保持鲁棒性。

Conclusion: COOPO通过循环协同机制成功解决了离线-在线过渡中的关键挑战，为自适应强化学习建立了新的效率和性能标准，实现了离线知识与在线探索的有效平衡。

Abstract: Offline reinforcement learning struggles with distributional shift and constrained performance due to static dataset limitations, while online RL demands prohibitive environment interactions. The recent advent of hybrid offline-to-online methods bridges these domains but suffers from distribution drift during transitions and catastrophic forgetting of offline knowledge. We introduce COOPO (Cyclic Offline-Online Policy Optimization), a generalized framework that repeatedly cycles between constrained offline training and online fine-tuning. Each cycle first anchors the policy to the dataset via KL-regularized advantage-weighted offline updates to minimize distributional shift and then fine-tunes it online using any policy optimization for stable exploration. Crucially, periodically returning to offline training eliminates forgetting and drift while maximizing dataset reuse. The cyclic behavior also helps reduce the online environment interactions. Theoretically, COOPO achieves better online sample efficiency, surpassing pure online RL, with guaranteed monotonic improvement under standard coverage assumptions. Extensive D4RL benchmarks demonstrate COOPO reduces online interactions versus state-of-the-art hybrids while improving final returns, maintaining robustness across diverse offline algorithms and online optimizers. This looped synergy sets new efficiency and performance standards for adaptive RL.

</details>


### [294] [Self-supervised local learning rules learn the hidden hierarchical structure of high-dimensional data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18557)
*Ariane Delrocq,Wu S. Zihan,Guillaume Bellec,Wulfram Gerstner*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究发现，直接反馈对齐等近似误差传播的局部学习规则无法解决分层任务，而层级自监督对比学习方法能够有效学习数据的分层隐藏结构，且具有与反向传播相当的数据效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大脑能够学习高维感官输入的抽象表示，但实现这种学习的突触可塑性规则尚不明确。本研究旨在探索生物可实现的局部学习规则，以理解神经网络如何学习高维数据的内在分层结构。

Method: 研究在随机分层模型（RHM）这一人工数据集上评估了两类生物可实现的局部学习规则：第一类使用直接反馈信号近似输出层的误差传播；第二类使用层级自监督对比或非对比损失函数，不显式近似输出层误差。

Result: 第一类规则无法解决RHM任务，原因在于缺乏全反向传播中实现的对输入特定非线性（“掩蔽”）机制；第二类算法能够成功学习RHM任务的分层隐藏结构，数据效率与有监督反向传播训练相当，且符合大脑皮层突触可塑性规则。

Conclusion: 层级的自监督对比学习方法为大脑学习抽象表示提供了一种生物学可实现的计算机制，能够有效学习分层结构，而仅依赖直接反馈信号的近似方法不足以支持复杂任务的学习。

Abstract: The brain learns abstract representations of high-dimensional sensory input, but the plasticity rules that enable such learning are unknown. We study biologically plausible algorithms on the Random Hierarchy Model (RHM), an artificial dataset designed to investigate how deep neural networks learn the intrinsic hierarchical structure of high-dimensional data. We focus on two types of local learning rules that avoid both a long convergence time and the use of a symmetric error network. The first type uses direct feedback signals to approximate error propagation from the output layer. The second type uses layerwise self-supervised contrastive or non-contrastive loss functions that do not explicitly approximate errors at the output layer. We show that all rules of the first type fail to solve the tasks of the RHM and trace this failure back to input-specific nonlinearities (`masking') that are implemented in full backpropagation and are essential for learning complex tasks. However, algorithms of the second type are able to learn the hierarchical hidden structure of the RHM tasks and are as data-efficient as supervised backpropagation training, while being compatible with known rules of synaptic plasticity in cortex.

</details>


### [295] [Ensembling Tabular Foundation Models - A Diversity Ceiling And A Calibration Trap](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18696)
*Aditya Tanna,Yash Desai,Pratinav Seth,Mohamed Bouadi,Nassim Bouarour,Vinay Kumar Sankarapu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 表格基础模型集成效果有限。研究发现在153个OpenML分类任务上，最佳集成策略(两级级联堆叠)仅比最佳单一模型提升0.18%准确率，但计算成本高达253倍。推荐贪心选择作为实际默认方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表格基础模型(TFMs)虽然在越来越多的表格任务上匹配或超越调优的梯度提升树，但没有单一TFM能在所有数据集上获胜。集成是常见的解决方案，但研究发现其效果不如预期。作者希望系统地评估不同集成策略在现代TFMs上的实际表现。
