Method: 研究选取了6个现代TFMs，发现它们形成近乎冗余的池(平均成对Q统计量为0.961，接近1，意味着任何凸组合都有上限)。在153个OpenML分类任务上基准测试了6种集成策略：均值集成、投票集成、堆叠集成(逻辑回归元学习器)、两级级联堆叠等。使用Friedman和Nemenyi统计检验分析各方法性能差异的显著性。

Result: 最佳集成方法是两级级联堆叠，相比最佳单一TFM仅提升+0.18%准确率，但需要253倍计算量。Friedman和Nemenyi分析将三个集成方法和最佳基础TFM置于同一等价组；其他三个集成甚至显著差于最佳基础模型。逻辑回归元学习器的堆叠集成在准确率和ROC-AUC上表现竞争，但log-loss排名最差。元学习器通过锐化类别边界提升准确率，但破坏了校准性。

Conclusion: TFMs集成收益有限。由于6个TFMs高度冗余(Q统计量接近1)，凸组合存在理论上限。考虑到计算成本与性能增益的不对称性(253倍计算换取0.18%精度提升)，推荐使用贪心选择作为实际应用的默认策略，而非复杂的集成方法。

Abstract: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) now match or beat tuned gradient-boosted trees on a growing fraction of tabular tasks, but no single TFM wins on every dataset. Ensembling is the go to fix here, and it works less well than expected. Six modern TFMs form a near-redundant pool: their mean pairwise Q-statistic is $0.961$, close enough to $1$ that any convex combination is bounded above. We benchmark six ensemble strategies over six TFMs on 153 OpenML classification tasks. The best ensemble, two-level cascade stacking, buys $+0.18\%$ accuracy over the strongest single TFM at $253\times$ the compute. A Friedman and Nemenyi analysis places three ensembles and the best base TFM in a single equivalence group; three other ensembles are significantly \emph{worse} than the best base. Stacking with a logistic-regression meta-learner is the most striking case: competitive accuracy and ROC-AUC, the worst log-loss rank among the ensembles. The meta-learner improves accuracy by sharpening class boundaries, which destroys calibration. We recommend greedy selection as the practical default.

</details>


### [296] [scHelix: Asymmetric Dual-Stream Integration via Explicit Gene-Level Disentanglement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18576)
*Xichen Yan,Zelin Zang,Changxi Chi,Jingbo Zhou,Chang Yu,Jinlin Wu,Shenghui Cheng,Fuji Yang,Jiebo Luo,Zhen Lei,Stan Z. Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了scHelix，一种自适应的scRNA-seq数据整合框架，通过将基因划分为锚点（Anchors）和变体（Variants）并进行差异处理，在消除批次效应的同时有效保持了生物学保真度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的单细胞RNA测序数据整合方法通常对整个转录组进行统一处理，忽略了批次效应在不同基因上表现出的异质性。这种处理方式往往导致过度校正，从而丢失细微的生物学信号。为了解决消除批次效应与保持生物学真实性之间的关键矛盾，需要一种能够对不同基因进行差异化处理的新方法。

Method: 提出scHelix框架，首先在输入层面将基因显式划分为领域不变的锚点和领域敏感的变体。采用配备停止梯度图缓存的双流稀疏扩散编码器学习多尺度结构表示。核心为非对称的对齐-精炼-融合协议：先将不稳定的变体流对齐到锚点流的鲁棒拓扑，再通过有界残差门控让锚点流吸收去噪细节。这种分治架构防止了捷径学习并确保了稳健的批次去除。

Result: 广泛的基准测试表明，scHelix在单细胞RNA测序数据整合任务中优于现有的最先进方法，成功实现了批次效应的去除与生物学聚类完整性的保持。

Conclusion: scHelix通过创新的数据自适应特征处理方式和双流架构，有效解决了scRNA-seq整合中批次效应去除与生物信号保留之间的平衡问题，为该领域提供了新的技术方案。

Abstract: A critical challenge in single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) integration is resolving the tension between eliminating batch effects and maintaining biological fidelity. While recent evidence indicates that batch effects manifest heterogeneously across genes, most existing methods process the transcriptome uniformly, frequently resulting in over-correction and loss of subtle biological signals. To address this, we present scHelix, a dataset-adaptive framework that fundamentally changes how features are processed by explicitly partitioning genes into domain-invariant Anchors and domain-sensitive Variants at the input level. scHelix utilizes a dual-stream sparse diffusion encoder equipped with stop-gradient graph caching to efficiently learn multi-scale structural representations. The core of our approach is a novel asymmetric Align-Refine-Fuse protocol: the unstable Variant stream is first aligned to the robust topology of the Anchor stream, followed by a conservative refinement phase where the Anchor stream absorbs denoised details via bounded residual gating. This divide-and-conquer architecture prevents shortcut learning and ensures robust batch removal without compromising the integrity of biological clusters. Extensive benchmarking demonstrates that scHelix outperforms state-of-the-art methods.

</details>


### [297] [S2Aligner: Pair-Efficient and Transferable Pre-Training for Sparse Text-Attributed Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18579)
*Yuhan Wang,Haopeng Zhang,Yibo Ding,Jiaqi Yu,Xinyu Zhao,Yuhang Liu,Ziwei Zhang,Xiao Wang,Ruijie Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了S2Aligner框架，一种面向稀疏文本属性图的稀疏感知与结构增强型图-文本预训练方法。通过解耦语义对齐与结构建模、注入拓扑信号并抑制不一致结构信息，以及引入稀疏感知的跨域风险平衡策略，有效解决了文本稀疏导致的监督不足和迁移偏差问题，在多种图域和下游任务中均优于现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的LLM-as-Aligner图文本预训练方法假设节点文本提供充分且可靠的监督信号，但现实中的稀疏文本属性图（TAGs）常面临文本锚点缺失、噪声或不均匀分布的问题。当文本信息薄弱时，图结构必须与弱语义证据对齐，导致结构-语义对应关系不可靠以及稀疏引起的迁移偏差。

Method: S2Aligner将图-文本表示解耦为语义和结构组件，采用结构导向的重构与一致性控制将可靠的拓扑信号注入文本表示，同时抑制文本稀疏情况下的不一致结构信号；引入稀疏感知的跨域风险平衡策略，通过全局-域密度比率校准域风险，并利用图可靠性估计降低不可靠稀疏样本的权重。

Result: 理论分析表明该方法通过控制域风险差异减少了跨域泛化差距；在多种图域、不同稀疏级别和下游任务上的广泛实验表明，S2Aligner始终优于现有基线方法。

Conclusion: S2Aligner通过解耦语义对齐与结构建模，并引入稀疏感知的风险平衡机制，有效提升了稀疏TAGs上的图-文本预训练性能，为构建鲁棒的图基础模型提供了新思路。

Abstract: Pre-training on text-attributed graphs (TAGs) is central to building transferable graph foundation models, where LLM-as-Aligner methods align graph and text representations through the semantic knowledge of large language models. However, these methods usually assume that node texts provide sufficient and reliable supervision, an assumption often violated in real-world sparse TAGs. When textual anchors are missing, noisy, or uneven across domains, graph structures must be aligned with weak semantic evidence, leading to unreliable structure-semantics correspondence and sparsity-induced transfer bias. This paper presents S2Aligner, a sparsity-aware and structure-enhanced LLM-as-Aligner framework for graph-text pre-training on sparse TAGs. The key idea is to decouple semantic alignment from structural modeling, allowing topology-aware signals to enhance alignment without contaminating the shared semantic space. Specifically, S2Aligner decomposes graph-text representations into semantic and structural components, uses structure-oriented reconstruction with consistency control to inject reliable topology cues into text representations, and suppresses inconsistent structural signals under textual sparsity. Moreover, S2Aligner introduces sparsity-aware cross-domain risk balancing, which calibrates domain risks through a global-domain density ratio and downweights unreliable sparse samples via graph reliability estimation. Theoretical analysis shows that this objective reduces cross-domain generalization gaps by controlling domain risk discrepancy. Extensive experiments across diverse graph domains, sparsity levels, and downstream tasks demonstrate that S2Aligner consistently outperforms existing baselines.

</details>


### [298] [Distilling Tabular Foundation Models for Structured Health Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18702)
*Aditya Tanna,Nassim Bouarour,Mohamed Bouadi,Vinay Kumar Sankarapu,Pratinav Seth*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种防止上下文泄漏的知识蒸馏方法，成功将表格基础模型迁移至轻量级模型，在保留预测性能的同时实现了显著的推理加速，适用于医疗场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表格基础模型（TFMs）在医疗数据集上表现优异，但其高昂的推理成本和基础设施需求限制了实际部署。本文旨在探索是否可以通过知识蒸馏将其预测能力迁移到轻量级表格模型中。

Method: 针对上下文TFMs在推理时依赖训练集的特点，指出简单蒸馏会导致上下文泄漏问题。本文采用分层样本外教师标注策略来解决该问题，并在多种教师-学生组合中进行实验。

Result: 在19个医疗数据集、6个TFM教师和4个学生模型族的广泛实验中，蒸馏后的学生模型保留了教师至少90%的AUC，部分情况甚至超越教师；CPU推理速度提升至少26倍，同时保持了关键的校准性和公平性。多教师集成并未持续优于最佳单教师。

Conclusion: 感知泄漏的蒸馏方法是将TFM级预测能力引入推理受限医疗场景的有效途径，实现了性能与效率的良好平衡。

Abstract: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) achieve strong performance on health datasets, but their inference cost and infrastructure requirements limit practical use. We study whether their predictive behavior can be transferred to lightweight tabular models through knowledge distillation. Since in-context TFMs condition on the training set at inference time, naive distillation can introduce context leakage; we address this with stratified out-of-fold teacher labeling. Across $19$ healthcare datasets, $6$ TFM teachers, $4$ student families, and several multi-teacher ensembles, we find that distilled students retain at least $90\%$ of teacher AUC, outperforming teachers in some cases, while running at least $26\times$ faster on CPU and preserving calibration and fairness critical for health applications. Moreover, multi-teacher averaging does not consistently improve over the best single teacher. Leakage-aware distillation is thus a viable route for bringing TFM-quality predictions into inference-constrained health settings.

</details>


### [299] [Pointwise Generalization in Deep Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18598)
*Shaojie Li,Yunbei Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过引入点wise黎曼维度建立了深度神经网络点wise泛化理论框架，该维度基于学习特征表示的特征值推导，推导出的泛化界比现有方法（基于模型大小、范数乘积、无限宽线性化）紧致数个数量级，能够更好地解释深度网络的泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对深度神经网络泛化能力这一根本性问题，现有理论难以刻画丰富的非线性特征学习机制，本文旨在突破长期存在的理论障碍，为表示学习建立新的统计基础。

Method: 针对每个训练模型，通过跨层学习特征表示的特征值推导点wise黎曼维度（pointwise Riemannian Dimension），以此建立依赖假设、感知表示的泛化界理论框架。

Result: 理论层面识别了深度网络可处理性的结构特性和数学原理；实验层面发现点wise黎曼维度展现显著特征压缩、随过参数化程度增加而降低、能捕捉优化器的隐式偏置；所提泛化界在理论和实验上均比现有方法紧致数个数量级。

Conclusion: 深度网络在实际场景中具有数学可处理性，其泛化能力可以由点wise、特征谱感知的复杂度精确解释，为表示学习提供了新的理论框架。

Abstract: We address the fundamental question of why deep neural networks generalize by establishing a pointwise generalization theory for fully connected networks. This framework resolves long-standing barriers to characterizing the rich nonlinear feature-learning regime and builds a new statistical foundation for representation learning. For each trained model, we characterize the hypothesis via a pointwise Riemannian Dimension, derived from the eigenvalues of the learned feature representations across layers. This establishes a principled framework for deriving hypothesis-dependent, representation-aware generalization bounds. These bounds offer a systematic upgrade over approaches based on model size, products of norms, and infinite-width linearizations, yielding guarantees that are orders of magnitude tighter in both theory and experiment. Analytically, we identify the structural properties and mathematical principles that explain the tractability of deep networks. Empirically, the pointwise Riemannian Dimension exhibits substantial feature compression, decreases with increased over-parameterization, and captures the implicit bias of optimizers. Taken together, our results indicate that deep networks are mathematically tractable in practical regimes and that their generalization is sharply explained by pointwise, feature-spectrum-aware complexity.

</details>


### [300] [Physics-Aligned Canonical Equivariant Fourier Neural Operator under Symmetry-Induced Shifts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18606)
*Jiaxiao Xu,Changhong Mou,Yeyu Zhang,Fengxiang He*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出PACE-FNO框架，利用连续对称性将坐标对齐与物理演化解耦，在周期域PDE上显著降低了平移和伽利略变换下的分布外（OOD）误差，降幅最高达12倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准神经算子逼近PDE解映射时不尊重控制方程的对称性。在分布外（OOD）场景下，网络需在单一映射中同时学习坐标对齐与物理演化，这损害了泛化能力。研究旨在利用演化方程已知的连续对称性，将这两个角色分离以提升泛化性能。

Method: 提出物理对齐规范等变傅里叶神经算子（PACE-FNO）：首先用李代数坐标估计器估计输入坐标系；将场映射到参考系；应用标准傅里叶神经算子（FNO）；最后将预测恢复到目标坐标系。通过对称性扰动联合训练对齐与算子预测，可选用低维精修在推理时更新估计坐标。等变性由输入输出变换保证，FNO架构保持不变。

Result: 在1D/2D Burgers、浅水方程和Navier-Stokes方程上，PACE-FNO在分布内精度与标准神经算子持平；在平移和伽利略变换下，相对FNO+Aug的OOD误差降低高达12倍；耦合旋转-平移变换下增益较小。消融实验表明输入对齐与输出恢复贡献大部分OOD增益，推理时精修提供较小修正。

Conclusion: 通过显式利用对称性将坐标对齐与物理演化解耦，PACE-FNO有效提升了神经算子在分布外场景的泛化能力，为物理驱动的机器学习模型设计提供了新思路。

Abstract: Neural operators approximate PDE solution maps, but they need not respect the symmetries of the governing equation. In out-of-distribution (OOD) regimes, a standard neural operator must often learn coordinate alignment and physical evolution within a single map, which can hurt generalization. We use known continuous symmetries of evolution equations on periodic domains to separate these two roles. We propose the Physics-Aligned Canonical Equivariant Fourier Neural Operator (PACE-FNO), which estimates the input frame with a Lie-algebra coordinate estimator, maps the field to a reference frame, applies a standard Fourier Neural Operator (FNO), and restores the prediction to the target frame. We train alignment and operator prediction jointly using bounded symmetry perturbations, with an optional low-dimensional refinement step that updates the estimated frame at inference. Equivariance is enforced by the input and output transformations, while the FNO architecture remains unchanged. Across 1-D and 2-D Burgers, shallow-water, and Navier-Stokes equations on periodic domains, PACE-FNO matches the in-distribution (ID) accuracy of standard neural operators and reduces out-of-distribution (OOD) relative error by up to 12x over FNO with symmetry augmentation (FNO+Aug) under translations and Galilean shifts, with smaller gains for coupled rotation-translation shifts. Ablations show that aligning the input and restoring the output frame account for most OOD gains; inference-time refinement provides a smaller correction.

</details>


### [301] [Perfect Parallelization in Mini-Batch SGD with Classical Momentum Acceleration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18609)
*Sachin Garg,Michał Dereziński*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文建立了随机动量加速的一般理论，证明了经典动量带来的加速效果与梯度小批量大小成正比（直至自然饱和点），从而实现了小批量计算的完美并行化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管经典动量（如Polyak重球法）在结合硬件加速训练大规模机器学习模型方面非常成功，但其在随机小批量优化中的理论影响尚不清楚，现有研究需要强噪声假设和极大的批量大小。为了解决这一理论空白，作者旨在建立一个更通用的理论框架。

Method: 作者在插值区域（interpolation regime）下，针对二次函数优化问题建立了一个包含重球法和Nesterov式动量的通用理论框架。该框架支持任意小批量大小，且对随机噪声做出了最小化的假设。

Result: 研究结果表明，经典动量带来的加速效果与小批量大小成正比（直至达到自然饱和点）。这一发现验证了小批量计算可以实现完美的并行化。此外，理论还提供了一个简单有效的动量参数选择方法。

Conclusion: 本文成功填补了随机小批量优化中经典动量理论理解的空白，证明了其加速潜力与并行化能力，并为动量参数的选择提供了理论依据，这对深度学习动力学的研究具有重要意义。

Abstract: Accelerating stochastic gradient methods with classical momentum schemes, such as Polyak's heavy ball, has proven highly successful in training large-scale machine learning models, particularly when combined with the hardware acceleration of large mini-batch computations. Yet, the effect of classical momentum on stochastic mini-batch optimization has been poorly understood theoretically, with prior works requiring strong noise assumptions and extremely large mini-batches. In this work, we develop a general theory of stochastic momentum acceleration for optimizing over quadratics in the interpolation regime, a popular abstraction for studying deep learning dynamics which also includes classical methods such as randomized Kaczmarz and coordinate descent. Our framework encompasses both heavy ball and Nesterov-style momentum, allows for arbitrary mini-batch sizes, and makes minimal assumptions on the stochastic noise. In particular, we show that acceleration from classical momentum is directly proportional to the gradient mini-batch size (up to a natural saturation point), thereby enabling perfect parallelization of mini-batch computations. Our theory also provides a simple choice for the momentum parameter, which is shown to be effective empirically.

</details>


### [302] [Aligned Training: A Parameter-Free Method to Improve Feature Quality and Stability of Sparse Autoencoders (SAE)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18629)
*Michał Brzozowski,Neo Christopher Chung*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种名为“对齐训练（aligned training）”的无参数重参数化方法，通过强制编码器和解码器方向的几何约束（内积等于1），解决了稀疏自编码器（SAE）中特征失活和不稳定的问题，显著提升了重建质量、特征稳定性和可解释性，且无需额外计算成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有稀疏自编码器（SAE）存在大量特征从未被激活（死特征）且训练不稳定的缺陷，现有改进方法往往需要额外数据或复杂训练。作者发现一个被忽视的现象：现代架构中SAE的特征质量（编码器与解码器方向的点积，即对齐分数）呈双峰分布，这揭示了训练中的退化源。

Method: 提出“对齐训练”，一种无参数的SAE重参数化方法。该方法在编码器和解码器之间强制施加几何约束，使得每个特征的内积（对齐分数）等于1，从而消除训练中的退化源，无需引入超参数或增加计算复杂度。该方法易于与Top/BatchTop-K架构和p-Annealing等技术集成。

Result: 在多种模型、字典大小和稀疏度水平下，对齐训练在SAEBench基准测试中实现了帕累托改进：同时提升了重建质量、消除了死特征、显著增强了跨训练种子的稳定性，并提高了特征质量。

Conclusion: 对齐训练是一种简单、高效且无需额外成本的方法，有效解决了SAE的死特征和稳定性问题，提升了特征质量，且易于与现有机械可解释性技术结合，具有广泛的适用性和实用价值。

Abstract: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are one of the main methods to interpret the inner workings of deep neural networks (DNNs), decomposing activations into higher-dimensional features. However, they exhibit critical shortcomings where a large fraction of features are never activated and are unstable. Despite variants of SAEs that attempt to mitigate these issues, they require additional data, resampling, or training. We propose the \textbf{aligned training}, a parameter-free reparameterization of SAEs that simultaneously improves reconstruction quality, eliminates dead features, and significantly enhances stability across training seeds. Our approach is motivated by an overlooked observation that SAE feature quality, measured by the inner product between encoder and decoder directions (which we call the \textbf{alignment score}), follows a bimodal distribution across all modern architectures. The proposed aligned training enforces a geometric constraint between the encoder and decoder such that their inner product equals one for every feature, which removes a source of degeneracy in the SAE training without adding any hyperparameters. Across multiple models, dictionary sizes, and sparsity levels, the aligned training shows Pareto improvements on the SAEBench benchmarks. Beyond improving dead features, stability and reconstruction, our method readily integrates with techniques in mechanical interpretability such as Top/BatchTop-K architectures and p-Annealing. Overall, the aligned training substantially improves feature quality and stability of SAE without computational complexity or cost.

</details>


### [303] [Efficient and Noise-Tolerant PAC Learning of Multiclass Linear Classifiers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18662)
*Rita Adhikari,Shiwei Zeng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种计算高效的算法，能够在常数率的恶意噪声下学习多类线性分类器，样本复杂度为O(k²·(d log d + log k))，即使在二分类特殊情况下也优于现有工作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 噪声容忍PAC学习线性模型是机器学习领域的核心问题。虽然已有许多计算高效的算法用于二分类线性阈值函数的学习，但在多类学习设置（k≥3）下，当数据集被恶意破坏时，是否存在计算高效的PAC学习算法仍然是未知的。

Method: 算法包含两个主要组成部分：1）基于聚类的剪枝方案（cluster-based pruning scheme）；2）标准多类铰链损失最小化程序（multiclass hinge loss minimization）。假设边际分布是有界方差分布的混合，且数据集同时满足边界条件。

Result: 证明了存在一种计算高效的算法，即使在常数率的恶意噪声下，也能使用至多O(k²·(d log d + log k))个样本PAC学习多类线性分类器{h_w: x↦arg max_{y∈[k]} w_y·x}。

Conclusion: 该工作首次解决了多类线性分类器在恶意噪声下的计算高效学习问题，建立了多项式样本复杂度上界。即使在k=2的二分类特殊情况下，该结果也严格强于所有先前的工作。

Abstract: Noise-tolerant PAC learning of linear models has been of central interests in machine learning community since the last century. In recent years, many computationally-efficient algorithms have been proposed for the problem of learning linear threshold functions under multiple noise models. Yet, when the problem is considered under multiclass learning settings, i.e. when the number of classes $k$ is at least $3$, it is unknown whether there exist computationally-efficient PAC learning algorithms when the data sets are maliciously corrupted. In this paper, we consider that the marginal distribution is a mixture of bounded variance distributions and the data sets satisfy a margin condition at the same time. We show that there exists a computationally-efficient algorithm that PAC learns multiclass linear classifiers $\{h_w:x\mapsto \arg\max_{y\in[k]}w_y\cdot x, x\in \mathbb{R}^d, w\in\mathbb{R}^{kd}\}$ using at most $O(k^2\cdot (d\log d+\log k))$ samples even under a constant rate of nasty noise. Our algorithm consists of two main ingredients: a cluster-based pruning scheme and a standard multiclass hinge loss minimization program. Even in the special case of binary setting, i.e. $k=2$, our result is strictly stronger than all prior works.

</details>


### [304] [A No-Defense Defense Against Gradient-Based Adversarial Attacks on ML-NIDS: Is Less More?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18666)
*Mohamed elShehaby,Ashraf Matrawy*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过大规模实验证明，较浅的网络、精简的特征集和ReLU激活函数的组合能够有效降低DNN-NIDS对梯度对抗攻击的脆弱性，其表现甚至优于采用对抗训练的复杂模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对梯度对抗攻击对机器学习模型特别是深度神经网络（DNN）网络入侵检测系统（NIDS）的威胁，现有研究多集中于添加显式防御机制。本文旨在探究是否仅通过精心的架构设计选择，无需额外显式防御，即可获得内在鲁棒的DNN-NIDS。

Method: 进行了约2200组对照实验，系统性地变化网络深度、特征维度、激活函数和Dropout等架构要素，在FGSM、PGD和BIM三种典型的梯度对抗攻击下评估模型的脆弱性。

Result: 实验结果表明，较浅的网络、减少的特征集以及ReLU激活函数三者协同作用，能够持续且显著地降低对抗脆弱性。遵循此设计原则的简单模型，其性能超越了更深、特征更全且经过对抗训练的模型，同时保持了近乎完美的正常流量检测率和更短的训练时间。

Conclusion: 研究结论指出“少即是多”，但核心在于选择“正确的少”。仅通过恰当的架构简化设计，即可构建具有内在鲁棒性的NIDS，为设计高效且安全的检测系统提供了新的思路。

Abstract: Gradient-based adversarial attacks subtly manipulate inputs of Machine Learning (ML) models to induce incorrect predictions. This paper investigates whether careful architectural choices alone can yield an inherently robust Deep Neural Network (DNN)-based Network Intrusion Detection Systems (NIDS), without any additional explicit defenses. Through thousands of experiments, around 2200, varying network depth, feature dimensionality, activation functions, and dropout across FGSM, PGD, and BIM attacks, we show that shallower networks, reduced feature sets, and ReLU activation consistently and jointly reduce adversarial vulnerability. Moreover, a simple model following this recipe outperforms deeper, fully-featured adversarially trained models, while maintaining near-perfect clean-traffic detection and lower training times. Nevertheless, while less is more, the selection of the right less is what truly matters.

</details>


### [305] [Learning Normal Representations for Blood Biomarkers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18701)
*Aashna P. Shah,Michelle M. Li,Yash Lal,Seffi Cohen,Liat F. Antwarg,Morgan Sanchez,James A. Diao,Chirag J. Patel,Ben Y. Reis,Ran D. Balicer,Noa Dagan,Arjun K. Manrai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出NORMA框架，通过结合个体历史检测数据与群体先验信息生成个性化医学参考区间，解决了过度个性化导致的过拟合问题，在预测死亡率、急性肾损伤等临床结局方面表现优于传统方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有血液生物标志物解读依赖固定的人群参考区间，忽略了稳定的个体内变异，可能导致延误疾病检测；而现有的个性化方法存在过拟合风险（高假阳性率）和可能纳入未识别疾病的问题。

Method: 利用来自北美、中东和东亚超过160万个体的近20亿次纵向实验室测量数据，开发NORMA——一种基于条件Transformer的框架，通过同时以患者历史数据和群体层面的"正常"变异信息为条件来生成参考区间。

Result: 纯个性化区间存在严重过拟合问题，将高达68%的测量值分类为异常，但与不良临床结局无对应关联；NORMA衍生的区间在预测死亡率、急性肾损伤和慢性疾病等结局方面实现了更高精度。

Conclusion: 研究警示实验室医学中应避免过度个性化，证明了将个体轨迹锚定到群体先验信息优于单独使用任一方法；作者公开了模型、代码和交互式用户界面以促进透明度和可及性。

Abstract: Blood-based biomarkers underpin clinical diagnosis and management, yet their interpretation relies largely on fixed population reference intervals that ignore stable, intra-patient variability. As such, population-based interpretation can mask meaningful deviation from an individual's baseline, risking delayed disease detection. To remedy this, there have been increasing efforts to personalize blood biomarker interpretation using individual testing histories. However, these methods may overfit to sparse data, inflating false-positive rates and unnecessary follow-up, and can also unwittingly include unrecognized or subclinical disease. Here, we leverage nearly 2 billion longitudinal laboratory measurements from over 1.6 million individuals across North America, the Middle East, and East Asia, to show that while laboratory values are highly individual, purely personalized intervals routinely overfit, classifying up to 68% of measurements as abnormal, without corresponding associations with adverse clinical outcomes. We then introduce NORMA, a conditional transformer-based framework that generates reference intervals by conditioning on both a patient's history and population-level data about "normal" variation. NORMA-derived intervals achieve higher precision for predicting outcomes, including mortality, acute kidney injury, and chronic disease. These findings caution against over-personalization in laboratory medicine and demonstrate that anchoring individual trajectories to population-level priors outperforms either approach alone. To promote transparency, we publicly release the model, code, and an interactive user interface for accessible, individualized laboratory interpretation.

</details>


### [306] [General Preference Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18721)
*Muhammad Umer,Muhammad Ahmed Mohsin,Ahsan Bilal,Arslan Chaudhry,Andreas Haupt,Sanmi Koyejo,Emily Fox,John M. Cioffi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出GPRL框架，利用多维偏好模型(GPM)替代标量奖励，通过结构化的策略更新和漂移监控机制，在开放性任务中实现了抗奖励欺骗的稳定对齐训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 后训练中的两个主要方向存在鸿沟：在线RL依赖程序验证器但无法处理开放性任务，偏好优化可处理开放任务但缺乏持续探索。标量奖励模型作为质量代理不完整，容易导致在线RL在某一维度上崩溃，需要新的验证器设计来桥接这一差距。

Method: 提出通用偏好模型(GPM)将响应嵌入k个斜对称子空间，表示结构化的偏好比较；在此基础上设计通用偏好强化学习(GPRL)，计算每维度组相对优势并独立归一化，使用上下文相关特征值聚合；引入闭环漂移监控器检测单轴利用并动态修正。

Result: 从Llama-3-8B-Instruct出发，GPRL在AlpacaEval 2.0上达到56.51%的长度控制胜率，在Arena-Hard、MT-Bench和WildBench上优于SimPO和SPPO，能在扩展训练中抵抗奖励欺骗。

Conclusion: GPRL成功桥接了在线RL与偏好优化的鸿沟，通过多维结构化偏好表示和自适应监控机制，实现了开放性任务中稳定且高效的语言模型对齐，为后训练提供了新的统一框架。

Abstract: Post-training has split large language model (LLM) alignment into two largely disconnected tracks. Online reinforcement learning (RL) with verifiable rewards drives emergent reasoning on math and code but depends on a programmatic verifier that cannot reach open-ended tasks, while preference optimization handles open-ended generation yet forgoes the continuous exploration that powers online RL. Closing this gap requires a verifier for open-ended quality, but a scalar reward model is the wrong shape for the job. Quality is multi-dimensional, and any scalar score is an incomplete proxy that lets online RL collapse onto whichever axis the score is most sensitive to. We turn instead to the General Preference Model (GPM), which embeds responses into $k$ skew-symmetric subspaces and represents preference as a structured, intransitivity-aware comparison. Building on this, we propose General Preference Reinforcement Learning (GPRL), which carries the $k$-way structure through to the policy update. GPRL computes per-dimension group-relative advantages, normalizes each on its own scale so no axis can dominate, and aggregates them with context-dependent eigenvalues. The same structure powers a closed-loop drift monitor that detects single-axis exploitation and corrects it on the fly by reweighting dimensions and tightening the trust region. Starting from $\texttt{Llama-3-8B-Instruct}$, GPRL reaches a length-controlled win rate of $56.51\%$ on AlpacaEval~2.0 while also outperforming SimPO and SPPO on Arena-Hard, MT-Bench, and WildBench by resisting reward hacking across extended training runs.

</details>

### [307] [End-to-End Simulation of 5G NR Integrated Access and Backhaul Networks for Remote Maritime Connectivity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16531)
*Alessandro Traspadini,Matteo Pagin,Raphaël Ihamouine,Rupert Lucas,Andrew Noren,Michele Zorzi,Marco Giordani*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文介绍了一个支持海事场景的mmWave IAB网络ns-3仿真模块，基于3GPP R16-R18标准实现完整协议栈，并通过系统级仿真验证了其在动态多跳海上环境中的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 毫米波5G网络虽然能提供高数据速率，但面临严重的路径损耗和阻塞问题，导致覆盖受限。这推动了集成接入与回传（IAB）技术的发展，作为一种灵活的无线回传方案，能够将连接扩展至小区边界、无光纤区域及海事环境。

Method: 首先综述了3GPP R16至R18版本的IAB网络规范；然后开发了一个完整的ns-3 IAB仿真模块，包含端到端协议栈、回传适配协议（BAP）层、灵活的时隙与控制配置，以及基于时分和频分的复用方案。通过自定义海事场景进行大规模系统级仿真测试，其中配备IAB节点的船只同时作为接入点和继电器，形成动态多跳网络。

Result: 在不同的网络拓扑和信道条件下对IAB模块进行了评估，验证了其功能，并为海上环境中mmWave IAB网络的设计和部署提供了关键见解。

Conclusion: 该研究证明了所提出的ns-3 IAB模块在动态复杂海事环境中的有效性，为未来海上mmWave通信网络的规划与实施提供了有价值的参考依据。

Abstract: Millimeter wave (mmWave) 5th generation (5G) networks offer high data rates but face coverage challenges due to severe path loss and blockage. These problems motivate the use of Integrated Access and Backhaul (IAB) as a flexible wireless backhaul solution that extends connectivity to cell boundaries and unfibered areas, including maritime environments. This paper overviews the latest 3GPP specifications for IAB networks in Releases 16 through 18. Then, it presents an ns-3 module for IAB, featuring a complete end-to-end protocol stack, including the backhaul adaptation protocol (BAP) layer, flexible slot and control configurations, and multiplexing schemes based on both time and frequency division. We test the IAB module via extensive system-level simulations in a custom maritime scenario where vessels, equipped with IAB-nodes, can simultaneously act as access points and relays, forming dynamic multi-hop networks that maintain connectivity via wireless backhaul to shore-based stations. We evaluate different topologies and channel conditions, providing insights into the design and deployment of mmWave IAB networks in offshore environments.

</details>


### [308] [Re/Imagining Smart Home Automation Framework in the Era of 6G-Enabled Smart Cities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16599)
*Byungkwan Jung,Suman Kumar,Adityasinh Manthansinh Chauhan*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于6G网络和6G云环境的智能家居自动化新框架，通过增强安全性、数据预处理、大数据智能和安全服务虚拟化来解决智能家居面临的挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能家居自动化系统面临多重挑战，包括需要及时更新、高效数据管理、实时大数据处理、鲁棒的安全措施和高级分析能力，传统技术难以满足这些需求。

Method: 提出了一种新型框架，充分利用6G网络和6G使能云计算的能力，该框架在云端集成了增强安全性、数据预处理、大数据智能和安全服务虚拟化等核心功能。

Result: 通过多个应用场景和案例研究（聚焦灾害期间的安全路由），验证了该框架的实用性，证明了6G网络和6G云环境在智能家居自动化中发挥的关键作用。

Conclusion: 6G网络与云计算的结合为智能家居自动化系统提供了有效的解决方案，能够显著改善智慧城市的整体格局，满足智能家居对实时性、安全性和智能化的需求。

Abstract: Smart home automation systems represent a seamless integration of Internet of Things technologies, facilitating the monitoring, management, and regulation of various aspects of our daily life. By leveraging advancements in communication, computing, sensing, and actuator technologies, they hold promises for enhancing the living experience. However, they face challenges such as the need for timely updates, efficient data management, real-time Big data processing, robust security measures, and advanced analytics. In this paper, we propose a novel framework that capitalizes on the capabilities of 6G networks and 6G-enabled cloud computing to address these challenges and improve the overall landscape of smart cities. This framework features enhanced security, data pre-processing, big data intelligence, and security service virtualization in the cloud. Through various application scenarios and a case study-focusing on safe routing during disasters, we demonstrate the utility of this framework and the critical role 6G networks and 6G-enabled cloud computing play in smart home automation.

</details>


### [309] [Transformer-Based MCS Prediction for 5G Multicast-Broadcast Services (MBS)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16735)
*Kasidis Arunruangsirilert,Jiro Katto*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 针对5G组播广播服务（MBS）广播模式下无反馈重传、丢包直接影响QoE的特点，提出一种轻量级Transformer框架，通过预测MCS成功率并采用非对称安全损失函数，实现保守稳健的链路自适应，在保证高可靠性的同时满足实时性要求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 5G MBS广播采用RLC-UM模式，缺乏HARQ反馈机制，丢包不可恢复且直接影响用户体验。传统面向单播的链路自适应算法激进追求吞吐量最大化，在此类风险不耐受环境下会导致严重的视频卡顿和缓冲，亟需一种面向广播场景的保守型链路适配方案。

Method: 提出轻量级Transformer框架，基于0.5毫秒时隙级粒度的商用网络数据集，预测未来视频段范围内全部28个MCS索引的成功概率。设计非对称安全损失函数（Asymmetric Safety Loss），通过对信道过估计施加更大惩罚，引导模型产生保守偏置，优先保障链路稳定性。模型针对实时应用进行优化。

Result: 实验表明，该方法可靠性得分达86.89%，显著优于针对原始吞吐量优化的标准AI基线（31.65%），同时保持安全的保守偏置。模型在商用5G智能手机上推理时间小于0.07毫秒，满足实时性需求。

Conclusion: 所提方法有效解决了MBS广播场景下传统链路自适应算法的风险不耐受问题，在保证高可靠性的前提下实现了实时推理能力，为5G MBS部署中UHD内容的高效可靠传输提供了实用化解决方案。

Abstract: The deployment of 5G Multicast-Broadcast Services (MBS) is emerging as a critical technology for spectral-efficient UHD content delivery and serving as a promising solution to modernize CATV deployment. However, unlike unicast networks that rely on RLC-AM with HARQ retransmissions, MBS broadcast operates in RLC Unacknowledged Mode (RLC-UM), where the absence of a feedback loop means packet loss is permanent and immediately impacts user QoE. Conventional link adaptation algorithms, designed for unicast, typically aggressively maximize throughput and fail in this risk-intolerant environment, resulting in severe video stalls and rebuffering. To address this, we propose a lightweight Transformer-based framework that predicts the success probability of all 28 MCS indices over an upcoming video segment horizon. Utilizing a unique commercial network dataset with 0.5 ms slot-level granularity, we train our model using a custom Asymmetric Safety Loss function that penalizes channel overestimation to prioritize link stability. Experimental results show that our approach achieves a reliability score of 86.89%, significantly outperforming standard AI baselines optimized for raw throughput (31.65%) while maintaining a safe conservative bias. Furthermore, the model is optimized for real-time applications, demonstrating an inference time of less than 0.07 ms on COTS 5G-era smartphones.

</details>


### [310] [SpaceMoE: Towards Orbital General Intelligence with Distributed Mixture-of-Experts Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16849)
*Qian Chen,Xianhao Chen,Min Sheng,Kaibin Huang*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文提出了SpaceMoE框架，通过混合专家(MoE)架构实现卫星网络上的分布式大语言模型推理，以应对卫星在内存、计算和能源方面的严格限制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着卫星网络向支持多样化服务和通用人工智能(AGI)演进，大语言模型(LLMs)成为未来空间系统的关键基础。然而，卫星上的内存、计算和能源限制严重阻碍了LLMs的部署，需要一种能够平衡模型性能与资源约束的创新架构。

Method: 利用MoE架构的稀疏专家激活特性实现可扩展的模型推理。提出SpaceMoE范式，重点研究三个核心设计问题：专家放置、专家选择、隐藏状态传输与路由，并考虑卫星特有的动态拓扑、电池退化和热限制等因素。

Result: 建立了SpaceMoE的理论框架，明确了卫星网络环境下MoE分布式推理的核心设计挑战，揭示了卫星特定因素如何根本性地重塑这些问题的解决方案。

Conclusion: 为未来卫星网络中实现可扩展、高效和可持续的在轨MoE推理指明了研究方向，为空间AGI系统的发展奠定了基础。

Abstract: As satellite networks evolve to support increasingly diverse services and artificial general intelligence (AGI), large language models (LLMs) are emerging as a critical foundation for future space systems. However, deploying LLMs on satellites is hindered by stringent constraints on onboard memory, computation, and energy. In this context, the mixture-of-experts (MoE) architecture emerges as a promising solution, leveraging sparse expert activation to enable scalable model inference. By harnessing the architectural advantages of MoE, this article provides a comprehensive overview of SpaceMoE, a new paradigm for distributed MoE inference in satellite networks. We first review recent industrial progress and emerging standardization trends that motivate the evolution toward space AGI systems. Then, we introduce the fundamentals and architectural evolution of SpaceMoE. Subsequently, we discuss three fundamental design problems in SpaceMoE, namely expert placement, expert selection, and hidden-state transmission and routing, highlighting how satellite-specific factors such as dynamic topology, battery degradation, and thermal limits fundamentally reshape their solutions. Finally, we outline promising research directions for realizing scalable, efficient, and sustainable on-orbit MoE inference in future satellite networks.

</details>


### [311] [Escape from Callback Hell! A New Programming Paradigm for Network Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16897)
*Yuanyi Zhu,Zijian Li,Xin Ai,Zixuan Chen,Sen Liu,Yang Xu*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 提出了基于协程的离散事件网络仿真开发范式CoDES，通过将回调机制转换为顺序工作流，显著降低了代码量和结构复杂度（最高降幅82.6%），同时保持仿真精度和性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的离散事件网络仿真器基于回调机制，无法自然模拟网络事件，导致程序必须采用非线性流程编写，引发"栈撕裂"和"回调地狱"问题，显著增加了开发工作量和编程调试的认知负担。

Method: 提出CoDES（基于协程的离散事件仿真）开发范式，利用协程机制使开发者能够以顺序工作流方式编写网络仿真程序，自然模拟网络事件；在NS-3仿真器上实现该框架，解决正确性、功能性、兼容性和开销等关键系统挑战。

Result: 在NS-3上实现了MPI、HPCC和RIP协议，代码量减少最高达62.3%，结构复杂度降低最高达82.6%，且未牺牲仿真精度、未延长执行时间或增加运行时内存。

Conclusion: CoDES范式成功优化了网络仿真开发流程而非单纯追求性能，有效解决了回调机制的根本性问题，在保持仿真准确性和性能的同时，显著提升了代码可读性和可维护性，为网络功能快速评估和演进提供了新的开发途径。

Abstract: Network simulation plays a crucial role in both networking research and industry. Existing commonly-used Discrete Event Simulations (DES) are based on callback mechanisms for discrete event (DE). However, due to the inability of callbacks to naturally simulate network events, programs in network simulation cannot be written in a sequential workflow. This leads to inherent complexity and poor maintainability, resulting in stack ripping and callback hell. These problems significantly increase simulation development workloads and introduce substantial cognitive loads associated with programming and debugging.
  To enable more efficient development of network simulation and facilitate the rapid evaluation and evolution of network functions, we propose a novel development paradigm for network simulation named ``CoDES" (\textbf{Co}routine-based \textbf{DES}). To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to focus on optimizing the network simulation development process rather than performance based on the coroutine mechanism. We implement a new network simulation framework based on CoDES that is capable of naturally simulating network events and effectively address key system challenges related to correctness, functionality, compatibility, and overhead. It enables developers to create sequential workflows for network programs and simplifies the code structure, thus reducing development workloads while enhancing code readability and maintainability.
  We apply this paradigm to a commonly used network simulator, NS-3 to implement Message Passing Interface (MPI), High Precision Congestion Control (HPCC), and Routing Information Protocol (RIP), achieving up to 62.3\% and 82.6\% reduction in code volume and structure complexity without sacrificing simulation accuracy, extending execution time or increasing runtime memory of simulation.

</details>


### [312] [Resilience Analysis in Off-Grid LoRa Mesh Networks: Evaluation of Meshtastic Profiles in Long-Range Propagation Scenarios](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17063)
*Guillermo Antonio Hernandez Ortiz,Edgar Santiago Quiroz Puentes,José de Jesús Rugeles*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文在哥伦比亚背景下（915 MHz ISM频段）对Meshtastic LoRa网状网络进行了确定性表征，揭示了扩频因子（SF）主导的性能分层，定义了三种运营机制，为智慧城市中的离网通信设计提供了定量标准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对智慧城市应急场景下的离网通信需求，研究LoRa技术与网状拓扑的集成方案。由于Meshtastic固件实现了去中心化网状网络，无需依赖传统基础设施，但其物理层性能缺乏确定性表征，因此需要建立设计和规划标准以指导实际部署。

Method: 采用受控引导链路方法论，隔离LoRa物理层与传播效应，对Meshtastic全部八种调制解调器预设配置在三种发射功率等级下进行确定性表征，共收集42个数据集，分析不同扩频因子（SF7-SF12）的路径衰减阈值和信噪比性能。

Result: 发现性能主要由扩频因子决定形成三个层级："Short"预设（SF7-SF8）在路径衰减110-120 dB时失效；"Medium"预设（SF9-SF10）可维持至135-150 dB；"Long"预设（SF11-SF12）最大化覆盖范围，其中"Long Slow"在180 dB时失效，相比最快配置具有60-70 dB优势。SNR分析证实SF12可实现低至-18 dB的噪声下解调，链路失效发生在理论极限2-4 dB范围内。

Conclusion: 基于性能阈值定义了三种运营机制：高密度物联网、平衡城市网状网和最大范围应急通信，为网络设计者提供了选择适当配置和节点密度的定量标准，指导智慧城市部署中的网络规划决策。

Abstract: The integration of LoRa technologies with mesh topologies represents a robust alternative for off-grid communications in emergency scenarios within smart cities. Meshtastic firmware implements a decentralised mesh network over LoRa where each node acts simultaneously as end device and router, enabling communication via Bluetooth-connected mobile devices without reliance on conventional infrastructure. Within the Colombian context (915 MHz ISM band), this work establishes design and planning criteria through a controlled guided-link methodology that isolates the LoRa physical layer from propagation effects, enabling deterministic characterisation of all eight Meshtastic modem presets at three transmission power levels (42 datasets). The results reveal a performance partitioning governed primarily by Spreading Factor (SF): "Short" presets (SF7-SF8) fail at 110-120 dB of path attenuation, "Medium" presets (SF9-SF10) sustain links up to 135-150 dB, and "Long" presets (SF11-SF12) maximise coverage, with "Long Slow" reaching 180 dB before failure - a 60-70 dB advantage over the fastest profiles. The SNR analysis confirms sub-noise-floor demodulation down to -18 dB for SF12, with abrupt link failure occurring within 2-4 dB of the theoretical limit. Based on these thresholds, three operational regimes are defined (high-density IoT, balanced urban mesh, and maximum-range emergency), providing network designers with quantitative criteria to select the appropriate configuration and node density for smart city deployments.

</details>


### [313] [An Efficient Machine Learning-based Framework for Detection and Prevention of Frauds in Telecom Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17245)
*Praveen Hegde,Mishal Shah*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本研究评估了AI驱动的电信欺诈检测模型，在包含101,174条通话详单记录的数据集上，随机森林（RF）模型实现了99.9%的准确率，表现优于XGBoost等其他模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电信欺诈是一个严重问题，会导致巨大的物质损失并损害电信系统的可靠性。为了有效应对这些威胁，需要开发高效准确的欺诈检测机制。

Method: 使用包含101,174条客户记录和17个属性的电信CDR数据集，其中包含8,830个欺诈案例。数据预处理包括处理缺失值、使用Min-Max缩放进行数据标准化、使用SMOTE技术进行数据平衡。训练了随机森林（RF）和XGBoost模型进行预测分析，并比较了RF、XGBoost、DBSCAN、RoBERTa和K-means等多种机器学习模型的性能。

Result: 随机森林模型表现最佳，准确率达99.9%，精确率99.9%，召回率99.9%，F1分数99.9%。XGBoost模型准确率为99.7%。研究结果表明所提出的框架能够成功检测欺诈行为，且误分类极少。

Conclusion: 研究强调随机森林是检测电信网络欺诈活动最有效的模型，能够确保稳健可靠的欺诈预防。该框架成功实现了电信网络中欺诈活动的高效检测。

Abstract: Telecommunication fraud is an acute problem that leads to substantial material losses and compromises the reliability of telecom systems worldwide. Only effective and efficient detection mechanisms can help to deal with these threats, though there are certain shifts in the approaches to fraud detection. This paper evaluates the performance of AI-driven models for fraud detection in telecommunication networks using Call Detail Record (CDR) datasets. This study focuses on fraud detection in telecom networks using the Telecom CDR dataset, which contains 101,174 customer records with 17 attributes, including 8,830 fraud cases. In feature preprocessing, missing values were dealt with, followed by data scaling using Min-Max scaling and data balancing using the SMOTE technique. The dataset was trained for predictive analysis using Random Forest (RF) and XGBoost models. F1-score, ROC AUC, recall, accuracy, time, and precision were used as indicators with which to compare performance of the two models. RF recorded a high level of accuracy at 99.9% while XGBoost at 99.7%. Findings show that the suggested framework successfully detects fraud with few misclassifications. Several machine learning models were evaluated and contrasted, such as RF, XGBoost, DBSCAN, RoBERTa, and K-means. Among all the models, RF was seen to give the highest performance with an accuracy of 99.9% and precision of 99.9%, recall of 99.9% and F1-score of 99.9%, XGBoost, GNN and BERT. The findings emphasize RF as the most effective model for detecting fraudulent activities in telecom networks, ensuring robust and reliable prevention of fraud.

</details>


### [314] [Wi-Fi HaLow (IEEE 802.11ah) for Long-Range Monitoring Links: Point-to-Point NLoS/LoS and LoS Mesh Field Characterization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17349)
*Jiajie Xu,Chaabane Mankai,Mohamed-Slim Alouini*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文对Wi-Fi HaLow在监控部署场景下的长距离无线链路性能进行了实地表征，揭示了带宽与距离的权衡关系，并验证了通过固定中继节点可实现公里级覆盖扩展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 监控部署通常需要可靠的长距离无线链路来间歇性上传传感器日志和短视频快照。Wi-Fi HaLow (IEEE 802.11ah) 因其亚1GHz传播特性和带宽灵活的PHY模式，成为满足此类需求的潜在候选技术。

Method: 研究围绕三种部署场景进行实地测试：（i）点对点非视距(NLoS)链路；（ii）几百米距离的点对点视距(LoS)链路；（iii）引入固定中继节点进行距离扩展的LoS网状网络。研究使用商用HaLow Dongle类节点，通过传输约30秒的视频文件作为代表性“重”对象，测量应用层吞吐量和以监控为中心的更新延迟。

Result: 测量结果揭示了：（a）明显的带宽-距离权衡，NLoS覆盖边界约在120米处；（b）LoS条件下随着距离增加吞吐量逐渐衰减，单跳最远达814米时吞吐量为0.15 Mbps；（c）引入固定中继后可实现公里级LoS扩展，使用两个固定中继达到901米，三个固定中继达到1110米。

Conclusion: Wi-Fi HaLow能够有效支持监控场景下的长距离无线通信，在LoS条件下通过中继节点可实现超过1公里的覆盖范围，为实际监控部署提供了重要的性能参考和设计依据。

Abstract: Monitoring deployments often require reliable long-range wireless links to intermittently upload sensor logs and short video snapshots. Wi-Fi HaLow (IEEE~802.11ah) is a promising candidate due to sub-1 GHz propagation and bandwidth-flexible PHY modes. This summary paper reports a field characterization organized around three deployment-driven regimes: (i) point-to-point Non-Line-of-Sight (NLoS) links; (ii) point-to-point Line-of-Sight (LoS) links over several-hundred-meter distances; and (iii) LoS mesh networking with fixed relay nodes for range extension. Using commodity HaLow dongle-class nodes in all regimes, we report application-layer goodput and monitoring-centric update latency based on transferring a representative ``heavy'' object (a $\sim$30 s video file). The measurements reveal (a) a clear bandwidth--range tradeoff and an NLoS coverage boundary around $\sim$120 m, (b) gradual throughput decay under LoS up to 814 m in single-hop with 0.15 Mbps at the farthest point, and (c) kilometer-class extension under LoS when fixed relays are introduced, reaching 901 m (two fixed relays) and 1110 m (three fixed relays

</details>


### [315] [Enhancing Network Resilience via Graph-Based Anomaly Detection in Sovereign Functions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17716)
*Xin Hao,Wei Ni,Chenhan Zhang,Massimo Piccardi,Raymond Owen*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文提出了GSID模型，通过二分图结构不一致性检测方法，结合自适应配置编码器(ACE)和不一致性动态注意力机制(IDA)，有效解决了协议配置异常检测问题，F1分数提升三倍，准确率提升23.2%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主权网络功能（如路由协议）日益复杂，容易因协议配置异常和异常配置引发故障，因此需要有效的协议配置异常检测方法。

Method: 将协议配置异常检测问题建模为二分图中连接节点和边的结构不一致性检测；提出图结构不一致性检测器(GSID)模型，包含自适应配置编码器(ACE)动态选择编码策略保留细粒度数值差异，以及不一致性动态注意力(IDA)机制通过从两端绘制不对称注意力来评分边。

Result: 实验表明GSID在F1分数上优于最先进基线三倍，准确率提升23.2%；消融研究验证了ACE和IDA模块的有效性；在未见过的网络规模和真实世界网络拓扑上测试显示出优越的适应性。

Conclusion: GSID模型有效解决了协议配置异常检测问题，通过创新的编码和注意力机制显著提升了检测性能，并展现出良好的泛化能力和实际应用潜力。

Abstract: Sovereign network functions, e.g., routing protocols, are becoming increasingly complex and susceptible to failures arising from protocol configuration anomalies and anomalous configurations. This paper interprets the protocol configuration anomaly detection problem as detection of structural inconsistencies of connected nodes and edges in a bipartite graph that captures both physical network entities and logical protocol states. This graph structural inconsistency detector (GSID) model is proposed to solve the problem efficiently. To handle the heterogeneous nature of protocol configuration parameters, GSID employs an adaptive configuration encoder (ACE) that dynamically selects encoding strategies per parameter to preserve fine-grained numerical discrepancies. To expose the subtle inconsistencies of connected nodes and edges in the bipartite graph, GSID uses an inconsistency dynamic attention (IDA) mechanism that scores edges by drawing asymmetric attentions from both ends, rule compliance from one end and route connectivity from the other. It is demonstrated experimentally that GSID outperforms state-of-the-art baselines by threefold in F1 score and by 23.2% in accuracy. Ablation studies validate the effectiveness of both the ACE and IDA modules. Tests on unseen network scales and real-world network topologies show the superior adaptability of our GSID, compared to the baselines.

</details>


### [316] [Enabling Agile Ambient IoT Networking via a Parameterized Hybrid Radio](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18314)
*Jiazhen Lei,Fengyuan Zhu,Tianze Cao,Yuxin Sha,Linling Zhong,Wenhui Li,Bingbing Wang,Zeming Yang,Jinyang Sun,Yibin Deng,Xiaohua Tian*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 提出了Janus，首个面向Ambient IoT的混合主动-被动可配置无线电架构，实现了快速协议原型设计和标准化验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Ambient IoT标志着大规模无电池网络范式的兴起，但缺乏灵活的物理层基础设施仍是研究和标准化的根本障碍。现有测试平台存在无线电路径解耦、静态功耗高、控制方法繁琐等问题，严重制约了快速协议原型设计。

Method: 设计了Janus混合主动-被动可配置无线电架构，采用参数化架构将被动和主动传输统一到单一射频前端，将复杂的物理层行为抽象为简洁参数。该设计实现了用于动态模式切换的系统级控制平面，以及用于多源细粒度能量收集的能量管理平面，并制作了紧凑的PCB原型进行验证。

Result: 在包括3GPP A-IoT、IEEE 802.11 AMP和Bluetooth SIG等多种协议场景下的实验结果表明，Janus在保持与专用无线电相当通信性能的同时，显著降低了配置开销。

Conclusion: Janus作为多功能使能平台，有效支持新兴协议验证，加速下一代低功耗网络的标准化进程，为Ambient IoT研究和部署提供了关键基础设施支撑。

Abstract: The emergence of Ambient IoT signals a paradigm shift toward massive batteryless networking. However, the absence of an agile physical layer substrate remains a fundamental barrier to research and standardization. Current testbeds are hindered by decoupled radio paths, high static power, and cumbersome control methods, which stifle rapid protocol prototyping. In this paper, we present Janus, the first hybrid active-passive configurable radio architected for agile Ambient IoT networking. Janus introduces a parameterized architecture that unifies passive and active transmission into a single RF front end, abstracting complex physical layer behaviors into concise parameters. This design enables a system-level control plane for dynamic mode transitions and an energy management plane for fine-grained harvesting across multiple sources. We implement a compact PCB prototype and evaluate its performance across diverse protocol landscapes, including 3GPP A-IoT, IEEE 802.11 AMP, and Bluetooth SIG. Our experimental results demonstrate that Janus achieves communication performance on par with dedicated radios while significantly reducing configuration overhead. Ultimately, Janus serves as a versatile enabler for validating emerging protocols and accelerating the standardization of next-generation low-power networks.

</details>


### [317] [CA3D: Computing Accessibility-Aware Cooperative 3D Deployment of Multiple UAVs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17852)
*Yiqin Deng,Zihan Fang,Yijie Wang,Qingxiao Huang,Junhui Gao,Qianyao Ren,Yuguang Fang*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种计算可达性感知的协作3D无人机部署方案（CA3D），通过理论分析揭示计算可达性是无人机部署影响时延约束任务完成的关键机制，并设计了平衡计算资源可达性、任务完成概率和冗余重叠的部署策略。实验表明，在热点用户分布下CA3D的任务完成概率比随机部署提高约3.3倍，在随机用户分布下比最佳基线提高约35%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无人机（UAV）部署与时延约束任务完成之间的关系尚不明确，特别是计算可达性如何影响任务完成效率需要深入理论分析。同时，无人机间距需要在计算资源可达性与任务完成之间进行权衡，这构成了一个基础性挑战。现有部署方法缺乏对计算可达性的显式考虑，导致任务完成性能不佳。

Method: 首先进行理论分析，证明计算可达性是连接无人机部署与时延约束任务完成的关键机制，并揭示无人机间距在计算资源可达性与任务完成之间创造的基本权衡关系。在此基础上，开发协作3D部署设计方法，联合平衡可达计算容量、任务完成概率以及冗余无人机重叠三个关键因素。该方案考虑异构计算节点能力的实际情况。

Result: 在热点地面用户（GU）分布场景下，当无人机数量为8时，CA3D实现接近完全任务完成，相比随机部署任务完成概率提升约3.3倍。在更具挑战性的随机GU分布场景下，当无人机数量为12时，CA3D的任务完成概率仍比最佳基线方法高出约35%。CA3D在异构计算节点容量下一致性地优于随机部署、固定部署和贪婪部署基线方法。

Conclusion: 计算可达性感知的协作3D部署不仅能够显著提升任务完成性能，还能增强对地面用户分布变化的鲁棒性。通过显式建模和优化计算可达性，CA3D为多无人机协作部署提供了一种有效的解决方案，证明了计算资源感知在无人机网络设计中的重要性。

Abstract: This letter investigates computing-accessibility-aware cooperative 3D deployment of multiple UAVs for task completion enhancement, termed CA3D. We first provide a theoretical analysis showing that computing accessibility is the key mechanism linking UAV deployment to delay-constrained task completion, and that UAV inter-spacing creates a fundamental tradeoff between computing-resource accessibility and task completion. We then develop a cooperative 3D deployment design that jointly balances accessible computing capacity, task completion probability, and redundant UAV overlap. Simulation results under heterogeneous computing node capacities show that CA3D consistently outperforms Random, Fixed, and Greedy deployment baselines under both hotspot and random ground user (GU) distributions. Under the hotspot GU distribution, CA3D achieves nearly full task completion, improving the task completion probability by about 3.3x over Random deployment when the number of UAVs is 8. Under a more challenging random GU distribution, CA3D still achieves about 35% higher task completion probability than the best baseline when the number of UAVs is 12. These results demonstrate that computing-accessibility-aware cooperative 3D deployment improves not only task completion but also robustness to GU distribution changes.

</details>


### [318] [ASTRA: Asynchronous Age-Aware Satellite Random Access via Mean-Field Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18282)
*Sayam Chakraborty,Aimin Li,Yigit Ince,Sajjad Baghaee,Elif Uysal*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文提出ASTRA框架，通过均值场MDP解决卫星IoT中无授权上行接入的新鲜度控制问题，证明了最优策略具有年龄阈值结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 卫星IoT中无授权上行接入存在耦合的新鲜度控制问题：增加重复和接收端多样性虽可提升设备的捕获-SIC机会，但会导致群体拥塞并降低全网新鲜度；现有AoI感知随机接入模型依赖时隙同步碰撞、固定交付概率或标量发射决策，无法刻画具有捕获和SIC的异步卫星上行链路。

Method: 建立考虑异步到达、部分重叠、捕获和SIC的接入模型，保持交付成功对每个设备重复分集动作的依赖性；将群体交互表述为可扩展的均值场MDP，设备仅利用本地AoI观测优化接入时机和强度。

Result: 系统存在均值场均衡，个体最优性与内生拥塞相互一致；最优均衡策略具有年龄阈值结构；数值结果表明所提策略相比年龄无关基准可降低AoI。

Conclusion: ASTRA框架有效解决了卫星IoT异步随机接入中的新鲜度控制问题，为设计高效的无授权上行接入策略提供了理论基础。

Abstract: Satellite Internet-of-Things (IoT) enables massive status-update services beyond terrestrial coverage, but grant-free uplink access creates a coupled freshness-control problem: increasing repetition and receiver-side diversity improves a device's capture-SIC opportunities, yet the resulting population congestion degrades network-wide freshness. Existing AoI-aware random-access models often rely on slot-synchronous collisions, fixed delivery probabilities, or scalar transmit-or-wait decisions and therefore cannot capture asynchronous satellite uplinks with capture and SIC. This paper develops a PHY-aware mean-field framework, termed ASTRA (Asynchronous Age-Aware Satellite Random Access), for freshness-driven satellite IoT random access. We build an access model that captures asynchronous arrivals, partial overlaps, capture, and SIC while preserving the dependence of delivery success on each device's repetition-diversity action. We then formulate the population interaction as a scalable mean-field MDP in which devices optimize access timing and intensity using only local AoI observations. The resulting system admits a mean-field equilibrium in which individual optimality and endogenous congestion are mutually consistent. We further prove that the optimal equilibrium policy admits an age-threshold structure. Numerical results show that the proposed policy reduces AoI relative to age-independent baselines.

</details>


### [319] [Collaborative Air-Ground Sensing, Communication, Computing, Storage, and Intelligence for Low-Altitude Economy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18503)
*Yiqin Deng,Junhui Gao,Zihan Fang,Yanan Ma,Xianhao Chen,Yuguang Fang*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文针对低空经济（LAE）的任务驱动特性，提出了一个整合场景需求、空地协作架构及SCCSI（感通算存智）协同优化方法论的框架，系统综述了相关使能技术并提供了测试平台与用例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低空经济将低空空域转化为新的信息物理基础设施，其本质是任务导向的，具有严格的安全与合规约束。仅以通信为中心的设计无法有效满足这些多样化需求，因此必须通过空地协作，协同编排感知、通信、计算、存储和智能（SCCSI）等多种资源。

Method: 提出了一个新颖的框架，将以下三部分连接起来：（i）LAE场景与需求-资源耦合矩阵；（ii）空地协作架构；（iii）SCCSI协同优化与在线决策的方法论工具箱。系统综述了协作SCCSI资源与能力的使能技术，重点关注其耦合关系与端到端权衡。

Result: 总结了现有的测试平台、数据集和评估指标，并提供了代表性用例，展示了该框架如何将应用需求转化为实际的任务驱动优化设计。同时分析了开放性挑战并提出了实现可扩展、可信LAE部署的技术路线图。

Conclusion: 该研究为低空经济领域提供了一个系统性的解决方案框架，通过SCCSI资源的协同优化与空地协作架构，能够有效满足LAE任务的多样化需求，为未来低空经济的规模化与可信部署奠定了理论基础和技术路径。

Abstract: Low-altitude economy (LAE) is transforming low-altitude airspace into a new cyber-physical infrastructure. Although air-ground communications have been widely studied, LAE is fundamentally different in the sense that it is mission-centric with diverse requirements, such as stringent safety and compliance constraints not be effectively addressed with a communication-centric design alone, which makes air-ground collaboration indispensable: Only through effectively coordinating air-ground infrastructure and resources can LAE missions be fulfilled. Consequently, LAE calls for task-driven, closed-loop, multi-resource orchestration of Sensing, Communication, Computing, Storage, and Intelligence (SCCSI), where key decisions must be co-designed under mobility and uncertainty. In this paper, we first present a novel framework that connects (i) LAE scenarios and a requirement--resource coupling matrix, (ii) an air--ground collaborative architecture, and (iii) methodological toolboxes for SCCSI co-optimization and online decision-making. We then systematically review enabling technologies for collaborative SCCSI resources and capabilities, emphasizing their coupling and end-to-end tradeoffs. Finally, we summarize testbeds, datasets, and evaluation metrics, and provide representative use cases to illustrate how the proposed framework translates application requirements into practical task-driven optimization designs, together with open challenges and a roadmap toward scalable and trustworthy LAE deployment.

</details>


<div id='cs.DC'></div>

# cs.DC [[Back]](#toc)

### [320] [The Impact of Process Competition on Energy Consumption: Analysis and Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16260)
*Eduardo Gomes Campos,Rafaela Sousa de Alencar Lacerda,Adnei Willian Donatti,Joberto S. B. Martins,Charles C. Miers,Tereza C. M. B. Carvalho*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 研究多用户竞争物理资源时进程能耗的变化规律，发现其随物理机核心数增加从线性关系转变为根函数关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着分布式系统和云计算发展，多用户共享基础设施导致物理计算资源竞争，亟需量化分析资源竞争对进程能耗的影响，这对云服务定价、任务调度、负载均衡及提升能效至关重要。

Method: 通过实验方法测量进程在不同资源竞争强度下的能耗表现，重点考察物理机处理器核心数量对能耗-竞争关系的影响。

Result: 进程能耗与资源竞争的依赖关系取决于物理机核心数：核心数较少时呈线性关系；核心数增加后，能耗与竞争的关系转变为根函数关系。

Conclusion: 资源竞争对进程能耗的影响受物理机核心数调控，为云环境下的能耗建模、定价策略与调度优化提供了理论依据。

Abstract: With the development of distributed systems, the need to manage the sharing of machines among multiple simultaneous users arises. In the cloud computing context, the instantiation of virtual machines and containers by different users utilizing the same infrastructure leads to a dispute for physical computational resources. In this regard, this paper analyses a process's energy consumption as a function of the competition for computational resources it encounters. Investigating this behavior is fundamental for many applications, such as pricing in cloud computing services, and for task scheduling and load balancing, while increasing energy efficiency. To determine this behavior, experiments were conducted and resulted in a dependency on the number of processor cores of the physical machine hosting the process. As the number of cores increases, the process's energy consumption as a function of the competition it faces transitions from linear to a root function.

</details>


### [321] [Exceeding the Numerical and Performance Characteristics of IEEE-754 SGEMM with BFloat16 Tensor Cores on GPUs for Scientific Computing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16617)
*Harun Bayraktar,Cole Brower,John Gunnels,Greg Henry,Cherin Joseph,Jack Kosaian,Dmitry Lyakh,Lukas Mosimann,Victor Podlozhnyuk,Addison Richards,Paul Springer,Haicheng Wu*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出利用现代GPU中的BF16 Tensor Cores模拟FP32矩阵乘法，在性能、效率和数值精度上均超越了原生FP32计算，并提供了完整的库级实现方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI应用推动了低精度浮点计算硬件（如BF16）的快速发展，这些硬件在数值计算能力和能效方面优于高精度硬件。由于BF16与FP32共享相同的动态范围，且Blackwell GPU架构提供了集成缩放硬件等特性，使得利用丰富的低精度硬件模拟高精度数学计算成为研究热点。

Method: 研究利用BF16 Tensor Cores通过FP32累加器进行FP32矩阵乘法的模拟方法，分析其在Blackwell GPU架构上的性能、效率、功耗和数值特性，并开发了完整的库级实现以正确处理非规格化数（denormals）。

Result: 实验证明，基于BF16模拟的FP32矩阵乘法在数值精度和性能特征上均超越了原生FP32计算，为科学应用提供了更优的计算方案。

Conclusion: BF16 Tensor Cores可有效用于FP32矩阵乘法的模拟计算，在科学计算应用中实现了比原生FP32更高的性能和数值精度，为利用低精度硬件加速高精度计算提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Largely due to their increased native capacity for numerical intensity and power efficiency, reduced-precision floating-point computing resources, primarily used in artificial intelligence (AI) applications, have expanded at a greater rate than their higher-precision relatives. This has led to various efforts focused upon leveraging plentiful reduced-precision hardware to mimic higher-precision mathematical calculations. This paper studies a specific use case, namely the use of bfloat16 (BF16) Tensor Cores found on modern GPUs in service of single precision (FP32) matrix multiply operations. Given that BF16 and FP32 share the same dynamic range, the option to accumulate BF16 operations into FP32 accumulators (at full-speed), and additional BF16 arithmetic characteristics specific to the Blackwell GPU architecture, such as integrated scaling hardware, such emulation is highly motivated. This paper examines the performance, efficiency, power, and numerical characteristics of FP32 matrix multiplication via BF16-based emulation and demonstrates how it exceeds numerical and performance characteristics of native FP32 for scientific applications. We also discuss a full library-ready implementation that correctly deals with denormals.

</details>


### [322] [HexAGenT: Efficient Agentic LLM Serving via Workflow- and Heterogeneity-Aware Scheduling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16637)
*You Peng,Youhe Jiang,Wenshuang Li,Xu Xu,Ke Zhou,Jiawei Jiang,Chen Wang,Binhang Yuan*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出了HexAGenT，一种针对异构预填充-解码分离LLM服务集群的工作流感知调度器，通过在线建模DAG工作流、预测完成时限并联合优化预填充/解码放置与队列优先级，显著降低了代理型LLM应用的端到端延迟SLO需求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着代理型LLM应用日益复杂，用户请求被处理为包含规划、工具调用、分支等步骤的多阶段工作流。现有研究关注单次LLM调用延迟，而用户体验的是整个工作流的端到端延迟。在异构预填充-解码分离的推理集群中，如何高效调度以满足工作流级延迟目标成为一个亟待解决的挑战性问题。

Method: 提出HexAGenT调度器：1) 将每个请求建模为在线揭示的DAG（有向无环图）；2) 维护工作流独立完成时限的实时估计；3) 根据错过时限的预估风险对就绪调用进行优先级排序；4) 联合决策预填充放置、解码放置和本地队列优先级，同时考虑KV缓存容量和跨阶段传输延迟。

Result: 在代表性代理工作负载和异构A100/H100/H200集群上的实验表明：HexAGenT在95%达成率下平均降低SLO需求20.1%，在99%达成率下平均降低33.0%；最大降幅分别达到45.0%和80.5%。

Conclusion: HexAGenT通过工作流感知的联合调度策略，有效解决了异构分离式LLM服务中的在线工作流调度问题，显著提升了代理型应用的服务质量，为实际部署提供了重要技术支撑。

Abstract: Agentic LLM applications increasingly execute user requests as multi-step workflows involving planning, tool use, branching, refinement, and synthesis. In such settings, users experience the end-to-end latency of an entire workflow, not the latency of any single LLM call. In this paper, we study how to schedule online agentic workflows across heterogeneous prefill-decode disaggregated LLM serving clusters to efficiently meet workflow-level latency objectives. The problem is challenging because workflow dependencies are revealed incrementally at runtime, calls have heterogeneous prompts, outputs, and KV-cache requirements, and the prefill and decode stages impose different compute, memory, and transfer constraints across heterogeneous GPUs. To solve this problem, we present HexAGenT, a workflow-aware scheduler for a heterogeneous prefill-decode inference service. HexAGenT models each request as an online-revealed DAG, maintains a running estimate of the workflow's standalone completion horizon, prioritizes ready calls by projected risk of missing that horizon, and jointly selects prefill placement, decode placement, and local queue priority while accounting for KV-cache capacity and cross-stage transfer latency. Across representative agentic workloads and heterogeneous A100/H100/H200 clusters, HexAGenT reduces the SLO scale required for timely workflow completion by an average of 20.1% at 95% attainment and 33.0% at 99% attainment, with maximum reductions of 45.0% and 80.5%, respectively.

</details>


### [323] [Approximate Distributed Coded Computing: Polynomial Codes and Randomized Sketching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16744)
*Neophytos Charalambides,Arya Mazumdar*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文综述了编码计算与随机化线性代数这两个领域的基础，并提出结合两者技术的分布式方案，以在存在慢速或无响应服务器的情况下加速优化和机器学习算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模系统存在瓶颈问题，高维数据分析面临挑战，且分布式系统中常有慢速或无响应服务器，需要有效方法来解决这些问题。

Method: 回顾编码计算与随机化线性代数的基础理论，将编码理论的冗余技术与随机化方法的压缩技术相结合，设计分布式计算方案。

Result: 提出了结合编码计算与随机化线性代数技术的分布式方案，能够在存在慢速或无响应服务器的环境中加速优化和机器学习算法。

Conclusion: 编码计算与随机化线性代数的结合为分布式优化和机器学习提供了有效的加速方案，能够有效应对系统瓶颈和服务器故障问题。

Abstract: Coded computing is a distributed paradigm that uses coding theory to introduce \textit{redundancy} and overcome bottlenecks in large-scale systems. In the same vein, randomized numerical linear algebra employs probabilistic methods to \textit{compress} and accelerate linear algebraic operations, addressing challenges in high-dimensional data analysis. This article reviews the foundations of both fields and presents distributed schemes that combine techniques from both to speed up optimization and machine learning algorithms, in the presence of slow or non-responsive servers. Along the way, we touch on various related topics and mathematical concepts.

</details>


### [324] [GoodServe: Towards High-Goodput Serving of Agentic LLM Inferences over Heterogeneous Resources](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16867)
*Boxiao Du,Boning Huangfu,Yizhou Luo,Chen Chen,Zijun Li,Minchen Yu,Xiaoyi Fan,Minyi Guo*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出了GoodServe系统，通过预测输出长度和GPU状态、智能路由决策以及运行时请求迁移，在异构GPU资源池上优化代理LLM推理的有效吞吐量，相比现有方法提升高达27.4%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型在新兴代理应用中扮演关键角色，需要及时完成每次推理。代理LLM推理越来越多地在异构GPU资源池上服务，因此需要将推理请求路由到合适的GPU以满足端到端延迟要求并实现高有效吞吐量。

Method: GoodServe采用预测-修正的方式进行推理路由：准确估计请求输出长度和GPU服务状态；基于需求和资源两侧信息，使用"刚好足够"的实例选择启发式方法做出高质量路由决策；周期性监控活跃请求的SLO违规风险，并触发运行时请求迁移以应对意外动态变化。

Result: 评估结果表明，GoodServe相比现有路由方法将有效吞吐量提升了高达27.4%。

Conclusion: GoodServe成功解决了异构GPU环境中代理LLM推理服务的有效吞吐量优化问题，证明了预测-修正路由方法和运行时迁移机制的有效性。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) play a critical role in emerging agentic applications, where the timely completion of each entire inference is critical. Meanwhile, agentic LLM inferences are increasingly served on heterogeneous GPUs in operator's resource pools. Therefore, it is crucial to route incoming inference requests to appropriate GPUs so that their end-to-end latency requirements are satisfied whenever possible, thereby achieving high goodput. In this paper, we propose GoodServe, a goodput-optimized serving system for agentic inferences over heterogeneous resources. GoodServe performs inference routing in a predict-and-rectify manner. It estimates the request output lengths as well as the GPU serving status in an accurate and also practical manner. Based on information from both the demand and resource sides, it then makes high-quality routing decisions using a just-enough instance selection heuristic. It also periodically monitors SLO-violation risks of active requests and triggers runtime request migrations to address unexpected dynamics. Our evaluations show that GoodServe improves goodput by up to 27.4% over existing routing methods.

</details>


### [325] [Charon: A Unified and Fine-Grained Simulator for Large-Scale LLM Training and Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17164)
*Mengtian Yang,Zhekun Zhang,Mingheng Wu,Jianwen Yan,Hanshi Sun,Li-wen Chang*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 提出了Charon，一个统一、模块化、细粒度的LLM性能模拟器，能高精度预测性能（误差低于5.35%）并指导实际部署优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模LLM训练和推理的性能部署极具挑战性，因为并行策略、系统优化和硬件配置的设计空间非常复杂。需要准确且快速的性能模拟来验证"what-if"假设，以指导优化工作。

Method: 引入了Charon模拟器，这是一个统一、模块化且细粒度的模拟器，用于准确预测LLM性能。

Result: 实验表明Charon在不同模型和配置下均实现高精度预测，总体预测误差始终低于5.35%，在大规模GPU集群训练中甚至低于3.74%。在实际推理部署案例中，Charon发现了比工程调优基线更能提高系统吞吐量的配置。

Conclusion: Charon能够高精度预测LLM性能，并在实际应用中展现出显著价值，能够发现优于工程调优基线的配置。

Abstract: Deploying large-scale LLM training and inference with optimal performance is exceptionally challenging due to a complex design space of parallelism strategies, system optimizations, and hardware configurations. Accurate and rapid performance simulation is critical for guiding optimization efforts and system studies by validating "what-if" Hooker Figure hypotheses. To address this, we introduce Charon, a unified, modular, and fine-grained simulator for accurately predicting LLM performance. Experiments show Charon achieves high accuracy across different models and configurations, with an overall prediction error consistently under 5.35%, and even under 3.74% for training with a large-scale GPU cluster. In a practical inference deployment case, Charon discovered a configuration that improved system throughput over an engineering-tuned baseline, demonstrating its significant real-world value.

</details>


### [326] [Send: Objects, History, and Transactions in a Single-Verb Kernel](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17401)
*Christopher Goes*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 提出一个最小化内核，统一实现多方对象协调的六个关键结构属性，通过单一机制替代传统的分层脆弱组合方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的多方对象协调系统（对象能力系统、智能合约平台、分布式Actor、事件溯源架构）需要组合多个独立机制（RPC、能力ACL、事务协调器、事件日志等）来实现六个结构属性，这种分层组合方式虽然每层独立研究充分，但整体组合脆弱且不兼容。

Method: 构建一个基于S表达式、统一'send'接口、事务机制和单一原语对象区分的最小化内核。核心设计是区分瞬时对象（继承调用者上下文）与持久对象（切换到内核分配的目标身份和仅追加日志）。内核通过内核调度将每个send目标结构化分类为六种情况，调用者接口统一，无需调用者输入。

Result: 在内核可信条件下，该设计以内核级别保障所有六个属性，内核的转移函数拒绝违反这些属性的状态。针对操作员的抗性方面：仅需内核可信即可保证六个属性中的五个抵抗无约束操作员；若要实现针对操作员的不透明性，还需操作员可信条件。通过密码学编译器可实现对抗性操作员部署。

Conclusion: 仅追加日志支撑不可变性、重放和历史派生状态；内核控制的持久调度提供认证溯源和不透明性；事务机制实现原子协调。该设计成功地将六个结构属性统一到一个最小化内核中，为多方对象协调提供了结构化的理论基础和实现方案。

Abstract: Multi-party object coordination - across object-capability systems, smart-contract platforms, distributed actors, and event-sourced architectures - is shaped by six structural properties: authenticated provenance, opaque encapsulation, atomic multi-object commit, deterministic replay, immutable history, and history-derived state. Existing systems compose subsets via separate layered mechanisms (RPC, capability ACLs, transaction coordinators, event journals, vat boundaries); each layer is well-studied but the combination is fragile. We present a minimal kernel which makes them jointly compatible.
  Our kernel is built from s-expressions, a uniform 'send' interface, transactions, and one primitive object distinction: *ephemeral* (caller's context inherited) vs. *persistent* (context switches to the target's kernel-assigned identity and append-only log). The kernel structurally classifies every send target into one of six cases without input from the caller - uniform caller interface, intensional kernel dispatch.
  Under kernel-faithful trust (the kernel runs its semantics as specified), this design holds all six properties as *kernel-level* against arbitrary programs - the kernel's transition function refuses states violating them. Opacity *against the operator* additionally requires operator-faithful trust (the operator accesses logs only via 'recall' and does not censor or reorder transactions); under kernel-faithful alone, five of six guarantees survive an unconstrained operator. Append-only logs underpin immutability, replay, and history-derived state; kernel-controlled persistent dispatch yields authenticated provenance and opacity; transactions deliver atomic coordination. Operator-adversarial deployments can be realized with a cryptographic compiler.

</details>


### [327] [TierCheck: Tiered Checkpointing for Fault Tolerance in Large Language Model Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17821)
*Shujie Han,Feng Jiang,Patrick P. C. Lee,Xiao Zhang,Zhijie Huang,Nannan Zhao,Xiaonan Zhao,Lichen Pan*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 提出了TierCheck，一种集群感知的分层检查点系统，通过将存储放置与故障异构性对齐，解决了LLM训练中断问题，实现了低开销持久化与快速恢复之间的最佳平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型训练经常因GPU崩溃到集群范围宕机等异构故障而中断。现有检查点系统依赖单层存储后端，被迫在状态保存开销和恢复速度之间进行权衡，无法有效应对故障异构性。

Method: 采用三层设计：在本地和对等内存中维护轻量级差异检查点以实现快速局部恢复，同时异步将重量级基础检查点迁移到远程持久存储；确保跨层级严格全局一致性而不停滞训练；在恢复期间实现快速集群感知检查点恢复。

Result: 在高达400亿参数模型上的评估表明，TierCheck实现了低训练开销，将端到端检查点时间减少到10秒以内，支持高频检查点操作。

Conclusion: TierCheck成功在低开销持久化和快速恢复之间达到最佳平衡，有效解决了LLM训练中的异构故障问题，显著提升了系统的可靠性和效率。

Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) training is frequently interrupted by a heterogeneous spectrum of failures, from common GPU crashes to catastrophic cluster-wide outages. Existing checkpointing systems rely on monolithic, single-tier storage backend, forcing a trade-off between state-saving overhead and recovery speed. We propose TierCheck, a cluster-aware tiered checkpointing system that aligns storage placement with failure heterogeneity. TierCheck adopts a three-tier design that maintains lightweight differential checkpoints in local and peer memory for fast localized recovery, while asynchronously migrating heavyweight base checkpoints to remote persistent storage. It also ensures strict global consistency across tiers without stalling training, and achieves fast cluster-aware checkpoint restoration during recovery. Evaluations on models up to 40 billion parameters show that TierCheck achieves low training overhead, reduces end-to-end checkpointing time to under 10s, and supports high-frequency checkpointing, ultimately striking an optimal balance between low-overhead persistence and fast recovery.

</details>


### [328] [Guard: Scalable Straggler Detection and Node Health Management for Large-Scale Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17879)
*Guanliang Liu,Abhinandan Patni,Congzhu Lin,Zoe Zeng,Jack Wittmayer,Josh Wu,Ashvin Nihalani,Binxuan Huang,Yinghong Liu,Rory Na,Anthony Ko,Alexander Zhipa,Cong Cheng,Mi Sun,Vijay Rajakumar,Rejith George Joseph,Parthasarathy Govindarajen*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出了Guard系统，通过结合轻量级在线监控和离线节点扫描机制，解决了大规模基础模型训练中的“fail-slow”节点检测难题，将FLOPs利用率最高提升1.7倍，训练步长方差从20%降至1%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在涉及数万张GPU、持续数月的前沿基础模型训练中，微小的性能退化会累积成巨大的效率损失。现有的健康检查机制（如NCCL测试或GPU老化测试）主要关注功能正确性，往往无法检测到悄无声息降低系统性能的“fail-slow”行为。

Method: 提出了Guard系统，该系统采用双重机制：(1) 轻量级在线性能监控，在训练过程中实时监测；(2) 离线节点扫描机制，在节点投入生产工作负载前进行系统性评估和认证。这种设计能够检测传统诊断工具无法捕捉的急性故障和长期存在的fail-slow行为。

Result: 在大规模基础模型预训练任务中部署Guard系统取得了显著成效：FLOPs利用率最高提升1.7倍；训练步长方差从20%降至1%；增加了平均故障时间（MTTF）；显著减少了运维和调试开销。

Conclusion: 主动的落后节点（straggler）检测和系统性的节点认证对于维持大规模训练的稳定性和高效性至关重要，证明了Guard系统在大规模AI基础设施中的实用价值。

Abstract: Training frontier-scale foundation models involves coordinating tens of thousands of GPUs over multi-month runs, where even minor performance degradations can accumulate into substantial efficiency losses. Existing health-check mechanisms, such as NCCL tests or GPU burn-in, primarily focus on functional correctness and often fail to detect fail-slow behaviors that silently degrade system performance. In this paper, we present Guard, a scalable system for detecting stragglers and ensuring node health in large-scale training clusters. Guard combines lightweight online performance monitoring during training with an offline node-sweep mechanism that systematically evaluates and qualifies nodes before they participate in production workloads. This design enables Guard to detect both acute failures and long-running fail-slow behaviors that traditional diagnostics cannot capture. Deployed on large-scale foundation model pretraining workloads, Guard improves mean FLOPs utilization by up to 1.7x, reduces run-to-run training step variance from 20% to 1%, increases mean time to failure (MTTF), and significantly reduces operational and debugging overhead. These results demonstrate that proactive straggler detection and systematic node qualification are critical for maintaining stable and efficient large-scale training.

</details>


### [329] [iHAC: A Hybrid Cluster Architecture for Enhanced Performance and Resilience](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18361)
*Siddique Abubakr Muntaka,Edward Danso Ansong,Benjamin Yankson,Oliver Kornyo,Faiza Hussein,Mohammed Nadhir Muntaka,Joshua Dagadu,Prince Clement Addo,Maxwell Dorgbefu Jnr.,Franco Osei-Wusu,Foster Yeboah,Michael Asante*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为iHAC的混合架构高可用集群，通过融合双活与主备配置的优势，显著提升了系统性能与容错能力，仿真实验显示HTTP页面响应时间减少超过40%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统高可用集群存在单点故障风险和资源分配效率低下等局限性，难以满足企业对不间断系统可用性的严苛要求，因此亟需一种更具弹性和高性能的集群架构设计。

Method: 提出并设计了集成式高可用集群（iHAC），该架构融合了双活和主备配置的优势，以优化工作负载分配和故障转移能力；使用Riverbed Modeler（OPNET）进行仿真建模，将iHAC与传统遗留集群进行对比分析。

Result: 实验结果表明iHAC性能显著提升：与传统的双活设置相比，平均HTTP页面响应时间从5秒降至3秒以内，降幅超过40%；同时降低了网络延迟并提高了整体吞吐量。

Conclusion: 研究验证了iHAC架构在构建稳健、高性能系统方面的优越性，为实现更高的业务连续性和系统弹性提供了一条切实可行的技术路径。

Abstract: Uninterrupted system availability is a critical requirement for enterprise operations, yet traditional high-availability clusters suffer from limitations such as single points of failure and inefficient resource allocation. This paper introduces and evaluates the Integrated High Availability Cluster (iHAC), a hybrid architecture designed to enhance system resilience and performance. The iHAC integrates the strengths of active-active and active-passive configurations to optimize workload distribution and failover capabilities. We conducted a comparative analysis, simulating iHAC against conventional (legacy) clusters using Riverbed Modeler (OPNET). The results reveal significant performance improvements: iHAC reduced the average HTTP page response time by over 40%, from five seconds in a traditional active-active setup to under three seconds. This was achieved alongside reduced network latency and increased overall throughput. This study validates the iHAC architecture as a superior design for building robust, high-performance systems, offering a practical path to greater operational continuity and resilience.

</details>


### [330] [AdaptiveLoad: Towards Efficient Video Diffusion Transformer Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17923)
*Yucheng Guo,Yongjian Guo,Zhong Guan,Haoran Sun,Wen Huang,Wanting Xu,Jing Long,Shuai Di,Junwu Xiong*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出AdaptiveLoad优化框架，通过双约束负载均衡和融合CUDA内核，解决了大规模视频扩散Transformer训练中的负载不均衡问题，显著提升了GPU资源利用率和训练吞吐量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在视频生成模型（特别是世界模型）中，训练大规模视频扩散Transformer（如DiT和MMDiT）面临巨大计算挑战。现有基于桶的数据加载策略依赖"等token长度"约束，未考虑自注意力机制的二次复杂度特性，导致严重的负载不均衡和GPU资源利用率低下。

Method: 提出AdaptiveLoad集成优化框架，包含两个核心组件：(1)双约束自适应负载均衡系统，通过同时限制内存消耗和计算负载（$B \times S^p \le M_{\text{comp}}$）来消除长序列瓶颈；(2)融合LayerNorm-Modulate CUDA内核，采用D-tile合并归约策略来提高吞吐量并缓解内存压力。

Result: 在Wan 2.1世界模型上的实验结果表明：计算不均衡率从39%降至18.9%，峰值显存利用效率提升22.7%，整体训练吞吐量提升27.2%。

Conclusion: AdaptiveLoad框架有效解决了混合模式数据集中序列长度极端变化导致的训练效率问题，为大尺度视频扩散模型的训练提供了实用的优化方案，显著改善了GPU资源利用率。

Abstract: In video generation models, particularly world models, training large-scale video diffusion Transformers (such as DiT and MMDiT) poses significant computational challenges due to the extreme variance in sequence lengths within mixed-mode datasets. Existing bucket-based data loading strategies typically rely on "equal token length" constraints. This approach fails to account for the quadratic complexity of self-attention mechanisms, leading to severe load imbalance and underutilization of GPU resources.
  This paper proposes \textit{AdaptiveLoad}, an integrated optimization framework consisting of two core components: (1) A dual-constraint adaptive load balancing system, which eliminates long-sequence bottlenecks by simultaneously limiting memory consumption and computational load ($B \times S^p \le M_{\text{comp}}$); (2) A fused LayerNorm-Modulate CUDA kernel, which utilizes a D-tile coalesced reduction strategy to increase throughput and alleviate memory pressure. Experimental results on the Wan 2.1 world model demonstrate that our method reduces the computational imbalance rate from 39\% to 18.9\%, improves peak VRAM utilization efficiency by 22.7\%, and achieves an overall training throughput increase of 27.2\%.

</details>


### [331] [The Task Completion Problem and its Application to Crash-Resilient Computation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17961)
*Orr Fischer,Ran Gelles*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文研究了任务完成问题，提出了一种在容错拥挤团模型下最优的确定性算法，并改进了容错算法模拟的轮数复杂度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究在拥挤团网络中，当最多αn个节点可能发生崩溃故障时，如何高效地完成M个抽象任务的问题。现有研究在容错算法模拟方面的效率有待提升。

Method: 提出了一种新颖的组合结构——“负载均衡覆盖族”。该结构为每个任务分配一组负责节点，其性质保证无论哪些任务未完成或哪些节点崩溃：(i) 节点负载均衡，不会被未完成任务过载；(ii) 每个任务都有足够的潜在分配节点。这防止了非崩溃节点集中在少量任务上，确保了任务完成进度。

Result: 1. 任务完成算法：在O(⌈M/n⌉ log n)轮内完成所有M个任务，该复杂度在log log n项内是最优的。
2. 算法模拟应用：可以在O(T² log n + T log² n)轮内确定性模拟任何T轮拥挤团算法，优于Censor-Hillel等人(DISC 2025)提出的T²·2^{O(√(log n)·log log n)}轮结果。

Conclusion: 通过引入负载均衡覆盖族这一关键技术，实现了容错拥挤团模型下任务完成问题的近似最优算法，并为容错分布式算法模拟提供了更高效的解决方案。

Abstract: We study the Task Completion problem, in which $M$ abstract tasks must be completed by a network of $n$ crash-prone nodes, where up to $αn$ nodes may crash for some constant $α<1$. Our main result is a deterministic congested-clique algorithm that completes all $M$ tasks in $O(\lceil M/n\rceil \log n)$ rounds. This round complexity is optimal up to $\log\log n$ terms.
  The key technical ingredient underlying our algorithm is a novel combinatorial structure, which we call a \emph{load balancing covering family}. In essence, this covering family induces, for each task, a subset of nodes responsible for attempting to complete it. The properties of the load balancing covering family guarantee that, regardless of which tasks remain incomplete and which nodes crash, (i) no node is overloaded with incomplete tasks, and (ii) no task is left with too few potential assigned nodes. This yields a balanced per-node workload and prevents non-crashed nodes from being concentrated on a small subset of tasks, thereby ensuring sufficient progress in completing the remaining tasks.
  As an application of our task completion method, we give a deterministic algorithm for simulating any $T$-round congested-clique algorithm in the presence of up to $αn$ crash faults in $O(T^2 \log n + T \log^2 n)$ rounds. This improves upon a recent result by Censor-Hillel et al. (DISC~2025), which requires $T^2\cdot 2^{O(\sqrt{\log n}\log\log n)}$ rounds.

</details>


### [332] [Distributed Renaming with Subquadratic Bits via Scalable Committee Election](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18086)
*Sirui Bai,Xinyu Fu,Yuyi Wang,Chaodong Zheng*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出了首批同时实现多对数级时间复杂度和亚二次方通信复杂度的拜占庭容错重命名算法，打破了传统算法中时间效率与消息效率的权衡瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在分布式计算的重命名问题中，现有的拜占庭容错算法面临效率困境：能实现对数级时间复杂度的算法往往需要Ω(n²)的高消息复杂度，而近期突破二次方消息复杂度的工作却需要线性运行时间并依赖共享随机性。本文旨在设计一种同时具备时间高效、消息高效且能容忍拜占庭故障的重命名算法，且仅需消息认证而不依赖共享随机性。
