Method: 提出了两个随机化算法，均可容忍最多(1/3-δ)n个拜占庭故障节点。第一个算法假设存在共享随机性，通过委员会选举机制实现对数级轮次与近似线性通信开销。第二个算法消除共享随机性假设，利用一种新颖且可扩展的委员会选举原语，实现多对数级运行时间，通信开销为Õ(n+min{nf,T})。该委员会选举原语是关键技术支撑，可被集成到其他算法中以低成本实现强容错。

Result: 首个算法在共享随机性假设下，实现了O(poly-log(n))轮终止时间和Õ(n)的总通信开销，在多对数因子内匹配已知下界。第二个算法无需共享随机性，同样实现O(poly-log(n))运行时间，并在广泛参数范围内实现亚二次方通信成本。这是首个在不依赖共享随机性的情况下，同时实现多对数级运行时间和亚二次方通信成本的拜占庭重命名算法。

Conclusion: 本研究成功解决了分布式重命名问题中时间效率与消息效率难以兼得的挑战，提出的算法在仅需消息认证的前提下，实现了强重命名和保序重命名，兼具高效性与强容错性。所提出的可扩展委员会选举原语具有通用价值，可广泛应用于其他分布式计算问题。

Abstract: In distributed computing, the renaming problem requires $n$ nodes with unique identities from a large namespace $[N]$ to acquire new, distinct identities from a smaller target namespace $[M]$. A solution is strong if $M=n$, and is order-preserving if the relative order of identities is maintained. In the synchronous message-passing model, although many fault-tolerant renaming algorithms achieve logarithmic time complexity, they universally incur a high message complexity of $Ω(n^2)$. Recent work breaks the quadratic barrier, but demands linear runtime and relies on shared randomness.
  This paper addresses the challenge of designing renaming algorithms that are simultaneously time-efficient, message-efficient, and Byzantine fault-tolerant, assuming only message authentication. We present two randomized algorithms for strong and order-preserving renaming that tolerate up to $(1/3-δ)n$ Byzantine failures for any constant $δ>0$. Our first algorithm, which assumes shared randomness, terminates in $O(\text{poly-log}(n))$ rounds with $\tilde{O}(n)$ total communication cost. This matches known lower bounds within poly-logarithmic factor. Our second algorithm eliminates the shared randomness assumption and achieves $O(\text{poly-log}(n))$ runtime with $\tilde{O}(n+\min\{nf,T\})$ total communication cost, where $f$ is the actual number of faulty nodes and $T$ is the amount of messages faulty nodes sent. This gives the first Byzantine renaming algorithm that achieves both poly-logarithmic runtime and subquadratic communication cost for a wide range of parameter regimes, without shared randomness. A key technical enabler is a novel and scalable committee election primitive that could be easily integrated into other algorithms to solve various distributed computing problems with low cost and strong fault-tolerance.

</details>


### [333] [Early-Stabilizing Counting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18171)
*Christoph Lenzen,Julian Loss*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出了首个具有早期稳定化特性的同步计数算法，实现了关于故障数量f的自适应稳定时间O(f+1)和摊销比特复杂度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对同步系统中存在至多t个拜占庭故障节点的自稳定同步计数问题，现有算法的稳定时间与实际故障数量f无关。本文受到早期停止共识协议的启发，提出了早期稳定化概念，旨在使算法的稳定时间和摊销比特复杂度能够自适应地取决于实际发生的故障数量f，而非最坏情况下的t。

Method: 作者开发了一系列模块化的构建模块，利用这些组件设计了一个C-计数算法。该方法借鉴了早期停止共识协议的设计思想，通过模块化的方式实现了对实际故障数量f的自适应，确保在仅有f个故障时能够快速稳定。

Result: 所提出的C-计数算法在渐近最优的O(f+1)轮内完成稳定，消息大小为O(log²n + log C)，摊销比特复杂度为O(n(f log C + log²n))，实现了稳定时间和通信复杂度对实际故障数量f的自适应。

Conclusion: 本文成功地将早期停止的概念引入自稳定领域，证明了在拜占庭故障模型下可以实现既具有渐近最优稳定时间又具有故障自适应通信复杂度的同步计数算法，为自稳定算法的效率优化提供了新的思路。

Abstract: Synchronous Counting is the task of reaching agreement on a common round counter in a synchronous system of $n$ nodes with up to $t$ Byzantine faults in a self-stabilizing manner. That is, after transient faults may have arbitrarily corrupted the system state and ceased, the at least $n-t$ non-faulty nodes need to (re-)establish that (i) their local outputs are identical and (ii) increase by $1$ modulo $C$ in each round. An overhead-free reduction from consensus shows that all known lower bounds and impossibilities for consensus carry over to the counting problem. In the other direction, prior work has established that a consensus algorithm $\mathcal{A}$ can be turned into a counting algorithm at small overhead relative to the running time and bit complexity of $\mathcal{A}$, without losing resilience.
  Taking inspiration from early-stopping consensus protocols, in this work we introduce the concept of early stabilization. That is, if there are $0\le f\le t$ (persistent) faults in an execution, the algorithm should stabilize in a number of rounds that depends on $f$ only. Likewise, we seek to achieve an amortized bit complexity that is adaptive in the number of actual faults $f$. By developing a number of modular building blocks suitable to these goals, we develop a $C$-counting algorithm that stabilizes within asymptotically optimal $O(f+1)$ rounds, has message size $O(\log^2 n + \log C)$, and has amortized bit complexity $O(n(f\log C +\log^2 n))$.

</details>


### [334] [ASSESSING THE STOCHASTIC PROPERTIES OF MODERN PSEUDO-RANDOM GENERATORS FOR PARALLEL COMPUTING](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18227)
*Théau Wartel,David R. C. Hill*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文对高性能计算和人工智能领域的现代伪随机数生成器（Xoshiro、Philox、PCG、MRG32k3a）进行了大规模系统性评估。通过对每个生成器超过1000个流进行TestU01 BigCrush测试，发现即使表现最好的生成器成功率仅为72%，几乎所有生成器都未能通过所有测试。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 伪随机数生成器（PRNGs）在现代计算中被广泛使用，且被期望具有优良的统计性能和可重复性。然而，目前缺乏针对高性能计算和人工智能领域中现代PRNGs的大规模、系统性评估研究，尤其是在多流测试场景下的表现。本研究旨在填补这一空白，对主流PRNG进行全面的实证分析。

Method: 研究者选取了来自不同家族的现代PRNGs（包括Xoshiro、Philox、PCG和MRG32k3a），使用TestU01库中的BigCrush测试套件进行系统评估。与以往仅测试单个流的方法不同，本研究对每个生成器测试了超过1000个流。所有测试在一致的条件下进行，并模拟真实世界的使用场景。测试结果通过git仓库公开，确保可复现性。

Result: 测试累计计算时间超过4.5年。结果显示，表现最好的生成器最高成功率仅为72%，几乎所有生成器都未能通过所有测试。研究记录了所有失败的测试项，并将测试结果与生成器作者的声明进行了对比分析。

Conclusion: 研究表明，即便是现代主流的伪随机数生成器，在大规模多流测试场景下也存在统计性能缺陷。这挑战了生成器作者的某些声明，强调了在实际应用中选择PRNG时需要进行更严格的测试评估，同时也为后续PRNG的设计和改进提供了重要的实证依据。

Abstract: Pseudo-random number generators (PRNGs) are widely used in modern computing and are expected to exhibit excellent statistical performance and repeatability. This study evaluates and compares modern PRNGs used in high performance computing and artificial intelligence. Our selections comes from different families, including Xoshiro, Philox, PCG, and MRG32k3a. We systematically assess the quality of these generators; instead of testing a single stream for each generator, we test more than 10 3 streams with the BigCrush battery form the TestU01 library. The results, involving more than 4.5 years of cumulative computing time, are analyzed against the claims made by the generators' creators. The highest success rate is 72%, and all tests have been failed by almost every generator, the failed tests are documented. To ensure fairness, all tests are conducted under consistent conditions and are designed to closely simulate real-world usage. The results of each test are available, usable and reproducible with a git repository.

</details>


### [335] [Duet instrumentation: An Agentic Approach to Improving Sensitivity in Cloud Service Benchmarking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18397)
*Sebastian Koch,Nils Japke,David Bermbach*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为"duet instrumentation"的新型基准测试范式，利用大语言模型（LLM）分析连续版本间的代码变化，在同步基准测试中直接测量性能相关变化，从而以更高灵敏度检测性能回归，相比传统方法能检测到严重程度低5倍的性能问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 云服务持续性能基准测试对于在生产部署前发现性能Bug至关重要。然而，应用基准测试将系统视为黑盒，由于I/O调用可变或底层云基础设施性能特征变化，难以检测性能回归；微基准测试虽然更敏感准确，但实现和运行耗时且无法捕获集成系统的整体性能。现有方法存在明显不足，亟需一种结合两者优势的新方法。

Method: 提出"duet instrumentation"基准测试范式，利用大语言模型的代码理解能力，分析两个连续应用版本间的代码变化，在同步基准测试期间直接在性能相关变化处测量性能差异。设计了自动化系统，可靠地评估和插桩两个应用版本间的性能相关代码变化。

Result: 在提供可配置性能回归的真实测试床应用实验中，原型系统在行距离阈值为5时，相比理想插桩平均达到58%精确率、93%召回率和71%特异性。在下游应用基准测试中，原型能在注入严重程度低至传统duet应用基准测试的5倍时仍能检测到性能回归，同时保持相似的A/A延迟分布。

Conclusion: duet instrumentation范式成功结合了应用基准测试和微基准测试的优势，通过LLM驱动的代码变化分析和同步基准测试，实现了更高灵敏度的性能回归检测，为云服务持续性能监控提供了有效的自动化解决方案。

Abstract: Continuous cloud service performance benchmarking is essential for detecting performance bugs early before deploying them to production. However, detecting performance regressions using application benchmarks, which usually treat the system under test as a black box, is challenging due to variable I/O calls or changing performance characteristics of the underlying cloud infrastructure. Microbenchmarks are often more sensitive and accurate, but also more time-consuming to implement and run. Further, they do not capture the performance of the integrated system as a whole. A comprehensive performance assessment therefore typically requires a combination of both approaches. To address the shortcomings of application benchmarks, we propose duet instrumentation, a novel benchmarking paradigm enabled by recent advancements in large language model (LLM) code understanding. The idea is to analyze code changes between two consecutive application versions and measure performance differences directly at performance-relevant changes during a synchronized benchmark of both application versions, uncovering performance changes with higher sensitivity. We design a system that reliably automates the assessment and instrumentation of performance-relevant code changes between the two application versions. In experiments with a realistic testbed application offering configurable performance regressions, we find that our prototype achieves 58% precision, 93% recall, and 71% specificity (averaged across tasks) when comparing the generated instrumentation against the ideal instrumentation with a line-distance threshold of five. In the downstream application benchmark, we find that our prototype can detect performance regressions at up to 5x lower injected severity compared to a traditional duet application benchmark while preserving similar A/A latency distributions.

</details>


### [336] [JanusPipe: Efficient Pipeline Parallel Training for Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18404)
*Hongyu Wang,Weijian Liu,Hongtao Xu,Yan Wang,Mingzhen Li,Weile Jia,Guangming Tan*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 提出了JanusPipe，一个针对保守机器学习原子间势(MLIPs)的高效三维并行训练系统，通过SymFold和WaveK技术解决了双反向传播模式带来的流水线并行挑战，在32 GPUs上相比基线方法平均提升1.45-1.51倍吞吐量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 发现原子级现象需要具有第一性原理精度的分子动力学(MD)模拟。机器学习原子间势(MLIPs)能够实现稳定、高精度的MD模拟，且表现出类似于大语言模型的缩放定律趋势。然而，缺乏可扩展且高效的分布式训练系统使得保守MLIPs难以规模化，原因是保守MLIPs固有地遵循双反向传播执行模式，在正向传播过程中涉及计算梯度，这种模式与现有的分布式训练系统（特别是流水线并行）存在不匹配。

Method: 提出了JanusPipe，一个为保守MLIPs量身定制的三维并行(PP/DP/GP)训练系统。该系统集成了两项关键技术：1) SymFold，用于为保守MLIPs实现内存高效的流水线并行；2) WaveK，通过平衡四阶段计算时间来减少流水线气泡。

Result: 在32个GPU上的实验结果表明，JanusPipe相比1F1B和Hanayo分别平均提升了1.51倍和1.45倍的吞吐量。

Conclusion: JanusPipe成功解决了保守MLIPs在分布式训练中的可扩展性问题，通过专门设计的SymFold和WaveK技术有效处理了双反向传播模式带来的挑战，为大规模MLIPs训练提供了高效的解决方案。

Abstract: Discovering atom-level phenomena requires molecular dynamics (MD) simulations with ab initio accuracy. Machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) enable stable, high-accuracy MD simulations, and their models exhibit scaling-law trends similar to large language models. However, the lack of scalable and efficient distributed training systems for conservative MLIPs makes them difficult to scale. This is because conservative MLIPs inherently follow a double-backward execution pattern, which involves computing gradients during the forward pass. This pattern creates a mismatch with existing distributed training systems, especially for pipeline parallelism. Therefore, we present JanusPipe, an efficient 3D-parallel (PP/DP/GP) training system tailored for conservative MLIPs. It integrates SymFold to enable memory-efficient pipeline parallelism for conservative MLIPs, and WaveK to reduce pipeline bubbles by balancing the four-phase compute time. Experimental results on 32 GPUs show that JanusPipe improves throughput by $1.51\times$ and $1.45\times$ on average over 1F1B and Hanayo, respectively.

</details>


### [337] [Residue Number System Comparison revisited, a software perspective](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18415)
*Laurent-Stéphane Didier,Léa Glandus,Nadia El Mrabet,Jean-Marc Robert*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种利用额外模数在余数系统（RNS）中比较两个数的新方法，具有全范围适用、无需特殊模数形式且复杂度低的优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在RNS中进行数值比较是一个经典难题。现有的先进方法通常受限于特定的RNS基数、要求输入数值有界限，或需要特殊形式的模数，这些限制阻碍了RNS在除法、缩放及密码学应用等领域的发展。

Method: 该方法利用一个在模运算和数字信号处理缩放中通常可用的额外模数，通过进行一次向混合基数表示的转换来实现两个整数的比较。该转换复杂度为O(n²)，通过并行化可降低至O(log(n))。

Result: 该方法实现了在RNS基数全范围内对两个整数的比较，无需对模数形式或输入数值范围施加特殊限制，相比传统方法和现有竞争方法具有显著优势。

Conclusion: 该方法克服了现有RNS比较技术的局限性，为推进除法、缩放及密码学应用等具有挑战性的RNS运算开辟了新前景。

Abstract: This paper presents a novel method to compare two numbers in Residue Number System (RNS) using an additional modulus, which is often already available because it is required in modular computations and digital signal processing scaling.Our method provides the comparison of two integers in the full range of the RNS base. It does not require moduli of a special form, unlike other state-of-the-art methods that are restricted to specific RNS bases or require bounds on input numbers. Our approach only requires one single conversion to a mixed radix representation with a complexity of O(n2), which can be reduced to O(log(n)) in time with parallelization. This provides a significant advantage over classical methods and more recent competitive methods which work under restrictions. This opens perspectives for advancements in challenging RNS operations such as division, scaling, and cryptographic applications.

</details>


### [338] [CB-SpMV:A Data Aggregating and Balance Algorithm for Cache-Friendly Block-Based SpMV on GPUs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18515)
*Xing Cong,Fukai Sun,Yifan Chen,Chenhao Xie*,Yi Liu,Depei Qian*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 提出CB-SpMV算法，通过数据收敛和自适应2D分块结构优化GPU上的稀疏矩阵-向量乘法，在2843个矩阵上相比现有方法实现最高3.95倍加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SpMV在计算科学、工程和机器学习中至关重要。尽管已有大量GPU优化工作，但数据局部性、硬件利用率和负载均衡问题仍然存在，仍有进一步优化空间。

Method: 提出CB-SpMV算法：1) 采用数据收敛和自适应2D分块结构，将矩阵划分为独立子块；2) 使用虚拟指针聚合块内数据以提升缓存级数据局部性；3) 设计块感知列聚合策略和子块格式选择机制以加速计算并适应不同稀疏矩阵；4) 提出块间负载均衡算法确保线程块间高效工作负载分配。

Result: 在SuiteSparse Collection的2,843个矩阵上进行实验评估，CB-SpMV显著提升缓存命中率，在NVIDIA A100和RTX 4090 GPU上相比cuSPARSE-BSR、TileSpMV、DASP等最先进方法实现平均最高3.95倍加速。

Conclusion: CB-SpMV通过创新的数据收敛和自适应分块策略有效解决了SpMV在GPU上的数据局部性、硬件利用率和负载均衡问题，为大规模稀疏矩阵计算提供了高效的优化方案。

Abstract: Sparse matrix-vector multiplication (SpMV) is crucial in computational science, engineering, and machine learning. Despite substantial efforts to improve SpMV performance on GPUs through various techniques, issues related to data locality, hardware utilization, and load balancing persist, leaving room for further optimization. This paper presents CB-SpMV, a cache-friendly SpMV optimization algorithm, using a novel data convergent and adaptable 2D blocking structure. The matrix in CB-SpMV is divided into independent sub-blocks, with virtual pointers aggregating different types of intra-block data for better cache-level data locality. To enhance hardware utilization, a block-aware column aggregation strategy and the selection of sub-block formats are proposed to accelerate computation and adapt to varying sparse matrices. Finally, an inter-block load-balancing algorithm is designed to ensure efficient workload distribution across thread blocks. Experimental evaluations on 2,843 matrices from the SuiteSparse Collection show that CB-SpMV significantly improves cache hit rates and achieves average speedups of up to 3.95x over state-of-the-art methods like cuSPARSE-BSR, TileSpMV, and DASP on NVIDIA A100 and RTX 4090 GPUs. The implementation is available at: \url{https://github.com/xing-cong/CB-Sparse}.

</details>


### [339] [EPIC: Abstraction and Polymorphism of In-Network Collectives on Ethernet](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18683)
*Yitao Yuan,Jianglong Nie,Tianyu Bai,Ruizhe Zhou,Siyuan Cao,Xujie Fan,Yuchen Xu,Junkai Chen,Chenqi Zhao,Nengyuan Zhang,Shaoke Fang,Jiangyuan Chen,Yuanfeng Chen,Jiaqi Sun,Zhan Wang,Xiaohua Xu,Yuchao Zhang,Yang Liu,Xiangrui Yang,Jing Lin,Xiaohe Hu,Yang Li,Chao Jiang,Limin Xiao,Weifeng Zhang,Junjie Wang,Wei Cheng,Yazhu Lan,Jianbo Dong,Binzhang Fu,Wenfei Wu*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出了EPIC，一种基于“统一抽象、多态实现”原则的以太网多态网络内集合加速协议规范及参考系统，旨在通过模块化设计、形式化验证及统一资源管理模型，解决开放以太网生态系统中INC的跨层采用难题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 网络内集合（INC）加速对优化AI训练和推理具有巨大潜力，但其跨层特性在开放的以太网生态系统中历来阻碍了相关投资与采用。为了弥合这一差距，需要一个能够兼容标准以太网且适应不同硬件能力的INC解决方案。

Method: 提出了EPIC，遵循“统一抽象、多态实现”原则。引入兼容标准以太网的抽象，将功能边界与参与者角色对齐，并提供适应不同硬件能力的多态实现。解决三大挑战：一是采用模块化设计，支持从简单到复杂的演进路径；二是应用形式化验证方法证明所有多态模式的正确性；三是开发统一资源管理模型以适应多种INC场景。

Result: 通过广泛的验证——包括模型检测、数据包/流仿真、虚拟机仿真、Tofino测试床以及FPGA/RTL验证——确认了EPIC的正确性、性能提升和可行性。

Conclusion: EPIC成功弥合了INC在开放以太网生态中的采用差距，证明了其在正确性、性能和可行性方面的有效性，为未来的硬件迭代和生态发展提供了坚实基础。

Abstract: In-Network Collective (INC) acceleration holds immense potential for optimizing AI training and inference; however, its cross-layer nature has historically hindered investment and adoption within the open Ethernet ecosystem. To bridge this gap, we propose EPIC (Ethernet Polymorphic In-network Collective), an INC protocol specification and reference system built on the principle of "Unified Abstraction, Polymorphic Realization." EPIC introduces an abstraction compatible with standard Ethernet that aligns functional boundaries with participant roles, while offering polymorphic realizations tailored to varying hardware capabilities.
  We address three fundamental challenges: first, we employ a modular design that enables an evolutionary path from simple to complex implementations, allowing vendors to iterate their hardware incrementally; second, we apply formal verification methodologies to prove the correctness of all proposed polymorphic modes; and third, we develop a unified resource management model versatile enough for diverse INC scenarios. Extensive validation -- spanning model checking, packet/flow simulations, VM emulation, Tofino Testbed, and FPGA/RTL verification -- confirms EPIC's correctness, performance gain, and feasibility.

</details>


### [340] [PopPy: Opportunistically Exploiting Parallelism in Python Compound AI Applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18697)
*Stephen Mell,David Mell,Konstantinos Kallas,Steve Zdancewic,Osbert Bastani*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: PopPy是一个针对Python复合AI应用的优化系统，通过自动并行化外部组件调用，实现了最高6.4倍的端到端加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 复合AI应用通过Python等通用编程语言组合ML模型调用，广泛应用于软件工程和企业自动化等领域。与传统应用不同，这类应用的执行时间主要由外部组件（如ML模型）主导，传统语言优化系统（如优化编译器）无法处理这些外部调用的优化问题，导致端到端延迟成为关键瓶颈。

Method: 开发PopPy系统，结合AOT编译器和运行时环境，通过自动发现Python应用中调用重型外部组件（包括复合AI应用中的组件）的并行化机会来优化性能。该系统支持Python的表达性片段，只需最少的开发者输入即可发现并行性，并解决了从Python应用中提取并行性的三个关键挑战：语言复杂性、动态分发和变量可变性。

Result: 在一组真实世界的复合AI应用上，PopPy相比标准Python执行实现了最高6.4倍的端到端执行加速，同时保持了顺序程序语义的正确性。

Conclusion: PopPy成功解决了传统优化系统无法处理的外部组件调用优化问题，为复合AI应用提供了一种有效的自动并行化解决方案，在保证程序语义正确性的前提下显著提升了应用性能。

Abstract: Compound AI applications, which compose calls to ML models using a general-purpose programming language like Python, are widely used for a variety of user-facing tasks, from software engineering to enterprise automation, making their end-to-end latency a critical bottleneck. In contrast to traditional applications, execution time is dominated by the external components, which cannot be handled by traditional language optimization systems, like optimizing compilers.
  To address this problem, we develop PopPy, a system that can uncover parallelization opportunities in Python applications that invoke these heavy external components, including those used in compound AI applications. PopPy supports a very expressive fragment of Python and requires minimal developer input to uncover parallelism. It combines an ahead-of-time compiler with a runtime, addressing three key challenges in extracting parallelism from Python applications: language complexity, dynamic dispatch, and variable mutation. On a set of real-world compound AI applications, PopPy achieves up to $6.4\times$ speedups in end-to-end execution time compared to standard Python execution while preserving the sequential program semantics.

</details>


### [341] [Ranking Opinions with Few States in Population Protocols](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18707)
*Tom-Lukas Breitkopf,Julien Dallot,Antoine El-Hayek,Stefan Schmid*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出了名为CIRCLES的新协议，将相对多数问题的状态复杂度从$O(k^7)$显著降低至$k^3$。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 群体协议中相对多数问题的状态复杂度长期存在较大差距，仅知介于$\Omega(k^2)$和$O(k^7)$之间，亟需更精确的状态界限。现有基于对决的方法难以有效推广至多颜色情况。

Method: 提出CIRCLES协议，将智能体划分为递减大小的循环链表，并确保同色智能体不位于同一环中。该方法摒弃了传统对决思路，转而利用环结构的性质来识别多数颜色，并能对抗最强对抗性调度器（弱公平调度器）。

Result: 成功设计出仅需$k^3$状态的相对多数问题解决方案，大幅缩小了状态复杂度的上下界差距。该协议可扩展处理平局判定、颜色无先验排序等情况，改进后还能以$2 \cdot k^4$状态解决排序问题。

Conclusion: CIRCLES协议为相对多数问题提供了更优的状态复杂度上界，证明了环结构方法在多颜色场景下的有效性，为后续进一步缩小状态复杂度界限奠定了基础。

Abstract: Population protocols are a model of distributed computing where $n$ agents, each a simple finite-state machine, interact in pairs to solve a common task against a (adversarial) interaction scheduler. This model was intensively studied in recent years; in particular, the problem of relative majority received much attention: Each agent starts with an input opinion (or color) out of $k$ possibilities, and the goal is for each agent to eventually output the color with the largest support in the population. Before our work, the state complexity (the minimum number of states required per agent) was only known to be between $Ω(k^2)$ and $O(k^{7})$. Our main contribution is a population protocol that solves the relative majority problem with $k^3$ states. We achieve this result with a new protocol called CIRCLES. While prior approaches in the literature relied on duels of agents to find the majority color -- an approach that proved effective for the case with two colors -- CIRCLES partitions the agents into circular linked lists of decreasing sizes, with the property that no two agents with the same initial color lie in the same circle. We show that CIRCLES always correctly computes the desired structure against the most adversarial of schedulers (weakly fair). We then show that a trivial extension of CIRCLES solves the relative majority problem. We extend our protocol to handle various tie-breaking mechanisms or to support the case where the agents do not share a prior ordering of the colors. Finally, we show that a modification of CIRCLES solves the ranking problem with $2 \cdot k^4$ states, where each agent must output the rank of its initial color in the population.

</details>


### [342] [Mosaic: Towards Efficient Training of Multimodal Models with Spatial Resource Multiplexing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18710)
*Yanbo Wang,Yuxuan Wang,Chen Chen,Chunyu Xue,Yu Feng,Anbang Wu,Quan Chen,Yin Chen,Qizhen Weng*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 提出了Apollo系统，通过时空复用策略让多个多模态模型模块同置于一GPU上，解决了现有时间复用方式GPU利用率低的问题，实现了最高1.31倍的训练加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着多模态模型（MMs）在实际场景中的广泛采用，高效训练具有日益复杂模块架构的新兴MMs变得至关重要。现有工作采用时间复用方式，即一个GPU仅分配给一个MM模块，这导致单个模块往往无法实现高GPU利用率，从而损害了训练效率。

Method: 提出Apollo系统，采用时空复用方式部署MMs，允许将多个MM模块以受控的资源配额同置于一个GPU上。具体包括：1) 开发支持任意资源配额MM训练的灵活轻量级执行引擎；2) 构建全面准确的性能模型，用于估算不同分配方案下的模块执行时间；3) 基于性能模型采用有效的启发式算法高效推导高质量的MM部署方案。

Result: 测试平台实验表明，Apollo有效提升了流行多模态模型的训练效率，实现了高达1.31倍的训练加速。

Conclusion: Apollo系统通过时空复用策略成功提高了GPU利用率，验证了在多模态模型训练中采用时空复用部署方案的可行性与有效性，为高效训练复杂架构的多模态模型提供了新的解决方案。

Abstract: With the wide adoption of Multimodal Models (MMs) in real-world scenarios, it is significant to efficiently train emerging MMs that exhibit increasingly complex module architectures. For MM deployment, existing works allocate a GPU to only one MM module in a temporal-multiplexing manner; this compromises training efficiency because a single module often fails to achieve high GPU utilization. To improve GPU utilization and enable efficient MM training, we propose deploying MMs in a temporal-spatial multiplexing manner, allowing multiple MM modules to colocate on a GPU with well-controlled resource quotas. In this paper, we propose Apollo, an efficient MM training system that applies temporal-spatial multiplexing. We first develop a flexible and lightweight execution engine that supports MM training with arbitrary resource quotas, and then build a comprehensive and accurate performance model to estimate module execution time under different allocation plans. With the performance model, we further adopt effective heuristics to derive high-quality MM deployment plans efficiently. Testbed experiments confirm that Apollo effectively improves the training efficiency of popular MMs, with a training speedup of up to 1.31x.

</details>


### [343] [A Readiness-Driven Runtime for Pipeline-Parallel Training under Runtime Variability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18750)
*Ruitao Liu,Xinyang Tian,Shuo Chen,Tingrui Zhang,Guang Yang,Alan Zhao,Wei Xu*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 提出了RRFP，一种就绪驱动的流水线并行运行时。它将调度视为非绑定的提示顺序而非必须遵守的固定序列，优先执行当前就绪的任务，有效解决了因运行时差异导致的流水线气泡问题。在128 GPU的大模型训练中，相比现有系统实现了最高2.77倍的加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代大模型训练负载在计算和通信方面存在运行时差异。现有流水线系统通常使用静态、profiling或自适应生成的调度作为预先提交的执行顺序。当实际任务就绪情况与预提交顺序不一致时，计算阶段即使有其他可执行工作也必须等待未就绪的任务，导致阶段错位、空闲气泡和利用率下降。

Method: 提出了Runtime-Readiness-First Pipeline (RRFP)，一种就绪驱动的流水线并行运行时。RRFP改变了调度在运行时的消费方式：将调度视为对当前就绪工作进行排序的非绑定提示顺序，而不是必须遵守的序列。技术实现包括：(1)消息驱动的异步通信；(2)用于集体一致性的轻量级张量并行协调；(3)用于低开销分发的就绪集仲裁。在基于Megatron的训练框架中实现了RRFP。

Result: 在多达128个GPU的语言模型和模态工作负载上进行评估：(1) 在所有设置下均优于固定顺序流水线基线；(2) 使用BFW提示时，语言工作负载最高加速1.77倍，多模态工作负载最高加速2.77倍；(3) 跨框架比较中，使用默认BF提示的RRFP比现有最快的系统快1.84倍，同时保持训练正确性。

Conclusion: RRFP通过将静态调度转变为就绪驱动的动态调度，有效解决了流水线并行中的运行时差异问题，显著提升了训练利用率和性能，为大模型训练提供了一种高效的调度方案。

Abstract: Pipeline parallelism is a key technique for scaling large-model training, but modern workloads exhibit runtime variability in computation and communication. Existing pipeline systems typically consume static, profiled, or adaptively generated schedules as pre-committed execution orders. When realized task readiness diverges from the pre-committed order, stages may wait for not-yet-ready work even though other executable work is available, creating stage misalignment, idle bubbles, and reduced utilization.
  We present Runtime-Readiness-First Pipeline (RRFP), a readiness-driven runtime for pipeline-parallel training. RRFP changes how schedules are consumed at runtime: instead of treating a schedule as a sequence that stages must wait to follow, it treats the schedule as a non-binding hint order for ranking currently ready work. To support this model, RRFP combines message-driven asynchronous communication, lightweight tensor-parallel coordination for collective consistency, and ready-set arbitration for low-overhead dispatch.
  We implement RRFP in a Megatron-based training framework and evaluate it on language-only and multimodal workloads at up to 128 GPUs. RRFP improves over fixed-order pipeline baselines across all settings. Using the BFW hint, RRFP achieves up to 1.77$\times$ speedup on language-only workloads and up to 2.77$\times$ on multimodal workloads. In cross-framework comparisons, RRFP with the default BF hint outperforms the faster available external system by up to 1.84$\times$ while preserving training correctness.

</details>


<div id='cs.AR'></div>

# cs.AR [[Back]](#toc)

### [344] [A comprehensive study on ILP acceleration accounting for sparsity, area, energy, data movement using near-memory architecture](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17158)
*Siddhartha Raman Sundara Raman,Lizy K John,Jaydeep P. Kulkarni*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文提出了SPARK，一种近缓存的可重构ILP加速器，通过感知稀疏性和计算重用，在极小的硬件开销下实现了相比CPU和GPU显著的性能提升和能耗降低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 整数线性规划（ILP）在路由和调度等优化问题中应用广泛，但算法具有稀疏性和分支密集的特点，导致在传统CPU和GPU上执行效率低下、能耗高且并行度受限，无法满足时间敏感型应用的需求。

Method: 提出SPARK架构，复用CPU现有的L1缓存作为近缓存加速器，硬件开销仅约1.4%；设计中引入近缓存稀疏检测机制以减少无效计算和数据搬运，并利用ILP算法的计算重用模式提升并行度与效率，同时支持稀疏/稠密ILP及线性规划（LP）。

Result: 在MIPLIB 2017真实负载测试中，针对稀疏ILP，SPARK相比AMD Zen3 CPU和NVIDIA Tesla V100 GPU分别实现了最高15倍和20倍的性能提升，以及最高152倍和740倍的能耗降低；针对稀疏LP，实现了7-17倍的性能提升和103-250倍的能耗降低。

Conclusion: SPARK证明了通过近缓存加速并结合稀疏感知与重用优化，能够以极小的硬件代价有效解决ILP/LP在传统架构上的性能瓶颈，具有广泛的适用性和优越的能效表现。

Abstract: Integer Linear Programming (ILP) is widely used for solving real-world optimization problems, including network routing, map routing, and traffic scheduling. However, ILP algorithms are sparse and branch-intensive, making them inefficient on conventional CPUs and GPUs. Prior work has shown that large-scale ILP problems can require tens of hours of execution time even on massively parallel systems, limiting their applicability to time-sensitive decision-making workloads. Existing ILP solvers such as Gurobi employ software-level optimizations to handle sparsity on CPUs, but still face throughput limitations. GPU-based ILP solvers are also constrained because GPUs are not well suited for sparse and branch-heavy workloads, leading to thread divergence, under-utilization of streaming multiprocessors, and frequent host-device interactions.
  This paper presents SPARK, a sparsity-aware, reuse-aware, energy-efficient, reconfigurable near-cache ILP accelerator. SPARK repurposes the existing L1 cache in CPUs to provide near-cache acceleration with minimal hardware overhead of approximately 1.4\% of the CPU area. The architecture performs near-cache sparsity detection and sparsity-aware computation to reduce insignificant computations and data movement energy. SPARK also exploits computational reuse patterns in ILP algorithms to improve parallelism and efficiency. The proposed design supports both sparse and dense ILPs as well as Linear Programs (LPs).
  Evaluations on real-world workloads from MIPLIB 2017 show that SPARK achieves up to 15x and 20x performance improvement, and up to 152x and 740x energy reduction compared to AMD Zen3 CPUs and NVIDIA Tesla V100 GPUs, respectively, for sparse ILPs. For sparse LPs, SPARK achieves 7-17x performance improvement and 103-250x energy reduction over CPU and GPU baselines, demonstrating the broad applicability of the proposed architecture.

</details>


### [345] [Workload-Aware Early-Stage Power Delivery Network Optimization via Architectural Power Traces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17182)
*Oran Hayes,Maria Pantazi-Kypraiou,Athanasios Tziouvaras,George Stamoulis,Anuj Pathania,Shreejith Shanker,George Floros*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于架构功耗轨迹的早期PDN优化方法，通过捕获工作负载的时间功耗活动并映射为空间功耗密度分布，实现了比传统最坏情况设计减少32.94%的PDN金属面积。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的早期PDN规划依赖于静态或最坏情况功耗假设，这往往导致设计过度配置和布线资源的低效使用。现代多处理器系统需要更精确的功耗建模方法来优化PDN设计。

Method: 该方法利用架构仿真以细粒度捕获时间功耗活动，将其映射为芯片上的空间功耗密度分布，然后将这些分布转换为电流需求曲线，以指导瓦片粒度的PDN拓扑规划，从而在早期设计阶段实现自适应PDN资源分配。

Result: 实验结果表明，该方法在保持符合IR压降和电迁移约束的同时，相比传统最坏情况设计实现了高达32.94%的PDN金属面积减少。

Conclusion: 通过纳入真实的工作负载行为，所提出的工作负载感知方法能够有效优化早期阶段的PDN设计，在保证电压完整性的前提下显著减少资源开销，为现代多处理器系统的PDN规划提供了一种更高效的解决方案。

Abstract: Power Delivery Networks (PDNs) are critical for maintaining voltage integrity in modern multiprocessor systems. Conventional early-stage PDN planning relies on static or worst-case power assumptions, often leading to over-provisioned designs and inefficient use of routing resources. This paper proposes a workload-aware methodology for early-stage PDN optimization based on architectural power traces. Using architectural simulations, temporal power activity is captured at fine granularity and mapped to spatial power density distributions across the chip. These distributions are then translated into current demand profiles to guide PDN topology planning at tile granularity. By incorporating realistic workload behavior, the proposed approach enables adaptive PDN resource allocation during early design stages. Experimental results demonstrate that the method achieves up to 32.94% reduction in PDN metal area compared to conventional worst-case designs, while maintaining compliance with IR drop and electromigration constraints.

</details>


### [346] [VeriCache: Turning Lossy KV Cache into Lossless LLM Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17613)
*Jiayi Yao,Samuel Shen,Kuntai Du,Shaoting Feng,Dongjoo Seo,Rui Zhang,Yuyang Huang,Yuhan Liu,Shan Lu,Junchen Jiang*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出VeriCache框架，通过"压缩KV缓存草拟+全量KV缓存验证"的机制，在保证与大模型全量KV缓存解码输出完全一致的前提下，实现了高达4倍的吞吐量提升，解决了现有KV缓存压缩方法在长上下文生成中存在精度损失的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着大语言模型上下文长度的增加，KV缓存的巨大内存占用已成为服务部署的主要瓶颈。现有的KV缓存压缩方法（如token丢弃和量化）虽然能减少内存占用，但本质上是有损的：在短输出时精度下降尚可接受，但随着解码token数量增加，输出与全量KV缓存输出的偏差会不断累积，导致代码生成和工具调用等任务出现灾难性失败。因此，需要一种既能保持压缩KV缓存的高吞吐量优势，又能保证输出与全量KV缓存完全一致的方法。

Method: 提出VeriCache推理框架，核心思想是利用压缩KV缓存进行草拟（drafting），然后使用全量KV缓存进行验证。关键技术创新包括：(1) 将压缩KV解码与全量KV缓存交换并行化，因为前者受限于HBM带宽，后者受限于PCIe/网络带宽，两者可以互补并行执行；(2) 利用压缩KV缓存通常产生与全量KV缓存相似输出的特性，采用较长的草拟视界来分摊每次全量KV缓存交换的开销。该框架通过统一的压缩器接口支持多种token丢弃和量化方法，并可与传统的推测解码技术组合使用。

Result: 实验结果表明，VeriCache在保证与全量KV缓存推理产生完全相同输出的前提下，相比全量KV推理实现了高达4倍的吞吐量提升。该框架适用于长上下文解码和远程前缀缓存场景，支持广泛的token丢弃和量化方法家族。

Conclusion: VeriCache成功解决了KV缓存压缩方法中精度损失与效率提升之间的矛盾，首次实现了在保证输出正确性的同时获得KV缓存压缩带来的性能优势。该工作为大语言模型的长上下文服务部署提供了一种既高效又可靠的解决方案，具有重要的实用价值。

Abstract: The large size of the KV cache has become a major bottleneck for serving LLMs with increasing context lengths. In response, many KV cache compression methods, such as token dropping and quantization, have been proposed. However, almost all of these methods are inherently lossy-despite minimal accuracy degradation for short outputs, their outputs increasingly diverge from full-KV-cache outputs as more tokens are decoded, which leads to catastrophic failures in code generation and tool calling.
  We present VeriCache, the first inference framework that ensures the same output as full-KV-cache decoding but largely preserves the high decoding throughput of a range of KV cache compression algorithms. VeriCache uses the compressed KV cache to draft tokens, then verifies them against the full KV cache. While it may seem like just speculative decoding, VeriCache requires addressing a key system challenge to work-keeping the full KV cache out of GPU memory and minimizing the overhead of swapping it in for verification. The insight is two-fold: (1) compressed-KV decoding can be parallelized with full-KV swap, because one is HBM-bandwidth-bound and the other is PCIe/network-bound, and (2) the compressed KV cache often produces output similar to the full KV cache, allowing a long drafting horizon to amortize each full-KV swap.
  VeriCache applies to both long-context decoding and remote prefix caching, supports a broad family of token-dropping and quantization methods through a uniform compressor interface, and composes with traditional speculative decoding. Experimental results show that VeriCache achieves up to 4X higher throughput than full-KV inference while producing identical outputs.

</details>


### [347] [μ-ORCA: Optimizing Acceleration for Microsecond-Scale Deep Neural Network Inference on ACAP](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17683)
*Shixin Ji,Jinming Zhuang,Zhuoping Yang,Xingzhen Chen,Wei Zhang,Peipei Zhou*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出了μ-ORCA，一个针对AMD ACAP等异构可重构平台的超低延迟DNN推理加速器框架，通过直接层间通信和开销感知性能模型，在高能物理jet-tagging应用中实现了0.93 μs的推理延迟，满足1 μs的延迟预算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于AMD ACAP等张量核心异构平台的DNN推理框架在处理小规模问题时，由于低效的片上通信和较大的层间延迟，无法满足高能物理jet-tagging应用中1 μs的延迟预算。同时，同步和VLIW处理器序言等硬件开销常被忽视，导致加速器优化不可行。

Method: 提出μ-ORCA框架，采用以下关键技术：1）在AIE阵列上实现DNN层间直接通信，避免使用共享内存或FPGA架构；2）使用512位/周期的级联连接替代32位/周期的DMA连接；3）提供开销感知的性能模型，适应不同神经网络层大小；4）进行设计空间探索以优化端到端延迟；5）支持MLP和DeepSets模型，在AIE上实现包括偏置、ReLU和全局聚合等非矩阵乘法内核。

Result: 在AMD ACAP VEK280平台上评估，μ-ORCA相比不同的最先进ACAP框架平均延迟降低超过1.70倍和1.83倍。对于6层真实DeepSets模型实现了0.93 μs的推理延迟，成功满足1 μs的延迟预算要求。

Conclusion: μ-ORCA成功解决了异构可重构平台上微秒级小规模DNN推理的挑战，通过创新的层间通信机制和开销感知优化，在高能物理等对延迟敏感的应用场景中实现了突破性性能，并已开源。

Abstract: Heterogeneous reconfigurable platforms with tensor cores, such as AMD ACAP, are increasingly adopted for deep neural network (DNN) inference due to their high throughput and flexibility. However, their suitability for microsecond-scale inference on small problem sizes remains underexplored. In jet-tagging applications in high-energy physics, inefficient on-chip communication and large inter-layer latency prevent existing frameworks from meeting the 1-μs latency budget. Moreover, hardware overheads such as synchronization and VLIW processor prologue are often overlooked, making it infeasible to optimize accelerators correctly. To address these problems, we propose μ-ORCA, a customized heterogeneous accelerator framework for ultra-low-latency model inference. μ-ORCA enables direct inter-layer communication between DNN layers on the AIE array, instead of using shared memory tiles or FPGA fabric. Moreover, a 512-bit/cycle cascade connection is applied instead of a 32-bit/cycle DMA connection. μ-ORCA also provides an overhead-aware performance model that adapts to different NN layer sizes, and conducts design space exploration to optimize end-to-end latency. μ-ORCA supports MLP and DeepSets models with non-MM kernels, including bias, ReLU, and global aggregation on AIE. We evaluate μ-ORCA on the AMD ACAP VEK280 platform. Experimental results show that μ-ORCA achieves average latency reduction of >1.70$\times$ and >1.83$\times$ compared with different state-of-the-art ACAP frameworks, and achieves 0.93 μs latency for a 6-layer real-world DeepSets model, satisfying the latency budget. We open source μ-ORCA at https://github.com/arc-research-lab/u-ORCA.

</details>


### [348] [ROA-Based Subharmonic Injection Locking for Oscillator-Based Ising Machines](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17720)
*Nicholas Sica,Baris Taskin*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于旋转行波振荡器阵列（ROA）的片上集成方案，用于在基于振荡器的伊辛机（OIM）中实现稳定的亚谐波注入锁定（SHIL），解决了传统方案在工艺、电压和温度（PVT）变化下性能下降的问题，实现了高准确率与低能耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在基于振荡器的伊辛机（OIM）中实现片上亚谐波注入锁定（SHIL）极具挑战性。SHIL信号的频率必须是OIM节点工作频率的倍数，且片上工艺偏差会影响相位，导致SHIL过程退化。这一问题限制了OIM实现的扩展性，无论其拓扑结构、耦合或图映射机制如何。

Method: 引入片上集成的旋转行波振荡器（RTWO），将其组织成旋转振荡器阵列（ROA）模块作为外部扰动源。该ROA模块拓扑结构能够产生高频信号，从而提供在工艺、电压和温度（PVT）变化下稳定的2.31 GHz SHIL信号。

Result: 在PVT变化条件下，传统的分布式环形振荡器SHIL（ROSC-SHIL）无法执行注入锁定，而提出的ROA-SHIL在324节点最大割问题中保持了93%至97%的求解准确率（与理想SHIL信号准确率相同）。ROA模块的驱动强度和版图规划显示出良好的扩展性，其求解能耗为2.49 nJ。

Conclusion: 所提出的ROA-SHIL方案成功克服了片上PVT变化对SHIL稳定性的影响，显著优于传统ROSC-SHIL方案，在保持高求解精度的同时实现了低能耗，证明了该架构在扩展OIM实现方面的有效性与潜力。

Abstract: This paper introduces on-chip integrated rotary traveling wave oscillators (RTWOs) organized into rotary oscillator array (ROA) bricks as an external perturbation to induce subharmonic injection locking (SHIL) in oscillator-based Ising machines (OIMs). The implementation of SHILs on chip is challenging, as the frequency of SHILs must be multiples of the operating frequency of the OIM nodes, with on-chip variations affecting the phase, degrading the SHIL process. This impedes the scaling of OIM implementations, regardless of the topology of Ising nodes, coupling or graph mapping mechanisms. The ROA brick topology implementation of RTWOs generates high frequency signals that are shown to provide a stable 2.31 GHz SHIL signal under process, voltage, and temperature (PVT) variations. Under PVT variations, distributed ring oscillator-based SHILs (ROSC-SHIL) fail to perform injection locking while the proposed ROA brick-based SHIL (ROA-SHIL) preserve 93% to 97% accuracy (the same accuracy of an ideal SHIL signal) in the OIM solutions of a sample 324-node max-cut problem. The driving strength and floorplan of the ROA brick are also shown to be amenable for scaling with an energy-to-solution impact of 2.49 nJ for the proposed ROA-SHIL.

</details>


### [349] [CPPL: A Circuit Prompt Programming Language](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17892)
*Shuo Yin,Yihe Wang,Lancheng Zou,Xufeng Yao,Tinghuan Chen,Chen Bai,Zhengrong Wang,Tsung-Yi Ho,Bei Yu*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文提出CPPL框架，通过编译器中介的方式，将LLM辅助硬件生成转化为静态可检查的前端问题，结合Python前端DSL和JSON格式中间表示，提高了硬件设计的正确性和可优化性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型在RTL设计自动化中具有潜力，但直接生成RTL代码难以验证、优化和与编译器流程集成。现有LLM难以直接生成编译器中间表示（如MLIR），因为需要处理复杂的语法、SSA形式、特定操作和严格位宽约束。

Method: 提出CPPL编译器中介设计框架，包含：(1) Python前端DSL用于声明模块接口和层次结构；(2) CPPL IR，一种基于JSON的电路中间表示，既暴露编译器可见结构又便于LLM生成。编译器从声明的模块端口推断操作位宽，验证生成的IR，检查层次结构和端口绑定，并确定性降低到CIRCT以生成可综合的Verilog。

Result: 在RTLLM基准测试中，CPPL相比直接生成Verilog和直接生成CIRCT IR提高了功能正确性；同时CIRCT优化减少了综合后的AIG节点数量。

Conclusion: 编译器中介接口可以使LLM辅助硬件设计更加可靠、可分析，并更易于后端优化，为硬件设计自动化提供了一个可行的解决方案。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in register-transfer level (RTL) design automation, but direct RTL generation remains difficult to validate, optimize, and integrate with compiler-based hardware design flows. Hardware compiler infrastructures such as CIRCT provide typed intermediate representations, legality checks, and optimization passes, yet current LLMs struggle to emit raw compiler IR because of MLIR syntax, SSA discipline, dialect-specific operations, and strict width constraints. This paper presents CPPL, a compiler-mediated design framework that turns LLM-assisted hardware generation into a statically checkable frontend problem rather than an unconstrained RTL text-generation task. CPPL combines a Python frontend DSL for declaring module interfaces and hierarchy with CPPL IR, a JSON-based circuit IR designed to expose compiler-visible structure while remaining accessible to LLMs. The compiler infers operation widths from declared module ports, validates generated IR, checks hierarchy and port bindings, and deterministically lowers the result to CIRCT for synthesizable Verilog generation. On the RTLLM benchmark, CPPL improves functional correctness over direct Verilog and direct CIRCT IR generation, while CIRCT optimization reduces post-synthesis AIG node counts. These results show that a compiler-mediated interface can make LLM-assisted hardware design more reliable, analyzable, and amenable to backend optimization. CPPL is available at https://github.com/SawyDust1228/CPPL.

</details>


### [350] [Building Reliable Arithmetic Multipliers Under NBTI Aging and Process Variations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18444)
*Masoud Heidary,Biresh Kumar Joardar*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出一种利用乘法符号不变性的硬件老化缓解技术，通过选择性应用补码转换重分配晶体管应力，有效延长算术乘法器（包括AI加速器中的脉动阵列）的寿命，且开销极低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 硬件老化（特别是负偏置温度不稳定性NBTI）严重影响集成电路的性能和寿命。算术乘法器作为CPU、GPU、FPGA以及AI加速器（如脉动阵列）的核心组件，在主要依赖乘法运算的AI工作负载下，老化效应会被加速，亟需有效的缓解方案。

Method: 利用乘法运算的符号不变性属性，提出一种新颖的老化缓解技术。该方法通过选择性地对输入应用二进制补码转换，在不改变计算结果的前提下，重新分配晶体管承受的应力，从而减轻NBTI老化效应。该技术被集成到脉动阵列AI加速器中以验证其在高吞吐量场景下的有效性。

Result: 使用Cadence工具进行的实验评估表明，与无缓解措施的基准相比，该方法显著延长了器件寿命。同时，引入的面积和延迟开销可忽略不计。

Conclusion: 该研究验证了利用算术特性进行硬件老化缓解的可行性，为AI加速器及其他高性能计算系统提供了一种低开销、高效率的电路级可靠性提升方案。

Abstract: Hardware aging poses a significant challenge for integrated circuits (ICs), leading to performance degradation and eventual failure. In this work, we focus on the aging of arithmetic multipliers, which are a cornerstone of modern computing systems including in CPUs, GPUs, and FPGAs, as well as AI accelerators like systolic arrays. In particular, AI workloads, which rely predominantly on multiplications, can accelerate Negative Bias Temperature Instability (NBTI) effects in multipliers. This paper presents a novel aging mitigation technique that leverages the signinvariance property of multiplication. By selectively applying 2s complement transformations to inputs, the method redistributes stress across transistors, reducing the effects of NBTI aging. The proposed method is also integrated into systolic arrays, a common AI accelerator, to demonstrate its efficiency in a high-throughput AI accelerator. Experimental evaluations using Cadence tools show better lifetime compared to natural aging (with no mitigation) baseline, while introducing negligible area and delay overheads.

</details>


### [351] [Predictive Software Scheduling as an Early-Warning Hint Layer for Optical Engine Thermal Drift in Heterogeneous SoIC Packaging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18612)
*Chi Fei Chung*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: TSMC的COUPE架构在A16/2nm节点集成光电共封装时面临关键的热光耦合挑战，微环谐振器对温度极度敏感，仅±1.7nm的谐振波长偏差就会导致BER性能下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着半导体工艺缩放推进至A16/2nm节点，通过TSMC的COUPE架构集成光电共封装技术成为趋势，但引入了关键的热光耦合挑战需要解决。

Method: 研究了集成在光子集成电路(PIC)层中的微环谐振器对温度变化的敏感性，分析谐振波长偏差与误码率(BER)退化之间的关系。

Result: 发现微环谐振器对温度极其敏感，仅±1.7nm的谐振波长偏差就会导致可测量的误码率(BER)性能退化。

Conclusion: 在A16/2nm节点的光电共封装集成中，热光耦合是关键挑战，微环谐振器的温度敏感性要求精确的热管理以确保系统性能。

Abstract: As semiconductor scaling reaches the A16 / 2 nm node, the integration of co-packaged optics (CPO) via TSMC's Co-Packaged Optics Ultra Engine (COUPE) architecture introduces critical thermal-optical coupling challenges. Micro-ring resonators embedded in the Photonic Integrated Circuit (PIC) layer are exquisitely sensitive to temperature: a deviation of merely +-1.7 nm in resonant wavelength causes measurable Bit Error Rate (BER) degradation.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [352] [Skim: Speculative Execution for Fast and Efficient Web Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16565)
*Mike Wong,Kevin Hsieh,Suman Nath,Ravi Netravali*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Skim是一个面向Web代理的推测执行框架，通过利用网站的稳定结构模式，使大部分查询绕过重量级组件，在无精度损失的前提下将中位任务成本降低1.9倍、延迟降低33.4%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前Web代理的推理成本过高，问题并非源于任务本身，而是代理的构建方式：前沿模型推理、浏览器渲染和ReAct式规划被应用于每个任务的每一步，无论任务复杂度如何。

Method: Skim利用网站具有稳定URL模式、答案格式和任务-轨迹映射的特性。离线分析器捕获每站点一次这些模式；运行时将查询匹配模板、合成目标URL并用小模型提取答案；轻量验证器检验输出，失败时回退至完整代理并利用快速路径的最终URL热启动。

Result: 在标准Web代理基准上，结合三种骨干代理（WebVoyager、AgentOccam、BrowserUse），Skim将中位每任务成本降低1.9倍、延迟降低33.4%，且无精度损失。

Conclusion: Skim证明了利用网站可预测结构进行推测执行的可行性，能够显著降低Web代理的计算开销与时延，同时保持任务准确性。

Abstract: Skim is a speculative execution framework for web agents that exploits the predictable structure of purpose-built websites. Today's web-agent expense is not intrinsic to the tasks but a property of how agents are composed: frontier-model inference, browser rendering, and ReAct-style planning are applied to every step of every task regardless of complexity. Skim's key observation is that websites enforce stable URL patterns, answer formats, and task-to-trajectory mappings across queries of the same type, so most queries can bypass these heavyweight components entirely. An offline profiler captures these patterns once per site. At runtime, Skim matches each query to a template, synthesizes the destination URL, and extracts the answer with a small model. A lightweight verifier gates each fast-path output against the query and schema; rare misspeculations cascade to the full agent, warm-started by the fast path's final URL to preserve upstream trajectory progress. Across standard web-agent benchmarks paired with three backboneagents (WebVoyager, AgentOccam, BrowserUse), Skim reduces median per-task cost by 1.9x and latency by 33.4% with no accuracy loss.

</details>


### [353] [AgentWall: A Runtime Safety Layer for Local AI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16265)
*Ashwin Aravind*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出AgentWall，一个面向本地AI智能体的运行时安全与可观测层，通过在动作执行前拦截、评估和审批来保障安全，实现了92.9%的策略执行准确率和亚毫秒级开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着AI智能体从被动文本生成器转变为能够执行shell命令、修改文件、调用API和浏览网页的主动行动者，不安全或对抗性操纵行为的后果变得直接且实际。现有的AI安全工作主要集中在模型对齐和输入过滤，但这些方法并未解决智能体意图转化为实际机器动作时的安全问题，尤其在本地环境中开发者对自身文件系统、凭据和基础设施的运行时控制不足。

Method: 引入AgentWall作为运行时安全与可观测层，在每个智能体动作到达主机环境前进行拦截，根据显式声明策略进行评估，对敏感操作要求人工审批，并记录完整执行轨迹以供审计和回放。实现方式包括策略执行的MCP代理和原生OpenClaw插件，支持Claude Desktop、Cursor、Windsurf、Claude Code和OpenClaw等平台，通过单一安装命令即可部署。

Result: 在14项基准测试中实现了92.9%的策略执行准确率，开销为亚毫秒级别。AgentWall已作为开源项目发布。

Conclusion: AgentWall为本地AI智能体提供了一个有效的运行时安全解决方案，填补了现有AI安全方法在动作执行时刻安全控制方面的空白，具有良好的策略执行准确性和低性能开销。

Abstract: The safety of autonomous AI agents is increasingly recognized as a critical open problem. As agents transition from passive text generators to active actors capable of executing shell commands, modifying files, calling APIs, and browsing the web, the consequences of unsafe or adversarially manipulated behavior become immediate and tangible. Existing AI safety work has focused primarily on model alignment and input filtering, but these approaches do not address what happens at the moment an agent's intent becomes a real action on a real machine. This gap is especially acute in local environments, where developers run agents against their own filesystems, credentials, and infrastructure with little runtime control. This paper introduces AgentWall, a runtime safety and observability layer for local AI agents. AgentWall intercepts every proposed agent action before it reaches the host environment, evaluates it against an explicit declarative policy, requires human approval for sensitive operations, and records a complete execution trail for audit and replay. It is implemented as a policy-enforcing MCP proxy and native OpenClaw plugin, working across Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, Claude Code, and OpenClaw with a single install command. We present the design, architecture, threat model, and policy model of AgentWall, and demonstrate 92.9% policy enforcement accuracy with sub-millisecond overhead across 14 benchmark tests. AgentWall is open-source at https://github.com/agentwall/Agentwall.

</details>


### [354] [ANNEAL: Adapting LLM Agents via Governed Symbolic Patch Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16309)
*Safayat Bin Hakim,Keyan Guo,Wenkai Tan,Alvaro Velasquez,Shouhuai Xu,Houbing Herbert Song*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出ANNEAL，一种神经符号智能体，通过治理化的符号编辑直接修复过程知识图谱，实现了在重复故障场景下0%的失败率，显著优于现有基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多数大语言模型（LLM）智能体虽能从单次执行错误中恢复，但在过程知识（如操作模式、前置条件和约束）未修复时，仍会在相同故障上重复失败。现有自我进化方法主要更新提示、记忆或模型权重，但均未直接修复编码任务执行方式的符号结构，且缺乏安全部署所需的治理保障。

Method: 引入ANNEAL系统，采用失败驱动知识获取（FDKA）机制。该方法将重复失败转化为对过程知识图谱的治理化符号编辑，无需修改基础模型权重。FDKA定位责任操作符，通过约束LLM生成合成类型化补丁，并经由多维评分、符号护栏和金丝雀测试验证后提交。每个接受的编辑均具备完整溯源和确定性回滚能力。

Result: 在四个领域和27次多种子运行中，ANNEAL是唯一能提交持久性结构修复的系统。强基线方法（如ReAct和Reflexion）在重复故障上的保留失败率为72-100%，而ANNEAL在测试的重复失败场景中将该比率降至0%。消融实验表明，移除FDKA会导致所有结构修复消失，成功率下降高达26.7个百分点。

Conclusion: 治理化的符号修复为持久性故障消除提供了一种与权重级和提示级适应互补的新范式，证明了直接修复符号结构在提升系统鲁棒性和可靠性方面的有效性。

Abstract: LLM-based agents can recover from individual execution errors, yet they repeatedly fail on the same fault when the underlying process knowledge--operator schemas, preconditions, and constraints--remains unrepaired. Existing self-evolving approaches address this gap by updating prompts, memory, or model weights, but none directly repair the symbolic structures that encode how tasks are executed, and few provide the governance guarantees required for safe deployment. We introduce ANNEAL, a neuro-symbolic agent that converts recurring failures into governed symbolic edits of a process knowledge graph without modifying foundation model weights. Its core mechanism, Failure-Driven Knowledge Acquisition (FDKA), localizes the responsible operator, synthesizes a typed patch through constrained LLM generation, and validates the proposal via multi-dimensional scoring, symbolic guardrails, and canary testing before commit. Every accepted edit carries full provenance and deterministic rollback capability. Across four domains and 27 multi-seed runs, ANNEAL is the only evaluated system that commits persistent structural repairs--strong baselines such as ReAct and Reflexion achieve high episodic recovery yet retain 72-100% holdout failure rates on recurring faults, whereas ANNEAL reduces these to 0% in the tested recurring-failure settings. Ablation confirms that removing FDKA eliminates all structural repairs and drops success rate by up to 26.7 percentage points. These results suggest that governed symbolic repair offers a complementary paradigm to weight-level and prompt-level adaptation for persistent fault elimination.

</details>


### [355] [From Prompts to Protocols: An AI Agent for Laboratory Automation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16552)
*Angelos Angelopoulos,James F. Cahoon,Ron Alterovitz*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个集成大语言模型的AI智能体架构，使科学家能够通过自然语言交互式地创建和监控自动化实验室协议，首次尝试协议生成成功率达97%，界面操作需求减少一个数量级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动化科学实验室能够加速新材料、药物等的发现与测试，但构建和运行自主实验室需要协调大量仪器和机器人，迫使科学家编写代码、管理配置文件并处理复杂的软件基础设施，门槛较高。

Method: 提出了一个将大语言模型与实验室编排相结合的AI智能体架构，集成到实验编排系统(EOS)中。该智能体在具有自动验证和错误纠正功能的智能循环下运行，支持完整的实验生命周期：创建协议、运行和监控协议及闭环优化活动、分析结果。同时配备可视化图形编辑器，将协议渲染为交互式节点图，与AI智能体的协议表示同步。

Result: 在跨越化学、生物学和材料科学的三个模拟自动化实验室上进行评估，AI智能体实现了97%的首次尝试协议生成成功率，所需界面操作减少了一个数量级。

Conclusion: 该AI智能体架构成功降低了自动化实验室的使用门槛，使科学家能够通过自然语言高效地创建和管理实验协议，显著提高了实验室自动化的可访问性和效率。

Abstract: Automating science laboratories enables faster, safer, more accurate, and more reproducible execution of protocols, accelerating the discovery and testing of new materials, drugs, and more. However, setting up and running autonomous labs requires coordinating numerous instruments and robots, forcing scientists to write code, manage configuration files, and navigate complex software infrastructure. We present an AI agent architecture that integrates large language models with laboratory orchestration, enabling scientists to interactively create and monitor automated lab protocols using natural language. Integrated into the Experiment Orchestration System (EOS), the AI agent operates under an agentic loop with automated validation and error correction, and supports the complete experimental lifecycle: creating protocols, running and monitoring both protocols and closed-loop optimization campaigns, and analyzing results. A visual graph editor renders protocols as interactive node-based diagrams synchronized with the AI agent's protocol representation, enabling seamless alternation between AI-assisted and manual protocol construction. Evaluated on three simulated automated labs spanning chemistry, biology, and materials science, the AI agent achieves a 97% first-attempt protocol generation success rate and an order of magnitude reduction in required interface actions.

</details>


### [356] [Scalable Uncertainty Reasoning in Knowledge Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16568)
*Jingcheng Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种模块化框架，通过代数、逻辑和几何方法解决知识图谱中三个层次的固有不确定性问题（属性值不精确、三元组存在概率性、模式知识不完整），在保持语义精度的同时实现计算的可处理性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实世界的数据本质上具有不确定性，这种不确定性在知识图谱中表现为三个层次：不精确的属性值、概率性的三元组存在以及不完整的模式知识。然而，现有的语义网标准缺乏对不确定性推理的原生支持，而简单的扩展往往会导致计算上的难处理性。

Method: 作者提出了一个模块化框架，针对三个层次的不确定性采用定制化技术：(1) 定义概率字面量及相应的查询代数，用于处理连续属性；(2) 基于编译的框架，将SPARQL溯源转换为可处理的概率电路，用于处理不确定三元组；(3) 拓扑感知的几何嵌入，用于统计模式推理。核心思想是利用专门的推理机制（代数、逻辑和几何方法）来调和语义精度与计算可处理性。

Result: 本论文构建了一个完整的模块化框架，成功地将代数方法（针对属性值）、逻辑方法（针对三元组）和几何方法（针对模式）应用于知识图谱不确定性推理的不同层次。

Conclusion: 研究表明，通过针对不同层次的不确定性采用特定的推理机制（代数、逻辑和几何方法），可以在保持语义精度的同时实现计算的可处理性，从而有效解决了现有语义网标准缺乏原生不确定性支持的问题。

Abstract: Knowledge Graphs are pivotal for semantic data integration. The real-world data they model is often inherently uncertain. Within knowledge graphs, uncertainty manifests in three distinct levels: imprecise attribute values, probabilistic triple existence, and incomplete schema knowledge. However, current Semantic Web standards lack native support for reasoning over such uncertainty, and naïve extensions often incur computational intractability. In this thesis, I aim to develop a modular framework that addresses each level through tailored techniques: (1) defining probabilistic literals and a corresponding query algebra for continuous attributes; (2) a compilation-based framework transforming SPARQL provenance into tractable probabilistic circuits for uncertain triples; and (3) topology-aware geometric embeddings for statistical schema reasoning. The central hypothesis is that specialized reasoning mechanisms, namely algebraic, logical, and geometric approaches, can reconcile semantic precision with computational tractability.

</details>


### [357] [Counterparty Modeling is Not Strategy: The Limits of LLM Negotiators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16575)
*Romain Cosentino,Sarath Shekkizhar,Adam Earle,Silvio Savarese*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究发现大型语言模型（LLM）代理能够准确推断谈判对手的偏好，但无法可靠地将此知识转化为战略性谈判优势。最终协议受初始报价锚定效应影响较大，而非实际的效用权重。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 谈判不仅需要推断对方意图，更需要利用该信息在多轮博弈中进行战略性报价与还价。本文旨在探究当前LLM代理在多属性谈判环境中是否具备这种战略性推理能力。

Method: 在受控的多属性谈判环境中评估LLM代理，分析其推理轨迹、轮次行为及最终结果。实验包含对称与不对称信息条件，并测试了要求代理显式陈述“让步-互惠”交易这一干预措施。

Result: LLM代理能准确建模对手偏好，但这并未可靠地转化为己方收益。它们常回应对手重视的议题，却未能同步争取自身高价值属性。在信息不对称时，知情方往往做出补偿不足的让步，导致最终协议更多受初始锚点驱动而非效用权重。显式陈述让步交易的干预虽使单轮行为看似更具策略性，但未能提升最终协议效率。

Conclusion: 当前LLM代理缺乏利用效用结构获取战略优势的能力，其谈判行为存在系统性缺陷（如过度迁就、补偿性让步不足），使其难以实现高效的谈判结果。

Abstract: Negotiation requires more than inferring what the other side wants: it requires using that information to make advantageous offers and counteroffers over multiple turns. We study whether large language model (LLM) agents do this in a controlled multi-attribute bargaining environment. We find that current LLM agents can model a counterparty's preferences, but do not reliably turn that knowledge into strategic bargaining. When given negotiating partner preference information, agents model it accurately and early in their reasoning traces, yet this does not reliably improve outcomes for the informed side. Turn-level analyses show why: agents often respond to what they believe the counterparty values, but do not consistently pair those moves with gains on their own high-value attributes. Sellers are more accommodating overall, and in asymmetric-information conditions, the informed side often makes the more weakly compensated concessions. Because agents fail to leverage this underlying utility structure for strategic advantage, their final agreements are heavily dictated by surface-level opening anchors rather than actual utility weights. Finally, requiring agents to explicitly state concession-for-reciprocity trades before making an offer makes individual turns look more strategic, but ultimately fails to improve the efficiency of the final agreements.

</details>


### [358] [PRISMat: Policy-Driven, Permutation-Invariant Autoregressive Material Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16612)
*Claire Schlesinger,Circe Hsu,Peter Schindler,Robin Walters*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了PRISMat模型，一种轻量级、置换不变的生成模型，在生成具有特定表面性质的晶体表面任务上超越了大型语言模型（LLM），同时显著降低了计算成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有用于材料筛选的机器学习方法（尤其是大型语言模型）参数量巨大、训练和推理计算成本高昂，难以满足高通量材料发现的需求。因此，亟需一种既高效又准确的替代方案。

Method: 提出了PRISMat（一种成本效益高且具有置换不变性的模型）。该模型旨在解决LLM过度参数化以及将材料生成构建为序列学习难题的问题，从而实现高效的推理。

Result: 在基于关键表面性质生成晶体表面的任务中，PRISMat在推理速度更快的情况下性能优于LLM。在特定的材料发现任务（解理能和功函数）中，其平均绝对误差分别达到0.188 eV/A²和2.79 eV，将误差相较于次优模型降低了4倍。

Conclusion: PRISMat证明了通过设计专门的、轻量级的模型结构（如置换不变性），可以在材料生成任务中取代昂贵的LLM，实现更高精度和更高效的材料筛选。

Abstract: Rapid identification of candidate materials with target properties has become a key task in materials science. Machine learning has emerged as an alternative to physics-based simulation, offering a faster and cheaper way to filter materials based on their stability and other target properties, reducing the number of candidates that reach the costly synthesis stage. Recently, Large Language Models (LLMs) have been applied to this role, but these models are parameter-heavy and computationally expensive both during training and at inference time, making them unsuitable for high-throughput tasks. This inefficiency stems from both the large over-parameterization of language models and the difficulty of framing material generation as a sequence learning problem. In this paper, we present PRISMat, a cost-effective, permutation-invariant model, which addresses these limitations. We show that PRISMat, despite taking less time for inference, is able to outperform LLMs in generating crystal slabs conditioned on critical materials' surface properties. In targeted material discovery, we achieve mean absolute errors of 0.188 eV/A$^2$ and 2.79 eV for cleavage energy and work function tasks, respectively, reducing the error of the next best model by 4$\times$.

</details>


### [359] [TTE-Flash: Accelerating Reasoning-based Multimodal Representations via Think-Then-Embed Tokens](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16638)
*Jianpeng Cheng,Xian Wu,Jiangfan Zhang,Wentao Bao,Chaitanya Ahuja,Shlok Kumar Mishra,Hanchao Yu,Yang Gao,Fan Xia,Qi Guo,Shaodan Zhai,Xiangjun Fan,Jun Xiao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出用隐式思考令牌替代显式思维链，在保持恒定推理成本的同时提升了通用多模态嵌入的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于显式思维链推理的通用多模态嵌入方法虽然有效，但生成显式推理轨迹的计算开销过高，限制了其实际应用。

Method: 提出隐式思考令牌作为潜变量替代显式思维链，使用思维链生成损失优化思考令牌，使用对比损失优化后续嵌入令牌，并研究如何从同一LLM骨干网络提取令牌以及如何将这两个任务作为依赖任务进行训练。

Result: 提出的TTE-Flash-2B模型在MMEB-v2基准测试上超越了显式思维链对应模型，同时在15个视频数据集上的零样本评估显示了随思考令牌数量增加的扩展行为，生成的隐式思考令牌在文本和视觉上均可解释。

Conclusion: 隐式思考令牌能够有效替代显式思维链推理，在降低计算成本的同时提升多模态表示性能，为自适应思考预算分配提供了研究基础。

Abstract: Recent research has demonstrated that Universal Multimodal Embedding (UME) benefits significantly from Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning. In this paradigm, a generative model produces explicit reasoning traces for a multimodal query, with the final representation extracted from an <eos> embedding token attending to both the query and the reasoning. Despite its effectiveness, the computational overhead of generating explicit CoT traces is often prohibitive. In this work, we propose replacing explicit CoT with latent think tokens, which are interpreted as latent variables that can produce explicit CoT traces as observed variables. By optimizing think tokens using CoT generation loss and subsequent embedding tokens using contrastive loss, we produce high-performance, reasoning-aware representations at a constant inference cost. Our study investigates two key architectural designs: 1) how think and embeddings tokens should be extracted from the same LLM backbone. 2) how the tokens should be trained as two dependent tasks. We introduce TTE-Flash-2B, a reasoning-aware multimodal representation model that outperforms its explicit-CoT counterpart on the MMEB-v2 benchmark, while producing latent think tokens that are interpretable both textually and visually. Furthermore, zero-shot evaluation across 15 video datasets reveals scaling behavior as the number of think tokens increases, and motivating a pilot study of adaptive think budget allocation based on task requirements.

</details>


### [360] [Sustainable Intelligence for the Wild: Democratizing Ecological Monitoring via Knowledge-Adaptive Edge Expert Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16671)
*Jiaxing Li,Hao Fang,Chi Xu,Miao Zhang,Jiangchuan Liu,William I. Atlas,Katrina M. Connors,Mark A. Spoljaric*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种将视觉感知与推理分离的架构，通过结合视觉编码器与动态知识库，实现从模型适应到知识适应的转变，以解决远程部署中资源受限的挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生物多样性快速流失亟需有效监测，但人工调查资源消耗大。现有设备端AI在野外环境中性能受环境变化影响，而依赖云资源的方法需持续上传数据重训模型，不适用于电力和网络受限的远程部署。

Method: 提出一种将视觉感知与推理分离的架构，结合视觉编码器与动态知识库。使用显式知识库替代将专家知识隐式编码到模型参数中，并通过与生物学家和原住民社区的跨学科合作进行AI协同开发。

Result: 该方法支持知识可持续性，以结构化形式保留专家见解，适用于资源受限的远程部署环境，避免了依赖云资源的持续数据上传和模型重训练。

Conclusion: 本工作通过跨学科合作推动了伦理AI协同开发，促进了负责任且具有文化意识的生态系统管理，为远程环境下的生物多样性监测提供了可行的解决方案。

Abstract: Rapid biodiversity loss underscore the urgency of effective monitoring, yet manual surveys remain resource-intensive. While on-device AI offers a scalable alternative, its performance in the wild is often challenged by environmental variability. Current methods rely heavily on cloud resource, which requires continuous uploading of field data for model retraining. This approach is unsuitable for remote deployments because it consumes limited power and network connectivity. To address these constraints, this research proposes a shift from model adaptation to knowledge adaptation. We introduce an architecture that separates visual perception from reasoning, combining a visual encoder with a dynamic knowledge base. We uses an explicit knowledge base to replace implicitly encoding expert knowledge into model parameters. This method also supports knowledge sustainability by preserving expert insights in a structured form. Through cross-disciplinary collaboration with biologists and Indigenous communities, this work advances ethical AI co-development, fostering responsible and culturally informed ecosystem management.

</details>


### [361] [LinAlg-Bench: A Forensic Benchmark Revealing Structural Failure Modes in LLM Mathematical Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16675)
*Shradha Agarwal,Deepak Rajbhar,Tariq J*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究提出了LinAlg-Bench基准测试，用于评估大语言模型在结构化线性代数计算中的表现。研究发现模型在处理4x4及以上矩阵时会出现从执行错误向计算放弃（编造回答）的行为转变，表明存在工作记忆限制而非知识缺口。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的大语言模型评估主要关注二元准确率，缺乏对模型数学失败原因的深入分析。研究者希望揭示LLM在数学计算失败时的结构化约束机制，特别是算法类型和矩阵维度如何影响模型的错误模式，从而更好地理解模型的能力边界和认知限制。

Method: 研究者构建了LinAlg-Bench基准，包含9种任务类型和660个经SymPy认证的问题，涵盖3x3、4x4和5x5矩阵的维度梯度，评估了10个前沿大语言模型。除二元准确率外，还引入三阶段自动化取证管道，将1,156个失败案例分类为10种主要错误标签及其细粒度子类型，实现了对6,600个模型输出的全面评估。

Result: 核心发现是存在一个4x4规模的尖锐行为阈值：低于该阈值时，模型失败主要表现为执行错误（符号追踪失败、算术漂移、奇偶性错误）；高于该阈值时，失败转变为计算放弃，模型通过工具角色扮演、约束一致性的虚构和结构化幻觉来编造回答。这种"编造-放弃"转变在所有模型层级和架构中普遍存在，表明这是工作记忆限制而非知识缺口，得到三种仅在4x4和5x5中出现的规模涌现错误类型的支持。此外，解决方案策略的僵化程度几乎是5x5行列式准确率的完美预测因子。

Conclusion: LLM的数学失败并非随机，而是受到算法类型和矩阵维度的结构化约束。研究识别了约束感知的虚构作为一种新的结构化幻觉失效模式，揭示了模型在超出工作记忆容量时会出现系统性的计算放弃行为，而非简单的知识缺乏。这一发现对理解LLM的认知限制具有重要意义。研究者公开了所有数据、模型输出、错误标签和判断管道。

Abstract: We introduce LinAlg-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark evaluating 10 frontier large language models on structured linear algebra computation across a strict dimensional gradient of 3x3, 4x4, and 5x5 matrices. Spanning 9 task types and 660 SymPy-certified problems, the benchmark exhaustively evaluates 6,600 model outputs. Beyond binary accuracy, LinAlg-Bench introduces a three-stage automated forensic pipeline classifying 1,156 failures into ten primary error tags with fine-grained subtypes, revealing that LLM mathematical failure is not random but structurally constrained by algorithm type and matrix dimension. Our central finding is a sharp behavioral threshold at 4x4 scale: below it, models fail through execution errors -- sign tracking failures, arithmetic drift, and parity errors; above it, failure transitions to computational abandonment, with models fabricating responses through tool roleplay, constraint-consistent confabulation, and structured hallucination rather than attempting computation. This fabrication-to-abandonment transition is near-universal across all model tiers and architectures, suggesting a working memory limit rather than a knowledge gap, supported by three scale-emergent error types absent at 3x3 but present at 4x4 and 5x5. We further show that solution strategy rigidity is a near-perfect predictor of 5x5 determinant accuracy, document constraint-aware confabulation as a novel structured hallucination failure mode, and release all data, model outputs, error labels, and judge pipeline publicly.

</details>


### [362] [NeuroMAS: Multi-Agent Systems as Neural Networks with Joint Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16757)
*Haoran Lu,Luyang Fang,Wenxuan Zhong,Ping Ma*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出了NeuroMAS，一种将多智能体语言系统视为可训练神经网络架构的方法，通过强化学习自动学习智能体间的通信与协作，无需预定义角色和工作流，显著优于现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的多智能体语言系统通常依赖于人工设计的工作流，其中智能体被预先分配特定的语义角色，通信协议也是预先指定的，这种设计方式缺乏灵活性和可扩展性。

Method: 将多智能体系统构建为类似神经网络的架构，LLM智能体作为节点，中间文本信号作为边；智能体无预设角色但具备结构感知能力，拓扑结构决定信息流向，通过强化学习训练确定通信、专业化与协调方式。

Result: 实验表明NeuroMAS在推理时和训练时的多智能体基线上均有显著提升；发现组织扩展具有路径依赖性，大型系统难以从头训练，但从较小的已训练系统逐步扩展则变得可行。

Conclusion: 从工作流工程转向架构设计（深度、宽度、连通性和增长协议）是多智能体系统可扩展性的新方向，理论分析表明模块化文本计算在分层任务中更高效，学习的神经多智能体系统是LLM扩展的有前景方向。

Abstract: Multi-agent language systems are often built as hand-designed workflows, where agents are assigned semantic roles and communication protocols are specified in advance. We propose NeuroMAS, a method that first treats a multi-agent language system as a trainable and scalable neural-network-like architecture with LLM agents as nodes and intermediate textual signals as edges. In NeuroMAS, agent nodes are role-free but structure-aware: the topology only determines how information can flow in general, while reinforcement learning training determines how nodes communicate, specialize, and coordinate. This formulation shifts multi-agent design from workflow engineering toward architecture design, where depth, width, connectivity, and growth protocol become scalable sources of capability. Further, we provide a theoretical perspective showing why such modular textual computation is more parameter-efficient when tasks admit hierarchical decompositions. Experiments show that NeuroMAS improves significantly over both inference-time and trained multi-agent baselines. We further find that organizational scaling is path-dependent: larger systems can be challenging to train from scratch, but become feasible when grown progressively from smaller trained systems. These results suggest that learned neural multi-agent systems are a promising scaling axis for LLMs.

</details>


### [363] [Enhancing Metacognitive AI: Knowledge-Graph Population with Graph-Theoretic LLM Enrichment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16676)
*Deniz Askin,Gal Hadar,Brendan Conway-Smith*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出了MetaKGEnrich自动化流程，通过构建知识图谱、识别知识稀疏区域、生成问题并检索网络证据，成功赋予LLM自我修复知识的能力，在三个主流数据集上答案质量提升超80%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代AI系统缺乏元认知能力，即无法像人类一样监测自身知识状态、发现知识盲区并自主填补，这限制了AI在知识密集型任务中的表现。

Method: 提出MetaKGEnrich流程，包含五个步骤：(1)基于种子查询构建知识图谱；(2)使用七种图拓扑指标检测知识稀疏区域；(3)利用GPT-4o针对稀疏区域生成问题；(4)使用Tavily检索网络证据并存入Neo4j图数据库；(5)通过GraphRAG重新回答问题并评估改进效果。

Result: 在Google Research Natural Questions、MS MARCO和HotpotQA三个数据集上（各30个查询）进行测试，答案质量提升比例分别为87%、83%和80%，同时保留了原有的高质量知识区域。

Conclusion: 该研究证明了结合拓扑自诊断与定向检索可以赋予AI类似人类的元认知学习能力，为构建具有自主知识修复能力的AI系统提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Metacognition-the ability to monitor one's own knowledge state, spot gaps, and autonomously fill them--remains largely absent from modern AI. Here, we present MetaKGEnrich, a fully automated pipeline that endows large language model (LLM) applications with self-directed knowledge repair. The system (i) builds knowledge graphs from a seed query, (ii) detects sparse regions via seven graph metrics, (iii) has GPT-4o generate targeted questions, (iv) retrieves web evidence with Tavily and ingests it into Neo4j, and (v) re-answers the query with GraphRAG for GPT-4 to evaluate improvement. Tested on 30 queries from each of three widely-used datasets: Google Research Natural Questions, MS MARCO, and Hot-potQA. MetaKGEnrich improved answer quality in 80% of HotpotQA questions, 87% of Google Research Natural Questions and 83% of MS MARCO questions, while preserving well-supported regions. This proof of concept demonstrates how topological self-diagnosis plus targeted retrieval can advance AI toward humanlike metacognitive learning.

</details>


### [364] [Reliability and Effectiveness of Autonomous AI Agents in Supply Chain Management](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17036)
*Carol Xuan Long,David Simchi-Levi,Feng Zhu,Huangyuan Su,Andre P. Calmon,Flavio P. Calmon*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究了自主生成式AI智能体在多级供应链中的表现，发现推理模型可超越人类水平并降低67%成本，但存在可靠性风险；提出了"智能体牛鞭效应"概念，并开发GRPO强化学习后训练框架来解决此问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究自主生成式AI智能体在多级供应链（以MIT啤酒游戏为例）中的应用潜力与可靠性风险，探索影响AI智能体供应链表现的推理时杠杆因素，识别并解决多智能体系统中决策不可靠性放大的问题。

Method: 基于MIT啤酒游戏进行实验，识别四个推理时杠杆：模型选择、策略与护栏、集中式数据共享、提示工程。建立数学框架分析"智能体牛鞭效应"现象，开发基于GRPO（Group Relative Policy Optimization）的强化学习后训练框架，使用系统级供应链奖励训练共享基础LLM。

Result: 模型能力是主导因素：开箱即用的推理模型超越人类水平性能，优化后的推理模型相比人类团队降低高达67%的成本。但强平均性能掩盖了重大可靠性风险。"智能体牛鞭效应"表现为决策方差在同一时间跨设施间、同一设施跨时间维度上的增加。重复采样无法有效缓解此现象。GRPO后训练显著减少尾部事件、抑制智能体牛鞭效应并提高自主供应链智能体的可靠性。

Conclusion: 虽然生成式AI智能体在供应链管理中展现出超越人类的性能潜力，但多智能体系统固有的协调和信息延迟会导致决策不可靠性在层级间放大（智能体牛鞭效应）。GRPO强化学习后训练框架可有效缓解此问题，提升AI智能体在复杂供应链环境中的可靠性和稳定性。

Abstract: This paper studies autonomous generative AI agents in multi-echelon supply chains using the MIT Beer Game. We identify four inference-time levers that shape performance: model selection, policies and guardrails, centralized data sharing, and prompt engineering. Model capability is the dominant factor: an out-of-the-box reasoning model exceeds human-level performance, and optimized reasoning models reduce costs by up to 67% relative to human teams. However, strong average performance masks substantial reliability risks. We introduce the agent bullwhip effect, the amplification of decision unreliability across echelons, manifesting along two dimensions: decision variance increases both across facilities at the same point in time and within the same facility across time. We develop a mathematical framework showing that this phenomenon is inherent to multi-agent systems that involve coordination and information delays, and we demonstrate that repeated sampling fails to meaningfully reduce it. To address this limitation, we propose a Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)-based reinforcement-learning post-training framework that trains a shared base LLM using system-level supply-chain rewards. GRPO post-training substantially reduces tail events, curtails agent bullwhip, and improves the reliability of autonomous supply-chain agents.

</details>


### [365] [Recall Isn't Enough: Bounding Commitments in Personalized Language Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16712)
*Rui Tang,Yichi Zhang,Xi Chen,Chen Dong,Youwei Yang,Yumeng Shen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出CBEA+LCV框架，通过有界证据激活和字典序承诺验证解决个性化系统中的承诺失败问题，实现了零失败率和显著降低的输入负载，但以牺牲部分记忆召回为代价。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的长上下文和记忆系统将个性化视为召回问题，但在实践中，系统在承诺阶段经常失败：将噪声提示转换为硬约束、丢弃罕见证据、遗忘下游义务或在不具备可行性时仍作答。这些失败发生在召回之后，表明个性化系统的关键瓶颈在于承诺管理而非信息检索。

Method: 提出Contract-Bounded Evidence Activation (CBEA)和Lexicographic Commitment Validation (LCV)框架。CBEA通过类型化覆盖、尾部证据和后果债务激活有界证据集；LCV在生成文本之前验证结构化承诺，将不可行状态路由到修复、弃权或重新签约。该框架关注承诺控制而非通用记忆主导。

Result: 在360个测试固件和三个生成后端上，CBEA+LCV在验证器范围内实现零失败，可用率为0.49-0.60。相比之下，使用相同LCV门的原始和长上下文基线仅在0.003-0.092可用率时达到零失败。影子oracle诊断显示CBEA+LCV召回0.012的未编译可见事实，而原始方法召回0.53。输入负载中位数降低74-75%。

Conclusion: CBEA+LCV提供了一个有界的操作点：明确的承诺控制和中位数输入负载降低74-75%，而非追求通用记忆主导地位。这是一种权衡解决方案，在承诺可靠性方面显著优于基线，但在事实召回方面有所取舍。

Abstract: Long-context and memory systems usually treat personalization as a recall problem. In practice, many failures occur later, when a system commits: it turns noisy hints into hard constraints, drops rare witnesses, forgets downstream obligations, or answers despite infeasibility. We introduce Contract-Bounded Evidence Activation (CBEA) with Lexicographic Commitment Validation (LCV). CBEA activates a bounded evidence set using typed coverage, tail witnesses, and consequence debt; LCV validates structured commitments before prose and routes infeasible states to repair, abstention, or recontract. Across 360 fixtures and three generation backends, CBEA+LCV reaches zero failures within validator scope at 0.49-0.60 availability over attempted runs. Raw and long-context baselines with the same LCV gate reach zero only at 0.003-0.092. A shadow oracle diagnostic marks the limit: CBEA+LCV recalls 0.012 of uncompiled visible facts, while raw recalls 0.53. The result is a bounded operating point: explicit commitment control and 74-75% lower median input payload, not universal memory dominance.

</details>


### [366] [GRID: Graph Representation of Intelligence Data for Security Text Knowledge Graph Construction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16714)
*Liangyi Huang,Zichen Liu,Fei Shao,Shang Ma,Mengshi Zhang,Zihao Chen,Yanfang Ye,Xusheng Xiao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出GRID框架，通过构建任务银行奖励机制，解决了从长篇网络威胁情报构建安全知识图谱的难题，在249篇CTI文章上达到68.53%的Avg F1分数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 安全知识图谱可为安全代理提供可计算的外部记忆，但从长篇网络威胁情报（CTI）构建知识图谱面临两大挑战：大语言模型缺乏落地的安全领域知识，端到端文档到图谱的训练难以用低成本、稳定的奖励信号进行监督。

Method: 提出GRID端到端框架：首先通过图谱提取和知识图谱约束的文本修订创建可追溯的文章-图对齐，构建安全领域监督；然后将文档到图谱学习转化为脚本化任务银行，结合四选多选题和三元组级正则匹配目标，生成比LLM评分更稳定的任务特定奖励；基于此训练两个Qwen3-4B提取器：主任务银行奖励模型和次级端到端奖励模型。

Result: 在来自GRID、CASIE、CTINexus、MalKG和SecureNLP的249篇CTI文章上，任务银行奖励模型达到84.62%源平均精确率、64.91%源平均召回率和68.53% Avg F1，取得最佳源平均召回率和接近顶级的Avg F1，同时具有更低的token使用量和部署成本；端到端奖励模型达到76.91%精确率、53.85%召回率和58.06% Avg F1；任务银行奖励可离线构建并跨训练复用，优于在线端到端LLM评分奖励及其他替代方案。

Conclusion: GRID框架成功解决了CTI知识图谱构建中的监督信号问题，任务银行奖励机制提供了稳定、可复用的监督信号，显著优于传统端到端LLM评分方法，为安全知识图谱自动化构建提供了高效解决方案。

Abstract: Security knowledge graphs can provide computable external memory for security agents, but constructing them from long-form cyber threat intelligence (CTI) remains difficult: LLMs often lack grounded security-domain knowledge, and end-to-end document-to-graph training is hard to supervise with cheap, stable rewards. We present GRID (Graph Representation of Intelligence Data), an end-to-end framework for security text knowledge graph construction. GRID first builds security-domain supervision from CTI articles by creating traceable article-graph alignments through graph extraction and knowledge-graph-conditioned text revision. It then turns document-to-graph learning into a scripted task bank combining four-option multi-select questions with triple-level regex matching targets, yielding more stable task-specific rewards than repeatedly scoring full graph outputs with an LLM judge. Using this supervision pipeline, we train two Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507-based 4B extractors: a primary Task-bank Reward model and a secondary End2End Reward model with LLM-as-judge precision/recall rewards. On 249 CTI articles from GRID, CASIE, CTINexus, MalKG, and SecureNLP, the Task-bank Reward model with the ontology-guided GRID extraction pipeline reaches 84.62% source-averaged precision, 64.91% source-averaged recall, and 68.53% Avg F1, achieving the best source-averaged recall and near-top Avg F1 with lower token usage and deployment cost. The End2End Reward model reaches 76.91% precision, 53.85% recall, and 58.06% Avg F1. Further analyses show that task-bank rewards can be built once offline and reused across later post-training runs, outperforming online End2End LLM-as-judge reward and weaker alternatives such as Choice-only Reward and End2End SFT without RL.

</details>


### [367] [MADP: A Multi-Agent Pipeline for Sustainable Document Processing with Human-in-the-Loop](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17159)
*Diego Gosmar,Giovanni Zenezini*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出了MADP多智能体文档处理架构，结合深度学习与大语言模型，在生产环境中实现了97%的自动化率和98.5%的准确率，同时显著降低了人力成本和环境影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业环境中的文档处理自动化仍是一个关键挑战，传统的人工处理方式不仅劳动密集，而且容易出错，亟需一种高效、准确的自动化解决方案。

Method: 提出了MADP多智能体架构，集成五个专门化智能体（分类器、拆分器、解析器、提取器和验证器），结合人在回路（HITL）机制和一种新颖的带反馈继承的提示微调（PFTFI）方法，通过选择性人工验证来保持准确性。

Result: 在每年10万张发票的生产用例中，FTE需求减少约70%；在实际处理955份文档的生产部署中，全流程自动化率达97.0%，仅3%需要非AI后备方案；在100份文档的分层消融评估中，文档级准确率达98.5%；相比传统人工处理，CO2排放减少69%，能耗减少69%，用水减少63%。

Conclusion: MADP系统通过混合AI+HITL方法成功实现了企业文档处理的高效自动化，在保证高准确率的同时大幅降低了人力成本和环境影响，并提供了多种LLM后端的基准比较，为生产环境部署提供了实用指导。

Abstract: Document processing automation remains a critical challenge in enterprise environments, where traditional manual approaches are labor-intensive and error-prone. We present MADP, a multi-agent architecture that addresses the challenge of automating document processing in enterprise settings by combining deep learning-based classification and parsing with large language model extraction, while maintaining accuracy through selective human validation. Our system integrates five specialized agents--Classificator, Splitter, Parser, Extraction, and Validator--with a Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) mechanism and a novel Prompt Fine Tuning with Feedback Inheritance (PFTFI) approach. The operational analysis on a production use-case scenario of 100,000 invoices per year indicates a potential reduction of Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) requirements by approximately 70%. Production deployment on 955 real-world documents processed through January 2026 achieves a 97.0% full-pipeline automation rate, with only 3% requiring non-AI fallback. Ablation evaluation on a stratified 100-document subset (5 documents per each of 20 supplier/document-type categories) demonstrates that the full MADP configuration with Human-in-the-Loop supervision attains 98.5% document-level accuracy. Additionally, we present a comprehensive sustainability analysis showing that our hybrid AI+HITL approach reduces CO2 emissions by 69%, energy consumption by 69%, and water usage by 63% compared to traditional manual processing. Benchmark comparisons of multiple LLM backends (Granite-Docling, Mistral-Small, DeepSeek-OCR) provide practical insights for deployment in production environments.

</details>


### [368] [Baba in Wonderland: Online Self-Supervised Dynamics Discovery for Executable World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16725)
*SeungWon Seo,DongHeun Han,SeongRae Noh,HyeongYeop Kang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了Alice系统，通过利用失败更新中的冲突信号来解决先验不对齐情况下的可执行世界模型学习问题，在Baba in Wonderland环境中取得了显著效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
